AI.title_translation: 面向资源受限自动驾驶车辆的视觉车道跟随与交通标志识别系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于嵌入式平台的轻量级视觉框架，通过结合高效的车道检测和轻量级CNN模型，在保证实时性的前提下实现了稳定的车道跟踪与交通标志识别。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的嵌入式平台上实现可靠的自动驾驶感知算法具有挑战性，需要开发计算效率高且性能稳定的感知框架。
AI.method: 1. 车道线：采用基于阈值的分割、透视变换和基于直方图的曲率估计；2. 控制：使用基于规则的转向控制器；3. 交通标志：评估了EfficientNet-B0和MobileNetV2两种轻量级卷积神经网络。
AI.result: 系统实现了实时车道跟踪，最大偏移RMSE仅为3.16%。EfficientNet-B0在测试集上达到98.77%的离线准确率，实时部署准确率为90%，优于MobileNetV2。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，该轻量级框架在资源受限的环境下能够实现实时车道跟踪与交通标志识别，其中EfficientNet-B0在准确率上表现更优，而MobileNetV2在推理速度上更具优势，验证了该方案在嵌入式自动驾驶应用中的可行性。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶车辆（AV）依赖实时感知系统来理解道路环境并确保安全导航。然而，由于计算资源有限，在资源受限的嵌入式平台上实现可靠的感知算法仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种轻量级的视觉感知框架，集成了车道检测、车道跟踪和交通标志识别功能，适用于嵌入式自动驾驶车辆。为了在各种光照条件下实现稳健的车道跟踪，采用了计算高效的基于阈值的车道分割方法，结合透视变换和基于直方图的曲率估计。一个基于规则的转向控制器用于生成转向指令以维持车辆稳定导航。对于交通标志识别，使用从车载摄像头捕获的自定义数据集对两种轻量级卷积神经网络（CNN）——EfficientNet-B0和MobileNetV2——进行了评估。实验结果表明，该系统在实现实时性能的同时保持了精确的车道跟踪，最大偏移RMSE仅为3.16%。EfficientNet-B0在测试数据集上实现了98.77%的高离线分类准确率，在实时设备端部署期间实现了90%的准确率，在两种设置下均优于MobileNetV2。然而，MobileNetV2提供了略快的推理速度和更低的计算成本。这些结果突显了轻量级视觉感知流水线在资源受限的自动驾驶应用中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对资源受限自动驾驶车辆的轻量级视觉框架，通过结合高效的车道检测算法与轻量级CNN模型（EfficientNet-B0和MobileNetV2），在实现实时车道跟踪和交通标志识别的同时，有效缓解了嵌入式设备的计算压力。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 资源受限, 车道检测, 交通标志识别, 轻量级CNN
AI.comments: 本文针对资源受限的自动驾驶平台，提出了一种轻量级的视觉感知框架。创新点在于将简单的图像处理技术（用于车道线）与轻量级深度学习模型（用于交通标志识别）相结合，在保证实时性的同时实现了较好的精度，为嵌入式自动驾驶系统的实际部署提供了有效的参考方案。

title: When Policies Cannot Be Retrained: A Unified Closed-Form View of Post-Training Steering in Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) can learn effective policies from fixed datasets, but deployment objectives may change after training, and in many applications the trained actor cannot be retrained because of data, cost, or governance constraints. We study deployment-time adaptation for frozen offline actors using Product-of-Experts (PoE) composition with a goal-conditioned prior. Our main practical finding is graceful degradation rather than universal performance gain: under degraded or random priors, precision-weighted composition remains anchored to the frozen actor, while additive and prior-only adaptation collapse, and a KL-budget selector often recovers a near-oracle operating point. We also make explicit a closed-form identity in the frozen-actor setting: for diagonal-Gaussian actors and priors, PoE with coefficient alpha yields the same deterministic policy as KL-regularized adaptation with beta = alpha / (1 - alpha), with posterior covariances differing only by a global scalar factor. Empirically, across four D4RL environments (3,900 MuJoCo episodes), we observe a 4/5/3 HELP/FROZEN/HURT split. Extending the analysis to six harder cells and two AntMaze diagnostics reveals an actor-competence ceiling: medium-expert remains HURT in all 9 cells at every tested alpha, while AntMaze with a behavior-cloned frozen actor yields zero success for all composition rules. Overall, PoE and KL-regularized adaptation are best viewed as a single actor-anchored safety mechanism for deployment-time steering.

AI.title_translation: 当策略无法重新训练时：离线强化学习中部署后策略调整的统一闭式解视角
AI.tldr: 研究表明，在离线强化学习中，部署时的策略调整（如 PoE）本质上是对原策略的安全锚定，受限于原策略的性能上限，无法实现无条件的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在许多离线强化学习应用中，由于数据、成本或治理约束，训练好的策略无法重新训练，但部署目标可能发生变化，因此需要一种无需重新训练的部署时策略调整机制。
AI.method: 利用专家乘积（PoE）组合与目标条件先验，对冻结的离线策略进行部署时适应；推导了 PoE 与 KL 正则化适应在特定条件下的闭式解等价性；并在 D4RL 环境下进行了大规模实证评估。
AI.result: 研究发现部署时的策略调整通常表现为性能的“优雅退化”而非普遍提升；推导证明了 PoE 与 KL 正则化适应在特定数学形式下是等价的；实证结果表明存在策略能力上限，无法通过简单的组合规则突破原始策略的性能瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: PoE 和 KL 正则化适应本质上是同一类锚定于原始策略的安全机制，由于存在策略能力上限，它们在部署时只能实现有限的性能调整，而非通用的性能提升。
AI.translation: 离线强化学习（RL）可以从固定数据集中学习有效的策略，但部署目标在训练后可能会发生变化，且在许多应用中，由于数据、成本或治理限制，训练好的执行器无法重新训练。我们研究了使用带有目标条件先验的专家乘积（PoE）组合对冻结的离线执行器进行部署时适应。我们的主要实践发现是“优雅退化”而非普遍的性能提升：在退化或随机先验下，精度加权组合仍锚定于冻结的执行器，而加法和仅先验适应会崩溃，KL 预算选择器通常能恢复到接近预言机的操作点。我们还在冻结执行器设置中明确了一个闭式恒等式：对于对角高斯执行器和先验，系数为 alpha 的 PoE 产生的确定性策略与 beta = alpha / (1 - alpha) 的 KL 正则化适应相同，且后验协方差仅差一个全局标量因子。在四个 D4RL 环境（3,900 个 MuJoCo 情节）的实证评估中，我们观察到 4/5/3 的 HELP/FROZEN/HURT 分布。将分析扩展到六个更难的单元和两个 AntMaze 诊断显示了执行器能力上限：中等专家在所有 9 个单元的每个测试 alpha 值下都保持为 HURT，而使用行为克隆冻结执行器的 AntMaze 对所有组合规则的成功率为零。总的来说，PoE 和 KL 正则化适应最好被视为部署时策略转向的单一、锚定于执行器的安全机制。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了在无法重新训练的情况下，如何对离线强化学习策略进行部署时的调整。通过将专家乘积（PoE）与 KL 正则化适应联系起来，作者揭示了这些方法的闭式解等价性，并指出在实际应用中，这些方法更多起到安全锚定的作用，而非显著提升策略性能，且受到原始策略能力的严格限制。
AI.keywords: 离线强化学习, 策略调整, 专家乘积, 部署时适应, 闭式解
AI.comments: 该论文提供了一个深刻的视角，揭示了在离线强化学习中，当无法重新训练模型时，通过专家乘积（PoE）进行策略调整的局限性与本质联系。其最大的贡献在于将复杂的策略调整简化为闭式解，并指出了“专家能力上限”这一关键瓶颈，即性能的提升往往受限于原始策略的质量，而非简单的组合算法。

title: SketchVLM: Vision language models can annotate images to explain thoughts and guide users
summary: When answering questions about images, humans naturally point, label, and draw to explain their reasoning. In contrast, modern vision-language models (VLMs) such as Gemini-3-Pro and GPT-5 only respond with text, which can be difficult for users to verify. We present SketchVLM, a training-free, model-agnostic framework that enables VLMs to produce non-destructive, editable SVG overlays on the input image to visually explain their answers. Across seven benchmarks spanning visual reasoning (maze navigation, ball-drop trajectory prediction, and object counting) and drawing (part labeling, connecting-the-dots, and drawing shapes around objects), SketchVLM improves visual reasoning task accuracy by up to +28.5 percentage points and annotation quality by up to 1.48x relative to image-editing and fine-tuned sketching baselines, while also producing annotations that are more faithful to the model's stated answer. We find that single-turn generation already achieves strong accuracy and annotation quality, and multi-turn generation opens up further opportunities for human-AI collaboration. An interactive demo and code are at https://sketchvlm.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: SketchVLM：视觉语言模型可以通过标注图像来解释思维并引导用户
AI.tldr: SketchVLM 赋予了视觉语言模型在图像上绘制 SVG 标注的能力，无需训练即可提升模型的推理准确性和解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型仅通过文本回答问题，缺乏视觉上的推理轨迹，导致用户难以验证模型的思考过程。
AI.method: 提出了一种训练无关（training-free）且模型无关（model-agnostic）的框架，通过在输入图像上生成可编辑的 SVG 覆盖层来可视化模型的推理过程和标注结果。
AI.result: 在七个视觉推理和绘图基准测试中，SketchVLM 将视觉推理任务的准确率提高了高达 28.5 个百分点，并将标注质量提高了 1.48 倍，且生成的标注与模型文本回答的一致性更高。
AI.conclusion: SketchVLM 通过引入 SVG 覆盖层生成，成功弥补了当前视觉语言模型在可解释性方面的不足，显著提升了模型在视觉推理和标注任务中的表现与可信度。
AI.translation: 在回答有关图像的问题时，人类自然会通过指向、标记和绘图来解释他们的推理过程。相比之下，现代视觉语言模型（VLM）如 Gemini-3-Pro 和 GPT-5 仅能以文本形式回应，这使得用户难以验证其回答。我们提出了 SketchVLM，这是一个训练无关、模型无关的框架，使 VLM 能够在输入图像上生成非破坏性的、可编辑的 SVG 覆盖层，从而直观地解释其答案。在涵盖视觉推理（迷宫导航、轨迹预测、物体计数）和绘图（零件标记、连点成线、物体周围绘制形状）的七个基准测试中，与图像编辑和微调绘图基线相比，SketchVLM 将视觉推理任务的准确率提高了高达 28.5 个百分点，标注质量提高了 1.48 倍，同时生成的标注与模型陈述的答案更加一致。我们发现单轮生成已能实现强大的准确性和标注质量，而多轮生成则为进一步的人机协作开辟了机会。交互式演示和代码见 https://sketchvlm.github.io/。
AI.summary: SketchVLM 是一个旨在提升视觉语言模型（VLM）可解释性的框架。它允许 VLM 在输入图像上生成可编辑的 SVG 覆盖层，从而直观地展示模型的推理轨迹和标注结果，无需额外训练即可应用于现有模型，并显著提升了视觉推理准确度和人机交互质量。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 可解释性, SVG标注, 视觉推理, 人机协作
AI.comments: SketchVLM 的创新之处在于其“训练无关”和“模型无关”的特性，这使得它能够即插即用，无需对大型基础模型进行昂贵的重新训练。通过 SVG 覆盖层实现视觉解释，不仅提高了模型的可解释性，还通过多轮交互增强了人机协作的潜力。该方法的局限性在于其主要依赖于 SVG 格式的生成，对于更复杂的像素级细粒度编辑可能存在局限。

title: Beyond Single-Agent Alignment: Preventing Context-Fragmented Violations in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: We identify and formalize a novel security risk: Context-Fragmented Violations (CFVs) - a class of policy breaches where individual agent actions appear locally safe and reasonable, yet collectively violate organizational policies because critical policy facts are siloed in different departments private contexts. Existing prompt-based alignment mechanisms and monolithic interceptors are poorly matched to violations that span contextual islands. We propose Distributed Sentinel, a distributed zero-trust enforcement architecture that introduces the Semantic Taint Token (STT) Protocol. Through lightweight sidecar proxies, our system propagates security state across organizational boundaries without exposing raw cross-domain data, enabling Counterfactual Graph Simulation for cross-domain policy verification. We construct PhantomEcosystem, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 9 categories of realistic cross-agent violation scenarios with adversarially balanced safe controls. On this benchmark, Distributed Sentinel achieves F1 = 0.95 with 106ms end-to-end latency (16ms verification + 90ms entity extraction on A100), compared to 0.85 F1 for prompt-based filtering and 0.65 for rule-based DLP. To empirically validate the need for external enforcement, we evaluate eight frontier LLMs in execution-oriented multi-agent workflows with per-agent domain world models. All models exhibit substantial violation rates (14-98%), with cross-domain data flows showing systematically higher violation rates than same-domain flows. These results indicate that self-avoidance is unreliable and that multi-agent security benefits from a centralized enforcement layer operating above individual agents.

title: TexOCR: Advancing Document OCR Models for Compilable Page-to-LaTeX Reconstruction
summary: Existing document OCR largely targets plain text or Markdown, discarding the structural and executable properties that make LaTeX essential for scientific publishing. We study page-level reconstruction of scientific PDFs into compilable LaTeX and introduce TexOCR-Bench, a benchmark, and TexOCR-Train, a large-scale training corpus, for this task. TexOCR-Bench features a multi-dimensional evaluation suite that jointly assesses transcription fidelity, structural faithfulness, and end-to-end compilability. Leveraging TexOCR-Train, we train a 2B-parameter model, TexOCR, using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards derived from LaTeX unit tests that directly enforce compilability and referential integrity. Experiments across 21 frontier models on TexOCR-Bench show that existing systems frequently violate key document invariants, including consistent section structure, correct float placement, and valid label-reference links, which undermines compilation reliability and downstream usability. Our analysis further reveals that RL with verifiable rewards yields consistent improvements over SFT alone, particularly on structural and compilation metrics.

AI.title_translation: TexOCR：推进用于可编译页面到LaTeX重建的文档OCR模型
AI.tldr: TexOCR通过引入强化学习和可验证的编译奖励，实现了从PDF到可编译LaTeX文档的高质量重建，解决了传统OCR在科学文档结构保持方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档OCR主要关注纯文本或Markdown，忽略了科学出版中至关重要的LaTeX文档结构和可执行性，导致生成的文档难以编译或丢失关键结构信息。
AI.method: 提出了TexOCR模型，采用监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行训练，其中RL利用基于LaTeX单元测试的可验证奖励来强制执行编译能力和引用完整性。
AI.result: 在TexOCR-Bench上的实验表明，现有模型常破坏文档结构（如节结构、浮动体位置和引用链接），而引入带有可验证奖励的强化学习方法能显著提升模型在结构完整性和编译成功率方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了通过监督微调与基于可验证奖励的强化学习相结合，可以显著提升OCR模型生成可编译LaTeX文档的能力，并解决现有模型在结构一致性方面的不足。
AI.translation: 现有的文档OCR主要针对纯文本或Markdown，丢弃了使LaTeX在科学出版中必不可少的结构和可执行属性。我们研究了科学PDF到可编译LaTeX的页面级重建，并为此引入了一个基准测试TexOCR-Bench和一个大规模训练语料库TexOCR-Train。TexOCR-Bench具有一个多维评估套件，可联合评估转录保真度、结构忠实度和端到端可编译性。利用TexOCR-Train，我们通过监督微调（SFT）和带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）训练了一个20亿参数的模型TexOCR，这些奖励源自直接强制执行可编译性和引用完整性的LaTeX单元测试。在TexOCR-Bench上对21个前沿模型的实验表明，现有系统经常违反关键的文档不变性，包括一致的节结构、正确的浮动体放置和有效的标签-引用链接，这破坏了编译可靠性和下游可用性。我们的分析进一步揭示，与仅进行SFT相比，带有可验证奖励的RL在结构和编译指标上产生了持续的改进。
AI.summary: 本文针对科学PDF转LaTeX任务，提出了TexOCR模型及相应的基准测试和训练集。通过引入基于可验证编译奖励的强化学习，有效解决了传统OCR在处理复杂文档结构和保证可编译性方面的局限性。
AI.keywords: 文档OCR, LaTeX重建, 强化学习, 科学文档分析, 可编译性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将文档OCR的目标从纯文本/Markdown提升至可编译的LaTeX格式，强调了科学文档的结构完整性和可执行性。通过引入基准测试（TexOCR-Bench）和大规模训练集（TexOCR-Train），并结合强化学习进行可验证奖励训练，为复杂文档结构恢复提供了有效的技术路径，对于学术出版的数字化具有重要意义。

title: MTServe: Efficient Serving for Generative Recommendation Models with Hierarchical Caches
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) offers superior modeling capabilities but suffers from prohibitive inference costs due to the repeated encoding of long user histories. While cross-request Key-Value (KV) cache reuse presents a significant optimization opportunity, the massive scale of individual user states creates a storage explosion that far exceeds physical GPU limits. We propose MTServe, a hierarchical cache management system that virtualizes GPU memory by leveraging host RAM as a scalable backup store. To bridge the I/O gap between tiers, MTServe introduces a suite of system-level optimizations, including a hybrid storage layout, an asynchronous data transfer pipeline, and a locality-driven replacement policy. On both public and production datasets, MTServe delivers up to 3.1* speedup while maintaining near-perfect hit ratios (>98.5%).

AI.title_translation: MTServe：基于分层缓存的生成式推荐模型高效服务系统
AI.tldr: MTServe 通过分层缓存（GPU+主机内存）和系统级优化，解决了生成式推荐模型推理成本高及显存受限的问题，实现了 3.1 倍的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐模型在推理时因重复编码长用户历史导致计算成本高昂，且跨请求的 KV 缓存复用受限于 GPU 物理显存容量，难以处理海量用户状态。
AI.method: 提出 MTServe 分层缓存管理系统，将主机内存作为 GPU 显存的备份存储；引入混合存储布局、异步数据传输流水线以及基于局部性的替换策略，以弥补分层存储间的 I/O 延迟。
AI.result: 在公共和生产数据集上实现了高达 3.1 倍的推理加速，同时保持了超过 98.5% 的缓存命中率。
AI.conclusion: MTServe 通过分层缓存技术有效解决了生成式推荐系统中的内存瓶颈，在保证高缓存命中率的同时显著提升了推理速度，是解决大规模推荐模型部署挑战的有效方案。
AI.translation: 生成式推荐（GR）提供了卓越的建模能力，但由于需要重复编码长用户历史，导致推理成本高昂。虽然跨请求的键值（KV）缓存重用提供了一个重要的优化机会，但海量用户状态的规模导致存储需求激增，远远超过了物理 GPU 的限制。我们提出了 MTServe，这是一个通过利用主机内存作为可扩展备份存储来虚拟化 GPU 内存的分层缓存管理系统。为了弥合各层之间的 I/O 差距，MTServe 引入了一套系统级优化，包括混合存储布局、异步数据传输流水线和基于局部性的替换策略。在公共和生产数据集上，MTServe 在保持近乎完美的命中率（>98.5%）的同时，实现了高达 3.1 倍的加速。
AI.summary: MTServe 是一款专为生成式推荐模型设计的分层缓存管理系统。它通过将 GPU 显存与主机 RAM 结合，并配合混合存储、异步传输和智能替换策略，有效缓解了推理时的内存瓶颈，在实现高效缓存复用的同时显著提升了系统吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 生成式推荐, 推理优化, 分层缓存, 内存管理, 系统性能
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的分层缓存管理系统解决了生成式推荐模型推理成本高昂的问题。其核心价值在于成功平衡了GPU显存限制与大规模用户状态存储需求，通过软硬件协同优化实现了显著的性能提升。该方案在工业级场景下具有很高的实用价值和可扩展性。

title: Predicting Wind Loads on Container Ships in Harbor Environments through Multi-Fidelity Modeling
summary:
Modern container ships face higher wind loads due to increased windage areas, making accurate predictions of wind loads essential for mooring design. Existing empirical models, largely developed for container ships with smaller windage areas and simpler geometrical configurations than those of modern large-scale vessels, often lack accuracy and do not account for the influence of nearby structures. This study proposes a multi-fidelity surrogate modelling framework for the prediction of wind-load coefficients, combining empirical correlations with simplified and detailed CFD models for ships in open-sea and harbor environments. The approach relies on recursive co-kriging to consistently fuse information across fidelity levels, enabling accurate predictions at a reduced computational cost. A sensitivity analysis is used to identify the most influential geometric parameters, and the resulting reduced parameter space is explored through sequential sampling to efficiently construct the training database.
  The surrogate models are validated over a wide range of loading configurations and for two distinct harbor environments. The results demonstrate that the multi-fidelity approach significantly improves prediction accuracy compared to single-fidelity models, while substantially reducing the reliance on high-fidelity simulations. In particular, the proposed framework captures the dependence of wind loads on key geometric parameters and consistently outperforms traditional empirical correlations, providing a robust and efficient tool for engineering applications.

title: NeuroAPS-Net: Neuro-Anatomically Aware Point Cloud Representation for Efficient Alzheimer's Disease Classification
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder and a major cause of dementia. Structural MRI is widely used to analyze AD-related brain atrophy; however, most deep learning methods rely on computationally expensive 3D convolutional neural networks (CNNs), limiting deployment in resource-constrained settings. This work introduces two main contributions. First, we propose a pipeline that converts T1-weighted MRI into anatomically informed 2D point clouds using Anatomical Priority Sampling (APS), producing ADNI-2DPC, the first neuroanatomically labeled MRI-derived point cloud dataset. Second, we present NeuroAPS-Net, a lightweight geometric deep learning model that incorporates anatomical priors via region-aware feature encoding and ROI token aggregation. Experiments on ADNI-2DPC demonstrate that NeuroAPS-Net achieves competitive classification accuracy while significantly reducing inference latency and GPU memory compared to state-of-the-art point cloud methods. These results highlight the potential of anatomically guided point cloud learning as an efficient and interpretable alternative to voxel-based CNNs for AD classification.

AI.title_translation: NeuroAPS-Net：用于高效阿尔茨海默病分类的神经解剖感知点云表示法
AI.tldr: 一种轻量级的神经解剖感知点云模型，通过将MRI转换为2D点云，在阿尔茨海默病检测中实现了高效率与高精度的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D CNN的阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测方法计算成本过高，难以在资源受限的环境中部署，因此需要开发更高效、更轻量化的模型。
AI.method: 1. 提出解剖学优先采样（APS）技术，将T1加权MRI转化为具有解剖学标记的2D点云（ADNI-2DPC数据集）；2. 设计NeuroAPS-Net模型，通过区域感知特征编码和ROI令牌聚合技术，将解剖学先验融入轻量级几何深度学习框架。
AI.result: 在ADNI-2DPC数据集上的实验表明，NeuroAPS-Net在保持竞争性分类准确率的同时，显著降低了推理延迟和GPU内存消耗。
AI.conclusion: NeuroAPS-Net 通过引入解剖学先验和轻量化架构，成功实现了高效且准确的阿尔茨海默病分类，证明了点云学习在医学影像分析中的巨大潜力和应用价值。
AI.translation: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，也是痴呆症的主要原因。结构MRI被广泛用于分析与AD相关的脑萎缩；然而，大多数深度学习方法依赖于计算昂贵的3D卷积神经网络（CNN），限制了其在资源受限环境下的部署。本工作主要有两点贡献。首先，我们提出了一种流水线，通过解剖优先采样（APS）将T1加权MRI转换为解剖信息丰富的2D点云，并生成了首个神经解剖标记的MRI衍生点云数据集ADNI-2DPC。其次，我们提出了NeuroAPS-Net，这是一种轻量级的几何深度学习模型，通过区域感知特征编码和ROI令牌聚合结合了解剖先验。在ADNI-2DPC上的实验表明，与现有的点云方法相比，NeuroAPS-Net在实现具有竞争力的分类准确率的同时，显著降低了推理延迟和GPU内存需求。这些结果突显了解剖引导的点云学习作为一种高效且可解释的替代方案，在AD分类中取代基于体素的CNN的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于解剖学先验的NeuroAPS-Net模型，通过将MRI转换为2D点云并结合区域感知编码，在实现高效阿尔茨海默病分类的同时，克服了传统3D CNN计算资源需求大的局限性。
AI.keywords: 阿尔茨海默病, 点云表示, 解剖学先验采样, 几何深度学习, 医学影像分析
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将传统三维卷积神经网络（CNN）的体素方法转化为轻量级的点云处理方法，并通过引入解剖学先验知识（APS）来提升模型在资源受限环境下的分类性能。这为医学影像分析提供了一种兼顾效率与可解释性的新思路。

title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Truly Understand Small Objects?
comments: Under Peer Review (26 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables)
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising potential in diverse understanding tasks, e.g., image and video analysis, math and physics olympiads. However, they remain blank and unexplored for Small Object Understanding (SOU) tasks. To fill this gap, we introduce SOUBench, the first and comprehensive benchmark for exploring the small objects understanding capability of existing MLLMs. Specifically, we first design an effective and automatic visual question-answer generation strategy, constructing a new SOU-VQA evaluation dataset, with 18,204 VQA pairs, six relevant sub-tasks, and three dominant scenarios (i.e., Driving, Aerial, and Underwater). Then, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation on 15 state-of-the-art MLLMs and reveal their weak capabilities in small object understanding. Furthermore, we develop SOU-Train, a multimodal training dataset with 11,226 VQA pairs, to improve the SOU capabilities of MLLMs. Through supervising fine-tuning of the latest MLLM, we demonstrate that SOU-Train can effectively enhance the latest MLLM's ability to understand small objects. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that, the proposed SOUBench, along with the SOU-VQA and SOU-Train datasets, provides a crucial empirical foundation to the community for further developing models with enhanced small object understanding capabilities. Datasets and Code: https://github.com/Hanfj-X/SOU.
comment: Under Peer Review (26 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables)

AI.title_translation: 多模态大模型真的能理解小目标吗？
AI.tldr: 本文通过构建首个小目标理解基准测试SOUBench，揭示了主流多模态大模型在处理小目标时的不足，并提供了SOU-Train数据集以有效提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大模型在多种任务中表现出色，但其在小目标理解（SOU）任务上的能力尚未得到探索，现有研究存在空白。
AI.method: 1. 构建SOUBench基准测试集，包含18,204对VQA数据；2. 对15种主流多模态大模型进行全面测评；3. 开发SOU-Train数据集，并对模型进行监督微调以提升性能。
AI.result: 实验揭示了现有多模态大模型在处理小目标时的能力严重不足；通过SOU-Train数据集进行微调，显著增强了模型对小目标的理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当前多模态大模型对小目标的理解能力薄弱，但通过引入SOU-Train数据集进行监督微调，可以有效增强模型在小目标场景下的理解与分析能力。
AI.translation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）在图像和视频分析、数学和物理竞赛等多种理解任务中展现出巨大潜力。然而，它们在小目标理解（SOU）任务上仍处于空白且未经探索的状态。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了SOUBench，这是第一个用于探索现有MLLMs小目标理解能力的综合基准。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种有效且自动的视觉问答生成策略，构建了一个新的SOU-VQA评估数据集，包含18,204个VQA对、6个相关子任务和3个主要场景（驾驶、航空和水下）。然后，我们对15个最先进的MLLMs进行了全面评估，揭示了它们在小目标理解方面的薄弱能力。此外，我们开发了SOU-Train（一个包含11,226个VQA对的多模态训练数据集）来提高MLLMs的SOU能力。通过对最新MLLM进行监督微调，我们证明了SOU-Train可以有效增强模型理解小目标的能力。全面的实验结果表明，所提出的SOUBench以及SOU-VQA和SOU-Train数据集，为社区进一步开发具有增强小目标理解能力的模型提供了重要的实证基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态大模型在小目标理解方面的空白，提出了首个综合基准SOUBench及配套数据集SOU-VQA和SOU-Train。研究通过测评15种主流模型，证实了其在处理小目标时的局限性，并证明了通过特定数据集微调可有效提升模型的小目标感知能力。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 小目标理解, 基准测试, 视觉问答, 监督微调
AI.comments: 该研究填补了多模态大模型在小目标理解领域的空白，通过构建系统性的基准测试与训练数据集，不仅揭示了现有模型的局限性，还为后续提升模型感知能力提供了实证基础和改进路径，具有较高的学术与应用价值。

title: Federated Cross-Modal Retrieval with Missing Modalities via Semantic Routing and Adapter Personalization
summary: Federated cross-modal retrieval faces severe challenges from heterogeneous client data, particularly non-IID semantic distributions and missing modalities. Under such heterogeneity, a single global model is often insufficient to capture both shared cross-modal knowledge and client-specific characteristics. We propose RCSR, a personalization-friendly federated framework that integrates prototype anchoring, retrieval-centric semantic routing, and optional client-specific adapters. Built on a frozen CLIP backbone, RCSR leverages lightweight shared adapters for global knowledge transfer while supporting efficient local personalization. Prototype anchoring helps unimodal clients align with global cross-modal semantics, and a server-side semantic router adaptively assigns aggregation weights based on retrieval consistency to mitigate alignment drift during heterogeneous updates. Extensive experiments on MS-COCO, Flickr30K, and other benchmarks show that RCSR consistently improves global retrieval accuracy and training stability, while further enhancing client-level retrieval performance, especially for clients with incomplete modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/RezinChow/RCSR-Retrieval-Centric-Semantic-Routing.

AI.title_translation: 基于语义路由与适配器个性化的联邦跨模态缺失检索研究
AI.tldr: RCSR框架通过语义路由和个性化适配器，解决了联邦跨模态检索中因数据异构和模态缺失导致的性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 联邦跨模态检索面临严重的客户端数据异构性（如non-IID语义分布）和模态缺失挑战，导致单一全局模型难以同时捕获共享知识与个性化特征。
AI.method: 提出名为RCSR的联邦框架，包含原型锚定（Prototype Anchoring）、以检索为中心的语义路由（Retrieval-centric Semantic Routing）以及客户端特定的适配器（Client-specific Adapters），并基于冻结的CLIP主干网络进行训练。
AI.result: 在MS-COCO、Flickr30K等基准测试中，RCSR框架一致性地提高了全局检索精度和训练稳定性，并显著提升了模态缺失客户端的本地检索性能。
AI.conclusion: RCSR框架通过原型锚定、语义路由和个性化适配器，有效解决了联邦跨模态检索中的异构数据和模态缺失问题，提升了全局与本地的检索性能。
AI.translation: 联邦跨模态检索面临着异构客户端数据带来的严峻挑战，特别是非独立同分布（non-IID）的语义分布和缺失模态问题。在这样的异构性下，单一的全局模型往往不足以同时捕获共享的跨模态知识和客户端特定的特征。我们提出了RCSR，这是一个对个性化友好的联邦框架，它集成了原型锚定、以检索为中心的语义路由以及可选的客户端特定适配器。RCSR建立在冻结的CLIP主干上，利用轻量级共享适配器进行全局知识迁移，同时支持高效的本地个性化。原型锚定帮助单模态客户端与全局跨模态语义对齐，服务器端的语义路由器根据检索一致性自适应地分配聚合权重，以减轻异构更新期间的对齐漂移。在MS-COCO、Flickr30K和其他基准测试上的广泛实验表明，RCSR始终提高了全局检索精度和训练稳定性，同时进一步增强了客户端级别的检索性能，特别是对于模态不完整的客户端。代码可在 https://github.com/RezinChow/RCSR-Retrieval-Centric-Semantic-Routing 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为RCSR的联邦跨模态检索框架，通过原型锚定、语义路由和个性化适配器，解决了客户端数据异构和模态缺失带来的挑战，实现了全局共享知识与本地个性化特征的有效结合。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 跨模态检索, 模态缺失, 语义路由, 个性化适配器
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种针对联邦跨模态检索的个性化框架，通过语义路由和适配器解决了非独立同分布（non-IID）数据及模态缺失的难题。其亮点在于利用冻结的CLIP主干网络实现了轻量级的知识迁移与本地个性化，为解决联邦学习中的异构性问题提供了一种高效且稳健的范式。

title: Breaking Degradation Coupling: A Structural Entropy Guided Decoupled Framework and Benchmark for Infrared Enhancement
summary: Thermal infrared image enhancement aims to restore high-quality images from complex compound degradations. Existing all-in-one approaches typically employ a single shared backbone to handle diverse degradations, which causes gradient interference and parameter competition. To address this, we propose a Structural Entropy-Guided Decoupled (SEGD) Framework. Unlike unified modeling paradigms, SEGD decomposes compound degradations into independent sub-processes and models them in a divide-and-conquer manner through Degradation-Specific Residual Modules (DRMs). Each DRM focuses on residual estimation for a specific degradation, enabling task decoupling while remaining jointly trainable, which mitigates parameter contention. A Degradation-Aware Evidential Network further estimates degradation type and intensity, providing priors that adaptively regulate DRM restoration strength. To handle compound cases, DRMs are composed in varying orders to form multiple restoration paths, from which the most informative features are aggregated under a structural-entropy criterion, yielding decoder-ready representations with structural fidelity and degradation awareness. Integrating divide-and-conquer restoration, evidential perception, and entropy-guided adaptation, SEGD achieves fine-grained and interpretable enhancement. We also construct a nighttime TIR benchmark for evaluation under real low-light conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that SEGD surpasses state-of-the-art methods while achieving higher efficiency with fewer parameters.

title: RouteGuard: Internal-Signal Detection of Skill Poisoning in LLM Agents
summary: Agent skills introduce a new and more severe form of indirect injection for LLM agents: unlike traditional indirect prompt injection, attackers can hide malicious instructions inside a dense, action-oriented skill that already functions as a legitimate instruction source. We study pre-execution skill-poison detection and show that successful skill poisoning induces a structured internal effect, attention hijacking, in which response-time attention shifts from trusted context to malicious skill spans and drives harmful behavior. Motivated by this mechanism, we propose RouteGuard, a frozen-backbone detector that combines response-conditioned attention and hidden-state alignment through reliability-gated late fusion. Across both real and synthetic open-source skill benchmarks, RouteGuard is consistently the strongest or most robust detector; on the critical Skill-Inject channel slice, it reaches 0.8834 F1 and recovers 90.51% of description attacks missed by lexical screening, showing that defending against skill poisoning requires internal-signal detection rather than text-only filtering

title: Quantifying and Mitigating Self-Preference Bias of LLM Judges
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge has become a dominant approach in automated evaluation systems, playing critical roles in model alignment, leaderboard construction, quality control, and so on. However, the scalability and trustworthiness of this approach can be substantially distorted by Self-Preference Bias (SPB), which is a directional evaluative deviation in which LLMs systematically favor or disfavor their own generated outputs during evaluation. Existing measurements rely on costly human annotations and conflate generative capability with evaluative stance, and thus are impractical for large-scale deployment in real-world systems. To address this issue, we introduce a fully automated framework to quantifying and mitigating SPB, which constructs equal-quality pairs of responses with negligible quality differences, enabling statistical disentanglement of discriminability from bias propensity without human gold standards. Empirical analysis across 20 mainstream LLMs reveals that advanced capabilities are often uncorrelated, or even negatively correlated, with low SPB. To mitigate this bias, we propose a structured multi-dimensional evaluation strategy grounded in cognitive load decomposition, which reduces SPB by 31.5\% on average.

title: StackFeat RL: Reinforcement Learning over Iterative Dual Criterion Feature Selection for Stable Biomarker Discovery
summary:
Feature selection in high-dimensional genomic data ($d \gg n$) demands methods that are simultaneously accurate, sparse, and stable. Existing approaches either require manual threshold specification (mRMR, stability selection), produce unstable selections under data perturbation (Lasso, Boruta), or ignore biological structure entirely. We introduce StackFeat-RL, a meta-learning framework that optimises the hyperparameters of an iterative dual-criterion feature selection algorithm via REINFORCE policy gradients. The dual criterion, requiring both coefficient consistency and selection frequency, guards against two failure modes missed by single-criterion methods, while iterative accumulation provides convergence guarantees via the law of large numbers.
  On COVID-19 miRNA data (GSE240888, 332 features) and three Alzheimer's disease classification tasks (GSE84422, 13237 genes; Normal vs.\ Possible, Probable, and Definite AD), StackFeat-RL achieves the highest predictive accuracy among all evaluated methods, including ElasticNet, Boruta, mRMR, and stability selection, while requiring 3--4$\times$ fewer features.
  Keywords: feature selection, reinforcement learning, REINFORCE, elastic net, biomarker discovery, Alzheimer's disease, dual-criterion selection, protein interaction networks

AI.title_translation: StackFeat RL：基于迭代双重准则特征选择的强化学习方法用于稳定生物标志物发现
AI.tldr: StackFeat-RL利用强化学习优化特征选择过程，在保持高预测准确性的同时，以极少的特征数量实现了更稳定的生物标志物发现。
AI.motivation: 现有特征选择方法在高维基因组数据中存在手动阈值设置困难、数据扰动下不稳定或忽视生物结构等问题，难以同时满足准确性、稀疏性和稳定性的要求。
AI.method: 采用基于REINFORCE策略梯度的元学习框架，对迭代双重准则（系数一致性与选择频率）特征选择算法的超参数进行优化。
AI.result: 在COVID-19 miRNA和阿尔茨海默病基因表达数据集上，StackFeat-RL在所有对比方法中实现了最高的预测准确率，且所需特征数量减少了3-4倍。
AI.conclusion: StackFeat-RL通过结合强化学习与双重准则特征选择，在高维基因组数据中实现了更优的准确性、稀疏性和稳定性，优于现有的多种经典特征选择方法。
AI.translation: 高维基因组数据（d >> n）的特征选择需要同时具备准确、稀疏和稳定性的方法。现有的方法要么需要手动设置阈值（mRMR，稳定性选择），要么在数据扰动下产生不稳定的选择（Lasso，Boruta），要么完全忽略生物结构。我们引入了StackFeat-RL，这是一个通过REINFORCE策略梯度优化迭代双重准则特征选择算法超参数的元学习框架。该双重准则要求同时具备系数一致性和选择频率，防止了单准则方法忽略的两种失效模式，而迭代积累通过大数定律提供了收敛保证。在COVID-19 miRNA数据（GSE240888，332个特征）和三个阿尔茨海默病分类任务（GSE84422，13237个基因；正常与可能、大概、确定的AD）中，StackFeat-RL在所有评估方法中实现了最高的预测准确性，包括ElasticNet、Boruta、mRMR和稳定性选择，同时所需的特征数量减少了3-4倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为StackFeat-RL的元学习框架，旨在解决高维基因组数据中特征选择的准确性与稳定性平衡问题。该方法通过REINFORCE算法动态优化迭代双重准则特征选择的超参数，有效克服了传统单准则方法的局限性，在多个生物医学数据集上表现出卓越的预测性能和稀疏性。
AI.keywords: 特征选择, 强化学习, 生物标志物发现, 高维基因组数据, 深度学习
AI.comments: StackFeat-RL的创新在于将强化学习引入特征选择的超参数优化中，并提出了双重准则（系数一致性和选择频率）来解决高维基因组数据中特征选择不稳定和过拟合的问题。该方法在保证准确性的同时显著提高了特征的稀疏性，对于生物医学领域发现可靠的生物标志物具有重要意义。

title: Utility-Aware Data Pricing: Token-Level Quality and Empirical Training Gain for LLMs
summary: Traditional data valuation methods based on ``row-count $\times$ quality coefficient'' paradigms fail to capture the nuanced, nonlinear contributions that data makes to Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities. This paper presents a dynamic data valuation framework that transitions from static accounting to utility-based pricing. Our approach operates on three layers: (1) token-level information density metrics using Shannon entropy and Data Quality Scores; (2) empirical training gain measurement through influence functions, proxy model strategies, and Data Shapley values; and (3) cryptographic verifiability through hash-based commitments, Merkle trees, and a tamper-evident training ledger. We provide comprehensive experimental validation on three real domains (instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code summarization), demonstrating that proxy-based empirical gain achieves near-perfect ranking alignment with realized utility, substantially outperforming row-count and token-count baselines. This framework enables a fair Data-as-a-Service economy where high-reasoning data is priced according to its actual contribution to model intelligence, while providing the transparency and auditability necessary for trustworthy data markets.

AI.title_translation: 效用感知的数据定价：大语言模型的Token级质量与经验训练增益
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模型实际训练效用的动态数据定价框架，通过结合Token级质量分析、经验增益评估和密码学审计技术，解决了传统方法无法衡量数据对LLM非线性贡献的难题。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于行数或质量系数的数据定价方法无法准确捕捉数据对大语言模型（LLM）性能提升的非线性贡献，导致数据定价不公。
AI.method: 提出了一套三层动态数据价值评估框架：1. 基于香农熵和数据质量评分的Token级信息密度度量；2. 通过影响函数、代理模型和Data Shapley值评估经验训练增益；3. 利用哈希提交、Merkle树和防篡改训练账本实现加密可验证性。
AI.result: 在指令遵循、数学推理和代码摘要三个领域验证显示，该代理模型评估方法在数据贡献度排序上与实际效用表现出近乎完美的对齐，显著优于传统的行数和Token数基准。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了基于代理模型的经验增益评估方法在衡量数据对LLM性能贡献方面具有极高的准确性，为数据资产化和高效的数据市场交易提供了可行方案。
AI.translation: 传统的基于“行数×质量系数”范式的数据估值方法，无法捕捉数据对大语言模型（LLM）能力的细微、非线性贡献。本文提出了一种从静态核算转向基于效用定价的动态数据估值框架。我们的方法包含三个层面：（1）使用香农熵和数据质量评分的Token级信息密度指标；（2）通过影响函数、代理模型策略和数据Shapley值进行经验训练增益度量；（3）通过基于哈希的提交、Merkle树和防篡改训练账本实现加密可验证性。我们在三个真实领域（指令遵循、数学推理和代码摘要）提供了全面的实验验证，表明基于代理的经验增益与实际效用的排序对齐度近乎完美，大大优于行数和Token数基准。该框架实现了一个公平的“数据即服务”经济，高推理价值的数据能根据其对模型智能的实际贡献进行定价，同时为可信数据市场提供了必要的透明度和可审计性。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种面向大语言模型的动态数据定价框架，通过Token级质量分析、基于代理模型的经验训练增益评估以及加密可验证技术，实现了对数据实际贡献的精准定价，为构建公平透明的数据市场提供了解决方案。
AI.keywords: LLM数据定价, 数据效用, 经验训练增益, 数据Shapley值, 数据市场透明度
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了一种从静态数据统计转向基于模型实际效用的动态定价框架。它不仅解决了传统数据定价在LLM训练中无法体现数据非线性贡献的痛点，还通过密码学技术确保了数据交易的透明度与可审计性，为构建公平的数据经济提供了扎实的理论与实践支撑。

title: Magnetic Indoor Localization through CNN Regression and Rotation Invariance
comments: Published and presented at the 2026 4th International Conference on Mechatronics, Control and Robotics (ICMCR)
summary: Indoor positioning is an essential technology for a wide range of applications in GNSS-denied environments, including indoor navigation and IoT systems. Combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and magnetic field-based features offers a low-cost, infrastructure-free solution for precise positioning. While magnetic fingerprints are a promising approach for indoor positioning, models trained on raw 3D magnetometer data are highly sensitive to device orientation. We address this by using two rotation invariant features derived from the 3D magnetic field: the norm (Mn) and the projection onto the gravity axis (Mg). We train a lightweight 7-layer dilated CNN (MagNetS/XL) on magnetic sequences to directly regress (x, y) positions. Using the MagPie dataset (three buildings, handheld trajectories), we systematically evaluate fixed and random rotations of test and/or train data. Raw 3D inputs (Mx, My , Mz) exhibit isotropic error increases under fixed 90° rotations and further degrade with growing random rotations. In contrast, 2D (Mn, Mg) inputs maintain rotation invariant accuracy and surpass the 3D inputs once rotation exceeds building-specific thresholds for three reference buildings: 0° for Loomis (large), 5° for Talbot (medium), and 6° for CSL (small). MagNetXL achieves or exceeds state-of-the-art accuracy on the MagPie dataset, and MagNetS delivers similar performance with roughly one third of the parameters, favoring mobile deployment. These results show that the robustness gained from rotation invariant inputs outweighs the loss of input dimensionality in realistic usage, allowing mapping and localization without orientation alignment or added infrastructure.
comment: Published and presented at the 2026 4th International Conference on Mechatronics, Control and Robotics (ICMCR)

AI.title_translation: 通过CNN回归与旋转不变性实现磁室内定位
AI.tldr: 通过将磁场数据转换为旋转不变的特征，提升了磁定位模型对设备方向变化的鲁棒性，并实现了轻量化的高精度定位。
AI.motivation: 室内定位在GNSS不可用环境下至关重要，但基于磁场指纹的定位模型通常对设备方向高度敏感，导致在实际应用中定位精度下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于旋转不变特征（磁场模值Mn和重力轴投影Mg）的方法，并训练了一个轻量级的7层空洞卷积神经网络（MagNetS/XL）来直接回归（x, y）坐标。
AI.result: MagNetXL在MagPie数据集上达到了最先进的定位精度，而MagNetS在参数量减少约三分之二的情况下仍保持了相似的性能，证明了旋转不变特征在实际应用中的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用旋转不变特征（Mn, Mg）结合轻量化CNN进行磁定位，在无需定向校准的情况下即可实现高精度定位，且在真实场景中优于传统的原始3D磁场数据输入。
AI.translation: 室内定位对于GNSS受限环境下的各种应用（包括室内导航和物联网系统）至关重要。结合卷积神经网络（CNN）和基于磁场的特征，为精确导航提供了一种低成本、无需基础设施的解决方案。虽然磁场指纹是一种很有前景的室内定位方法，但基于原始3D磁力计数据训练的模型对设备方向高度敏感。为了解决这个问题，我们使用了从3D磁场导出的两个旋转不变特征：模值（Mn）和重力轴投影（Mg）。我们在磁场序列上训练了一个轻量级的7层空洞CNN（MagNetS/XL），用于直接回归（x, y）位置。利用MagPie数据集（三座建筑物，手持轨迹），我们系统地评估了测试和/或训练数据的固定和随机旋转情况。原始3D输入（Mx, My, Mz）在固定90°旋转下表现出各向同性的误差增加，并随着随机旋转的增加而进一步退化。相比之下，2D（Mn, Mg）输入保持了旋转不变的准确性，并且在旋转超过特定阈值后超过了3D输入。MagNetXL在MagPie数据集上达到了或超过了最先进的精度，而MagNetS在参数量仅为前者约三分之一的情况下提供了相似的性能，有利于移动部署。这些结果表明，在实际使用中，旋转不变输入带来的鲁棒性超过了输入维度减少带来的损失，实现了无需方向对齐或额外基础设施的地图绘制和定位。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于旋转不变磁场特征的室内定位方法，通过使用磁场模值和重力轴投影作为CNN的输入，消除了设备方向变化对定位精度的影响，并在MagPie数据集上验证了其在无需额外基础设施下的优越性能。
AI.keywords: 室内定位, 磁场指纹, 卷积神经网络, 旋转不变性, IoT
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地通过特征工程（使用磁场模值和重力轴投影）解决了磁定位中设备方向敏感的痛点，显著提升了在真实环境下的鲁棒性。其轻量化模型设计非常适合移动设备部署，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Citation-Driven Multi-View Training for Patent Embeddings: QaECTER and Sophia-Bench
summary: Patent retrieval underpins critical decisions in innovation, examination, and IP strategy, yet progress has been hampered by the absence of benchmarks that reflect the diversity of real world search scenarios. We address this gap with two contributions. First, we introduce Sophiabench, a large-scale patent retrieval benchmark comprising 10,000 queries and 75,000 corpus documents stratified across ten years, eight IPC technology sections, and twelve filing jurisdictions. Unlike prior benchmarks, Sophia-bench tests retrieval using 12 different query types-from structured patent fields to AI-generated summaries-and evaluates results against citation-based ground truth enhanced with a novel domain-relevance metric (InScope). Together, these enable systematic measurement of how well models perform across query types, technology domains, and jurisdictions. Second, we introduce QaECTER, a 344M-parameter embedding model trained on patent citation graphs and multi-view self-alignment. Despite its compact size, QaECTER establishes a new state of the art for patent retrieval. It outperforms the \#1 model on the English retrieval text embedding benchmark (RTEB), a model 23x larger, as well as all existing patent specific models across every query type, IPC section, and jurisdiction on Sophia-bench, with gains of up to 7.2% average NDCG@10 over the next-best model. These results are confirmed on an independent external benchmark, where QaECTER surpasses all prior models without requiring task-specific instruction prompts. Both the benchmark and the model are designed for practical deployment in large-scale patent search systems.

AI.title_translation: 基于引用驱动的多视图专利嵌入训练：QaECTER与Sophia-bench
AI.tldr: 本文发布了大规模专利检索基准Sophia-bench，并提出了高性能专利嵌入模型QaECTER，该模型通过引用驱动训练在专利检索任务中刷新了SOTA记录。
AI.motivation: 现有的专利检索研究缺乏能够反映真实世界多样化搜索场景的基准，且现有模型在跨技术领域和司法管辖区的表现有待提升。
AI.method: 提出了基于引用驱动的多视图自我对齐训练方法（QaECTER模型），并构建了包含12种查询类型、覆盖多个技术领域和司法管辖区的大规模专利检索基准（Sophia-bench）。
AI.result: QaECTER在Sophia-bench上全面超越现有专利模型，平均NDCG@10提升高达7.2%，且在外部基准上表现优异，无需特定指令提示即可达到SOTA水平。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过发布Sophia-bench基准和QaECTER模型，有效解决了专利检索领域缺乏多样化基准和高效模型的问题，为专利检索任务设立了新的性能标杆。
AI.translation: 专利检索是创新、审查和知识产权战略决策的关键支撑，但由于缺乏能够反映真实世界多样化搜索场景的基准，相关进展受到阻碍。我们通过两项贡献填补了这一空白。首先，我们引入了Sophia-bench，这是一个大规模专利检索基准，包含10,000个查询和75,000个语料库文档，跨越十年、八个IPC技术部分和十二个申请司法管辖区。与之前的基准不同，Sophia-bench测试了12种不同查询类型的检索，并使用基于引用的基准事实（通过新颖的领域相关性指标InScope增强）来评估结果。这些使得能够系统地衡量模型在不同查询类型、技术领域和司法管辖区的表现。其次，我们引入了QaECTER，这是一个在专利引用图和多视图自我对齐上训练的344M参数嵌入模型。尽管尺寸紧凑，QaECTER仍为专利检索建立了新的最先进水平。它在英语检索文本嵌入基准（RTEB）上超越了排名第一的模型（该模型体积是其23倍），并在Sophia-bench的所有查询类型、IPC部分和司法管辖区中超越了所有现有的专利特定模型，平均NDCG@10比次优模型提高了7.2%。这些结果在独立的外部基准中得到了证实，其中QaECTER在不需要特定任务指令提示的情况下超越了所有先前的模型。基准和模型都专为大规模专利搜索系统中的实际部署而设计。
AI.summary: 本文针对专利检索领域缺乏多样化基准的问题，提出了包含10,000个查询和75,000个文档的大规模基准Sophia-bench。同时，开发了基于引用图和多视图自我对齐训练的344M参数模型QaECTER，该模型在专利检索任务中实现了新的最优性能。
AI.keywords: 专利检索, 嵌入模型, Sophia-bench, QaECTER, 引用图学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了基于引用驱动的多视图训练方法，并构建了一个极具代表性的大规模专利检索基准Sophia-bench。QaECTER模型在参数量仅为344M的情况下，性能超越了比其大23倍的模型，展示了在特定垂直领域中，利用领域知识（引用图）进行训练的巨大潜力。

title: Reconstructive Authority Model: Runtime Execution Validity Under Partial Observability
comments: Agent Governance Series, Paper P5. Standalone resubmission following consolidation of P3+P4 into a single paper (P3/4, submit/7510907). Prior submission: submit/7501806. Companion papers on arXiv: P0 (2604.17511), P1 (2603.18829), P2 (2604.17517). Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.19669430
summary:
Autonomous systems increasingly operate under partial observability where execution-relevant state is never fully accessible. Existing governance mechanisms -- trusted execution environments, oracle-signed state proofs, cryptographic attestation -- enforce the integrity of computation and state projections. We show this is structurally insufficient: an authenticated projection of state is necessary but never sufficient for execution validity.
  We introduce the Reconstructive Authority Model (RAM), which separates integrity from coverage. RAM defines a reconstruction gate that reasons over an explicit coverage envelope -- comprising proven state, declared assumptions, and an acknowledged unobservable residual -- and permits execution only when coverage is adequate for the action class. When coverage is insufficient, RAM narrows privileges dynamically or fails closed. Attestation proves trust in measurement; RAM proves adequacy of what is measured.
  We formalize RAM, prove necessity via two theorems (attestation insufficiency and RAM necessity) and three corollaries, and present a hybrid RAM+Attestation architecture with privilege-narrowing. Synthetic experiments (N=100,000, seed=42) show RAM achieves zero invalid execution rates at all coverage levels. Attestation-based systems exhibit IER=0.423 at low coverage and IER=0.233 even at full coverage, the latter arising from undefined-state handling failures undetectable by integrity checks alone.
  This reframes execution validity as a coverage reconstruction problem, distinct from and complementary to integrity guarantees provided by attestation.
