AI.title_translation: 机器人中的视觉-语言-动作模型：数据集、基准测试与数据引擎综述
AI.tldr: 机器人视觉-语言-动作学习的瓶颈不在模型架构，而在数据基础设施；本文系统综述并强调了高质量数据引擎与评估协议对未来具身智能的重要性。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的研究过度关注模型架构，而忽视了底层数据基础设施（数据集、基准、数据引擎）对具身智能学习的决定性影响。
AI.method: 通过对现有的数据集、基准测试和数据引擎进行系统性分类和对比分析，识别当前领域的研究瓶颈，并归纳出四个核心开放挑战。
AI.result: 揭示了现有数据集的保真度与成本权衡、基准测试在长程推理和组合泛化方面的结构性缺失，以及数据引擎在物理接地和模拟到真实迁移方面的局限性。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型的未来突破取决于数据基础设施的系统性构建。研究人员应将数据集、基准测试和数据引擎作为核心研究对象，而非仅仅关注模型架构，以解决物理接地、泛化能力和长程推理等关键挑战。
AI.translation: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型取得了显著进展，但一个核心瓶颈仍未得到充分审查：具身学习底层的核心数据基础设施。在本综述中，我们认为VLA的未来进展将不再主要依赖模型架构，而更多取决于高保真数据引擎与结构化评估协议的协同设计。为此，我们围绕数据集、基准测试和数据引擎这三大支柱，对VLA研究进行了系统性、以数据为中心的分析。在数据集方面，我们根据具身多样性、模态组成和动作空间定义对真实世界和合成语料库进行了分类，揭示了制约大规模数据收集的保真度与成本间的权衡问题。在基准测试方面，我们联合分析了任务复杂性和环境结构，暴露了现有协议在组合泛化和长程推理评估方面的结构性差距。在数据引擎方面，我们考察了基于模拟、视频重建和自动任务生成的范式，识别了它们在物理接地和模拟到真实（sim-to-real）迁移方面的共同局限。综合这些分析，我们提炼出四个开放性挑战：表征对齐、多模态监督、推理评估和可扩展数据生成。我们认为，解决这些问题需要将数据基础设施视为一流的研究课题，而不是背景关注点。
AI.summary: 本文通过对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）领域进行数据中心的系统性综述，强调了数据基础设施（即数据集、基准测试和数据引擎）对具身智能发展的关键作用，并指出了当前研究在泛化、推理及物理接地方面的不足，提出了未来需重点攻克的四大挑战。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 机器人学习, 数据集, 基准测试, 数据引擎
AI.comments: 本文具有极高的洞察力，将研究重心从模型架构转向数据基础设施，这符合当前机器人学习领域从“模型驱动”向“数据驱动”转型的趋势。其提出的三个支柱分类法为该领域提供了清晰的地图，对未来研究方向的指引具有重要参考价值。

title: FormalScience: Scalable Human-in-the-Loop Autoformalisation of Science with Agentic Code Generation in Lean
summary: Formalising informal mathematical reasoning into formally verifiable code is a significant challenge for large language models. In scientific fields such as physics, domain-specific machinery (\textit{e.g.} Dirac notation, vector calculus) imposes additional formalisation challenges that modern LLMs and agentic approaches have yet to tackle. To aid autoformalisation in scientific domains, we present FormalScience; a domain-agnostic human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline that enables a single domain expert (without deep formal language experience) to produce \textit{syntactically correct} and \textit{semantically aligned} formal proofs of informal reasoning for low economic cost. Applying FormalScience to physics, we construct FormalPhysics, a dataset of 200 university-level (LaTeX) physics problems and solutions (primarily quantum mechanics and electromagnetism), along with their Lean4 formal representations. Compared to existing formal math benchmarks, FormalPhysics achieves perfect formal validity and exhibits greater statement complexity. We evaluate open-source models and proprietary systems on a statement autoformalisation task on our dataset via zero-shot prompting, self-refinement with error feedback, and a novel multi-stage agentic approach, and explore autoformalisation limitations in modern LLM-based approaches. We provide the first systematic characterisation of semantic drift in physics autoformalisation in terms of concepts such as notational collapse and abstraction elevation which reveals what formal language verifies when full semantic preservation is unattainable. We release the codebase together with an interactive UI-based FormalScience system which facilitates autoformalisation and theorem proving in scientific domains beyond physics.https://github.com/jmeadows17/formal-science

AI.title_translation: FormalScience：基于Lean智能体代码生成的科学领域可扩展“人在回路”自动形式化系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了FormalScience框架，通过“人在回路”的智能体流水线辅助专家将复杂物理推理自动形式化为Lean4代码，并构建了FormalPhysics数据集以评估大模型在科学形式化中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在将非形式化数学推理转化为形式化验证代码方面存在困难，特别是在物理学等具有特定领域符号和语义复杂性的学科中，缺乏有效的自动形式化工具。
AI.method: 提出了一种领域无关的“人在回路”智能体流水线（FormalScience），结合零样本提示、自我修正反馈机制以及多阶段智能体策略，辅助领域专家将非形式化推理转化为Lean4形式化代码。
AI.result: 构建了包含200个大学物理问题及其Lean4形式化表示的FormalPhysics数据集；评估表明该方法能实现语法正确且语义对齐的证明；首次系统性地刻画了物理学自动形式化中的语义漂移（如符号塌陷和抽象提升）。
AI.conclusion: FormalScience提供了一个高效、可扩展的框架，通过智能体与人类专家协同，有效解决了科学领域自动形式化的难题，并揭示了现有模型在保持语义一致性方面的局限性。
AI.translation: 将非形式化数学推理形式化为可验证的代码对大模型来说是一个重大挑战。在物理学等科学领域，特定领域的机制（例如狄拉克符号、矢量微积分）带来了额外的形式化挑战，而现代大模型和智能体方法尚未解决这些问题。为了辅助科学领域的自动形式化，我们提出了FormalScience；这是一个领域无关的、人在回路的智能体流水线，使单个领域专家（无需深厚的形式语言经验）能够以低经济成本生成语法正确且语义对齐的非形式化推理形式证明。我们将FormalScience应用于物理学，构建了FormalPhysics，这是一个包含200个大学水平（LaTeX）物理问题和解决方案（主要是量子力学和电磁学）及其Lean4形式化表示的数据集。与现有的形式数学基准相比，FormalPhysics实现了完美的形式有效性并展现出更高的陈述复杂度。我们通过零样本提示、带错误反馈的自我修正以及一种新颖的多阶段智能体方法，评估了开源模型和专有系统在我们数据集上的陈述自动形式化任务，并探索了基于大模型的自动形式化方法的局限性。我们首次在符号塌陷和抽象提升等概念方面对物理自动形式化中的语义漂移进行了系统性刻画，揭示了当无法实现完全语义保持时，形式语言验证的内容。我们发布了代码库以及一个基于交互式UI的FormalScience系统，该系统促进了物理学以外科学领域的自动形式化和定理证明。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FormalScience，这是一个支持“人在回路”的智能体框架，旨在将科学领域的非形式化推理自动转化为Lean4形式化代码。研究者通过该系统构建了FormalPhysics数据集，并系统评估了主流大模型在物理领域自动形式化任务中的表现，同时深入分析了语义漂移现象，为科学计算的形式化验证提供了新的方法论。
AI.keywords: 自动形式化, Lean4, 智能体, 物理学, 语义漂移
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“人在回路”的智能体流水线，成功降低了科学领域形式化验证的门槛，特别是针对物理学中复杂的符号和概念。其主要贡献在于构建了FormalPhysics数据集，并深入探讨了自动形式化过程中的语义漂移问题，为大模型在科学严谨性方面的研究提供了重要参考。

title: Collocation-based Robust Physics Informed Neural Networks for time-dependent simulations of pollution propagation under thermal inversion conditions on Spitsbergen
comments: Robust Variational Physics Informed Neural Networks; Pollution propagation simulations; Longyearbyen at Spitsbergen; Advection-diffusion model; In-field measurements; Open source software
summary: In this paper, we propose a Physics-Informed Neural Network framework for time-dependent simulations of pollution propagation originating from moving emission sources. We formulate a robust variational framework for the time-dependent advection-diffusion problem and establish the boundedness and inf-sup stability of the corresponding discrete weak formulation. Based on this mathematical foundation, we construct a robust loss function that is directly related to the true approximation error, defined as the difference between the neural network approximation and the (unknown) exact solution. Additionally, a collocation-based strategy is introduced to speed up neural network training. As a case study, we investigate pollution propagation caused by snowmobile traffic in Longyearbyen, Spitsbergen, supported by detailed in-field measurements collected using dedicated sensors. The proposed framework is applied to analyze the effects of thermal inversion on pollutant accumulation. Our results demonstrate that thermal inversion traps dense and humid air masses near the ground, significantly enhancing particulate matter (PM) concentration and worsening local air quality.
comment: Robust Variational Physics Informed Neural Networks; Pollution propagation simulations; Longyearbyen at Spitsbergen; Advection-diffusion model; In-field measurements; Open source software

AI.title_translation: 基于搭配的稳健物理信息神经网络：斯匹次卑尔根热逆温条件下污染物扩散的时间相关模拟
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对污染物扩散的稳健物理信息神经网络框架，通过变分方法与搭配策略，成功模拟了斯匹次卑尔根群岛热逆温对空气质量的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有模拟方法在处理时间相关污染物扩散及复杂气象条件（如热逆温）时存在局限性，需要更稳健且高效的计算框架来准确模拟移动排放源的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一种针对时间相关对流扩散问题的稳健变分物理信息神经网络框架，推导了离散弱形式的稳定性，构建了与近似误差直接相关的损失函数，并采用基于搭配（collocation）的策略加速模型训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，热逆温会导致稠密潮湿的空气滞留在地面附近，显著增加了颗粒物（PM）浓度，恶化了当地空气质量，验证了该模型在真实环境数据下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一种稳健的PINN框架，证明了热逆温效应会显著加剧地面污染物积聚，为极端环境下的污染物扩散模拟提供了高效的数学工具。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种用于模拟源自移动排放源的污染物扩散的时间相关物理信息神经网络框架。我们为时间相关的对流扩散问题制定了一个稳健的变分框架，并建立了相应离散弱形式的有界性和inf-sup稳定性。在此数学基础上，我们构建了一个与真实近似误差（定义为神经网络近似值与（未知）精确解之间的差值）直接相关的稳健损失函数。此外，引入了一种基于搭配的策略来加速神经网络训练。作为案例研究，我们调查了斯匹次卑尔根朗伊尔城由雪地摩托交通引起的污染物扩散，并得到了使用专用传感器收集的详细现场测量数据的支持。所提出的框架被应用于分析热逆温对污染物积聚的影响。我们的结果表明，热逆温将稠密和潮湿的空气团困在地面附近，显著增强了颗粒物（PM）浓度并恶化了当地空气质量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于时间相关污染物扩散模拟的稳健物理信息神经网络框架。通过建立变分公式及相应的稳定性分析，作者构建了直接关联近似误差的损失函数，并引入搭配策略加速训练。案例研究证实了该框架在模拟斯匹次卑尔根群岛热逆温条件下污染物积聚方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 污染物扩散, 热逆温, 变分框架, 斯匹次卑尔根
AI.comments: 该研究将物理信息神经网络（PINN）与变分框架相结合，通过构建与近似误差直接相关的损失函数，提升了模型的鲁棒性。其创新点在于引入搭配（collocation）策略加速训练，并成功应用于斯匹次卑尔根群岛的真实环境案例，验证了其在复杂气象条件下的有效性。

title: Delay Modeling with Conformable and Caputo Derivatives: Analytical and Computational Insights
summary: This work presents an analytical and computational study of fractional-order delay differential equations formulated using both the conformable and Caputo derivatives. For the conformable case, we develop the associated integral, exponential function, and Laplace transform, showing how the conformable Laplace framework preserves algebraic structure and facilitates explicit solutions. Delay terms are treated through series expansions and transform-based methods, ensuring causal and finite representations. In parallel, Caputo-based formulations are examined, highlighting the challenges posed by convolutional memory kernels and the potential for long-term numerical instability. Numerical implementations are carried out using mesh-aligned algorithms: Euler and Runge--Kutta schemes for conformable dynamics, and Euler, L2--$σ$, and a series--anchored predictor--corrector method for Caputo dynamics. Comparative experiments demonstrate that conformable derivatives yield stable, consistent agreement between analytic and numerical solutions, whereas Caputo dynamics require higher-order or series-anchored schemes to suppress discretization noise and maintain long-term accuracy. These results underscore the advantages of the conformable formalism in modeling dynamic phenomena with delay and memory, offering a tractable and physically interpretable alternative to integral-based fractional models.

AI.title_translation: 利用一致性导数与Caputo导数进行时滞建模：解析与计算洞察
AI.tldr: 本文对比了两种分数阶导数在处理时滞微分方程时的优劣，发现一致性导数在计算稳定性和解析结构上优于传统的Caputo导数。
AI.motivation: 分数阶微分方程在建模时滞现象时，Caputo导数因其卷积记忆核导致计算复杂且易产生长期数值不稳定性，作者旨在通过引入一致性导数提供一种更简洁、稳定的替代建模方法。
AI.method: 针对一致性导数，开发了相应的积分、指数函数及Laplace变换框架；针对时滞项采用级数展开和变换方法；针对Caputo导数，分析了卷积核带来的挑战；数值实现上分别采用了Euler、Runge-Kutta、L2-σ及级数锚定预测-校正方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，一致性导数框架能实现解析解与数值解的高度一致且计算稳定；相比之下，Caputo动力学模型需要更高阶或特殊的数值方案来抑制离散化噪声以维持长期精度。
AI.conclusion: 一致性导数在处理时滞微分方程时表现出更优的数学结构和计算稳定性，是比传统的基于卷积核的Caputo分数阶导数更具可行性和物理可解释性的选择。
AI.translation: 本文对使用一致性导数和Caputo导数构建的分数阶时滞微分方程进行了解析和计算研究。对于一致性导数情况，我们发展了相关的积分、指数函数和Laplace变换，展示了一致性Laplace框架如何保持代数结构并促进显式解的获得。时滞项通过级数展开和基于变换的方法处理，确保了因果且有限的表示。同时，研究了基于Caputo的公式，重点分析了卷积记忆核带来的挑战以及长期数值不稳定的可能性。数值实现采用了网格对齐算法：一致性动力学采用Euler和Runge-Kutta方案，Caputo动力学采用Euler、L2-σ以及级数锚定的预测-校正方法。对比实验表明，一致性导数在解析解和数值解之间产生了稳定、一致的结果，而Caputo动力学需要更高阶或级数锚定的方案来抑制离散化噪声并保持长期精度。这些结果强调了一致性形式在模拟具有时滞和记忆的动力学现象中的优势，为基于积分的分数阶模型提供了一种易于处理且具有物理可解释性的替代方案。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于一致性导数和Caputo导数的时滞分数阶微分方程。通过建立一致性导数的Laplace变换框架，简化了解析求解过程。对比实验显示，一致性导数在处理时滞动力学时具有更好的数值稳定性和解析一致性，优于具有卷积记忆核的Caputo导数模型。
AI.keywords: 时滞微分方程, 一致性导数, Caputo导数, 数值稳定性, Laplace变换
AI.comments: 该研究通过对比一致性（conformable）导数与Caputo导数在处理时滞微分方程时的表现，提供了一种更易于分析和计算的替代方案。其创新点在于通过Laplace变换框架简化了一致性导数的解析求解，并揭示了其在数值稳定性上的优势，为复杂动力学建模提供了新视角。

title: Chinese-SkillSpan: A Span-Level Dataset for ESCO-Aligned Competency Extraction from Chinese Job Ads
summary: Job Skill Named Entity Recognition (JobSkillNER) aims to automatically extract key skill information from large-scale job posting data, which is important for improving talent-market matching efficiency and supporting personalized employment services. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first Chinese JobSkillNER dataset for recruitment texts. We propose annotation guidelines tailored to Chinese job postings and an LLM-empowered Macro-Micro collaborative annotation pipeline. The pipeline leverages the contextual understanding ability of large language models (LLMs) for initial annotation and then refines the results through expert sentence-level adjudication. Using this pipeline, we annotate more than 20,000 instances collected from four major recruitment platforms over the period 2014-2025. Based on these efforts, we release Chinese-SkillSpan, the first Chinese JobSkillNER dataset aligned with the ESCO occupational skill standard across four dimensions: knowledge, skill, transversal competence, and language competence (LSKT). Experimental results show that the dataset supports effective model training and evaluation, indicating that Chinese-SkillSpan helps fill a major gap in Chinese JobSkillNER resources and provides a useful benchmark for intelligent recruitment research. Code and data are available at https://sites.google.com/view/cn-skillspan-resources .

AI.title_translation: Chinese-SkillSpan：一个用于中文招聘广告中 ESCO 对齐能力提取的跨度级数据集
AI.tldr: 本文发布了首个与 ESCO 标准对齐的中文职位技能提取数据集 Chinese-SkillSpan，通过 LLM 辅助的人工标注流程构建，旨在提升中文招聘信息的智能化分析能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决中文招聘领域缺乏高质量职位技能命名实体识别（JobSkillNER）数据集的问题，以提升人才市场匹配效率及个性化就业服务水平。
AI.method: 提出了一套针对中文招聘文本的标注准则，并采用了“宏观-微观”协作标注流程：利用大语言模型（LLM）进行初步标注，随后通过专家进行句子级的裁定与精修。
AI.result: 成功构建了包含超过20,000个实例的 Chinese-SkillSpan 数据集，涵盖知识、技能、通用能力和语言能力四个维度，实验证明该数据集可有效支持模型训练与评估。
AI.conclusion: Chinese-SkillSpan 是首个对齐 ESCO 标准的中文职位技能提取数据集，为提高人才匹配效率及后续学术研究奠定了重要基础。
AI.translation: 职位技能命名实体识别（JobSkillNER）旨在从大规模招聘数据中自动提取关键技能信息，这对提高人才市场匹配效率和支持个性化就业服务至关重要。据我们所知，本研究展示了首个用于招聘文本的中文 JobSkillNER 数据集。我们提出了针对中文招聘广告的标注准则，以及一种由大语言模型（LLM）赋能的“宏观-微观”协作标注流程。该流程利用 LLM 的上下文理解能力进行初步标注，并通过专家进行句子级的裁定来精炼结果。利用该流程，我们对 2014-2025 年间从四个主要招聘平台收集的 20,000 多个实例进行了标注。基于这些工作，我们发布了 Chinese-SkillSpan，这是首个在知识、技能、通用能力和语言能力（LSKT）四个维度上与 ESCO 职业技能标准对齐的中文 JobSkillNER 数据集。实验结果表明，该数据集支持有效的模型训练和评估，这表明 Chinese-SkillSpan 填补了中文 JobSkillNER 资源的重大空白，并为智能招聘研究提供了一个有用的基准。代码和数据可在 https://sites.google.com/view/cn-skillspan-resources 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了首个对齐 ESCO 标准的中文职位技能命名实体识别数据集 Chinese-SkillSpan。研究团队通过融合 LLM 和专家人工校对的协作标注流程，从主流招聘平台收集并标注了超过 20,000 个实例，填补了中文招聘数据资源的空白，并为智能招聘领域提供了可靠的评估基准。
AI.keywords: 中文职位技能命名实体识别, ESCO, 数据集构建, 大型语言模型, 自动标注
AI.comments: 该研究填补了中文招聘领域技能命名实体识别数据集的空白。其创新之处在于结合了LLM辅助标注与人工精修的“宏观-微观”协作流程，并首次实现了与ESCO职业技能标准的对齐，为智能招聘研究提供了高质量的基准。

title: GenAssets: Generating in-the-wild 3D Assets in Latent Space
summary: High-quality 3D assets for traffic participants are critical for multi-sensor simulation, which is essential for the safe end-to-end development of autonomy. Building assets from in-the-wild data is key for diversity and realism, but existing neural-rendering based reconstruction methods are slow and generate assets that render well only from viewpoints close to the original observations, limiting their usefulness in simulation. Recent diffusion-based generative models build complete and diverse assets, but perform poorly on in-the-wild driving scenes, where observed actors are captured under sparse and limited fields of view, and are partially occluded. In this work, we propose a 3D latent diffusion model that learns on in-the-wild LiDAR and camera data captured by a sensor platform and generates high-quality 3D assets with complete geometry and appearance. Key to our method is a "reconstruct-then-generate" approach that first leverages occlusion-aware neural rendering trained over multiple scenes to build a high-quality latent space for objects, and then trains a diffusion model that operates on the latent space. We show our method outperforms existing reconstruction and generation based methods, unlocking diverse and scalable content creation for simulation.

AI.title_translation: GenAssets：在隐空间中生成真实场景的3D资产
AI.tldr: GenAssets 是一种新型3D隐空间扩散模型，通过结合遮挡感知神经渲染与扩散技术，能从稀疏且受限的真实驾驶场景数据中生成高质量、完整的3D资产，为自动驾驶仿真提供了高效的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经渲染重建方法在非原始视角下表现不佳，而现有的扩散模型在处理真实驾驶场景（稀疏视角、遮挡严重）时效果欠佳，亟需一种能从真实数据中生成高质量、多样化且完整3D资产的方法用于自动驾驶仿真。
AI.method: 提出了一种“先重建后生成”的方法：首先利用跨场景训练的遮挡感知神经渲染构建高质量的物体隐空间，随后在该隐空间上训练扩散模型以生成完整的3D几何与外观。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在资产生成的质量、完整性以及多样性方面均优于现有的重建和生成方法，能够支持大规模的仿真内容创建。
AI.conclusion: GenAssets 成功通过在隐空间进行扩散生成，实现了从稀疏、遮挡的真实世界数据中合成高质量、完整3D资产的目标，在自动驾驶仿真领域展现了显著的性能优势。
AI.translation: 用于交通参与者的高质量3D资产对于多传感器仿真至关重要，这对于自动驾驶的端到端开发至关重要。利用真实场景数据构建资产是实现多样性和真实性的关键，但现有的基于神经渲染的重建方法速度缓慢，且生成的资产仅在接近原始观测视角的范围内渲染效果良好，限制了其在仿真中的应用。最近基于扩散的生成模型虽然能构建完整且多样的资产，但在真实驾驶场景中表现不佳，因为观测到的主体通常是在稀疏、有限的视野下被捕获，且存在部分遮挡。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种3D隐空间扩散模型，该模型学习传感器平台捕获的真实激光雷达和相机数据，并生成具有完整几何结构和外观的高质量3D资产。我们方法的关键在于一种“先重建后生成”的方法，即首先利用跨场景训练的遮挡感知神经渲染来构建高质量的物体隐空间，然后训练一个在该隐空间上运行的扩散模型。我们证明了我们的方法优于现有的基于重建和生成的方法，解锁了用于仿真的多样化且可扩展的内容创作。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 GenAssets，一种针对真实世界驾驶场景的3D隐空间扩散模型。该方法通过“先重建后生成”的策略，利用遮挡感知神经渲染构建隐空间，并结合扩散模型，实现了从有限的真实传感器数据中生成高质量、完整的3D资产，有效解决了自动驾驶仿真中的资产构建难题。
AI.keywords: 3D资产生成, 隐空间扩散模型, 自动驾驶仿真, 神经渲染, 真实场景数据
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了神经渲染与扩散模型，解决了自动驾驶领域中真实场景3D资产重建与生成的难题。通过构建隐空间实现“先重建后生成”，在保证资产完整性的同时提升了生成的多样性，对于自动驾驶仿真具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: On-Device Vision Training, Deployment, and Inference on a Thumb-Sized Microcontroller
comments: 25 pages; 3 figures; 3 tables. Code and datasets available at https://github.com/webmcu-ai/on-device-vision-ai. Paper 1 of the webmcu-ai series. Implements end-to-end on-device CNN training and inference on a thumb-sized microcontroller (ESP32-S3) the XIAO ML Kit in ~1,750 lines of single-file C++ without external ML dependencies
summary: This paper presents a complete, end-to-end on-device vision machine learning pipeline, comprising data acquisition, two-layer CNN training with Adam optimization, and real-time inference, executing entirely on a microcontroller-class device costing $15-40 USD. Unlike cloud-based workflows that require external infrastructure and conceal the computational pipeline from the practitioner, this system implements every step of the core ML lifecycle in approximately 1,750 lines of readable C++ that compiles in under one minute using the Arduino IDE, with no external ML dependencies. Running on the Seeed Studio ESP32-S3 XIAO ML Kit (8 MB PSRAM), the firmware achieves three-class 64x64 image classification in approximately 9 minutes per training run, with real-time inference at 6.3 FPS. Key contributions include: correct batch-level gradient accumulation; pre-computed resize lookup tables for inference; dual-format weight export for SD-free baked-in deployment; a three-tier weight priority system (SD binary > baked-in header > He-initialization) resolved automatically at boot; a single-constant network reconfiguration interface; and PSRAM-aware memory management suited to microcontroller constraints. All source code and reference datasets are released under the MIT License at https://github.com/webmcu-ai/on-device-vision-ai

AI.title_translation: 在拇指大小的微控制器上进行设备端视觉训练、部署与推理
AI.tldr: 在低成本微控制器上实现了完全脱离云端的端到端视觉模型训练与实时推理系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的云端机器学习工作流依赖外部基础设施且流程不透明，作者旨在开发一种完全在低成本、资源受限的微控制器上运行的端到端视觉机器学习系统。
AI.method: 在ESP32-S3微控制器上实现了包含数据采集、两层CNN训练（Adam优化）和实时推理的完整流水线。采用批处理级梯度累积、预计算调整大小查找表、PSRAM内存管理及三级权重优先级系统等优化技术。
AI.result: 在Seeed Studio ESP32-S3上实现了64x64的三分类图像识别，训练仅需约9分钟，实时推理速度达到6.3 FPS，且代码量仅约1750行C++。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功证明了在低成本微控制器上进行实时视觉模型训练与推理的可行性，为边缘计算提供了一种轻量级、高效且透明的解决方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种完整的、端到端的设备端视觉机器学习流水线，包括数据采集、采用Adam优化的两层CNN训练以及实时推理，全部在成本为15-40美元的微控制器级设备上执行。与需要外部基础设施且对从业者隐藏计算流程的云端工作流不同，该系统用约1750行可读的C++代码实现了核心机器学习生命周期的每一步，使用Arduino IDE在不到一分钟内即可编译，且无外部机器学习依赖。在Seeed Studio ESP32-S3 XIAO ML Kit（8 MB PSRAM）上运行，该固件实现了三类64x64图像分类，每次训练运行约9分钟，实时推理速度为6.3 FPS。主要贡献包括：正确的批次级梯度累积；用于推理的预计算调整大小查找表；用于无需SD卡嵌入式部署的双格式权重导出；在引导时自动解析的三级权重优先级系统（SD二进制 > 嵌入式头文件 > He初始化）；单一常量网络重配置接口；以及适应微控制器约束的PSRAM感知内存管理。所有源代码和参考数据集均在MIT许可证下发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在低成本微控制器上运行的端到端视觉机器学习流水线，涵盖数据采集、模型训练与实时推理。该系统无需云端支持，在ESP32-S3上实现了高效的图像分类，并提供了针对资源受限环境的内存与性能优化方案。
AI.keywords: 微控制器, 边缘计算, 视觉机器学习, 实时训练, 嵌入式系统
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于实现了完全脱离云端、无需外部依赖的端到端微控制器视觉机器学习流程。其代码简洁、易于理解，极大地降低了嵌入式AI开发的门槛，并为资源受限设备上的实时训练与部署提供了可行的参考架构。

title: Integrated Lander-Propulsion-GNC Framework for Autonomous Lunar Powered Descent
comments: Accepted at IEEE RAST 2026, 13-15 May, Istanbul, Türkiye. 6 pages. \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. Personal use permitted; other uses require IEEE permission
summary: This paper presents an integrated lander-propulsion-GNC framework for autonomous lunar powered descent. The BUG VTVL test vehicle serves as the reference platform, with the YUNT V0 throttleable bipropellant engine providing variable thrust across a wide operating envelope, integrated with a real-time successive convexification guidance solver. The vehicle design accounts for structural configuration, landing stability, center-of-mass migration, and inertia evolution, while the propulsion architecture defines the throttle ratio, dead-zone behavior, and gimbal authority that constrain the guidance problem. A successive convexification algorithm addresses all nonconvexities; thrust lower bounds, mass depletion coupling, and thruster dead-zone behavior are all handled within a unified second-order cone program solvable in near-real time. Parametric analysis reveals a fundamental coupling between throttle ratio, pointing authority, and surface gravity. Monte Carlo simulations validate guidance robustness, achieving sub-50-meter landing precision under realistic perturbations.

AI.title_translation: 用于自主月球动力下降的集成化着陆器-推进-GNC框架
AI.tldr: 提出一种集成化框架，通过连续凸优化算法解决月球着陆器在推进系统约束下的实时制导问题，实现了高精度自主着陆。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决月球自主动力下降过程中，着陆器结构、推进系统限制与复杂制导约束之间的强耦合问题，以实现高精度的自主着陆。
AI.method: 提出了一种集成化的设计框架，利用连续凸优化算法（Successive Convexification）将推力下界、质量消耗耦合及推力器死区行为统一转化为二阶锥规划问题进行实时求解。
AI.result: 参数分析揭示了推力比、指向能力与表面重力之间的基本耦合关系；Monte Carlo仿真显示，在真实扰动下，该系统能够实现小于50米的着陆精度。
AI.conclusion: 该集成框架通过统一的二阶锥规划有效解决了复杂约束下的自主着陆问题，仿真证明了其在实际干扰下实现高精度着陆的可行性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于自主月球动力下降的集成化着陆器-推进-GNC框架。以BUG VTVL试验飞行器为参考平台，结合YUNT V0可变推力双组元发动机，并集成了实时连续凸优化制导求解器。车辆设计考虑了结构配置、着陆稳定性、质心偏移及惯性演变，同时推进架构定义了制导问题中的推力比、死区行为及万向节控制权限约束。连续凸优化算法解决了所有非凸性问题；推力下界、质量消耗耦合及推力器死区行为均在可近实时求解的统一二阶锥规划中得到处理。参数分析揭示了推力比、指向能力与表面重力之间的基本耦合关系。Monte Carlo仿真验证了制导的鲁棒性，在真实扰动下实现了小于50米的着陆精度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于自主月球动力下降的集成化着陆器-推进-GNC设计框架。通过将结构特性、推进系统约束（如死区、推力比）与先进的连续凸优化制导算法相结合，实现了近实时的高精度着陆控制。仿真结果验证了该框架在复杂约束和扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 自主月球着陆, 推进系统, 制导导航与控制(GNC), 连续凸优化, 动力下降
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将着陆器结构、推进系统特性与制导算法进行了深度耦合建模，提供了一个完整的自主着陆系统框架。其局限在于仅基于特定平台（BUG VTVL）进行了仿真验证，对复杂未知环境下的鲁棒性有待进一步实地测试。

title: Approximating Energy-Constrained Drone Delivery Packing Problem for Last-Mile Logistics
summary: Collaboration between drones and trucks in a last-mile delivery system offers numerous benefits and reduces many challenges of the traditional delivery system. Here, we introduce Drone-Delivery Packing Problem, where a set of parcels, associated with delivery intervals and cost, should be delivered to customer locations. The system comprises a set of identical drones and battery stations along truck's route, where drones swap depleted batteries or recharge them. The objective is to find assignment for all parcels by using the minimum number of drones, subject to the battery budget and compatibility of each drone's assignment. We consider three variants of the problem, based on conflicting characteristics and existence of battery service stations. All are NP-hard, and we have proposed approximation algorithms for each. When there are no battery stations, we propose a constant factor approximation algorithm using first fit decreasing bin packing algorithm. When the intervals are non-conflicting, we design a $(2+ ψ)$-approximation algorithm. In the presence of both battery stations and conflicting intervals, we present a $(4+ψ)$-approximation algorithm. The algorithm is later modified into a $(3+ψ)$-approximation algorithm when the battery service stations act as swapping stations. Here $ψ$ is a function of battery budget, minimum and maximum cost of the deliveries. Finally, we validate our results and compare the performance with the optimum on different instances.

AI.title_translation: 面向最后一公里物流的能量约束无人机配送装箱问题近似算法研究
AI.tldr: 本文针对无人机与卡车协作配送中的能量受限装箱问题，提出了三种高效的近似算法，旨在最小化无人机使用数量并平衡任务冲突。
AI.motivation: 随着最后一公里物流配送需求的增加，传统的物流系统面临挑战。无人机与卡车协作虽然能提升效率，但无人机受电池能量约束限制，如何通过优化无人机任务分配以最小化无人机数量成为了一个关键的NP-hard优化问题。
AI.method: 将无人机配送任务建模为装箱问题，针对三个变体分别设计算法：1. 无电池站场景采用“首次适应递减”（First Fit Decreasing）算法；2. 非冲突任务场景设计了(2+ψ)-近似算法；3. 存在电池站且任务冲突时，设计了(4+ψ)-近似算法，并在电池交换场景下优化至(3+ψ)-近似算法。其中ψ为电池预算及成本相关的函数。
AI.result: 论文提出的近似算法在不同实例中均取得了较好的性能，且通过与最优解对比，验证了算法在处理不同复杂程度的无人机配送场景时的有效性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文针对无人机配送装箱问题（DDPP）的三个变体，提出了相应的近似算法，并在理论上证明了其性能，通过实验验证了算法的有效性，为解决此类NP-hard问题提供了可行的路径。
AI.translation: 无人机与卡车在最后一公里配送系统中的协作提供了诸多益处，并减少了传统配送系统面临的许多挑战。本文介绍了无人机配送装箱问题，即一组带有配送间隔和成本的包裹需要被送达至客户点。该系统包含一组相同的无人机以及沿卡车路线分布的电池站，无人机可在这些站点更换或充电电池。目标是在满足电池预算和无人机分配兼容性的前提下，通过使用最少数量的无人机来完成所有包裹的分配。我们根据冲突特征和电池服务站的存在情况，考虑了该问题的三个变体。所有变体均为NP-hard问题，我们为每个变体提出了近似算法。在没有电池站的情况下，我们使用“首次适应递减”（First Fit Decreasing）装箱算法提出了一个常数因子近似算法。当间隔无冲突时，我们设计了一个(2+ψ)-近似算法。在存在电池站和冲突间隔的情况下，我们提出了一个(4+ψ)-近似算法。当电池服务站作为交换站时，该算法被修改为(3+ψ)-近似算法。其中ψ是电池预算、配送最小和最大成本的函数。最后，我们验证了结果，并与不同实例下的最优解进行了性能对比。
AI.summary: 本文研究了无人机与卡车协作的“最后一公里”配送问题，提出了无人机配送装箱问题（DDPP），旨在满足电池约束的前提下，最小化配送任务所需的无人机数量。针对该问题的三个NP-hard变体，作者设计了相应的近似算法，并给出了具体的理论近似比。实验结果验证了这些算法在解决实际配送优化问题中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 无人机物流, 最后一公里配送, 装箱问题, 近似算法, 能量约束
AI.comments: 该论文针对“最后一公里”物流中无人机与卡车协作的复杂场景，提出了无人机配送装箱问题（DDPP）。其创新点在于将配送任务建模为带能量约束的装箱问题，并针对不同场景（有无电池更换站、任务冲突等）设计了多种近似算法，理论上保证了近似比。这对于解决实际物流中的资源调度优化具有重要的学术价值。

title: DeepSignature: Digitally Signed, Content-Encoding Watermarks for Robust and Transparent Image Authentication
summary: AI-powered generative models have significantly expanded the possibilities for editing, manipulating, and creating high-quality images. Particularly, images that falsely appear to originate from trusted sources pose a serious threat, undermining public trust in image authenticity. We propose DeepSignature, a novel approach that integrates the guarantees of digital signatures with the capabilities of deep neural networks. Neural networks are used both to generate content-encoding watermarks and to embed them imperceptibly into images while ensuring robust extraction. These watermarks are cryptographically verifiable, enabling source attribution and image integrity validation. DeepSignature is compatible with existing image formats and requires no special handling of signed images. It supports client-side verification, requiring only the signer's public key. Additionally, we introduce a novel latent-space verification approach to detect and localize tampering attempts. We evaluate DeepSignature in terms of imperceptibility, robustness to benign transformations, forgery detection, and its resilience against various attack scenarios. Our results highlight the inherent trade-offs between imperceptibility, robustness, and integrity verification. We demonstrate that DeepSignature reliably identifies significant forgery attempts -- achieving near 100\% in our experiments. Finally, we emphasize DeepSignature's modularity and tunable parameters, allowing adaptation to application-specific requirements. Code and model weights will be published.

AI.title_translation: DeepSignature：用于鲁棒且透明图像认证的数字签名内容编码水印
AI.tldr: DeepSignature 通过将数字签名与深度学习水印相结合，为图像提供了一种可验证来源、抗篡改且兼容现有格式的有效认证手段。
AI.motivation: 生成式 AI 技术使得图像编辑与伪造变得极其容易，导致公众对图像真实性的信任度下降，因此迫切需要一种稳健且透明的图像认证机制。
AI.method: 利用深度神经网络生成并嵌入内容编码水印，通过密码学数字签名实现来源归属和完整性验证，并引入潜空间（latent-space）验证方法来检测和定位图像篡改。
AI.result: 在实验中实现了近 100% 的重大伪造检测率，并证明了该系统对良性图像变换的鲁棒性，同时保持了水印的不可感知性，且支持客户端公钥验证。
AI.conclusion: DeepSignature 成功地将数字签名与深度水印技术融合，提供了一种既能确保图像来源真实性，又能有效检测并定位篡改的稳健图像认证方案，为应对生成式 AI 带来的虚假图像挑战提供了有效工具。
AI.translation: 人工智能驱动的生成模型极大地扩展了编辑、操纵和创建高质量图像的可能性。特别是那些虚假地看起来源自可信来源的图像，对公众在图像真实性方面的信任构成了严重威胁。我们提出了 DeepSignature，这是一种将数字签名的保证与深度神经网络能力相结合的新方法。神经网络既用于生成内容编码水印，又用于将它们不可感知地嵌入到图像中，同时确保鲁棒的提取。这些水印是密码学可验证的，能够实现来源归属和图像完整性验证。DeepSignature 与现有的图像格式兼容，不需要对签名图像进行特殊处理。它支持客户端验证，仅需要签名者的公钥。此外，我们引入了一种新的潜空间验证方法来检测和定位篡改尝试。我们在不可感知性、对良性变换的鲁棒性、伪造检测以及对各种攻击场景的抵御能力方面对 DeepSignature 进行了评估。我们的结果强调了不可感知性、鲁棒性和完整性验证之间的内在权衡。我们证明了 DeepSignature 可以可靠地识别重大的伪造尝试——在我们的实验中达到了近 100%。最后，我们强调了 DeepSignature 的模块化和可调参数，允许适应特定应用的需求。代码和模型权重将会发布。
AI.summary: DeepSignature 是一种结合数字签名与深度水印的图像认证方案。它利用神经网络将可加密验证的水印嵌入图像，不仅能确认图像来源，还能通过潜空间分析实现篡改检测与定位。该方案兼容现有图像格式，具有高度的灵活性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 图像认证, 数字签名, 深度水印, 篡改检测, 生成式 AI 安全
AI.comments: DeepSignature 的创新之处在于将传统的数字签名技术与深度学习水印相结合，既实现了密码学层面的可验证性，又具备了深度学习模型在图像处理上的灵活性。该方法在处理图像篡改检测和定位方面表现出色，且无需对现有图像格式进行修改，具有很强的实用性。局限性在于需要在不可感知性、鲁棒性和完整性验证之间进行权衡。

title: Complex SGD and Directional Bias in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
summary: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is a known stochastic iterative method popular for large-scale convex optimization problems due to its simple implementation and scalability. Some objectives, such as those found in complex-valued neural networks, benefit from updates like in SGD and Gradient Descent (GD) with a newly defined ``gradient'' that allows for complex parameters. This complex variant of the SGD/GD methods has already been proposed, but convergence guarantees without analyticity constraints have not yet been provided. We propose a variant of SGD (complex SGD) that allows for complex parameters, and we provide convergence guarantees under assumptions that parallel those from the real setting. Notably, these results extend to GD as well, and with the same set of assumptions, we confirm that some directional bias results extend from the real to the complex setting for kernel regression problems. We provide empirical results demonstrating the efficacy of the complex SGD in kernel regression problems utilizing complex reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. In particular, we demonstrate we may recover superoscillation functions and Blaschke products from the Fock Space and Hardy Space, respectively, as the optimal functions for a particular choice of a loss function.

AI.title_translation: 复数SGD与再生核希尔伯特空间中的方向偏差
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于复数参数的SGD变体，在无需解析性约束的情况下证明了其收敛性，并将实数域中的方向偏差分析扩展到了复数核回归问题中。
AI.motivation: 现有的复数SGD/GD方法缺乏在无需解析性约束下的收敛性保证，且实数域中的方向偏差结果在复数域中的适用性尚未得到确认。
AI.method: 提出了一种允许复数参数的复数SGD变体，并在与实数设置平行的假设下提供了收敛性保证，同时将其推广至梯度下降（GD）并分析了核回归中的方向偏差。
AI.result: 理论上证明了复数SGD和GD的收敛性，确认了方向偏差结果可推广至复数域，并通过实验证明了其在Fock空间和Hardy空间中恢复特定函数的能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了复数SGD和GD在无需解析性约束下的收敛性，并确认了实数域中的方向偏差结果可推广至复数域，通过实验验证了其在复杂核希尔伯特空间中的有效性。
AI.translation: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是一种众所周知的随机迭代方法，因其实现简单且具有可扩展性，在大型凸优化问题中很受欢迎。一些目标函数，例如在复值神经网络中发现的目标函数，受益于SGD和梯度下降（GD）中定义的允许复数参数的新“梯度”。这种SGD/GD方法的复数变体已经被提出，但尚未提供在没有解析性约束下的收敛性保证。我们提出了一种允许复数参数的SGD变体（复数SGD），并在与实数设置平行的假设下提供了收敛性保证。值得注意的是，这些结果也扩展到了GD，并且在相同的假设集下，我们确认了核回归问题中一些方向偏差结果从实数域扩展到了复数域。我们提供了经验结果，证明了复数SGD在利用复数再生核希尔伯特空间的核回归问题中的功效。特别是，我们证明了我们可以分别从Fock空间和Hardy空间恢复超振荡函数和Blaschke乘积，作为特定损失函数选择的最优函数。
AI.summary: 本文针对复数参数优化问题，提出了一种无需解析性约束的复数SGD算法，并证明了其收敛性。同时，论文探讨了复数域下的方向偏差，并通过核回归实验验证了该方法在处理复核希尔伯特空间任务时的有效性。
AI.keywords: 随机梯度下降, 复值神经网络, 复核希尔伯特空间, 收敛性分析, 方向偏差
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将随机梯度下降（SGD）的收敛性分析从实数域扩展到了复数域，且不需要传统的解析性约束。这为在复值神经网络和复核希尔伯特空间中应用优化算法提供了坚实的理论支持。其局限性在于主要聚焦于特定的核回归问题，对于更广泛的非线性复杂模型仍需进一步验证。

title: AmaraSpatial-10K: A Spatially and Semantically Aligned 3D Dataset for Spatial Computing and Embodied AI
summary: Web-scale 3D asset collections are abundant, but rarely deployment-ready. Assets ship with arbitrary metric scale, incorrect pivots and forward axes, brittle geometry, and textures that do not support relighting, which limits their utility for embodied AI, robotics simulation, game development, and AR/VR. We present AmaraSpatial-10K, a dataset of over 10,000 synthetic 3D assets designed for downstream use rather than volume alone. Each asset is released as a metric-scaled, semantically anchored .glb with separated PBR material maps, a convex collision hull, a paired reference image, and rich multi-sentence text metadata. The dataset spans indoor objects, vehicles, architecture, creatures, and props under a unified spatial convention. Alongside the dataset, we introduce an evaluation suite for 3D asset banks. The suite comprises a continuous Scale Plausibility Score (SPS) with an LLM-as-Judge interval protocol, an LLM Concept Density score for metadata, an anchor-error metric, and a cross-modal CLIP coherence protocol, and we use it to audit AmaraSpatial-10K alongside matched subsets from Objaverse, HSSD, ABO, and GSO. Compared with Objaverse-sourced assets, we demonstrate that AmaraSpatial-10K substantially improves text-based retrieval precision (CLIP Recall@5 of 0.612 vs 0.181, a 3.4x improvement with median rank falling from 267 to 3), and we establish that it satisfies the spatial and semantic prerequisites for physics-aware scene composition and embodied-AI asset banks, leaving those downstream evaluations to future work. AmaraSpatial-10K is publicly available on Hugging Face.

title: Understanding Representation Gaps Across Scales in Tropical Tree Species Classification from Drone Imagery
summary: Accurate classification of tropical tree species from unoccupied aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery remains challenging due to high species diversity and strong visual similarity among species at typical image resolutions (centimeters per pixel). In contrast, models trained on close-up citizen science photographs captured with smartphones achieve strong plant species classification performance. Recent advances in UAV data acquisition now enable the collection of close-up images that are spatially registered with top-view aerial imagery and approach the level of visual detail found in smartphone photographs, with the trade-off that such high-resolution photos cannot be acquired for many trees. In this work, we evaluate the performance of existing methods using paired top-view and close-up UAV imagery collected in a species-rich tropical forest. Through fine-tuning experiments, we quantify the performance gap between vision foundation models and in-domain generalist plant recognition models across both image types (high-resolution close-up versus coarser-resolution top-view imagery). We show that classification performance is consistently higher on close-up images than on top-view aerial imagery, and that this performance gap widens for rare species. Finally, we propose that self-supervised representation alignment across these two spatial scales offers a promising approach for integrating fine-grained visual information into canopy-level species classification models based on top-view UAV imagery. Leveraging high-resolution close-up UAV imagery to enhance canopy-level species classification could substantially improve large-scale monitoring of tropical forest biodiversity.

AI.title_translation: 理解热带树种无人机分类中跨尺度的表征鸿沟
AI.tldr: 通过自监督表征对齐技术整合无人机拍摄的近摄细节与顶视影像，可有效提升热带树种分类精度及生物多样性监测能力。
AI.motivation: 热带树种多样性高且外观相似，导致基于无人机顶视影像的分类精度较低，而近摄影像虽然细节丰富但覆盖范围有限，亟需解决跨尺度表征鸿沟问题。
AI.method: 利用无人机采集配对的顶视影像和高分辨率近摄影像，通过微调实验对比视觉基础模型与领域内通用植物识别模型的性能，并提出通过自监督表征对齐来整合两种尺度信息。
AI.result: 近摄图像的分类性能始终优于顶视影像，且这种性能差距在稀有物种上表现得更为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过自监督表征对齐整合多尺度视觉信息是提升热带树种无人机分类性能的有效途径，特别是对于稀有物种的识别具有重要意义。
AI.translation: 由于高物种多样性和典型影像分辨率（厘米/像素）下物种间强烈的视觉相似性，从无人机（UAV）影像中准确分类热带树种仍然具有挑战性。相比之下，使用智能手机拍摄的公民科学照片训练的模型在植物物种分类方面表现出色。无人机数据采集的最新进展现在能够收集与顶视航拍影像空间对齐、且接近智能手机照片视觉细节水平的近摄图像，但代价是无法为许多树木获取此类高分辨率照片。在这项工作中，我们评估了在物种丰富的热带森林中收集的配对顶视和近摄无人机影像的现有方法表现。通过微调实验，我们量化了视觉基础模型和领域内通用植物识别模型在两种图像类型（高分辨率近摄与较粗分辨率顶视影像）上的性能差距。我们发现，近摄图像的分类性能始终高于顶视航拍影像，并且对于稀有物种，这种性能差距会进一步扩大。最后，我们提出在这些空间尺度之间进行自监督表征对齐，为将细粒度视觉信息整合到基于顶视无人机影像的冠层树种分类模型中提供了一种有前景的方法。利用高分辨率近摄无人机影像来增强冠层树种分类，可以大幅改善热带森林生物多样性的大规模监测。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了热带森林树种无人机分类中的跨尺度表征差异。研究发现，相比于顶视影像，高分辨率近摄图像能显著提升分类准确率，且稀有物种的识别差距更大。作者提出利用自监督表征对齐技术，将近摄图像的细粒度特征整合到顶视分类模型中，以改善大规模森林生物多样性监测。
AI.keywords: 热带树种分类, 无人机影像, 尺度鸿沟, 自监督学习, 生物多样性监测
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了无人机遥感在热带树种分类中的尺度鸿沟问题，通过对比不同尺度图像（顶视与近摄）的分类表现，为利用多尺度数据提升生物多样性监测能力提供了新思路。其创新点在于提出通过自监督表征对齐来弥补这一差距，具有重要的生态监测应用价值。

title: The Prophet and the Voronoi Diagram
summary: Consider a stream of $n$ random points (say, from the unit square) arriving one by one, where a player has to make an irreversible immediate decision for each arriving point whether to pick it. The player has to pick a single point, and the payoff is the area of the cell of the picked point, in the final Voronoi diagram of \emph{all} the points. We show that there is a simple strategy so that with probability $\geq 1 - \tilde O(1/\sqrt{n})$, the player's payoff is only a constant factor smaller than the optimal choice (i.e., the one made by the prophet). This competitiveness is somewhat surprising, as this payoff is larger by a factor of $Θ( \log n)$ than the average payoff.

AI.tldr: 在随机点流中，通过一种简单策略在线选择点，其在最终Voronoi图中的胞腔面积可达到接近先知最优解的常数倍。
AI.motivation: 在在线决策场景下，探究如何从随机到达的点流中选出一个点，使其在最终构成的Voronoi图中占据最大的胞腔面积，以此实现收益最大化。
AI.method: 提出了一种简单的在线决策策略，在点依次到达时进行选择，并证明了该策略相对于先知最优解的竞争比。
AI.result: 证明了该策略的收益以至少 $1 - \tilde O(1/\sqrt{n})$ 的概率，与先知最优解相比仅差一个常数因子。这一结果优于平均预期收益 $Θ(\log n)$ 倍。
AI.conclusion: 对于随机到达的Voronoi点集，存在一种简单的在线策略，使其收益在概率意义上与先知最优解仅相差常数倍，体现了极高的竞争力。
AI.translation: 考虑一串$n$个随机点（例如来自单位正方形）一个接一个地到达，玩家必须为每个到达的点做出不可逆的即时决定，是否选择它。玩家必须选择一个点，收益是所选点在所有点的最终Voronoi图中的胞腔面积。我们展示了一种简单的策略，使得玩家的收益以至少 $1 - \tilde O(1/\sqrt{n})$ 的概率，仅比最优选择（即先知所做的选择）小一个常数因子。这种竞争力有些令人惊讶，因为该收益比平均收益大 $Θ(\log n)$ 倍。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在随机到达的$n$个点流中，在线选取一个点以最大化其在最终Voronoi图中所占胞腔面积的问题。作者提出了一种简单的选择策略，证明了该策略在概率上能达到接近最优解（先知解）的性能，且显著优于平均水平。
AI.keywords: 先知不等式, Voronoi图, 在线算法, 随机点流, 几何概率
AI.comments: 该研究将先知不等式（Prophet Inequality）理论应用于几何问题，展示了即使在信息不对称的情况下，也能通过简单策略获得接近最优的结果。其创新之处在于将Voronoi胞腔面积的随机性与在线决策过程结合。

title: CASP: Support-Aware Offline Policy Selection for Two-Stage Recommender Systems
summary: Two-stage recommender systems first choose a candidate generator and then rank items within the generated set. Because the generator decides which items are available to the ranker, changing the generator changes both the policy value and the data support used to estimate that value. This creates an offline selection problem that standard single-stage objectives do not capture: a policy may look good under a retrieval score or a raw off-policy value estimate, but still be unreliable if it depends on weakly supported generator-item pairs. We propose CASP (Coupled Action-Set Pessimism), a support-aware offline selector for finite libraries of two-stage recommender policies. CASP combines doubly robust value estimation with a support-burden penalty. We show that stagewise rules that ignore downstream continuation value can be arbitrarily suboptimal, and we derive population, finite-class, and reconstructed-propensity guarantees for conservative selection. In simulations and a reconstructed MovieLens 1M application, CASP selects lower-burden policies when estimated value and support credibility are in tension.

title: Sharp condition-number bounds for growth factors of Higham matrices in Gaussian elimination
summary: Higham's conjecture on the growth factor of complex symmetric positive definite matrices is a longstanding problem in the stability theory of Gaussian elimination without pivoting. It asserts that every complex matrix $A=B+iC$ with $B$ and $C$ real symmetric positive definite, is called Higham matrix and has growth factor $ρ_n(A)<2$. In 2013, Drury [Linear Algebra Appl. \textbf{439} (2013), no.~10, 3129--3133] proved that $ρ_n(A)\le 2$. In fact, we will see his sectorial determinant method can be refined to give the strict bound $ρ_n(A)<2$ for each fixed Higham matrix; however, the resulting constant $1+δ_A^2$ depends on the matrix $A$. In this paper, we establish sharp condition-number-dependent lower and upper bounds for the growth factors of Higham matrices, thereby providing a quantitative refinement of Drury's result. The main ingredient is a sharp scalar Schur-complement inequality, proved via a two-dimensional domination.We also obtain corresponding sharp scalar and diagonal estimates for accretive-dissipative matrices, and an improved entrywise growth bound for that broader class.

AI.title_translation: 高斯消去法中Higham矩阵增长因子的尖锐条件数界限
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入条件数依赖的尖锐界限，对Higham矩阵在高斯消去法中的增长因子猜想进行了定量改进，并将其推广至增生-耗散矩阵。
AI.motivation: Higham猜想指出复对称正定矩阵（Higham矩阵）的高斯消去法增长因子小于2，尽管Drury在2013年证明了其上界为2，但缺乏关于该界限依赖于矩阵性质的定量分析。
AI.method: 利用细化后的扇形行列式方法，并通过二维控制（two-dimensional domination）证明尖锐的标量Schur补不等式，从而推导出条件数相关的上下界。
AI.result: 确立了Higham矩阵增长因子的尖锐条件数依赖上下界，并获得了增生-耗散矩阵的尖锐标量和对角估计，以及逐项增长界限的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立与条件数相关的尖锐上下界，本文不仅证明了Higham矩阵的增长因子严格小于2，还为更广泛的增生-耗散矩阵类提供了改进的增长估计。
AI.translation: 关于复对称正定矩阵增长因子的Higham猜想是高斯消去法无选主元稳定性理论中的一个长期未决问题。该猜想断言，每个复矩阵 $A=B+iC$（其中 $B$ 和 $C$ 为实对称正定矩阵，被称为Higham矩阵）的增长因子 $ρ_n(A)<2$。2013年，Drury [Linear Algebra Appl. 439 (2013), no. 10, 3129–3133] 证明了 $ρ_n(A) \le 2$。事实上，我们将看到他的扇形行列式方法可以被细化，从而为每个固定的Higham矩阵给出严格界限 $ρ_n(A)<2$；然而，所得常数 $1+δ_A^2$ 取决于矩阵 $A$。在本文中，我们建立了Higham矩阵增长因子的尖锐条件数依赖的上下界，从而提供了Drury结果的定量细化。主要组成部分是一个尖锐的标量Schur补不等式，该不等式通过二维控制证明。我们还获得了对应于增生-耗散矩阵的尖锐标量和对角估计，以及该更广泛类别矩阵的改进逐项增长界限。
AI.summary: 本文针对Higham矩阵的高斯消去法增长因子问题，在Drury研究的基础上，通过建立与条件数相关的尖锐上下界，实现了对增长因子的定量细化。研究核心在于通过二维控制证明了尖锐的Schur补不等式，并将其应用推广至增生-耗散矩阵。
AI.keywords: Higham矩阵, 高斯消去法, 增长因子, 条件数, Schur补不等式
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入条件数相关的界限，对长期存在的Higham猜想进行了定量细化。其核心创新在于使用二维控制（two-dimensional domination）证明了尖锐的Schur补不等式，不仅解决了Higham矩阵的增长因子问题，还推广至增生-耗散矩阵，在数值线性代数稳定性理论中具有重要意义。

title: Self-Supervised Learning for Android Malware Detection on a Time-Stamped Dataset
summary: Android malware detectors built with machine learning often suffer from temporal bias: models are trained and evaluated without respecting apps' actual release times, inflating accuracy and weakening real-world robustness. We address this by constructing a time-stamped dataset of benign and malicious Android apps and introducing a timestamp-verification procedure to ensure temporal accuracy. We then propose a detection framework that uses Bootstrap Your Own Latent (BYOL) for self-supervised pre-training to learn obfuscation-resilient representations, followed by supervised classification. Under time-aware evaluation, the method attains 98% accuracy and 89% F1. We further characterize malware behavior by analyzing true positives and false negatives using VirusTotal and the MITRE ATT&CK framework. To support reproducibility and further innovation, we release our dataset and source code.

AI.title_translation: 面向带时间戳数据集的Android恶意软件检测的自监督学习研究
AI.tldr: 通过引入时间戳验证和自监督预训练（BYOL），该研究解决了Android恶意软件检测中普遍存在的时间偏差问题，实现了更具鲁棒性的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习Android恶意软件检测模型忽视了应用发布的时间顺序，导致“时间偏差”，使得评估准确率虚高，且在真实场景中鲁棒性较差。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含应用发布时间的时间戳数据集并进行时间戳验证；2. 采用BYOL（Bootstrap Your Own Latent）进行自监督预训练以学习抗混淆特征；3. 进行后续的有监督分类；4. 使用VirusTotal和MITRE ATT&CK框架进行行为分析。
AI.result: 在时间感知评估下，该方法达到了98%的准确率和89%的F1分数，并有效提升了对恶意软件行为的表征能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建时间戳数据集和采用自监督预训练方法，本研究有效缓解了Android恶意软件检测中的时间偏差问题，显著提升了模型在真实环境下的检测性能与鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 基于机器学习的Android恶意软件检测器通常遭受时间偏差的影响：在训练和评估时未考虑应用程序的实际发布时间，这导致了准确率的虚高并削弱了真实世界的鲁棒性。我们通过构建良性和恶意Android应用程序的时间戳数据集，并引入时间戳验证程序来确保时间准确性，从而解决了这一问题。随后，我们提出了一种检测框架，该框架使用“Bootstrap Your Own Latent”（BYOL）进行自监督预训练，以学习抗混淆的表示，随后进行有监督分类。在时间感知评估下，该方法达到了98%的准确率和89%的F1分数。我们进一步通过使用VirusTotal和MITRE ATT&CK框架分析真阳性和假阴性，来表征恶意软件行为。为了支持可重复性和进一步的创新，我们发布了我们的数据集和源代码。
AI.summary: 本文针对Android恶意软件检测中忽视时间因素导致的评估偏差问题，构建了一个时间戳数据集。通过引入自监督学习（BYOL）进行抗混淆特征预训练，并结合时间感知评估框架，显著提升了模型在真实场景下的检测性能。此外，研究还通过MITRE ATT&CK框架深入分析了模型检测行为。
AI.keywords: Android恶意软件检测, 时间偏差, 自监督学习, BYOL, 时间戳数据集
AI.comments: 该论文的核心创新在于引入了时间戳验证机制来解决Android恶意软件检测中的“时间偏差”问题，这对于构建具有实际部署价值的鲁棒性模型至关重要。将自监督学习（BYOL）应用于该领域，证明了在无需大量标签数据的情况下，能够有效学习到抗混淆的特征表示。

title: A Systematic Approach for Large Language Models Debugging
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become central to modern AI workflows, powering applications from open-ended text generation to complex agent-based reasoning. However, debugging these models remains a persistent challenge due to their opaque and probabilistic nature and the difficulty of diagnosing errors across diverse tasks and settings. This paper introduces a systematic approach for LLM debugging that treats models as observable systems, providing structured, model-agnostic methods from issue detection to model refinement. By unifying evaluation, interpretability, and error-analysis practices, our approach enables practitioners to iteratively diagnose model weaknesses, refine prompts and model parameters, and adapt data for fine-tuning or assessment, while remaining effective in contexts where standardized benchmarks and evaluation criteria are lacking. We argue that such a structured methodology not only accelerates troubleshooting but also fosters reproducibility, transparency, and scalability in the deployment of LLM-based systems.

AI.title_translation: 一种大语言模型调试的系统化方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用的系统化LLM调试框架，通过统一评估和分析流程，帮助开发者在缺乏标准基准的环境下更高效地诊断并优化模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型具有不透明性和概率性，导致其在处理多样化任务时诊断错误非常困难，目前缺乏系统化的调试方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种将模型视为可观测系统的通用框架，统一了评估、可解释性分析和错误诊断流程，支持通过迭代优化提示词、参数及数据来修复模型问题。
AI.result: 建立了一套结构化的模型调试方法论，能够有效帮助开发者在缺乏标准化基准的情况下，识别模型弱点、优化模型表现并提升开发效率。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种系统化的LLM调试方法，通过将模型视为可观测系统，促进了LLM部署的可重复性、透明度和可扩展性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）已成为现代人工智能工作流的核心，为从开放式文本生成到复杂的基于代理的推理等各种应用提供支持。然而，由于其不透明和概率性的本质，以及在不同任务和设置中诊断错误的难度，调试这些模型仍然是一个持久的挑战。本文介绍了一种系统化的大语言模型调试方法，将模型视为可观测系统，提供了从问题检测到模型优化的结构化、与模型无关的方法。通过统一评估、可解释性和错误分析实践，我们的方法使从业者能够迭代地诊断模型弱点、优化提示词和模型参数，并调整数据以进行微调或评估，同时在缺乏标准化基准和评估标准的背景下依然有效。我们认为，这种结构化的方法论不仅加速了故障排除，还促进了基于LLM系统的部署的可重复性、透明度和可扩展性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对大语言模型的系统化调试方法。该方法将LLM视为可观测系统，通过整合评估、可解释性技术和错误分析，为开发者提供了一套从问题检测到模型优化的通用流程，以解决LLM不透明和难以调试的问题。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 模型调试, 系统化方法, 可解释性, 错误分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种将LLM视为可观测系统的调试框架，填补了当前LLM开发中缺乏系统性调试方法的空白。其创新点在于将评估、可解释性和错误分析统一起来，具有很好的通用性，特别适用于缺乏标准化基准的任务。但文中未提及具体的量化指标，实际应用效果有待进一步验证。

title: Equivariant Filter for Radar-Inertial Odometry
summary: Radar-Inertial Odometry (RIO) based on the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) relies on accurate extrinsic calibration between the radar and the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and is sensitive to disturbances, as large linearization errors can degrade performance or even cause divergence. To address these limitations, this letter proposes an Equivariant Filter (EqF) for RIO based on a Lie group symmetry that geometrically couples navigation states and IMU biases, extending it to incorporate radar-IMU extrinsic calibration and multi-state constraint updates. This equivariant formulation inherently preserves consistency and enhances robustness, enabling reliable state estimation even under poor or completely wrong initialization of calibration states. Real-world experiments on two different Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) show that the proposed EqF-RIO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under correct extrinsic calibration and offers improved convergence under large calibration errors, where the conventional EKF-RIO fails. Evaluation code is open-sourced.

title: The Decay of Impact with Network Distance in Linear Diffusion Processes
summary: Many processes related to status, power, and influence within social networks have been modeled using forced linear diffusion models; examples include the highly successful Friedkin-Johnsen model of social influence, the status/power scores of Katz and Bonacich, and the widely used network autocorrelation model. While a basic assumption of such models is that the impact of one individual on another through any given path falls exponentially with path length, the total impact of the first individual on the second involves contributions from walks of all lengths; thus, while total impact is expected to decline with network distance, the relationship is not trivial. Here, we provide an approximate solution for the total impact of one node on another as a function of network distance, showing that the total impact is given to first order by a product of eigenvector centrality scores together with an expression in terms of the graph spectrum (eigenvalues of the adjacency matrix) that falls exponentially with distance. We also show how this solution can be refined using higher-order eigenvectors of the adjacency matrix. A numerical study on interpersonal networks drawn from educational settings verifies an average exponential decline in impact strength under the linear diffusion model, and shows that the first-order eigenvector approximation can often be a good proxy for total impact as obtained from the exact solution. This suggests a simple model that can be used to approximate total impact for social influence or status processes in a range of settings.

AI.title_translation: 线性扩散过程中影响力随网络距离的衰减
AI.tldr: 本文通过数学推导发现线性扩散中的总影响力随网络距离呈指数下降，并提出了一个基于特征向量中心性的简单近似公式，经数值验证表现良好。
AI.motivation: 虽然线性扩散模型（如Friedkin-Johnsen模型、Katz/Bonacich中心性）假设路径影响力随距离呈指数衰减，但由于总影响力涉及所有长度路径的贡献，其随网络距离的整体变化关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过解析推导，将节点间的总影响力表达为特征向量中心性与图谱（邻接矩阵特征值）函数的乘积；并利用高阶特征向量对近似结果进行修正。此外，通过教育环境下的社交网络数据进行数值验证。
AI.result: 研究发现，线性扩散过程中的总影响力随网络距离呈平均指数下降；一阶特征向量中心性近似值在大多数情况下能很好地拟合精确解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了线性扩散过程中的总影响力随网络距离呈指数下降，并提供了一个基于特征向量中心性的简单有效近似公式，为社交影响力和地位过程的建模提供了有力工具。
AI.translation: 许多涉及社交网络中地位、权力和影响力的过程都使用了强制线性扩散模型进行建模；例如，非常成功的Friedkin-Johnsen社会影响模型、Katz和Bonacich的地位/权力得分，以及广泛使用的网络自相关模型。虽然这些模型的一个基本假设是，一个个体对另一个体通过任意给定路径的影响力随路径长度呈指数下降，但第一个个体对第二个个体的总影响力涉及所有长度路径的贡献；因此，虽然总影响力预期会随网络距离下降，但这种关系并非显而易见。在这里，我们提供了一个节点间总影响力随网络距离变化的近似解，表明总影响力的一阶近似是由特征向量中心性得分的乘积，以及一个随距离呈指数下降的图谱（邻接矩阵的特征值）表达式给出的。我们还展示了如何使用邻接矩阵的高阶特征向量来细化该解。对教育环境中人际网络的数值研究验证了线性扩散模型下影响力强度的平均指数下降，并表明一阶特征向量近似值通常可以作为精确解所得总影响力的良好代理。这提出了一个简单的模型，可用于近似各种设置下社会影响或地位过程的总影响力。
AI.summary: 本文研究了线性扩散模型中网络节点间总影响力的衰减规律。通过数学推导，证明了总影响力随网络距离呈指数下降，并提出了一个基于特征向量中心性的近似计算模型。数值实验验证了该近似方法在社交网络应用中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 线性扩散模型, 网络距离, 影响力传播, 特征向量中心性, 社交网络
AI.comments: 该论文为理解线性扩散模型中节点间的影响力传播提供了一个优雅的数学近似，简化了计算复杂性，具有很高的理论和应用价值。其局限性在于主要基于线性扩散模型，可能难以完全捕捉非线性社交互动过程的复杂性。

title: Remote Concolic Multiverse Debugging -- Extended Version with Additional Appendices
summary:
Debugging nondeterministic programs is inherently difficult, particularly in microcontroller environments where execution paths can diverge unpredictably due to external sensor inputs. Traditional debugging techniques often fail to capture or reproduce this nondeterministic behavior effectively. Multiverse debugging has emerged as a compelling technique to debug nondeterministic programs, allowing developers to systematically explore all possible execution paths. Unfortunately, current multiverse debuggers are snapshot-based and most operate over a model of the program, limiting their use for debugging resource-constrained microcontrollers. Additionally, current multiverse debuggers, even ones specifically designed for microcontrollers suffer from state explosion making the state space overwhelming during debugging.
  To address these challenges, we introduce a trace-based multiverse debugger with a novel state-space reduction technique based on concolic execution. Our approach interleaves concolic analysis with live debugging to identify input values that define unique program paths. This hybrid technique efficiently prunes redundant paths from the state space while ensuring full code coverage. Unlike MIO, a recently published multiverse debugger for microcontrollers that focuses on IO consistency, our approach directly targets state explosion by leveraging concolic execution and uses a trace-based approach, significantly reducing the memory and communication overhead.
  We implemented a prototype using the WARDuino WebAssembly VM, demonstrating the feasibility and efficiency of our approach in real-world scenarios. Our results highlight substantial reductions in the state space compared to traditional multiverse debugging. This makes multiverse debugging more accessible and efficient for developers working with complex, nondeterministic programs running on microcontrollers.

AI.title_translation: 远程具体化多元宇宙调试——含附加附录的扩展版本
AI.tldr: 通过结合具体化执行与追踪技术，该调试器有效解决了微控制器程序中非确定性行为导致的状态空间爆炸难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的多元宇宙调试器多基于快照模型，在资源受限的微控制器上难以应用，且普遍面临状态空间爆炸问题，导致调试效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于具体化执行的追踪式（trace-based）多元宇宙调试方法，将具体化分析与实时调试交替进行，以识别并修剪冗余的程序路径，从而降低状态空间复杂度。
AI.result: 在WARDuino WebAssembly虚拟机上的原型验证显示，该方法相比传统多元宇宙调试技术，能够大幅缩减状态空间，有效降低了内存和通信开销。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了基于具体化执行的追踪式多元宇宙调试在微控制器环境中的可行性，通过有效剪枝状态空间，显著提升了调试效率。
AI.translation: 调试非确定性程序具有内在的困难，特别是在微控制器环境中，由于外部传感器输入，执行路径可能会不可预测地发生偏差。传统的调试技术往往无法有效捕获或重现这种非确定性行为。多元宇宙调试作为一种调试非确定性程序的有力技术手段应运而生，允许开发者系统地探索所有可能的执行路径。然而，当前的多元宇宙调试器多基于快照，且大多在程序模型上运行，限制了其在资源受限微控制器上的应用。此外，现有的多元宇宙调试器，即使是专门为微控制器设计的，也存在状态爆炸问题，使得调试过程中的状态空间过于庞大。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一种基于具体化执行（concolic execution）的追踪式多元宇宙调试器，并提出了一种新颖的状态空间缩减技术。我们的方法将具体化分析与实时调试交替进行，以识别定义独特程序路径的输入值。这种混合技术在确保完整代码覆盖率的同时，有效地从状态空间中修剪了冗余路径。与最近发表的专注于IO一致性的微控制器多元宇宙调试器MIO不同，我们的方法通过利用具体化执行直接针对状态爆炸问题，并采用追踪式方法，显著降低了内存和通信开销。我们在WARDuino WebAssembly虚拟机上实现了原型，证明了我们的方法在实际场景中的可行性和高效性。我们的结果突显了与传统多元宇宙调试相比，该方法在状态空间上的大幅缩减，使得多元宇宙调试对于在微控制器上运行复杂、非确定性程序的开发者而言更加易用和高效。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对微控制器的追踪式多元宇宙调试器，通过融合具体化执行技术来动态识别并修剪冗余路径，从而解决传统方法中的状态空间爆炸问题，并显著降低了资源消耗。
AI.keywords: 多元宇宙调试, 具体化执行, 微控制器, 状态空间缩减, 非确定性程序
AI.comments: 该论文通过结合具体化执行（concolic execution）与多元宇宙调试，创新性地解决了嵌入式系统中非确定性程序调试的“状态爆炸”问题。其核心优势在于通过路径分析减少了冗余，降低了内存与通信开销，为资源受限环境下的复杂调试提供了切实可行的方案。

title: Preserving Long-Tailed Expert Information in Mixture-of-Experts Tuning
summary: Despite MoE models leading many benchmarks, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for the MoE architectures remains difficult because its router layers are fragile. Methods such as DenseMixer and ESFT mitigate router collapse with dense mixing or auxiliary load-balancing losses, but these introduce noisy gradients that often degrade performance. In preliminary experiments, we systematically pruned experts and observed that while certain super experts are activated far more frequently, discarding less used experts still leads to notable performance degradation. This suggests that even rarely activated experts encode non-trivial knowledge useful for downstream tasks. Motivated by this, we propose an auxiliary-loss-free MoE SFT framework that combines bias-driven sparsification with always-active gated condenser experts. Rather than enforcing balanced activation across all experts, our method encourages task-relevant experts to remain active while pushing long-tailed experts toward inactivity. The condenser experts provide a persistent, learnable pathway that alleviates gradient starvation and facilitates consolidation of information that would otherwise remain fragmented across sparsely activated experts. Analysis further suggest that this design better preserves long-tailed expert information under sparse routing. Experiments on large-scale MoE models demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art SFT baselines such as DenseMixer and ESFT, achieving average gain of 2.5%+ on both mathematical reasoning and commonsenseQA benchmarks.

title: Approaching the Conway-99 problem using SAT solvers
summary: The Conway-99 problem questions the existence of a strongly regular graph with 99 vertices and specific parameters. A \textit{strongly} regular graph is a regular graph that exhibits two additional properties: vertices must share a fixed number of neighbours, depending on whether they are adjacent or not, given by two parameters. Despite the search space for this graph being finite, the computational power needed to traverse it is substantial. Therefore, better strategies are required in order to find this graph or prove its non-existence. SAT solvers, designed to solve instances of boolean satisfiability formulas, have been developed and optimised significantly due to the simplicity of SAT problems. Based on Cook-Levin's theorem, computer scientists have been focusing on developing efficient SAT solvers as many problems can be reduced to a SAT problem instance. Hence, we decided to approach the Conway-99 problem using SAT solvers. To do this, we study strongly regular graphs' properties and SAT solvers' capabilities. By encoding the problem of finding strongly regular graphs into SAT instances and running experimental tests, we shall see the incapability of SAT solvers facing this problem in a reasonable time. We will then explore the underlying mathematical reasons for these limitations.

title: Control Barrier Functions Solved with Hierarchical Quadratic Programming for Safe Physical Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Physical human-robot interaction offers the potential to leverage human intelligence and robot physical capabilities to enable a range of exciting applications, e.g., collaborative robots for rehabilitation. Safety is critical for the successful deployment of this kind of robotic system. In recent years, Control Barrier Function (CBF) has emerged as an effective approach to enforce safety guarantees, which has been widely applied in various applications, from adaptive cruise control to navigation of legged robots. CBFs can be solved in a Quadratic Programming (QP) problem, which can include many CBF-formulated tasks. To manage a large number of safety tasks, a hierarchical CBF has been used to allow hierarchical relaxation of safety tasks to ensure the feasibility of a solution in the presence of conflicting tasks. In this work, we propose to use a CBF-based Hierarchical Quadratic Programming (HQP) framework in physical human-robot interaction to allow us to design both performance tasks (e.g., preserve the desired behavior at the human-robot interaction point) and safety tasks at any level of a hierarchy to balance the safety and the performance in a more flexible way. Extensive experiments were carried out on a real redundant robot to validate the effectiveness, flexibility, and generality of this approach.

AI.title_translation: 用于安全物理人机交互的层级二次规划控制障碍函数求解方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用层级二次规划（HQP）来求解控制障碍函数（CBF），从而在物理人机交互中灵活地平衡安全约束与任务性能。
AI.motivation: 在物理人机交互中，如何同时保证安全性和执行性能是一个挑战，且现有的CBF方法在处理大量相互冲突的复杂任务时存在可行性问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的层级二次规划（HQP）框架，允许将安全任务和性能任务置于层级结构的不同优先级，通过松弛机制解决冲突。
AI.result: 在实际冗余机器人上的实验表明，该方法能够成功实现安全约束与人机交互性能任务的有效平衡，且具有良好的灵活性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在冗余机器人上的实验验证，该方法能够有效地在物理人机交互中平衡安全任务与性能任务，证明了其灵活性和通用性。
AI.translation: 物理人机交互有望结合人类智能与机器人的物理能力，从而实现包括康复机器人等在内的一系列应用。安全性是此类机器人系统成功部署的关键。近年来，控制障碍函数（CBF）作为一种强制执行安全保证的有效方法脱颖而出，被广泛应用于从自适应巡航控制到足式机器人导航等各种应用中。CBF可以通过二次规划（QP）问题来求解，该问题可包含许多由CBF制定的任务。为了管理大量安全任务，层级化CBF被用于允许对安全任务进行分层松弛，以确保在存在冲突任务时解的可行性。在这项工作中，我们提议在物理人机交互中使用基于CBF的层级二次规划（HQP）框架，使我们能够在层级的任何级别设计性能任务（例如，在人机交互点保持期望的行为）和安全任务，从而以更灵活的方式平衡安全性和性能。在真实的冗余机器人上进行了大量实验，以验证该方法的有效性、灵活性和通用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合控制障碍函数（CBF）与层级二次规划（HQP）的框架，旨在解决物理人机交互中安全与性能任务之间的冲突。通过层级化的任务处理方式，该方法能够灵活地调整安全与性能任务的优先级，确保在复杂交互环境下系统的安全性和任务执行效率。
AI.keywords: 控制障碍函数 (CBF), 层级二次规划 (HQP), 物理人机交互, 安全控制, 任务优先级
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入层级二次规划（HQP）来解决传统CBF在处理复杂任务时的冲突问题，为物理人机交互中的安全与性能平衡提供了一种灵活且实用的框架，具有较好的工程应用价值。

title: Within-person prediction of depressive symptom change using year-long Screenome data and CES-D assessments
summary: Predicting whether an individual's depressive symptoms will worsen, remain stable, or improve over the coming weeks can enable earlier and more targeted care, yet prospective within-person trajectory prediction remains largely unaddressed in digital phenotyping. We combine fortnightly CES-D assessments with over 100 million screenshots captured every five seconds via the Stanford Screenomics platform from 96 adults followed for approximately one year (M = 20.9, SD = 3.9 assessments per participant, 2,002 total observations). We frame prediction as a within-person classification task: whether symptoms will worsen, remain stable, or improve over the subsequent fortnight, operationalized in three ways to capture clinically meaningful change. Under temporal holdout, XGBoost achieves an AUC of 0.906 for crossings of established CES-D severity bands and 0.755 for change relative to each participant's own within-person variability, generalizing to unseen individuals (AUC = 0.821). Each person's typical symptom level was the only statistically significant predictor above the most recent CES-D score; without it, the most consequential worsening transitions go undetected. Screenome-derived behavioral features revealed prodromal patterns of worsening, including escalating social media use, fragmented device engagement, and changes in overnight activity, with substantial individual heterogeneity. These findings establish a proof-of-concept foundation for monitoring systems that could identify individuals approaching clinical deterioration before symptoms reach a crisis point.

AI.title_translation: 利用为期一年的屏幕组学数据和CES-D评估进行个体内部抑郁症状变化的预测
AI.tldr: 研究利用手机屏幕交互数据成功预测了个人未来两周的抑郁症状波动，识别出了如设备使用碎片化等关键预警行为。
AI.motivation: 为了解决当前数字表型研究中缺乏针对个体内部症状轨迹的前瞻性预测问题，从而实现抑郁症的早期识别与精准干预。
AI.method: 研究采用个体内部的分类任务框架，结合XGBoost算法，利用96名参与者为期一年的CES-D抑郁量表评估及屏幕截图数据（Screenomics），对未来两周内抑郁症状（恶化、稳定、改善）进行预测。
AI.result: XGBoost模型在预测症状跨度变化时表现出高准确性（AUC达0.906），并识别出包括社交媒体使用增加、设备使用碎片化及夜间活动改变等在内的抑郁恶化前兆行为模式。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了利用屏幕交互数据预测抑郁症状变化的临床可行性，为开发能够预防临床恶化的实时监测系统奠定了概念验证基础。
AI.translation: 预测个体的抑郁症状在未来几周内是会恶化、保持稳定还是改善，可以实现更早、更有针对性的护理，然而在数字表型分析中，前瞻性的个体内部轨迹预测仍未得到充分解决。我们结合了每两周一次的CES-D评估和通过斯坦福Screenomics平台每五秒捕获一次的超过1亿张屏幕截图，对96名成年人进行了为期约一年的跟踪（平均每位参与者20.9次评估，总计2002次观测）。我们将预测定义为个体内部的分类任务：即症状在随后的两周内是会恶化、保持稳定还是改善，并以三种方式进行操作以捕捉具有临床意义的变化。在时间留出法下，XGBoost在跨越既定CES-D严重程度带时的AUC达到0.906，在相对于每个参与者自身内部变异的变化预测中AUC达到0.755，并推广到未见过的个体（AUC = 0.821）。每个人的典型症状水平是除最近一次CES-D分数外唯一具有统计学意义的预测指标；如果没有它，最严重的恶化转变将无法被检测到。源自屏幕组学的行为特征揭示了恶化的前驱模式，包括社交媒体使用增加、设备参与碎片化以及夜间活动的变化，并表现出显著的个体异质性。这些发现为监测系统建立了一个概念验证基础，该系统可以在症状达到临界点之前识别出接近临床恶化的个体。
AI.summary: 本研究利用为期一年的屏幕交互数据与抑郁量表评估，通过XGBoost算法构建了个体内部的抑郁症状变化预测模型。结果显示，该模型能有效识别症状恶化的预警行为模式，为预防性心理健康监测提供了新的技术路径。
AI.keywords: 数字表型, 抑郁症, 屏幕组学, 纵向预测, 行为模式
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模、细粒度的“屏幕组学”（Screenomics）数据捕捉个体的数字行为轨迹，为抑郁症的早期预警提供了极具潜力的客观指标。其创新点在于将预测任务细化为“个体内部”的动态变化，并成功识别了如社交媒体使用增加、设备使用碎片化等预警性行为模式。然而，该研究仍面临个体差异大、模型对基线症状水平的高度依赖等挑战。

title: A Differentiable Framework for Global Circulation Model Precipitation Bias Correction
summary: Systematic biases in Global Circulation Model (GCM) outputs limit their direct applicability in regional planning, necessitating bias correction. Correcting precipitation is particularly challenging due to its non-Gaussian distribution, intermittent nature, and non-linear extremes. However, traditional statistical methods cannot learn from big data and easily address systematic biases in the GCMs, and while machine learning does provide this flexibility, their black-box type functionality hinders us from understanding these biases completely which also further prevents generalization across different GCMs and locations, especially for precipitation. In this study, we propose a differentiable bias adjustment framework called δCLIMBA (or dCLIMBA), that learns a spatiotemporally adaptive parametric bias adjustment procedure between historical CMIP6 model outputs and reference reanalysis datasets (Livneh). Results demonstrate that the proposed method accurately corrects both the magnitude and distribution of extreme storm events, with particularly strong performance in capturing extremes. The quantile distribution of precipitation is well reproduced across diverse U.S. cities, and spatial patterns perform comparably to the widely used LOCA2 statistical downscaling technique. In addition, the framework showed future trend preservation unlike pure quantile based methods and LOCA2; and results from bias correction over unseen regions showed that the marginal biases were attenuated. This work presents a modular, computationally efficient and extensible bias correction approach that is physically informed, scalable, and compatible with both historical and future applications. Its flexibility makes it suitable for integration into Earth system post-processing pipelines and impact workflows.

title: Shape of Memory: a Geometric Analysis of Machine Unlearning in Second-Order Optimizers
comments: Full experiment data available at secondstreetlabs.io
summary: We argue that current definitions of machine unlearning are underspecified for second-order optimizers. We compare first-order and second-order learners for their ability to handle the data deletion task with varying degrees of eigendecomposition to mimic the loss model memory. While both first and second-order methods realign with the ideal counterfactul in terms of performance and gradient, the second-order optimizer shows significant volatility in the optimizer state. This indicates residual information, supposedly deleted, that isn't detectable by first-order analysis. Various eigendecay treatments show that stability and information loss is regained only under controlled state pertubation where geometric information (or memory) is erased.
comment: Full experiment data available at secondstreetlabs.io

AI.title_translation: 记忆的形状：二阶优化器中机器遗忘的几何分析
AI.tldr: 二阶优化器在遗忘任务中虽能对齐性能，但其状态中仍残留着一阶分析无法检测到的隐性记忆，需通过几何扰动来彻底擦除。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器遗忘定义对于二阶优化器而言不够明确，且二阶优化器在遗忘任务中表现出的状态波动暗示了存在一阶分析无法检测到的隐性信息残留。
AI.method: 通过对比一阶与二阶学习器在数据删除任务中的表现，利用不同程度的特征分解（eigendecomposition）来模拟损失模型记忆，并研究受控状态扰动（eigendecay treatments）对消除残留信息的作用。
AI.result: 研究发现，二阶优化器在性能和梯度上能实现反事实对齐，但其优化器状态存在显著波动，表明存在未被删除的残留信息；通过受控的几何状态扰动，可以有效消除这些残留的几何记忆。
AI.conclusion: 二阶优化器在执行遗忘任务时会保留隐性记忆，仅通过一阶指标（性能和梯度）无法完全确保遗忘效果，必须通过受控的状态扰动来擦除几何记忆。
AI.translation: 我们认为，当前的机器遗忘定义对于二阶优化器来说是不够明确的。我们比较了一阶和二阶学习器在处理数据删除任务时的能力，通过不同程度的特征分解来模拟损失模型记忆。虽然一阶和二阶方法在性能和梯度方面都能与理想的反事实对齐，但二阶优化器在优化器状态上表现出显著的波动。这表明存在据称已被删除但无法通过一阶分析检测到的残留信息。各种特征衰减处理表明，只有在受控的状态扰动下，当几何信息（或记忆）被擦除时，稳定性和信息丢失才能恢复。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了二阶优化器在机器遗忘任务中的局限性，指出其优化器状态中隐藏着一阶分析无法察觉的残留记忆。研究通过特征分解与状态扰动实验，证明了仅靠性能对齐不足以实现彻底遗忘，必须从几何层面擦除优化器状态中的信息。
AI.keywords: 机器遗忘, 二阶优化器, 几何分析, 模型记忆, 特征分解
AI.comments: 该论文通过几何视角揭示了二阶优化器在机器遗忘（Machine Unlearning）任务中的隐性挑战，指出单纯的性能或梯度对齐不足以完全消除模型记忆。其创新点在于引入了对优化器状态的几何分析，为理解复杂优化器中的信息残留提供了新思路。限制在于未提供具体的遗忘算法实现，仅探讨了理论现象。

title: The Impact of Documentation on Test Engagement in Pull Requests in OSS
summary:
Automated testing is crucial for maintaining open-source software quality. However, motivating contributors to include tests for code changes remains a challenge. While existing interventions, such as code coverage metrics and reviewer feedback, are often reactive and applied only after a pull request is opened, this study investigates whether documentation on testing can serve as a proactive measure to encourage testing behavior.
  In this work, we investigate the relationship between documentation on testing and contributor testing behavior. We introduce the Test Engagement Ratio (TER) to help understand testing frequency. Using data from 160 OSS repositories, we analyze the relationship between documentation comprehensiveness and TER. Our results show a weak but statistically significant positive correlation ($ρ=0.36$, $p<0.001$), which strengthens to a moderate relationship ($ρ=0.44$) in repositories with higher pull request activity. Documentation categories such as How to Run Tests and How to Write Tests show the strongest correlation with testing engagement. Furthermore, TER is found to be moderately correlated ($ρ=0.52$, $p<0.001$) with Test Code Ratio, providing preliminary evidence of its validity. Our findings suggest that documentation on testing may be associated with increased testing engagement. Future work will explore causality, documentation quality at a granular level, and cross-repository exposure effects.

title: A Decoupled Human-in-the-Loop System for Controlled Autonomy in Agentic Workflows
summary:
AI agents are increasingly deployed to execute tasks and make decisions within agentic workflows, introducing new requirements for safe and controlled autonomy. Prior work has established the importance of human oversight for ensuring transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness in such systems. However, existing implementations of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) mechanisms are typically embedded within application logic, limiting reuse, consistency, and scalability across multi-agent environments.
  This paper presents a decoupled HITL system architecture that treats human oversight as an independent system component within the agent operating environment. The proposed design separates human interaction management from application workflows through explicit interfaces and a structured execution model. In addition, a design framework is introduced to formalize HITL integration along four dimensions: intervention conditions, role resolution, interaction semantics, and communication channel. This framework enables selective and context-aware human involvement while maintaining system-level consistency.
  The approach supports alignment with emerging agent communication protocols, allowing HITL to be implemented as a protocol-level concern. By externalizing HITL and structuring its integration, the system provides a foundation for scalable governance and progressive autonomy in agentic workflows.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于智能体工作流中受控自主性的解耦人机交互系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将人机监督从智能体逻辑中剥离的解耦架构，通过标准化的框架实现更灵活、可扩展的智能体控制与治理。
AI.motivation: 现有的HITL机制通常嵌入在应用逻辑内部，导致在多智能体环境中难以复用、缺乏一致性且难以扩展，无法满足日益增长的智能体工作流对安全和受控自主性的要求。
AI.method: 提出了一种解耦的HITL系统架构，将人机交互管理从应用工作流中分离，并引入了一个包含干预条件、角色解析、交互语义和通信渠道四个维度的设计框架，支持在协议层面实现HITL。
AI.result: 成功构建了独立于应用逻辑的HITL系统，实现了上下文感知的选择性人机交互，并支持通过协议级集成来提升系统治理能力和自主性水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦HITL设计，该系统实现了更具可扩展性和一致性的智能体治理，为实现受控自主性提供了标准化的架构基础。
AI.translation: 人工智能智能体越来越多地被部署在智能体工作流中执行任务和做出决策，这为安全和受控的自主性提出了新的要求。先前的研究已经确立了人类监督对于确保此类系统的透明度、问责制和可信度的重要性。然而，现有的“人在回路”（HITL）机制通常嵌入在应用逻辑中，限制了其在多智能体环境中的复用性、一致性和可扩展性。本文提出了一种解耦的HITL系统架构，将人类监督视为智能体操作环境中的一个独立系统组件。所提出的设计通过显式接口和结构化的执行模型，将人机交互管理与应用工作流分离开来。此外，还引入了一个设计框架，从干预条件、角色解析、交互语义和通信渠道四个维度对HITL集成进行规范化。该框架在保持系统级一致性的同时，实现了选择性的、上下文感知的人类参与。该方法支持与新兴的智能体通信协议对齐，允许将HITL实现为协议层面的关注点。通过将HITL外置并结构化其集成方式，该系统为智能体工作流中的可扩展治理和渐进式自主性提供了基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种解耦的HITL架构，通过将人机监督从智能体工作流中分离，并引入四维设计框架，解决了现有HITL实现方式在可扩展性和一致性方面的局限，为智能体工作流提供了标准化的治理方案。
AI.keywords: 智能体工作流, 人机交互 (HITL), 系统架构, 受控自主性, 治理框架
AI.comments: 该研究通过将人机交互（HITL）从应用逻辑中解耦，解决了当前智能体工作流中监督机制难以复用和扩展的问题。其创新之处在于将HITL视为一种独立的系统组件，并提出了一个四维度的集成框架，这对于构建可信、可控的复杂智能体系统具有重要意义。

title: Evaluating Temporal Consistency in Multi-Turn Language Models
summary: Language models are increasingly deployed in interactive settings where users reason about facts over time rather than in isolation. In such scenarios, correct behavior requires models to maintain and update implicit temporal assumptions established earlier in a conversation. We study this challenge through the lens of temporal scope stability: the ability to preserve, override, or transfer time-scoped factual context across dialogue turns. We introduce ChronoScope, a large-scale diagnostic benchmark designed to isolate temporal scope behavior in controlled multi-turn interactions, comprising over one million deterministically generated question chains grounded in Wikidata. ChronoScope evaluates whether models can correctly retain inferred temporal scope when follow-up questions omit explicit time references, spanning implicit carryover, explicit scope switching, cross-entity transfer, and longer temporal trajectories. Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art language models, we find that temporal scope stability is frequently violated in controlled multi-turn settings, with models often drifting toward present-day assumptions despite correct underlying knowledge. These failures intensify with interaction length and persist even under oracle context conditions, revealing a gap between single-turn factual accuracy and coherent temporal reasoning under sequential interaction. We make our dataset and evaluation suite publicly available at https://github.com/yashkumaratri/ChronoScope

title: ML-Guided Primal Heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs
summary: Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) are an important and complex set of problems in combinatorial optimization. As solving large-scale combinatorial optimization problems is challenging, primal heuristics have been developed to quickly identify high-quality solutions within a short amount of time. Recently, a growing body of research has also used machine learning to accelerate solution methods for challenging combinatorial optimization problems. Despite the increasing popularity of these ML-guided methods, a large body of work has focused on Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs). MBQPs are challenging to solve due to the combinatorial complexity coupled with nonlinearities. This work proposes ML-guided primal heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) by adapting and extending existing work on ML-guided MILP solution prediction to MBQPs. We introduce a new neural network architecture for MBQP solution prediction and a new training data collection procedure. Moreover, we extend existing loss functions in solution prediction and propose to combine contrastive and weighted cross-entropy losses. We evaluate the methods on standard and real-world MBQP benchmarks and show that the developed ML-guided methods significantly outperform existing primal heuristics and state-of-the-art solvers. Furthermore, models trained with our proposed extension with combined losses outperform other ML-based methods adapted from MILPs and improve generalization in cross-regional inference on a real-world wind farm layout optimization problem.

AI.title_translation: 面向混合二元二次规划的机器学习引导原始启发式算法
AI.tldr: 通过机器学习技术，该研究为混合二元二次规划（MBQP）问题开发了比传统启发式算法更高效的求解策略，并在实际应用中展现了优异的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习引导的优化方法多集中于混合整数线性规划（MILP），而MBQP因其组合复杂性与非线性耦合，求解难度更大，亟需针对性的高效启发式算法。
AI.method: 提出了一种用于MBQP解预测的新型神经网络架构；开发了新的训练数据收集流程；引入了结合对比损失与加权交叉熵损失的扩展损失函数。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在标准和实际MBQP基准测试中显著优于现有的原始启发式算法和最先进的求解器，且在跨区域推理任务中表现出更好的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了机器学习引导的启发式方法在处理混合二元二次规划（MBQP）问题上的有效性，通过定制化的模型架构和训练策略，显著提升了求解效率和解的质量。
AI.translation: 混合二元二次规划（MBQP）是组合优化中一类重要且复杂的问题。由于求解大规模组合优化问题极具挑战性，原始启发式算法被开发用于在短时间内快速识别高质量解。近年来，越来越多的研究使用机器学习来加速复杂组合优化问题的求解方法。尽管这些机器学习引导的方法日益普及，但大量研究仍集中在混合整数线性规划（MILP）上。MBQP由于组合复杂性与非线性的耦合，求解难度极大。本研究通过调整和扩展现有的机器学习引导MILP解预测方法，提出了面向MBQP的机器学习引导原始启发式算法。我们引入了一种用于MBQP解预测的新型神经网络架构和一种新的训练数据收集流程。此外，我们扩展了现有的解预测损失函数，并提出结合对比损失和加权交叉熵损失。我们在标准和实际MBQP基准上评估了这些方法，结果表明所开发的机器学习引导方法明显优于现有的原始启发式算法和最先进的求解器。此外，使用我们提出的扩展损失函数训练的模型，其性能优于从MILP改编的其他机器学习方法，并提高了在实际风电场布局优化问题中跨区域推理的泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于混合二元二次规划（MBQP）的机器学习引导原始启发式算法。通过设计专门的神经网络结构、优化训练数据采集流程以及改进损失函数（整合对比损失和加权交叉熵），该方法有效解决了MBQP中的非线性与组合复杂性难题，并在多个基准测试及实际风电场布局优化问题中展现出优于现有算法的性能。
AI.keywords: 混合二元二次规划 (MBQP), 机器学习, 原始启发式算法, 组合优化, 神经网络
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将机器学习引导的启发式方法从较为成熟的MILP领域成功扩展到了更具挑战性的MBQP领域。通过设计专用的神经网络架构和改进损失函数（结合对比损失和加权交叉熵损失），该方法在解决非线性组合优化问题上表现出色。其在实际风电场布局优化问题中的泛化能力证明了该方法的实用价值。

title: DeepImagine: Learning Biomedical Reasoning via Successive Counterfactual Imagining
summary: Predicting the outcomes of prospective clinical trials remains a major challenge for large language models. Prior work has shown that both traditional correlational predictors, such as random forests and logistic regression, and strong commercial LLMs achieve limited performance on this task. In this paper, we propose DeepImagine, a framework for teaching LLMs biomedical reasoning through successive counterfactual imagining. The central idea is to approximate hidden causal mechanisms of clinical trials by training models to infer how observed trial results would change under controlled perturbations of experimental conditions, such as dosage, outcome measures, study arms, geography, and other trial attributes. To support this objective, we construct both natural and approximate counterfactual pairs from real clinical trials with reported outcomes. For settings where strict counterfactual supervision is available, such as paired outcome measures or dose-ranging study arms within the same trial, we train models with supervised fine-tuning. For broader settings where only approximate counterfactual pairs can be retrieved, we optimize models with reinforcement learning using verifiable rewards based on downstream benchmark correctness. We further augment training with synthetic reasoning traces that provide causally plausible explanations for local counterfactual transitions. Using this pipeline, we train language models under 10B parameters, including Qwen3.5-9B, and evaluate them on clinical trial outcome prediction. We aim to show that DeepImagine consistently improves over untuned language models and traditional correlational baselines. Finally, we aim to show that the learned reasoning trajectories provide interpretable signals about how models represent trial-level mechanisms, suggesting a practical path toward more mechanistic and scientifically useful biomedical language models.

title: K-Score: Kalman Filter as a Principled Alternative to Reward Normalization in Reinforcement Learning
comments: Accepted in NewInML Workshop, The 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025).\href{https://icml.cc/virtual/2025/affinity-event/39980}{Event Page}
summary: We propose a simple yet effective alternative to reward normalization in policy gradient reinforcement learning by integrating a 1D Kalman filter for online reward estimation. Instead of relying on fixed heuristics, our method recursively estimates the latent reward mean, smoothing high-variance returns and adapting to non-stationary environments. This approach incurs minimal overhead and requires no modification to existing policy architectures. Experiments on \textit{LunarLander} and \textit{CartPole} demonstrate that Kalman-filtered rewards significantly accelerate convergence and reduce training variance compared to standard normalization techniques. Code is available at https://github.com/Sumxiaa/Kalman_Normalization.
comment: Accepted in NewInML Workshop, The 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025).\href{https://icml.cc/virtual/2025/affinity-event/39980}{Event Page}

AI.title_translation: K-Score：作为强化学习中奖励归一化原则性替代方案的卡尔曼滤波
AI.tldr: 提出使用卡尔曼滤波进行在线奖励估计，作为一种更高效、更具适应性的奖励归一化替代方案，可显著提升强化学习的收敛速度和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的奖励归一化方法多依赖于固定启发式规则，难以有效处理高方差回报或适应非平稳环境。
AI.method: 在策略梯度强化学习中集成一维卡尔曼滤波，用于在线估计潜在奖励均值，从而平滑高方差回报并适应非平稳环境。
AI.result: 在 LunarLander 和 CartPole 任务中，K-Score 显著加快了收敛速度，并降低了训练过程中的方差。
AI.conclusion: K-Score 通过在线卡尔曼滤波实现了高效的奖励平滑，是替代传统奖励归一化的稳健、高性能选择。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种在策略梯度强化学习中替代奖励归一化的简单且有效的方法，即通过集成一维卡尔曼滤波进行在线奖励估计。我们的方法不依赖于固定的启发式规则，而是递归地估计潜在的奖励均值，从而平滑高方差的回报并适应非平稳环境。该方法开销极小，且无需修改现有的策略架构。在 LunarLander 和 CartPole 上的实验表明，与标准归一化技术相比，卡尔曼滤波奖励显著加快了收敛速度并降低了训练方差。代码已在 https://github.com/Sumxiaa/Kalman_Normalization 开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 K-Score 的方法，利用一维卡尔曼滤波取代传统的奖励归一化。该方法通过递归估计潜在奖励均值，有效平滑了回报波动并提升了对环境变化的适应性，在保持低计算开销的同时实现了更优的训练性能。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 奖励归一化, 卡尔曼滤波, 策略梯度, 在线估计
AI.comments: 该方法巧妙地将经典的卡尔曼滤波引入强化学习的奖励处理中，提供了一种比传统启发式奖励归一化更具理论基础和适应性的方案。其优势在于计算开销极小且无需修改现有模型架构，非常易于实际应用。

title: Don't Make the LLM Read the Graph: Make the Graph Think
comments: main body has 9 pages, 4 figures, under review for COLM 2026 conference
summary: We investigate whether explicit belief graphs improve LLM performance in cooperative multi-agent reasoning. Through 3,000+ controlled trials across four LLM families in the cooperative card game Hanabi, we establish four findings. First, integration architecture determines whether belief graphs provide value: as prompt context, graphs are decorative for strong models and beneficial only for weak models on 2nd-order Theory of Mind (80% vs 10%, p<0.0001, OR=36.0); when graphs gate action selection through ranked shortlists, they become structurally essential even for strong models (100% vs 20% on 2nd-order ToM, p<0.001). Second, we identify "Planner Defiance," a model-family-specific failure where LLMs override correct planner recommendations at partial competence (90% override, replicated N=20); Gemini models show near-zero defiance while Llama 70B shows 90%, and models distinguish factual context (deferred to) from advisory recommendations (overridden). Third, full-game evidence confirms inter-agent conventions (+128% over baseline, p=0.003) outperform all single-agent interventions, and individual belief-graph components must be combined to produce gains. Fourth, preliminary scaling analysis (N=10/cell, exploratory) suggests graph depth has diminishing returns: shallow graphs provide the best cost-benefit ratio, while deeper ToM graphs appear harmful at larger player counts (-1.5 pts at 5-player, p=0.029).
comment: main body has 9 pages, 4 figures, under review for COLM 2026 conference

AI.title_translation: 别让大模型读图：让图去思考
AI.tldr: 通过实验证明，将信念图整合为动作筛选机制比简单的提示输入更能显著提升大模型在合作多智能体任务中的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 探究显式信念图（belief graphs）是否能提升大语言模型（LLM）在合作多智能体推理任务中的表现。
AI.method: 通过3000多次对照实验，在合作卡牌游戏Hanabi中测试了四种不同类型的LLM，对比了将信念图作为提示上下文与通过排序短名单筛选动作两种不同集成架构的表现，并分析了模型家族特有的“规划者反抗”现象。
AI.result: 1. 架构决定价值：作为提示词时仅对弱模型有效，作为动作筛选器时对所有模型至关重要；2. 发现“规划者反抗”现象，不同模型对建议的采纳程度差异巨大；3. 多智能体约定优于单智能体干预；4. 图深度存在收益递减，深层图在多玩家场景下可能有害。
AI.conclusion: 将信念图作为提示上下文对于强模型价值有限，但通过排序短名单机制进行动作筛选时，信念图变得至关重要；此外，多智能体间的约定比单智能体干预更有效，且图深度存在收益递减。
AI.translation: 我们研究了显式信念图是否能提高大语言模型在合作多智能体推理中的表现。通过在合作卡牌游戏Hanabi中对四个LLM系列进行的3000多次对照试验，我们得出了四个发现。首先，集成架构决定了信念图是否有价值：作为提示上下文时，图对强模型来说只是装饰，仅对弱模型在二阶心理理论任务上有所帮助（80%对10%，p<0.0001，OR=36.0）；当图通过排序短名单门控动作选择时，即使对强模型也具有结构上的必要性（二阶心理理论上为100%对20%，p<0.001）。其次，我们确定了“规划者反抗”，这是一种模型族特有的失败模式，即LLM在具备部分能力时会覆盖正确的规划建议（90%的覆盖率，N=20）；Gemini模型几乎没有反抗，而Llama 70B显示出90%的反抗，且模型能区分事实上下文（接受）和咨询建议（覆盖）。第三，全游戏证据证实智能体间的约定（比基线高出128%，p=0.003）优于所有单智能体干预，且必须结合单个信念图组件才能产生收益。第四，初步缩放分析（N=10/单元，探索性）表明图深度具有收益递减效应：浅层图提供了最佳的成本效益比，而更深的心理理论图在玩家数量较多时似乎有害（5名玩家时减少1.5分，p=0.029）。
AI.summary: 本文研究了信念图在合作多智能体推理中的作用。研究发现，将信念图作为提示词的效果有限，而将其作为动作选择的限制条件时效果显著。此外，研究揭示了LLM在处理建议时存在“规划者反抗”现象，并证明了多智能体间的协作约定优于个体干预，同时指出图深度对性能的影响存在临界点。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 多智能体推理, 信念图, 心理理论, 规划者反抗
