AI.method: 通过50次独立重复实验对六个回归数据集进行评估；分析CRPS方差轨迹；提出利用局部CRPS方差作为单次种子估计误差的信号；引入β-NLL目标函数来改善训练不稳定性。
AI.result: 发现MAP和深度集成模型在特定训练规模下会出现显著的方差峰值，导致RMSE预测误差激增；局部CRPS方差与单次种子估计误差高度相关（Spearman相关性>0.96）；使用β-NLL可显著降低这种不规则行为。
AI.conclusion: 单次训练评估在小样本和特定模型中极不可靠。研究建议放弃单一终点指标报告，转而采用方差轨迹评估，并利用局部方差作为估计误差的信号。
AI.translation: 在有限数据设置下，评估指标（如连续排名概率评分，CRPS）的单次终点均值本身就是一个随机变量，但它通常被当作一种方法的稳定属性来报告。我们研究了这种做法何时会失效。通过对六个回归数据集进行50次独立重复实验，我们发现CRPS方差轨迹在不同方法间存在显著差异，且并不总是能用平滑的幂律衰减来描述。具有学习异方差方差头的方法，即MAP和深度集成（Deep Ensembles），在真实数据集的中等训练规模下会产生显著且可重复的方差峰值，而MC Dropout和Bayes by Backprop通常表现出平滑的方差收缩。这些峰值具有直接的实际后果：在Seoul Bike数据集的方差峰值处，单次种子MAP估计的相对RMSE达到93.6%，落入重复运行均值±10%范围内的概率下降至5.9%。我们证明了局部CRPS方差提供了单次种子估计误差的直接信号，在每个真实数据集上的Spearman相关性均高于0.96。幂律拟合质量和单调性共同提供了轨迹规律性的紧凑方法级总结。最后，用β-NLL替换标准异方差目标函数显著减少了这种不规则行为，这与异方差训练目标导致不稳定的观点一致。从业者应在报告终点均值的同时报告轨迹总结，并将重复评估集中在方差较高的区域。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了贝叶斯深度学习中单次种子评估的局限性。通过对比六个回归数据集上的CRPS方差轨迹，研究发现异方差模型在特定训练阶段存在显著的不稳定性，导致单次评估结果极不可靠。作者建议通过报告方差轨迹并聚焦高方差区域来改进评估方法。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯深度学习, 评估指标, CRPS, 异方差, 模型稳定性
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了贝叶斯深度学习领域中长期被忽视的一个重要问题：单次训练（Single-seed）评估的不可靠性。其创新之处在于量化了评估指标（CRPS）的方差轨迹，并指出异方差回归模型在特定训练规模下会产生显著的不稳定性。这对机器学习评估标准的规范化具有重要意义。

title: HBGSA: Hydrogen Bond Graph with Self-Attention for Drug-Target Binding Affinity Prediction
summary: Accurate prediction of drug-target binding affinity accelerates drug discovery by prioritizing compounds for experimental validation. Current methods face three limitations: sequence-based approaches discard spatial geometric constraints, structure-based methods fail to exploit hydrogen bond features, and conventional loss functions neglect prediction-target correlation, a key factor for identifying high-affinity compounds in virtual screening. We developed HBGSA (Hydrogen Bond Graph with Self-Attention), a 3.06M-parameter model that encodes hydrogen bond spatial features. HBGSA uses graph neural networks to model hydrogen bond spatial topology with self-attention enhancement and Pearson correlation loss. Experimental results on PDBbind Core Set and CSAR-HiQ dataset demonstrate that HBGSA outperforms baseline methods with strong generalization capability. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of hydrogen bond modeling and Pearson correlation loss.

AI.title_translation: HBGSA：用于药物-靶点结合亲和力预测的含自注意力机制的氢键图模型
AI.tldr: HBGSA通过建模氢键空间特征和引入皮尔逊相关损失，有效提升了药物-靶点结合亲和力预测的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在三大局限：序列方法忽略空间几何约束，结构方法未充分利用氢键特征，且传统损失函数未能捕捉预测值与目标值之间的相关性。
AI.method: 开发了HBGSA模型，利用图神经网络对氢键的空间拓扑结构进行建模，引入自注意力机制增强特征表示，并使用皮尔逊相关损失函数优化模型训练。
AI.result: 在PDBbind Core Set和CSAR-HiQ数据集上的实验结果显示，HBGSA在预测性能上优于基准方法，并表现出强大的泛化能力。消融实验证实了氢键建模和皮尔逊相关损失的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HBGSA模型通过显式建模氢键空间特征与采用针对性的损失函数，显著提升了药物-靶点结合亲和力预测的准确性与泛化能力。
AI.translation: 准确预测药物-靶点结合亲和力可以通过优先筛选化合物进行实验验证来加速药物发现。当前方法面临三个局限：基于序列的方法丢弃了空间几何约束，基于结构的方法未能利用氢键特征，且传统的损失函数忽略了预测值与目标值之间的相关性，而这对于虚拟筛选中识别高亲和力化合物至关重要。我们开发了HBGSA（含自注意力机制的氢键图模型），这是一个具有306万参数的模型，用于编码氢键的空间特征。HBGSA利用图神经网络来建模氢键的空间拓扑，并通过自注意力机制增强和皮尔逊相关损失进行优化。在PDBbind Core Set和CSAR-HiQ数据集上的实验结果表明，HBGSA优于基准方法，并具有很强的泛化能力。消融研究证实了氢键建模和皮尔逊相关损失的有效性。
AI.summary: HBGSA是一种新型药物-靶点结合亲和力预测模型。它通过图神经网络和自注意力机制显式建模氢键的空间拓扑特征，并采用皮尔逊相关损失函数，旨在解决现有方法在空间几何信息利用和预测相关性方面的不足。实验表明该模型具有卓越的预测性能和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 药物-靶点结合亲和力, 氢键图, 自注意力机制, 皮尔逊相关损失, 药物发现
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于显式引入了氢键空间特征，并结合自注意力机制与皮尔逊相关损失函数，有效解决了药物-靶点结合亲和力预测中的关键痛点。模型参数量适中，具备较强的通用性和实验验证支持。

title: Analysis of Efficient Scheduling in Layered Decoding of GLDPC Codes
summary: In this study, we investigate the characteristics of scheduling sequences that enable efficient decoding of generalized low-density parity-check (GLDPC) codes under the layered message-passing algorithm. In particular, we show that scheduling sequences leading to higher decoding efficiency should prioritize the update of constraint nodes corresponding to subcodes with larger minimum distance, fewer minimum-weight codewords, and shorter code length. Based on these characteristics, we design a scheduling algorithm, which further demonstrates the effectiveness of these characteristics through simulation experiments.

AI.title_translation: GLDPC码分层译码中高效调度的分析
AI.tldr: 通过优先更新具备大最小距离、少最小权重码字和短码长的约束节点，显著提升了GLDPC码的分层译码效率。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索GLDPC码在分层消息传递译码算法中，什么样的调度序列能够实现更高效的译码性能。
AI.method: 通过分析GLDPC码的结构特性（最小距离、最小权重码字数、码长），提出一种基于优先级的调度算法，并进行仿真验证。
AI.result: 仿真实验证实了所提出的基于特定特征的调度算法能够有效提升GLDPC码的译码效率。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，优先更新具有更大最小距离、更少最小权重码字以及更短码长的约束节点，可以显著提升GLDPC码分层译码的效率。
AI.translation: 在本研究中，我们调查了在分层消息传递算法下，能够实现广义低密度奇偶校验（GLDPC）码高效译码的调度序列特性。特别是，我们证明了导致更高译码效率的调度序列应该优先更新对应于具有更大最小距离、更少最小权重码字和更短码长的子码的约束节点。基于这些特性，我们设计了一种调度算法，并通过仿真实验进一步验证了这些特性的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了GLDPC码分层译码中调度序列的优化问题，指出优先更新具备特定结构特性（大最小距离、少最小权重码字、短码长）的约束节点能提高译码效率，并据此设计了相应的调度算法。
AI.keywords: 广义低密度奇偶校验码, 分层译码, 调度算法, 消息传递算法
AI.comments: 该研究通过分析GLDPC码分层译码中调度序列的影响，提出了一套明确的优化原则。其创新点在于将子码的最小距离、最小权重码字数量及码长等结构特性与译码调度策略相结合，为高效译码提供了理论指导。该方法具有较强的实用价值。

title: Breaking Lock-In: Preserving Steerability under Low-Data VLA Post-Training
summary: Have you ever post-trained a generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policy on a small demonstration dataset, only to find that it stops responding to new instructions and is limited to behaviors observed during post-training? We identify this phenomenon as lock-in: after low-data, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), the policy becomes overly specialized to the post-training data and fails to generalize to novel instructions, manifesting as concept lock-in (fixation on training objects/attributes) and spatial lock-in (fixation on training spatial targets). Many existing remedies introduce additional supervision signals, such as those derived from foundation models or auxiliary objectives, or rely on augmented datasets to recover generalization. In this paper, we show that the policy's internal pre-trained knowledge is sufficient: DeLock mitigates lock-in by preserving visual grounding during post-training and applying test-time contrastive prompt guidance to steer the policy's denoising dynamics according to novel instructions. Across eight simulation and real-world evaluations, DeLock consistently outperforms strong baselines and matches or exceeds the performance of a state-of-the-art generalist policy post-trained with substantially more curated demonstrations.

title: Source-Code Analysis of iFogSim for Simulating Distributed IoT Architectures: Coverage, Challenges, and Enhancements
summary: Simulation is an indispensable tool for validating distributed IoT architectures before physical deployment, and iFogSim has emerged as one of the most widely adopted platform in the fog and edge computing research community. Yet the experience of using iFogSim for non-canonical, application-specific architectures remains incompletely documented, leaving practitioners without guidance on when the tool is appropriate, which scientific objectives it can address, and how to manage the modelling approximations it imposes. This article helps in providing that guidance through two complementary contributions. First, we present a structured state of the art covering iFogSim and iFogSim2, a taxonomy of ten scientific objectives that motivate IoT architecture simulation, and a comparative survey of eight simulation tools assessed against those objectives. Second, we report our experience of simulating a four-tier smart emergency response system for resource-constrained urban environments, covering a 25-node synthetic road topology, four experimental configurations, and quantitative results including end-to-end alert latency (near 205 ms), FPGA-accelerated Dijkstra path computation (x10 CPU speedup), concurrent incident conflict rates (75% under dual load), and path-cache acceleration (x197). The analysis is organised around five practitioner questions: whether iFogSim fits the target architecture, which objectives it covers natively versus partially, what modelling challenges arise and how their workarounds bias reported results, what changes to the iFogSim source code would close the identified gaps, and whether tool co-simulation can provide comprehensive coverage. Seven modelling challenges are documented with source-code-grounded root causes and explicit bias assessments; finally, seven developer recommendations are proposed as an actionable improvement roadmap for the iFogSim community.

AI.title_translation: 用于模拟分布式物联网架构的iFogSim源代码分析：覆盖范围、挑战与增强
AI.tldr: 本文通过分析iFogSim源代码，揭示了其在复杂物联网仿真中的局限性，并提供了针对性的建模挑战总结与改进建议。
AI.motivation: iFogSim在物联网仿真中应用广泛，但针对非典型、特定应用架构的建模缺乏详细文档和指导，导致研究人员难以评估其适用性及处理建模偏差。
AI.method: 本文采用结构化文献综述方法构建了科学目标分类法，并通过构建一个四层智能应急响应系统案例进行实证分析，结合源代码分析识别建模挑战，最终提出开发改进路线图。
AI.result: 研究识别了7项关键建模挑战及其根源，量化了智能应急响应系统的性能指标（如205ms延迟、FPGA加速性能提升等），并提出了7项旨在改进iFogSim的开发者建议。
AI.conclusion: 通过对iFogSim的深入剖析，本文识别了其在模拟复杂物联网架构时的局限性，并为未来的开发和工具增强提供了明确的改进建议，从而促进了该领域仿真工作的准确性和可扩展性。
AI.translation: 仿真是在物理部署前验证分布式物联网架构不可或缺的工具，iFogSim已成为雾计算和边缘计算研究领域应用最广泛的平台之一。然而，使用iFogSim进行非典型、特定应用架构模拟的经验仍未得到完整记录，导致从业者在工具适用性、可解决的科学目标以及如何管理建模近似方面缺乏指导。本文通过两项互补的贡献提供了这些指导。首先，我们提出了涵盖iFogSim和iFogSim2的结构化技术现状、十种驱动物联网架构仿真的科学目标分类法，以及针对这些目标评估的八种仿真工具的比较调查。其次，我们报告了模拟资源受限城市环境中四层智能应急响应系统的经验，涵盖25节点合成道路拓扑、四种实验配置，以及包括端到端警报延迟（近205毫秒）、FPGA加速Dijkstra路径计算（CPU速度提升10倍）、并发事件冲突率（双重负载下75%）和路径缓存加速（197倍）在内的定量结果。分析围绕五个从业者问题展开：iFogSim是否适合目标架构、它原生覆盖哪些目标、会出现哪些建模挑战以及它们的变通方法如何影响报告结果、对iFogSim源代码进行哪些更改可以弥补已识别的差距，以及工具联合仿真是否能提供全面覆盖。文中记录了七项具有源代码根源和明确偏差评估的建模挑战；最后，提出了七项开发者建议作为iFogSim社区的可行改进路线图。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决iFogSim在复杂物联网架构仿真中缺乏实践指导的问题。作者通过分类科学目标、对比多种仿真工具，并结合智能应急响应系统的案例研究，深入分析了iFogSim的源代码，识别了建模局限性，并提出了具体的改进建议和开发路线图。
AI.keywords: iFogSim, 物联网仿真, 边缘计算, 架构建模, 性能评估
AI.comments: 该论文通过深入的源代码分析，填补了iFogSim在非典型架构应用中的文档空白。其创新之处在于将理论上的科学目标与实际的建模挑战相结合，并提出了具体的源代码改进路线图，为物联网/边缘计算领域的研究人员提供了极具价值的实践指导。

title: ArgRE: Formal Argumentation for Conflict Resolution in Multi-Agent Requirements Negotiation
summary: As software systems grow in complexity, they must satisfy an increasing number of competing quality attributes, making it essential to balance them in a principled manner -- for example, a safety requirement for sensor-fusion verification may conflict with a tight planning-cycle budget. Multi-agent large language model frameworks support this balancing process by assigning specialized agents to different objectives. However, their conflict resolution is typically heuristic. Requirements are aggregated implicitly without explicit acceptance or rejection, limiting auditability in regulated domains. We present ArgRE, a multi-agent requirements negotiation system that embeds Dung-style abstract argumentation into the negotiation stage. Each proposal, critique, and refinement is modeled as an argument, conflicts are represented as directed attack relations, and the accepted set of arguments is computed under grounded and preferred semantics. The pipeline further integrates KAOS goal modeling, multi-layer verification, and standards-oriented artifact generation. Evaluation across five case studies spanning safety-critical, financial, and information-system domains shows that ArgRE provides argument-level traceability absent from existing frameworks. Independent evaluators rated its decision justifications significantly higher than those of heuristic synthesis (4.32 vs. 3.07, p < 0.001), indicating improved auditability, while semantic intent preservation remains comparable (94.9% BERTScore F1) and compliance coverage reaches 84.7% versus 47.6%--47.8% for baselines. Structural analysis further confirms that the default pairwise protocol yields acyclic graphs in which grounded and preferred semantics coincide, whereas cross-pair arbitration introduces controlled cyclicity, leading to predictable divergence between the two semantics.

AI.title_translation: ArgRE：用于多智能体需求协商中冲突解决的形式化论证方法
AI.tldr: ArgRE通过引入形式化论证模型，使多智能体需求协商过程可审计且决策更合理，有效解决了复杂系统中的需求冲突问题。
AI.motivation: 随着软件系统日益复杂，多智能体LLM框架虽被用于平衡相互冲突的质量属性，但现有框架多依赖启发式方法，缺乏明确的需求接受/拒绝机制，导致在受监管领域中审计难度大。
AI.method: 提出ArgRE系统，将Dung风格的抽象论证理论嵌入多智能体协商过程，将需求提案、批评和细化建模为论证，通过有向攻击关系表示冲突，并结合KAOS目标建模、多层验证和标准导向的工件生成进行处理。
AI.result: 在五个案例研究中，ArgRE在决策合理性评分上显著优于启发式方法（4.32 vs 3.07），合规覆盖率达到84.7%（基准为47.6%-47.8%），且保持了94.9%的语义意图保存率。
AI.conclusion: ArgRE通过形式化论证模型显著提升了多智能体需求协商的审计能力和决策质量，在保证语义一致性的同时，实现了比传统启发式方法更优的合规覆盖率。
AI.translation: 随着软件系统复杂性的增加，它们必须满足越来越多的竞争性质量属性，因此以原则性的方式平衡这些属性至关重要——例如，传感器融合验证的安全需求可能与紧迫的规划周期预算相冲突。多智能体大语言模型框架通过为不同目标分配专门的智能体来支持这种平衡过程。然而，它们的冲突解决通常是启发式的。需求被隐式聚合而没有明确的接受或拒绝，限制了受监管领域的可审计性。我们提出了ArgRE，一个将Dung风格的抽象论证嵌入协商阶段的多智能体需求协商系统。每个提案、批评和细化都被建模为一个论证，冲突被表示为有向攻击关系，并且在基础语义和偏好语义下计算被接受的论证集。该流水线进一步集成了KAOS目标建模、多层验证和面向标准的工件生成。跨越安全关键、金融和信息系统领域的五个案例研究的评估表明，ArgRE提供了现有框架所缺乏的论证级可追溯性。独立评估者对其实施决策理由的评分显著高于启发式合成（4.32 vs 3.07，p < 0.001），表明其审计能力得到提高，同时语义意图保存保持相当（94.9% BERTScore F1），合规覆盖率达到84.7%，而基线为47.6%–47.8%。结构分析进一步证实，默认的成对协议产生无环图，其中基础语义和偏好语义重合，而跨对仲裁引入了受控循环，导致两种语义之间的可预测分歧。
AI.summary: ArgRE是一个旨在改善多智能体需求协商的新型系统。它通过将形式化论证理论集成到协商流程中，将需求变更建模为可追踪的论证图，从而解决了传统LLM协商框架缺乏透明度和审计性的局限。实验证明该方法在复杂系统需求冲突解决中具有更高的决策质量和合规表现。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 需求工程, 形式化论证, 冲突解决, 可审计性
AI.comments: 该论文通过将形式化论证理论（Argumentation Theory）引入多智能体需求协商，解决了现有LLM框架中冲突解决缺乏透明度和可审计性的问题。其创新之处在于将协商过程结构化为论证图，不仅提升了决策的可解释性，还在安全关键领域中展示了极高的合规性覆盖。

title: Learning from Imperfect Text Guidance: Robust Long-Tail Visual Recognition with High-Noise Label
summary: Real-world data often exhibit long-tailed distributions with numerous noisy labels, substantially degrading the performance of deep models. While prior research has made progress in addressing this combined challenge, it overlooks the severe label-image mismatch inherent to high-noise settings, thereby limiting their effectiveness. Given that observed labels, though mismatched with images, still retain category information, we propose employing auxiliary text information from labels to address label-image inconsistencies in long-tailed noisy data. Specifically, we leverage the intrinsic cross-modal alignment in pre-trained visual-language models to correct the label-image inconsistencies. This supervisory signal, referred to as Weak Teacher Supervision (WTS), is unaffected by label noise and data distribution biases, albeit exhibits limited accuracy. Therefore, the activation of WTS is determined by evaluating the discrepancy between text-predicted labels and observed labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of WTS across synthetic and real-world datasets, particularly under high-noise conditions. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WTS-0F3C.

AI.title_translation: 从不完美的文本指导中学习：具有高噪声标签的鲁棒长尾视觉识别
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种弱教师监督（WTS）方法，通过利用预训练视觉-语言模型的跨模态对齐能力，有效解决了长尾分布下高噪声标签导致的标签-图像不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的长尾分布与噪声标签处理方法忽略了高噪声场景下严重存在的标签-图像不匹配问题，导致模型性能受限，亟需一种能利用额外辅助信息来纠正这种不一致性的方案。
AI.method: 提出弱教师监督（WTS）方法，利用预训练视觉-语言模型的跨模态对齐能力，通过计算文本预测标签与观测标签之间的差异来动态激活监督信号，从而纠正标签-图像的不匹配。
AI.result: 在多个合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，WTS方法在长尾分布及高噪声条件下均取得了优于现有技术的表现。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的WTS方法通过整合辅助文本信息，有效缓解了长尾分布下高噪声标签导致的模型性能下降问题，证明了跨模态对齐在处理复杂数据分布中的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 现实世界的数据往往表现出长尾分布且伴随大量噪声标签，这极大地降低了深度模型的性能。虽然此前的研究在应对这一综合挑战方面取得了一定进展，但它们忽视了高噪声环境下固有的严重标签-图像不匹配问题，从而限制了其有效性。鉴于观察到的标签尽管与图像不匹配，但仍保留了类别信息，我们建议利用来自标签的辅助文本信息来解决长尾噪声数据中的标签-图像不一致问题。具体而言，我们利用预训练视觉-语言模型中内在的跨模态对齐来纠正标签-图像的不一致性。这种被称为弱教师监督（WTS）的监督信号不受标签噪声和数据分布偏差的影响，尽管其准确性有限。因此，WTS的激活是通过评估文本预测标签与观察标签之间的差异来确定的。广泛的实验证明了WTS在合成和真实数据集上的优越性能，特别是在高噪声条件下。源代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WTS-0F3C 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对长尾分布中存在严重噪声标签导致模型性能下降的问题，提出了一种基于弱教师监督（WTS）的新方法。该方法通过引入预训练视觉-语言模型的跨模态对齐信息，动态评估并纠正标签与图像之间的不匹配，在处理高噪声长尾数据时表现出显著的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.keywords: 长尾识别, 噪声标签, 视觉-语言模型, 弱教师监督, 跨模态对齐
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）的跨模态对齐能力，为解决长尾分布与高噪声标签共存的问题提供了一种新颖的监督机制。其创新之处在于通过文本信息纠正标签与图像的不匹配，有效地将噪声标签转化为可用的监督信号。局限性在于该方法高度依赖预训练模型的质量以及文本描述的准确性。

title: System-Level Impacts of Flexible Data Center Load Scheduling on Cost, Emissions, and Transmission Congestion
summary: Large data centers are being deployed in the U.S. at an unprecedented rate, introducing significant flexible load potential. A portion of data center workloads - best-effort (BE) jobs - can be scheduled flexibly to reduce power system operating costs and emissions. However, the system-level impacts of such scheduling remain underexplored. This paper investigates the effects of flexible data center load scheduling on operating cost, system stress, and emissions using the ACTIVSg2000 2000-bus test system. Results show that BE loads shift toward periods of lower locational marginal prices (LMPs), typically aligned with high renewable generation. Importantly, latency-critical (LC) workloads remain unaffected, preserving quality of service (QoS). Flexible scheduling also leads to reductions in both greenhouse gas and toxic emissions, as well as transmission congestion, compared to inflexible operation, demonstrating its potential to support more efficient and sustainable grid operation.

title: MindTrellis: Co-Creating Knowledge Structures with AI through Interactive Visual Exploration
comments: 21 pages, 7 figures, ACM Designing Interactive Systems. DIS 2026
summary: Knowledge workers face increasing challenges in synthesizing information from multiple documents into structured conceptual understanding. This process is inherently iterative: users explore content, identify relationships between concepts, and continuously reorganize their mental models. However, current approaches offer limited support. LLM-based systems let users query information but not shape how knowledge is organized; manual tools like mind maps support structure creation but lack intelligent assistance. This leaves an open opportunity: supporting collaborative construction where users and AI jointly develop an evolving knowledge representation. We present MindTrellis, an interactive visual system where users and AI collaboratively build a dynamic knowledge graph. Users can query the graph to retrieve document-grounded information, and contribute by introducing new concepts, modifying relationships, and reorganizing the hierarchy to reflect their developing understanding. In a user study where 12 participants created slide decks, MindTrellis outperformed retrieval-only baselines in knowledge organization and cognitive load, as measured by expert ratings of content coverage and structural quality.
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, ACM Designing Interactive Systems. DIS 2026

AI.title_translation: MindTrellis：通过交互式视觉探索与人工智能共同创造知识结构
AI.tldr: MindTrellis 是一个允许用户与 AI 协作构建动态知识图谱的系统，旨在解决知识工作者在整合多文档信息时面临的组织和认知难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 系统缺乏对知识组织结构的直接支持，而传统的手动工具（如思维导图）又缺乏 AI 的智能化辅助，导致知识工作者在将多文档信息转化为结构化认知时面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为 MindTrellis 的交互式可视化系统，允许用户与 AI 共同构建动态知识图谱；用户可通过查询获取基于文档的信息，并能手动干预图谱的结构、关系和层级，从而实现知识的共创。
AI.result: 在包含 12 名参与者的用户研究中，MindTrellis 在知识组织效果和认知负荷方面均优于仅提供检索功能的基准系统，专家评估显示其在内容覆盖率和结构质量上表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: MindTrellis 通过支持用户与 AI 共同构建动态知识图谱，有效地辅助知识工作者进行信息的深度综合与结构化，在提升知识组织质量和降低认知负荷方面表现优于传统的检索工具。
AI.translation: 知识工作者在将多个文档中的信息综合为结构化的概念理解时面临着日益严峻的挑战。这个过程本质上是迭代的：用户探索内容、识别概念之间的关系，并不断重组他们的思维模型。然而，目前的方法提供的支持有限。基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统允许用户查询信息，但不能塑造知识的组织方式；而像思维导图这样的手动工具虽然支持结构创建，但缺乏智能辅助。这留下了一个开放的机会：支持协作构建，即用户和 AI 共同开发一种不断演变的知识表示。我们提出了 MindTrellis，这是一个交互式视觉系统，用户和 AI 在其中协作构建动态知识图谱。用户可以查询图谱以检索基于文档的信息，并通过引入新概念、修改关系和重组层级来贡献自己的理解，以反映其不断发展的认知。在一项由 12 名参与者创建幻灯片的实验中，MindTrellis 在知识组织和认知负荷方面表现优于仅检索的基准系统，专家对内容覆盖率和结构质量的评分也证实了这一点。
AI.summary: MindTrellis 是一个交互式视觉系统，旨在通过人机协作构建动态知识图谱，帮助知识工作者将多文档信息转化为结构化的认知模型。该系统弥补了现有 AI 工具在知识组织上的缺失，并已通过实证研究证明其在提升知识组织质量和降低认知负荷方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 人机协作, 知识图谱, 交互式可视化, 大语言模型, 知识合成
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）的智能辅助与思维导图式的交互可视化相结合，解决了知识工人难以将碎片化信息转化为结构化知识的痛点。其核心贡献在于提出了人机协作构建动态知识图谱的范式，相比于单纯的信息检索，这种方式更能有效降低认知负荷并提升知识组织的质量。

title: Mechanistic Steering of LLMs Reveals Layer-wise Feature Vulnerabilities in Adversarial Settings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can still be jailbroken into producing harmful outputs despite safety alignment. Existing attacks show this vulnerability, but not the internal mechanisms that cause it. This study asks whether jailbreak success is driven by identifiable internal features rather than prompts alone. We propose a three-stage pipeline for Gemma-2-2B using the BeaverTails dataset. First, we extract concept-aligned tokens from adversarial responses via subspace similarity. Second, we apply three feature-grouping strategies (cluster, hierarchical-linkage, and single-token-driven) to identify SAE feature subgroups for the aligned tokens across all 26 model layers. Third, we steer the model by amplifying the top features from each identified subgroup and measure the change in harmfulness score using a standardized LLM-judge scoring protocol. In all three approaches, the features in the layers [16-25] were relatively more vulnerable to steering. All three methods confirmed that mid to later layer feature subgroups are more responsible for unsafe outputs. These results provide evidence that the jailbreak vulnerability in Gemma-2-2B is localized to feature subgroups of mid to later layers, suggesting that targeted feature-level interventions may offer a more principled path to adversarial robustness than current prompt-level defenses.

title: UAV Trajectory and Bandwidth Allocation for Efficient Data Collection in Low-Altitude Intelligent IoT: A Hierarchical DRL Approach
summary: Under the 6G wireless network evolution, the low-altitude Internet of Things (IoT), supported by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) capabilities, provides ground sensing networks with advanced real-time monitoring and data collection. To maximize data collection volume from distributed IoT nodes, AI-powered data collection technology plays a critical role in enabling intelligent decision-making. Among them, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has gained particular attention. However, the existing DRL-based work on UAV-assisted IoT nodes data collection rarely address problems such as unknown interference and dynamic data volume. Moreover, these DRL models have high arithmetic requirements and slow convergence speed, making it difficult to carry on UAVs with limited load and arithmetic power. To address these challenges, a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning (HDRL), which can converge quickly and with smaller models, is designed to optimize UAV trajectories and bandwidth allocation to maximize data collection volume. Firstly, the proposed scenario incorporates interference from jammers, dynamic data volume of IoT nodes, and multiple types of obstacles. The entire task is hierarchically structured: the upper-level makes flight trajectory decisions at a coarse temporal granularity, while the lower-level makes bandwidth allocation decisions at a finer temporal granularity. Secondly, a trajectory and bandwidth allocation optimization algorithm based on hierarchical deep deterministic policy gradients (TBH-DDPG) is proposed to solve the problem. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm improves convergence speed by 44.44%, and reduces computational cost by 58.05%, compared to non-hierarchical algorithm.

AI.title_translation: 面向低空智能物联网高效数据采集的无人机轨迹与带宽分配：一种分层DRL方法
AI.tldr: 通过分层深度强化学习将无人机轨迹规划与带宽分配解耦，在降低58%计算成本的同时提升了收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的无人机数据采集DRL方案在面对干扰和动态数据量时表现不足，且模型计算需求过高、收敛速度慢，难以满足无人机受限的计算能力需求。
AI.method: 提出了基于分层深度确定性策略梯度（TBH-DDPG）的算法，将任务划分为上层（粗粒度轨迹规划）和下层（细粒度带宽分配）两个层级，以应对动态环境和计算资源限制。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，与非分层算法相比，该算法在收敛速度上提升了44.44%，计算成本降低了58.05%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的TBH-DDPG算法通过分层决策机制，在保证最大化数据采集量的同时，显著提升了收敛效率并降低了计算开销，为资源受限的无人机物联网应用提供了高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 在6G无线网络演进背景下，由具备感知与通信一体化（ISAC）能力的无人机（UAV）支持的低空物联网，为地面感知网络提供了先进的实时监控和数据采集手段。为了最大化分布式物联网节点的数据采集量，人工智能驱动的数据采集技术在实现智能决策方面发挥着关键作用，其中深度强化学习（DRL）备受关注。然而，现有的基于DRL的无人机辅助物联网数据采集研究很少涉及未知干扰和动态数据量等问题。此外，这些DRL模型对算力要求高且收敛速度慢，难以在计算资源受限的无人机上运行。为了应对这些挑战，本文设计了一种分层深度强化学习（HDRL）框架，以优化无人机轨迹和带宽分配。该方案将任务分层结构化：上层在粗时间粒度上进行飞行轨迹决策，下层在细时间粒度上进行带宽分配决策。此外，提出了基于分层深度确定性策略梯度（TBH-DDPG）的优化算法。仿真结果证明，与非分层算法相比，该算法的收敛速度提高了44.44%，计算成本降低了58.05%。
AI.summary: 本文针对低空物联网中无人机数据采集效率问题，提出了一种分层深度强化学习（HDRL）架构。通过将轨迹规划（粗粒度）与带宽分配（细粒度）任务分层处理，该模型在应对干扰和动态数据量的同时，有效降低了计算开销并加快了收敛速度。
AI.keywords: 无人机, 物联网, 深度强化学习, 轨迹优化, 带宽分配
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入分层深度强化学习（HDRL）框架，有效解决了传统单层DRL在无人机辅助物联网数据采集场景中收敛慢、计算开销大的痛点。其创新之处在于将轨迹规划与带宽分配解耦为不同时间粒度的任务，非常契合无人机有限的计算资源约束。该研究在干扰和动态数据环境下的鲁棒性表现值得关注。

title: h-MINT: Modeling Pocket-Ligand Binding with Hierarchical Molecular Interaction Network
summary: Accurate molecular representations are critical for drug discovery, and a central challenge lies in capturing the chemical environment of molecular fragments, as key interactions, such as H-bond and π stacking, occur only under specific local conditions. Most existing approaches represent molecules as atom-level graphs; however, atom-level representations can hardly express higher-order chemical context (e.g., stereochemistry, lone pairs, conjugation). Fragment-based methods (e.g., principal subgraph, predefined functional groups) fail to preserve essential information such as chirality, aromaticity, and ionic states. This work addresses these limitations from two aspects. (i) OverlapBPE tokenization. We propose a novel data-driven molecule tokenization method. Unlike existing approaches, our method allows overlapping fragments, reflecting the inherently fuzzy boundaries of small-molecule substructures and, together with enriched chemical information at the token level, thereby preserving a more complete chemical context. (ii) h-MINT model. OverlapBPE induces many-to-many atom-fragment mappings, which necessitate a new hierarchical architecture. We therefore develop a hierarchical molecular interaction network capable of jointly modeling interactions at both atom and fragment levels. By supporting fragment overlaps, the model naturally accommodates the many-to-many atom-fragment mappings introduced by the OverlapBPE scheme. Extensive evaluation against state-of-the-art methods shows our method improves binding affinity prediction by 2-4% Pearson/Spearman correlation on PDBBind and LBA, enhances virtual screening by 1-3% in key metrics on DUD-E and LIT-PCBA, and achieves the best overall HTS performance on PubChem assays. Further analysis demonstrates that our method effectively captures interactive information while maintaining good generalization.

title: Surface Sensitivity in Lean 4 Autoformalization
summary: Natural-language variation poses a key challenge in Lean autoformalization: semantically equivalent paraphrases of the same theorem statements can induce divergent formal outputs, yet it remains unclear whether this variation reflects semantic disagreements or shallower failures. We investigate this question in Lean 4 using 60 deterministic paraphrase rules applied to ProofNet\# and miniF2F. Across four GPT-family models and three open-weight 7B autoformalizers, we find that the observed paraphrase sensitivity reflects compilation-boundary failures rather than semantic divergence among successful formalizations. In particular, when both baseline and perturbed outputs compile, paired predictions are semantically equivalent under BEq+ and structurally near-identical under GTED. By contrast, paraphrasing substantially affects whether outputs compile, with failure modes varying across datasets and perturbation classes. Our results suggest that future training-time interventions should target the compile boundary rather than the semantic layer, and that benchmarks should separate compile-conditional equivalence from surface consistency.

title: How Researchers Navigate Accountability, Transparency, and Trust When Using AI Tools in Early-Stage Research: A Think-Aloud Study
summary: In the early stages of scientific research, researchers rely on core scholarly judgments to identify relevant literature, assess credible evidence, and determine which directions merit pursuit. As AI tools become increasingly integrated into these early-stage workflows, the scholarly judgments that were once transparent and attributable to individual researchers become obscured, raising critical Responsible AI (RAI) concerns around accountability, transparency, and trust. Yet how these three dimensions manifest in real-time, in-situ scholarly practice remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we conducted a think-aloud study with 15 researchers to examine how they used AI tools powered by large language models (LLMs) across early-stage research tasks, including literature exploration, synthesis, and research ideation. Our key findings address the tripartite constructs of accountability, transparency, and trust. First, the confident tone of AI outputs misrepresents epistemic uncertainty, making it more difficult for researchers (who are ultimately accountable) to identify which outputs require the greatest scrutiny. Second, opaque retrieval and content construction make provenance difficult to establish for transparency. Third, trust in AI is fragile, context-dependent, and easily eroded. In response, participant researchers were seen to develop compensatory strategies to restore scholarly judgment under uncertainty. Overall, our findings serve to contextualize AI-mediated research as a RAI problem grounded in lived researcher experience and motivate attention to deliberate AI integration that preserves accountability, supports transparency, and fosters informed trust.

AI.title_translation: 研究人员如何在早期科研中使用AI工具时处理问责制、透明度和信任问题：一项有声思维研究
AI.tldr: 该研究通过实验揭示了AI工具在科研初期应用中对学术问责、透明度和信任造成的挑战，并发现科研人员正通过补偿策略来应对这些不确定性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI工具在科研初期的普及，原本透明且可归因的科研判断变得模糊，引发了关于负责任AI（RAI）在问责制、透明度和信任方面的担忧，但目前尚缺乏针对这些维度在实际科研实践中如何体现的研究。
AI.method: 采用“有声思维”（think-aloud）研究法，对15名科研人员在使用基于大语言模型的AI工具进行文献探索、综合和研究构思等初期阶段任务时的过程进行了观察和记录。
AI.result: 研究发现：1. AI自信的语气掩盖了认识论上的不确定性，增加了科研人员审查的难度；2. AI检索和内容生成的黑箱化使得建立溯源机制变得困难；3. 科研人员对AI的信任是脆弱且依赖语境的，容易受损；4. 科研人员已开始发展出补偿策略以在不确定性中恢复自身的学术判断力。
AI.conclusion: AI在科研初期的应用削弱了科研判断的透明度与可追溯性。为了实现负责任的AI集成，必须关注AI对认识论不确定性的掩盖，并开发能增强可解释性、支持科研人员保持主体判断力的工具。
AI.translation: 在科学研究的早期阶段，研究人员依赖核心的学术判断来识别相关文献、评估可信证据并确定值得追求的方向。随着AI工具日益融入这些早期研究流程，曾经透明且可归因于研究人员个人的学术判断变得模糊，引发了围绕问责制、透明度和信任的负责任AI（RAI）关键问题。然而，这三个维度在实时、现场的学术实践中如何体现，目前仍未得到充分探索。为了填补这一空白，我们对15名研究人员进行了一项有声思维研究，以考察他们在包括文献探索、综合和研究构思在内的早期研究任务中如何使用基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI工具。我们的主要发现涉及问责制、透明度和信任这三个结构。首先，AI输出的自信语调掩盖了认识论上的不确定性，使得研究人员（他们是最终的责任承担者）更难识别哪些输出需要最严格的审查。其次，不透明的检索和内容构建使得透明度所需的溯源难以建立。第三，对AI的信任是脆弱的、依赖语境的，并且很容易受到侵蚀。对此，参与研究的人员表现出开发补偿策略，以在不确定性下恢复学术判断力。总的来说，我们的研究结果将AI辅助研究情境化为基于研究人员生活经验的RAI问题，并推动人们关注旨在保持问责制、支持透明度并培养知情信任的审慎AI集成。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对15名科研人员进行有声思维实验，分析了AI工具在科研早期阶段对问责制、透明度和信任的影响。研究指出，AI输出的过度自信、内容生成的黑箱化以及脆弱的信任感是主要挑战，研究人员因此发展出相应的补偿策略来维护学术判断。
AI.keywords: 负责任AI, 科研实践, 大语言模型, 问责制, 透明度
AI.comments: 该研究通过“有声思维”法深入探讨了AI在科研初期应用中的伦理挑战，具有很高的现实意义。其创新点在于将抽象的“负责任AI”概念落实到科研工作者的实际操作体验中，揭示了AI工具如何潜移默化地影响科研判断，并指出了科研人员为弥补AI局限性而采取的补偿策略。

title: CNN-ViT Fusion with Adaptive Attention Gate for Brain Tumor MRI Classification: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model
comments: 9 pages, 4 figures, submitted as conference paper
summary: Early detection and classifying brain tumors using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) images is highly important but difficult to extract in medical images. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are good at capturing both local texture and spatial information whereas Vision Transformers (ViTs) are good at capturing long-range global dependencies. We propose a new hybrid architecture that combines a SqueezeNet-style CNN branch with a MobileViT-style global transformer branch, through an Adaptive Attention Gate mechanism, in this paper. The gate learns dynamically per-sample, per-feature weights to weight the contribution of each branch, allowing context-sensitive merging of local and global representations. The proposed model has a test accuracy of 97.60, a precision of 97.30, a recall of 97.50, an F1-score of 97.40, and a macro-average area under the curve (AUC) of 0.9946 with a trained and evaluated on the Brain Tumor MRI Dataset (Kaggle). These scores are higher than single CNN and ViT baselines, and current competitive fusion methods, showing that dynamic feature weighting is an effective way to classify medical images.
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, submitted as conference paper

AI.title_translation: 基于自适应注意力门控的CNN-ViT融合脑肿瘤MRI分类：一种混合深度学习模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合CNN和ViT的混合模型，通过自适应注意力门控机制动态融合局部与全局特征，在脑肿瘤MRI分类任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决医疗图像中脑肿瘤早期检测与分类困难的问题，利用CNN捕捉局部纹理和空间信息，以及ViT捕捉全局依赖关系的互补优势。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合架构，将SqueezeNet风格的CNN分支与MobileViT风格的全局Transformer分支相结合，并通过自适应注意力门控机制对两个分支的特征贡献进行动态加权融合。
AI.result: 在Kaggle脑肿瘤MRI数据集上，模型测试准确率为97.60%，精确率为97.30%，召回率为97.50%，F1分数为97.40%，宏平均AUC为0.9946，优于单一模型及现有的竞争性融合方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，提出的混合模型结合了CNN的局部特征提取能力和ViT的全局依赖建模能力，通过自适应门控机制实现了优于现有单一模型和传统融合方法的分类性能。
AI.translation: 使用磁共振成像（MRI）对脑肿瘤进行早期检测和分类非常重要，但在医学图像中进行特征提取具有挑战性。卷积神经网络（CNN）擅长捕捉局部纹理和空间信息，而视觉Transformer（ViT）擅长捕捉长距离的全局依赖关系。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的混合架构，通过自适应注意力门控机制将SqueezeNet风格的CNN分支与MobileViT风格的全局Transformer分支相结合。该门控机制学习每个样本、每个特征的动态权重，以衡量每个分支的贡献，从而实现局部和全局表示的上下文敏感融合。该模型在Kaggle脑肿瘤MRI数据集上进行训练和评估，测试准确率为97.60%，精确率为97.30%，召回率为97.50%，F1分数为97.40%，宏平均曲线下面积（AUC）为0.9946。这些分数高于单一CNN和ViT基线以及目前具有竞争力的融合方法，表明动态特征加权是分类医学图像的有效途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合CNN和ViT的混合深度学习模型，通过自适应注意力门控机制动态融合局部纹理特征与全局依赖关系，从而提升脑肿瘤MRI影像的分类准确性。
AI.keywords: 脑肿瘤MRI分类, 卷积神经网络, 视觉Transformer, 自适应注意力门控, 混合深度学习模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入自适应注意力门控机制，有效解决了传统CNN和ViT在处理医学影像时特征融合僵化的问题，动态权重分配是其核心创新，在脑肿瘤MRI分类任务上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: GreenDyGNN: Runtime-Adaptive Energy-Efficient Communication for Distributed GNN Training
summary: Distributed GNN training is dominated by remote feature fetching, which can be very costly. Multi-hop neighborhood sampling crosses partition boundaries and triggers fine-grained RPCs whose fixed initiation cost and GPU-stall latency waste energy. Prior systems try to reduce this overhead with presampling and static caching, but cache policies cannot react to runtime network variation. We show that under time-varying congestion, static caching can increase energy by up to 45% because a fixed rebuild schedule is insufficient. We present GreenDyGNN, which formulates cache window management as a sequential decision problem. GreenDyGNN performs intra-epoch cache rebuilds and uses a Double-DQN agent, trained in a calibrated simulator with domain-randomized congestion, to adapt rebuild window size and per-owner cache allocation at each boundary. An asynchronous double-buffered pipeline makes adaptation effectively free. Under congestion, GreenDyGNN cuts total energy by up to 43% over Default DGL and 4-24% over the best static policy, while closely matching the optimum under clean conditions.

AI.title_translation: GreenDyGNN：面向分布式 GNN 训练的运行时自适应节能通信机制
AI.tldr: GreenDyGNN 引入基于强化学习的动态缓存管理，解决了分布式 GNN 训练中因网络拥塞导致的能效问题，显著降低了系统总能耗。
AI.motivation: 分布式 GNN 训练中远程特征获取开销巨大，现有的静态缓存策略无法应对动态网络环境下的拥塞问题，导致能效低下。
AI.method: 将缓存窗口管理建模为序列决策问题，利用 Double-DQN 代理根据网络拥塞情况动态调整重建窗口大小和缓存分配，并通过异步双缓冲流水线实现低开销的执行。
AI.result: 在网络拥塞环境下，GreenDyGNN 相比默认 DGL 系统降低了高达 43% 的能耗，相比最佳静态策略降低了 4% 到 24% 的能耗，且在网络状况良好时表现接近最优。
AI.conclusion: GreenDyGNN 通过基于强化学习的动态缓存管理，有效解决了分布式 GNN 训练中由于网络波动导致的能效浪费问题，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了系统能耗。
AI.translation: 分布式 GNN 训练主要受远程特征获取的制约，其成本非常高昂。多跳邻居采样会跨越分区边界，并触发细粒度的远程过程调用（RPC），其固定的启动成本和 GPU 停滞延迟浪费了大量能源。先前的系统试图通过预采样和静态缓存来减少这种开销，但缓存策略无法响应运行时的网络变化。我们研究表明，在时变拥塞下，静态缓存可能会使能耗增加高达 45%，因为固定的重建调度是不够的。我们提出了 GreenDyGNN，它将缓存窗口管理建模为一个序列决策问题。GreenDyGNN 执行周期内的缓存重建，并使用在经过域随机化拥塞校准的模拟器中训练的 Double-DQN 代理，以在每个边界调整重建窗口大小和每所有者的缓存分配。异步双缓冲流水线使得这种自适应过程几乎没有开销。在拥塞情况下，GreenDyGNN 将总能耗比默认 DGL 降低了高达 43%，比最佳静态策略降低了 4-24%，同时在网络状况良好时紧密匹配了最优性能。
AI.summary: GreenDyGNN 是一种针对分布式 GNN 训练的运行时自适应节能通信框架。它通过 Double-DQN 代理动态管理缓存窗口和分配，克服了静态缓存策略在应对网络波动时能效不足的局限，实现了在保障性能的同时大幅降低能耗。
AI.keywords: 分布式 GNN 训练, 能效优化, 动态缓存管理, 强化学习, 网络拥塞自适应
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将强化学习（Double-DQN）引入分布式图神经网络（GNN）训练的缓存管理中，解决了静态缓存策略在网络波动环境下能效低的问题。通过异步双缓冲流水线实现了几乎无开销的动态调整，在能效优化方面具有显著的实际意义。

title: UNSEEN: A Cross-Stack LLM Unlearning Defense against AR-LLM Social Engineering Attacks
summary: Emerging AR-LLM-based Social Engineering attack (e.g., SEAR) is at the edge of posing great threats to real-world social life. In such AR-LLM-SE attack, the attacker can leverage AR (Augmented Reality) glass to capture the image and vocal information of the target, using the LLM to identify the target and generate the social profile, using the LLM agents to apply social engineering strategies for conversation suggestion to win the target trust and perform phishing afterwards. Current defensive approaches, such as role-based access control or data flow tracking, are not directly applicable to the convergent AR-LLM ecosystem (considering embedded AR device and opaque LLM inference), leaving an emerging and potent social engineering threat that existing privacy paradigms are ill-equipped to address. This necessitates a shift beyond solely human-centric measures like legislation and user education toward enforceable vendor policies and platform-level restrictions. Realizing this vision, however, faces significant technical challenges: securing resource-constrained AR-embedded devices, implementing fine-grained access control within opaque LLM inferences, and governing adaptive interactive agents. To address these challenges, we present UNSEEN, a coordinated cross-stack defense that combines an AR ACL (Access Control Layer) for identity-gated sensing, F-RMU-based LLM unlearning for sensitive profile suppression, and runtime agent guardrails for adaptive interaction control. We evaluate UNSEEN in an IRB-approved user study with 60 participants and a dataset of 360 annotated conversations across realistic social scenarios.

title: An Algebraic State Observer for a Class of Physical Systems
summary: In this paper we present a radically new approach to design state observers for nonlinear systems, with particular emphasis on physical ones. Our objective is to obtain an algebraic relation between the unmeasurable part of the state and filtered versions of the systems inputs and outputs, which holds true for all $t \geq 0$. The latter qualifier should be contrasted with the usual asymptotic (or fixed/finite time) objective. The standing assumption for our design is the availability -- or possibility of constructing, via coordinate change -- state components with measurable derivatives. In the physical systems studied in the paper this condition is naturally satisfied. The next step in the design is the application of the Swapping Lemma to pull out from the dynamics the derivative of one of these signals. The design is completed replacing the latter by the measurable signals and arranging the remaining terms. The algebraic observer constitutes a refreshing major departure from classical asymptotic observer designs, even in the case of electrical motors and mechanical systems that have been exhaustively studied. Particularly notable is the fact that no observability or excitation condition is imposed for the construction of the algebraic observer.

AI.title_translation: 一类物理系统的代数状态观测器
AI.tldr: 一种无需观测性或激励条件，能实现非渐近状态估计的全新代数观测器设计方法。
AI.motivation: 克服传统渐近观测器设计中对观测性、激励条件的依赖，并追求在所有时间点（t ≥ 0）均成立的状态估计，而非仅仅是渐近收敛。
AI.method: 利用系统状态分量的可测导数，结合交换引理（Swapping Lemma）进行代数变换，从而建立未测量状态与输入输出滤波信号之间的代数关系。
AI.result: 成功构建了一种代数观测器，能够直接通过输入输出信号的代数关系获取系统状态，无需满足传统的观测性或激励条件。
AI.conclusion: 该文提出了一种无需观测性或激励条件、适用于特定物理系统的代数观测器设计方法，实现了非渐近的瞬时状态估计。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种设计非线性系统（特别强调物理系统）状态观测器的全新方法。我们的目标是获得未测量状态部分与系统输入输出滤波版本之间的代数关系，该关系在所有 t ≥ 0 时成立。后一个限定条件应与通常的渐近（或固定/有限时间）目标形成对比。我们设计的首要假设是可获得——或通过坐标变换构建——具有可测导数的状态分量。在本文研究的物理系统中，这一条件自然得到满足。设计过程的下一步是应用交换引理，从动力学中提取出这些信号之一的导数。设计的完成是通过用可测信号替换后者并整理剩余项来实现的。即便对于已经过详尽研究的电动机和机械系统，这种代数观测器也构成了对经典渐近观测器设计的重大背离。特别值得注意的是，该代数观测器的构建无需施加任何观测性或激励条件。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对物理非线性系统的全新代数观测器设计方法。该方法通过利用可测导数的物理特性，结合交换引理，建立未测量状态与系统输入输出滤波信号之间的代数关系。与传统渐近观测器不同，该方法不需要观测性或激励条件，实现了对系统状态的直接代数估计。
AI.keywords: 代数观测器, 非线性系统, 状态估计, 交换引理, 物理系统
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种非渐近的代数观测器设计方法，其核心创新在于摆脱了对观测性或激励条件的依赖，这在控制理论中是一个重大的范式转变。其局限性在于对系统结构有特定要求（如可测导数的存在性）。

title: UpstreamQA: A Modular Framework for Explicit Reasoning on Video Question Answering Tasks
summary: Video Question Answering (VideoQA) demands models that jointly reason over spatial, temporal, and linguistic cues. However, the task's inherent complexity often requires multi-step reasoning that current large multimodal models (LMMs) perform implicitly, leaving their internal decision process opaque. In contrast, large reasoning models (LRMs) explicitly generate intermediate logical steps that enhance interpretability and can improve multi-hop reasoning accuracy. Yet, these models are not designed for native video understanding, as they typically rely on static frame sampling. We propose UpstreamQA, a modular framework that disentangles and evaluates core video reasoning components through explicit upstream reasoning modules. Specifically, we employ multimodal LRMs to perform object identification and scene context generation before passing enriched reasoning traces to downstream LMMs for VideoQA. We evaluate UpstreamQA on the OpenEQA and NExTQA datasets using two LRMs (o4-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro) and two LMMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash). Our results demonstrate that introducing explicit reasoning can significantly boost performance and interpretability of downstream VideoQA, but can also lead to performance degradation when baseline performance is sufficiently high. Overall, UpstreamQA offers a principled framework for combining explicit reasoning and multimodal understanding, advancing both performance and diagnostic transparency in VideoQA in several scenarios.

AI.title_translation: UpstreamQA：一种用于视频问答任务显式推理的模块化框架
AI.tldr: 通过将视频问答拆解为“显式推理”与“下游问答”两个模块，在提升模型可解释性的同时，在特定场景下显著增强了视频理解的准确度。
AI.motivation: 当前大多模态模型在视频问答中进行多步推理时过程不透明，缺乏显式逻辑，而现有大推理模型又缺乏原生视频理解能力。
AI.method: 提出 UpstreamQA 框架，通过多模态大推理模型（LRMs）执行对象识别和场景上下文生成，并将生成的显式推理追踪传递给下游大多模态模型（LMMs）进行最终问答。
AI.result: 在 OpenEQA 和 NExTQA 数据集上的实验表明，显式推理能显著提高视频问答的性能和可解释性，但在基线模型性能较高时可能会导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: UpstreamQA 证明了显式推理模块能有效提升视频问答的可解释性和部分场景下的准确性，为复杂多模态任务的推理结构设计提供了新思路。
AI.translation: 视频问答（VideoQA）要求模型联合推理空间、时间和语言线索。然而，该任务固有的复杂性通常需要多步推理，而当前的大多模态模型（LMMs）往往隐式执行这些推理，导致其内部决策过程不透明。相比之下，大推理模型（LRMs）通过显式生成中间逻辑步骤，增强了可解释性并能提高多跳推理的准确性。然而，这些模型并非为原生视频理解而设计，通常依赖静态帧采样。我们提出了 UpstreamQA，这是一个通过显式上游推理模块解耦并评估核心视频推理组件的模块化框架。具体而言，我们利用多模态 LRMs 在将丰富的推理追踪传递给下游 LMMs 进行 VideoQA 之前，执行对象识别和场景上下文生成。我们在 OpenEQA 和 NExTQA 数据集上使用两种 LRM（o4-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro）和两种 LMM（GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash）评估了 UpstreamQA。结果表明，引入显式推理可以显著提高下游 VideoQA 的性能和可解释性，但在基线性能足够高时也可能导致性能下降。总的来说，UpstreamQA 为结合显式推理和多模态理解提供了一个原则性框架，在多种场景下推进了 VideoQA 的性能和诊断透明度。
AI.summary: UpstreamQA 是一种用于视频问答的模块化框架，旨在通过显式推理提升模型的透明度和准确性。该框架利用推理模型执行预处理任务（如对象识别和场景分析），并将推理过程作为上下文提供给下游多模态模型，从而弥补了现有模型在复杂推理上的不足。
AI.keywords: 视频问答, 显式推理, 大多模态模型, 模块化框架, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种模块化框架，将复杂的视频问答任务拆解为显式的推理步骤，提升了模型决策的可解释性。其局限性在于，当基线模型本身性能已经很高时，引入额外的显式推理步骤反而可能导致性能下降，这揭示了显式推理与端到端模型结合时的权衡问题。

title: Maximizing Memory-Level Parallelism via Integrated Stochastic Logic-in-Memory Architectures
summary: Today's high-performance architectures are increasingly constrained by data movement latency and energy overhead, as the slowdown of single-core performance scaling coincides with the rise of highly data-intensive workloads. In-memory architectures have emerged as a complementary solution to conventional von Neumann systems by alleviating memory bandwidth bottlenecks, exploiting massive concurrency, and mitigating excessive data movement between memory and processing units. This study proposes a parallel in-memory stochastic computing (SC) architecture that implements an end-to-end computation pipeline within Magnetic Tunnel Junction (MTJ)-based memory augmented with logic-in-memory (LIM) capabilities. By leveraging the inherent stochasticity and write-read characteristics of MTJ devices, the proposed architecture enables a fully parallel and deterministic conversion of binary operands into probabilistic bit-streams, eliminating the need for energy-intensive external random number generation circuitry. These bit-streams are processed by parallel stochastic arithmetic units integrated directly within the memory arrays to efficiently implement core arithmetic and transcendental functions with minimal hardware complexity and inherent noise tolerance. The resulting stochastic outputs can be either reused as an input of future stochastic processing or converted back to binary form using parallel accumulation mechanisms and stored in the MTJ memory. By tightly integrating data storage, bit-stream generation, and computation within a unified in-memory fabric, the proposed design maximizes memory-level parallelism while substantially minimizing data movement.

AI.title_translation: 通过集成随机存内计算架构最大化内存级并行性
AI.tldr: 该研究通过将随机计算逻辑集成在MTJ内存中，利用器件固有特性消除随机数生成成本，显著提升了数据密集型任务的计算效率和并行度。
AI.motivation: 高性能架构受限于数据移动带来的高延迟和高能耗，且单核性能扩展放缓，无法满足日益增长的数据密集型工作负载需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于磁隧道结（MTJ）的集成随机存内计算架构，利用MTJ的固有随机特性实现二进制到概率位流的转换，并在内存阵列内部直接集成随机算术单元进行并行计算。
AI.result: 实现了端到端的计算流水线，在最小化硬件复杂度和数据移动的同时，支持算术和超越函数的高效执行，并具备固有噪声容忍度。
AI.conclusion: 该架构通过在内存阵列内集成数据存储、随机流生成和算术逻辑，实现了高效的存内并行计算，有效缓解了数据移动带来的延迟和功耗问题，为高性能数据密集型应用提供了新的硬件方案。
AI.translation: 当今的高性能架构日益受到数据移动延迟和能耗开销的限制，单核性能提升的放缓与高度数据密集型工作负载的兴起同时发生。存内架构作为传统冯·诺依曼系统的补充方案应运而生，通过缓解内存带宽瓶颈、利用大规模并发以及减少内存与处理单元之间过多的数据移动来解决上述问题。本研究提出了一种并行存内随机计算（SC）架构，在具有存内计算（LIM）能力的磁隧道结（MTJ）内存中实现了端到端的计算流水线。利用MTJ器件固有的随机性和读写特性，该架构实现了二进制操作数到概率位流的完全并行且确定性的转换，消除了对高能耗外部随机数生成电路的需求。这些位流由直接集成在内存阵列内的并行随机算术单元处理，以最小的硬件复杂度和固有的噪声容忍度高效地实现核心算术和超越函数。生成的随机输出既可以作为未来随机处理的输入，也可以通过并行累加机制转换回二进制形式并存储在MTJ内存中。通过在统一的存内架构中紧密集成数据存储、位流生成和计算，所提出的设计最大限度地提高了内存级并行性，同时大幅减少了数据移动。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于MTJ的并行随机存内计算架构，通过将计算逻辑直接集成在内存阵列中，利用器件固有随机性消除外部随机数生成需求，从而最大化内存级并行性并显著降低数据传输功耗。
AI.keywords: 存内计算, 随机计算, 磁隧道结 (MTJ), 内存级并行, 存内处理
AI.comments: 该研究通过将随机计算（SC）与基于MTJ的存内计算（LIM）架构深度融合，巧妙地利用了器件的固有随机性，避免了传统的随机数生成开销。这种方法在处理数据密集型任务时具有显著的能效和性能优势，是解决“冯·诺依曼瓶颈”的一种极具前景的创新思路。

title: PhySE: A Psychological Framework for Real-Time AR-LLM Social Engineering Attacks
summary: The emerging threat of AR-LLM-based Social Engineering (AR-LLM-SE) attacks (e.g. SEAR) poses a significant risk to real-world social interactions. In such an attack, a malicious actor uses Augmented Reality (AR) glasses to capture a target visual and vocal data. A Large Language Model (LLM) then analyzes this data to identify the individual and generate a detailed social profile. Subsequently, LLM-powered agents employ social engineering strategies, providing real-time conversation suggestions, to gain the target trust and ultimately execute phishing or other malicious acts. Despite its potential, the practical application of AR-LLM-SE faces two major bottlenecks, (1) Cold-start personalization, Current Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) methods introduce critical delays in the earliest turns, slowing initial profile formation and disrupting real-time interaction, (2) Static Attack Strategies, Existing approaches rely on fixed-stage, handcrafted social engineering tactics that lack foundation in established psychological theory. To address these limitations, we propose PhySE, a novel framework with two core innovations, (1) VLM-Based SocialContext Training, To eliminate profiling delays, we efficiently pre-train a Visual Language Model (VLM) with social-context data, enabling rapid, on-the-fly profile generation, (2) Adaptive Psychological Agent, We introduce a psychological LLM that dynamically deploys distinct classes of psychological strategies based on target response, moving beyond static, handcrafted scripts. We evaluated PhySE through an IRB-approved user study with 60 participants, collecting a novel dataset of 360 annotated conversations across diverse social scenarios.

title: Scaling Multi-Node Mixture-of-Experts Inference Using Expert Activation Patterns
summary:
Most recent state-of-the-art (SOTA) large language models (LLMs) use Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to scale model capacity without proportional per-token compute, enabling higher-quality outputs at manageable serving costs. However, MoE inference at scale is fundamentally bottlenecked by expert load imbalance and inefficient token routing, especially in multi-node deployments where tokens are not guaranteed to be routed to local experts, resulting in significant inter-node all-to-all communication overhead.
  To systematically characterize these challenges, we profile SOTA open-source MoE models, including Llama 4 Maverick, DeepSeek V3-671B, and Qwen3-230B-A22B, on various datasets and collected over 100k real expert activation traces. Upon studying the expert activation patterns, we uncover various persistent properties across all the frontier MoE models: variable expert load imbalance, domain-specific expert activation where expert popularity shifts across task families (code, math, chat, general), and a strong correlation between prefill and decode expert activations. Motivated by these findings, we propose workload-aware micro-batch grouping and an expert placement strategy to maximize token locality to the destination expert, thereby reducing inter-node communication. Across models and datasets, these optimizations help reduce all2all communication data up to 20, resulting in lower MoE decode latency and better accelerator utilization.

title: RANalyzer: Automated Continuous RAN Software Evaluation and Regression Analysis
summary:
Software-driven O-RAN architectures enable rapid innovation through frequent, independent updates to virtualized components. However, attributing performance variations to specific software changes is challenging due to the stochastic nature of wireless systems, where channel conditions, interference, and hardware variability confound analysis. Traditional threshold-based monitoring and manual troubleshooting do not scale with modern software evolution.
  This paper presents RANalyzer, an automated test analysis framework that quantifies the performance impact of software updates beyond what can be explained by wireless channel conditions. RANalyzer combines LLM-assisted semantic extraction with residuals analysis. The first categorizes code changes by affected protocol layers and functional components, while the second provides insights on the effect of load, channel, or code changes on the test performance. We contribute an extensive dataset collected over more than two years of continuous over-the-air testing on an experimental O-RAN testbed, comprising over 8,600 automated tests across 69 releases of the OAI stack. By modeling expected performance and interpreting deviations as software-induced effects, we identify degraded instances attributable to code changes and correlate them with specific change categories. The framework can be integrated into CI/CD/CT pipelines for automated, continuous evaluation of software updates at scale.

AI.title_translation: RANalyzer：自动化的持续RAN软件评估与回归分析
AI.tldr: RANalyzer通过LLM和残差分析技术，克服了无线环境随机性的干扰，实现了O-RAN软件更新性能影响的自动化归因与回归分析。
AI.motivation: O-RAN架构下频繁的软件更新使得性能评估变得复杂，传统的监控和手动排查方法难以应对无线系统固有的随机性（如信道条件和干扰），导致难以准确归因性能变化。
AI.method: 提出RANalyzer框架，利用LLM辅助进行代码变更的语义提取（分类协议层与功能组件），并结合残差分析方法，通过建模预期性能并对比实际偏差，将性能波动归因于无线环境因素或软件代码变更。
AI.result: 基于两年多、超过8600次自动化测试的数据集验证，RANalyzer能够有效识别由代码变更引起的性能退化，并将退化与具体的代码变更类别关联，实现了高效的自动化回归分析。
AI.conclusion: RANalyzer成功实现了对O-RAN软件更新性能影响的自动化量化与归因，证明了其在CI/CD流水线中进行持续性能评估的可行性与有效性。
AI.translation: 软件驱动的O-RAN架构通过对虚拟化组件进行频繁、独立的更新，实现了快速创新。然而，由于无线系统的随机性（如信道条件、干扰和硬件差异），将性能变化归因于特定的软件变更具有挑战性。传统的基于阈值的监控和手动故障排除无法适应现代软件的演进。本文介绍了RANalyzer，这是一个自动化的测试分析框架，它量化了软件更新对性能的影响，超出了无线信道条件所能解释的范围。RANalyzer结合了LLM辅助的语义提取与残差分析。前者根据受影响的协议层和功能组件对代码变更进行分类，后者则提供了关于负载、信道或代码变更对测试性能影响的见解。我们贡献了一个广泛的数据集，该数据集是在一个实验性O-RAN测试台上经过两年多的连续无线测试收集的，包含69个OAI堆栈版本中的8600多个自动化测试。通过建模预期性能并将偏差解释为软件诱导的影响，我们确定了可归因于代码变更的退化实例，并将它们与特定的变更类别相关联。该框架可以集成到CI/CD/CT流水线中，用于大规模的软件更新自动化、持续评估。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RANalyzer，这是一个用于O-RAN软件的自动化测试分析框架。它通过结合LLM语义代码分析与残差性能评估，从复杂的无线环境噪声中分离出软件更新带来的性能影响，实现了对软件回归的自动化检测与归因，适用于现代CI/CD/CT流水线。
AI.keywords: O-RAN, 软件回归分析, 大语言模型, 自动化测试, 性能评估
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）与残差分析相结合，解决了O-RAN架构中无线环境随机性对软件性能评估的干扰问题。它填补了自动化CI/CD流程中针对无线通信软件性能回归分析的空白，具有很高的工程应用价值。

title: Mesh-Intrinsic GFEM: High-Order Smoothness on $C^0$ Unstructured Meshes
summary:
High-order partial differential equations (PDEs) require derivative regularity that standard $C^0$ finite element infrastructures do not directly provide on unstructured meshes. We propose a mesh-intrinsic generalized finite element method (MiGFEM) that reconstructs local polynomial fields on overlapping nodal patches from shared nodal unknowns and blends them by a partition of unity, without introducing extra global degrees of freedom.
  The core analysis establishes a partition-of-zero (PoZ) smoothness-transfer mechanism driven by interface coherence: derivative jumps cancel exactly for polynomial reproduction and decay as $O(h^{p+1-|α|}) $for smooth nonpolynomial fields. On this basis, we define a PoZ-consistent intrinsic derivative that is polynomial-exact and approximation-order consistent, enabling pointwise strong-form evaluation of high-order PDEs on $C^0$ meshes. For derivative-type/free boundary conditions in strong-form collocation,we introduce a boundary absorption constrained weighted least-squares strategy (BA-CWLS), which embeds boundary constraints into local patch reconstruction. This avoids globally overdetermined boundary augmentation and penalty tuning, while preserving a square sparse global system.
  Numerical experiments show machine-precision patch tests,jump-decay rates consistent with theory, and robust performance on highly distorted meshes. The same mesh-intrinsic trial space supports both weak-form Galerkin and strong-form collocation discretizations, providing a unified high-order route on standard $C^0$ mesh infrastructures.

title: Birds of a Feather Cluster Nearby: a Proximity-Aware Geo-Codebook for Local Service Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation systems are increasingly adopted in local service platforms, where semantic relevance alone is insufficient without strict geographic feasibility. A key technical challenge lies in semantic ID (SID) tokenization, which directly impacts the recommendation performance. However, existing semantic codebooks neglect geographic constraints, often resulting in recommendations that are semantically relevant yet geographically unreachable. To address this limitation, we propose Pro-GEO, a Proximity-aware GEO-codebook. Pro-GEO establishes a geo-centroid local coordinate system to capture intra-cluster spatial relationships and a geo-rotary position encoding mechanism that models geographic proximity as orthogonal rotational transformations in the high-dimensional embedding. This design enables semantic and spatial signals to be jointly modeled in a balanced manner, without reducing geographic information to a weak auxiliary feature. Extensive experiments conducted on a large-scale industrial dataset reveal that Pro-GEO significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. In particular, Pro-GEO reduces the average geographic clustering distance by 45.60% and achieves a 1.87% improvement in Hit@50, highlighting its effectiveness for real-world local service recommendation.

title: Quantifying opinion homophily in online social networks: A bounded confidence perspective
summary: The concept of homophily is pervasive in online social media. While many empirical studies have relied on external sociodemographic traits to investigate it, significantly less is known about homophily at the cognitive level, that is, at the level of shared opinions or values. For such "value homophily", in this paper we study interval-based patterns of opinion homophily from a bounded confidence perspective. We consider three heterogeneous datasets from Reddit and Twitter covering polarizing issues, with user opinions quantified via sentiment analysis and fact-checking, and analyze the interaction networks formed by weaker (reply-based) and stronger (follow-based) social ties. Our findings show that users' interaction neighborhoods are significantly more concentrated in opinion space than expected by chance, with tie strength and issue polarization further amplifying this effect. Moreover, users often exhibit asymmetric tolerance ranges, with asymmetry typically directed toward locally mainstream positions rather than more radical or opposing ones. These findings support a bounded confidence interpretation of online value homophily.

title: The Energy Based Near Singularity for Fourier Spectral 3D Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: We investigate the three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. The equations are discretized with Fourier spectral method and a fourth-order Runge-Kutta scheme in time. The spectral accuracy, resolution conditions, and an energy based conditional regularity framework are established analytically. Then we prove exponential convergence in space, algebraic convergence in time, and an a posteriori criterion that links numerical blowup to loss of regularity. This work develops a suite of diagnostics for detecting potential finite time singular behavior.

title: BSViT: A Burst Spiking Vision Transformer for Expressive and Efficient Visual Representation Learning
summary: Spiking Vision Transformers (S-ViTs) offer a promising framework for energy-efficient visual learning. However, existing designs remain limited by two fundamental issues: the restricted information capacity of binary spike coding and the dense token interactions introduced by global self-attention. To address these challenges, this work proposes BSViT, a burst spiking-driven Vision Transformer featuring a Dual-Channel Burst Spiking Self-Attention (DBSSA) mechanism. DBSSA encodes queries with binary spikes and keys with burst spikes to enhance representational capacity. The value pathway adopts dual excitatory and inhibitory binary channels, enabling signed modulation and richer spike interactions. Importantly, the entire attention operation preserves addition-only computation, ensuring compatibility with energy-efficient neuromorphic hardware. To further reduce spike activity and incorporate spatial priors, a patch adjacency masking strategy is introduced to restrict attention to local neighborhoods, resulting in structure-aware sparsity and reduced computational overhead. In addition, burst spike coding is systematically integrated across the network to increase spike-level representational capacity beyond conventional binary spiking. Extensive experiments on both static and event-based vision benchmarks demonstrate that BSViT consistently outperforms existing spiking Transformers in accuracy while maintaining competitive energy efficiency.

title: A satellite foundation model for improved wealth monitoring
summary: Poverty statistics guide social policy, but in many low- and middle-income countries, censuses and household surveys that collect these data are costly, infrequent, quickly outdated, and sometimes error-prone. Satellite imagery offers global coverage and the possibility of predicting economic livelihoods at scale, yet existing approaches to predicting livelihoods with imagery or other non-traditional data often fail to reliably identify local-level variation and, as we show, degrade under temporal shift. Here we introduce Tempov, a satellite foundation model pretrained by self-supervision on three million bi-temporal Landsat pairs and adapted with parameter-efficient fine-tuning to sparse survey labels. The model enables large-scale, high-resolution wealth mapping and dynamic measurement, including zero-shot nowcasting up to a decade after observed labels, retrospective hindcasting, and decadal change tracking, while outperforming existing neural network and geospatial foundation-model baselines. In low-label regimes, Tempov achieves competitive accuracy with only 10% of survey samples, indicating substantially reduced dependence on expensive label collection. The model further generalizes across populous countries within and outside Africa, and scales to a unified Africa-wide model with strong continent-level performance ($R^2=0.63$, $r^2=0.68$), from which we generate high-resolution decadal maps of wealth and wealth changes for the African continent. Analysis of these maps shows large variation in recent economic performance both within and across countries. Our open-source approach provides a pathway to timely, scalable, low-cost monitoring of wealth and poverty from routinely collected satellite data.

title: A Topology fixated Shape Gradient Framework for Non Simple Boundary Extraction for CIE Lab color images with Repulsive Energy
summary: A levelset free but a hybrid image segmentation approach based on a modified version of the piece wise constant shape gradient of an Mumford Shah shape functional and a repulsive function is considered. The segmentation is performed a non-local shape based through an evolution of discrete curves driven by a non local shape based energy to segment images containing disjoint regions and multiple boundaries. This formulation has a novel additional component as a multivariable function dependent on a few sampled points of the curves that handles the occurrence of self intersection during boundary curves evolution. The method is applied to a few gray scale and color images, including images with nested structures and astronomical objects. The results indicate effective segmentation in complex scenarios with absolute control on the topology of the segments and self-intersections of the boundaries

title: Approximate Maintenance of Maximum Subarray Sum in the Sliding Window Model
summary: In the sliding window model, we are required to maintain the target statistics over the most recent $n$ elements of a data stream, which is captured by a window of size $n$ sliding over the data stream. Exact computation usually requires space linear in $n$, and the central goal is approximate maintenance using sublinear space. In this paper, we study the problem of maintaining the maximum subarray sum in the sliding window model. While the classical Kadane's algorithm computes the exact answer using constant space in the static setting, it does not extend directly, because a new element makes the oldest one expire, which may invalidate the optimal subarray so far. Our first observation is that the so-called Smooth Histogram framework can lead to a constant-factor approximation (in the sense of relative error) using $O((\log n)^2)$ bits of space. We then refine this framework accordingly, which enables for any $ε> 0$ to maintain a $(1 \pm ε)$-approximation using $O(ε^{-1}(\log n)^2)$ bits of space and $O(ε^{-1}\log n)$ operations per update. The space complexity is asymptotically optimal.

title: A Linear-Time Algorithm for Finding an Odd Cycle Through Two Specified Vertices
summary: We present a deterministic linear-time algorithm for finding an odd cycle through two specified vertices in an undirected graph. This is shown in a generalized form as follows: Let $Γ$ be any group in which every element is of order at most $2$. For a given $Γ$-labeled graph with two specified vertices (or edges), we can determine in linear time whether there exist two cycles with distinct labels that are through both of the two specified vertices (or edges), and find such cycles if yes.

title: Core Logic and Algorithmic Performance Enhancements for a System Vulnerability Analysis Technique for Complex Mission Critical Systems Implementation
summary: Core logic and processing improvements were made to the software for operations and network attack results review (SONARR) and are presented, herein. Previous SONARR versions' Boolean-only logic, derived from the Blackboard Architecture, was replaced with generic logic that allows any .NET type (e.g., integers, decimals, strings) to be utilized within facts. This allows calculations and equality operations with all data types to drive the algorithm's processing of network models. Additionally, multi-compute capabilities were implemented to increase the processing power for larger workloads. In this paper, the new logic objects are described, examples are presented to illustrate the efficacy of creating digital-twin systems using the new generic logic, and performance test results are presented that illustrate the expanded processing capability from the multi-compute functionality.

title: Single-Source Shortest Paths and Almost Exact Diameter in Pseudodisk Graphs
summary:
We study SINGLE-SOURCE SHORTEST PATH (SSSP) on unweighted intersection graphs whose node set corresponds to a set of $n$ constant-complexity objects in the plane. We prove SSSP can be solved in $O(U(n)\ \mathrm{polylog}\,n)$ expected time for any class of objects whose union complexity is $U(n)$. In particular, we obtain an $O(n 2^{α(n)}\log^2 n)$ algorithm for arbitrary pseudodisks, and an $O(λ_{s+2}(n)2^{O(\log^* n)} \log^2 n)$ algorithm for locally fat objects. This significantly extends the class of objects for which SSSP can be solved in $O(n\ \mathrm{polylog}\, n)$ time: so far, $O(n\ \mathrm{polylog}\, n)$ SSSP algorithms were not even known for pseudodisks that are fat and convex and similarly-sized.
  Our second result concerns the DIAMETER problem, which asks for the maximum distance between any two nodes in a graph. Even for intersection graphs, near-quadratic algorithms are difficult to obtain, and the $O(n^2\ \mathrm{polylog}\, n)$ running time that follows from our SSSP algorithm is the first near-quadratic running time for such general classes of intersection graphs. Obtaining subquadratic running time is even more challenging. We prove that the diameter of a set of arbitrary pseudodisks can be computed almost exactly, namely up to an additive error of 2, in $\tilde{O}(n^{2-1/14})$ expected time. This generalizes and speeds up a recent algorithm by Chang, Gao, and Le~(SoCG 2024) that works for similarly-sized disks (or similarly-sized pseudodisks that are fat and satisfy a strong monotonicity assumption) and runs in $\tilde{O}(n^{2-1/18})$ time. To this end, we develop a so-called star-based $r$-clustering for intersection graphs of pseudodisks, which is interesting in its own right. Our star-based $r$-clustering can also be used to obtain an almost exact distance oracle for pseudodisks that uses $O(n^{2-1/13})$ storage and has $O(1)$ query time.

title: Efficient VQ-QAT and Mixed Vector/Linear quantized Neural Networks
summary: In this work, we developed and tested 3 techniques for vector quantization (VQ) based model weight compression. To mitigate codebook collapse and enable end-to-end training, we adopted cosine similarity-based assignment. Building on ideas from attention-based formulations in Differentiable K-Means (DKM), we further improved this approach by using cosine similarity for assignment combined with top-1 sampling and a straight-through estimator, thereby eliminating the need for weighted-average reconstruction. Finally, we investigated the use of differentiable neural architecture search (NAS) to adaptively select layer-wise quantization configurations, further optimizing the compression process. Although our method does not consistently outperform existing approaches across all quantization levels, it provides useful insights into the design trade-offs and behaviors of VQ-based model compression methods.

title: One Identity, Many Roles: Multimodal Entity Coreference for Enhanced Video Situation Recognition
comments: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Findings. Project Page: https://katha-ai.github.io/projects/cinemec/
summary:
Video Situation Recognition (VidSitu) addresses the challenging problem of "who did what to whom, with what, how, and where" in a video. It tests thorough video understanding by requiring identification of salient actions and associated short descriptions for event roles across multiple events. Grounding with VidSitu requires spatio-temporal localization of key entities across shots and varied appearances.
  We posit that coherent video understanding requires consistent identification of entities that play different roles. We propose Multimodal Entity Coreference (MEC) to unite entity descriptions in text with grounding across the video. Towards this, we introduce CineMEC, a multi-stage approach that unites event role mention groups with visual clusters of entities, without explicit grounding supervision during training. Our approach is designed to exploit the synergy between visual grounding and captioning, where improving one influences the other and vice versa. For evaluation, we extend the VidSitu dataset with grounding annotations. While previous work focuses primarily on descriptions, CineMEC improves consistency across both: captioning (+2.5% CIDEr, +7% LEA) and visual grounding (+18% HOTA).

AI.title_translation: 一个身份，多种角色：用于增强视频情境识别的多模态实体共指
AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态实体共指（MEC）方法CineMEC，通过将文本中的实体描述与视频中的视觉实体聚类相结合，显著提升了视频情境识别中的描述生成和视觉定位的一致性，即使在训练时没有明确的定位监督。

title: GPU-Native Multi-Area State Estimation via SIMD Abstraction and Boundary Condensation
summary: Power system state estimation (SE) is foundational for grid monitoring, yet conventional centralized solvers face increasing computational pressure as the system scale and real-time requirements grow. This paper presents a GPU-native framework for hierarchical multi-area state estimation (MASE) that addresses these bottlenecks through a single-instruction, multiple-data (SIMD) abstraction and sparse Schur local condensation. We partition the network into areas, evaluate measurement residuals and derivatives using fixed-sparsity templates, and directly assemble local normal-equation blocks through a fused GPU accumulation kernel without materializing explicit Jacobians. Each area is then factorized on the GPU in Schur mode to export a dense local boundary block and condensed right-hand side, after which a reduced global boundary system is assembled and solved on device. This design preserves device residency across measurement evaluation, local condensation, and boundary coordination while exposing parallelism across areas. Numerical experiments on partitioned PEGASE 2869-bus, PEGASE 9241-bus, and ACTIVSg10k benchmark systems demonstrate that the proposed approach effectively leverages GPU throughput by maintaining full device residency and high arithmetic intensity.

AI.title_translation: GPU原生多区域状态估计通过SIMD抽象和边界凝聚
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种GPU原生的分层多区域状态估计框架，通过SIMD抽象和稀疏Schur局部凝聚来加速电力系统状态估计，以应对大规模系统和实时性挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统的集中式电力系统状态估计求解器随着系统规模和实时性要求的增长，面临越来越大的计算压力和瓶颈。
AI.method: 该方法将电网划分为多个区域，使用固定稀疏模板评估测量残差和导数，并通过融合的GPU累积核直接组装局部正规方程块，避免显式雅可比矩阵。每个区域在GPU上以Schur模式分解，导出密集的局部边界块和凝聚的右侧，最后在设备上组装并求解简化的全局边界系统。此设计在整个过程中保持设备驻留性并暴露区域间并行性。
AI.result: 在分区PEGASE 2869-bus、PEGASE 9241-bus和ACTIVSg10k基准系统上的数值实验表明，所提出的方法通过保持完全设备驻留性和高算术强度，有效利用了GPU的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的GPU原生多区域状态估计方法通过其创新的SIMD抽象和边界凝聚设计，能够有效利用GPU吞吐量，解决大规模电力系统状态估计的计算效率问题。

title: Judging the Judges: A Systematic Evaluation of Bias Mitigation Strategies in LLM-as-a-Judge Pipelines
comments: 16 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Under review at TMLR
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge has become the dominant paradigm for evaluating language model outputs, yet LLM judges exhibit systematic biases that compromise evaluation reliability. We present a comprehensive empirical study comparing nine debiasing strategies across five judge models from four provider families (Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta), three benchmarks (MT-Bench n=400, LLMBar n=200, custom n=225), and four bias types. Our key findings: (1) Style bias is the dominant bias (0.76-0.92 across all models), far exceeding position bias (<= 0.04), yet has received minimal research attention. (2) All models show a conciseness preference on expansion pairs, but truncation controls confirm they correctly distinguish quality from length (0.92-1.00 accuracy), suggesting quality-sensitive evaluation rather than a simple length bias. (3) Debiasing is beneficial but model-dependent: the combined budget strategy significantly improves Claude Sonnet 4 by +11.2 pp (p < 0.0001), with directionally positive trends for other models. Only 2 of 20 non-baseline configurations show decreased agreement. We release our evaluation framework, controlled dataset, and all experimental artifacts at https://github.com/sksoumik/llm-as-judge.
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Under review at TMLR

title: Cooperative Informative Sensing for Monitoring Dynamic Indoor Environments via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Monitoring human activity in indoor environments is important for applications such as facility management, safety assessment, and space utilization analysis. While mobile robot teams offer the potential to actively improve observation quality, existing multi-robot monitoring and active perception approaches typically rely on coverage or visitation based objectives that are weakly aligned with the accuracy requirements of human-centric monitoring tasks. In this work, we formulate cooperative active observation as a decentralized control problem in which multiple robots adjust their motion to directly optimize monitoring accuracy under partial observability. We propose a learning-based framework for cooperative policies from decentralized observations using multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), supported by an architecture that handles variable numbers of humans and temporal dependencies. Simulation results across diverse indoor environments and monitoring tasks show that the proposed approach consistently outperforms classical coverage, persistent monitoring, and learning-free multi-robot baselines, while remaining robust to changes in the number of observed humans.

title: A 99-Line Homogenization Code for Lattice-skin Plate Structures
summary: Recent years have seen growing application potential for Lattice-skin Plate Structures in advanced manufacturing fields such as aerospace and automotive engineering. For multiscale performance evaluation of such structures, conventional homogenization methods for lattice-filled volume structures are often used for equivalent analysis. However, in finite-thickness Lattice-skin Plate Structures, periodic boundary conditions imposed along the three orthogonal directions of the representative cell cannot adequately capture the boundary effect of the free surfaces in the thickness direction, which introduces bias into the prediction of effective properties. To reduce this bias, this study develops and open-sources a homogenization method for Lattice-skin Plate Structures, forming an open-source computational framework for this class of structures. Representative numerical examples show that the framework can stably extract effective plate/shell stiffness matrices and can be extended to predict multiphase material properties and analyze steady-state heat conduction. The tool provides an open and reusable analysis foundation for the high-fidelity design of multifunctional lightweight structures.

title: An Exponentially stable Extended Kalman Filter with Estimate dependent Process noise Covariance for Chemical Reaction Networks
summary: Biomolecular systems are often modeled with partially known nonlinear stochastic dynamics, making state and parameter estimation a central challenge. While Kalman filtering techniques are widely used in this setting, their performance critically depends on the choice of the process noise covariance, which is typically assumed constant and heuristically tuned. Such assumptions are not justified for biomolecular systems, where intrinsic noise arises from underlying reaction kinetics. In this work, we propose an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) with a state estimate-dependent process noise covariance based on Chemical Langevin Equation (CLE). Further, we analyze the stochastic stability of the proposed filter and derive conditions under which the estimation error remains exponentially bounded in the mean-square sense. In particular, we obtain an upper bound on the sampling period for discrete-time biomolecular systems that guarantees this property. The proposed framework is validated through simulations on a nonlinear gene expression model. This approach enables first principle-based modeling and filter design choices for synthetic biomolecular circuits, eliminating the need for heuristic tuning of the process noise covariance.

title: Designing escalation criteria for international AI incident response: criteria, triggers, and thresholds
summary: AI incident reporting requirements are emerging in regulation and policy, yet no operational criteria exist for determining when a detected AI incident warrants escalation beyond national handling to international coordination. This paper proposes an escalation framework to address this gap, intended as a common reference point across jurisdictions that enables aligned escalation while preserving flexibility in how actors respond within their own legal and policy contexts. We review SB 53, the EU AI Act, the GPAI Code of Practice, and incident frameworks from other industries to derive eight criteria for assessing whether an incident warrants escalation, translated into a sequential flowchart with gated decision points and threshold checks. For each criterion, we map how it interplays with these regulatory frameworks, identifying where their design choices support or undermine effective detection. We test the framework against ten documented AI incidents and structured variants to identify where criteria under-detect or misclassify incidents in practice. We find three design patterns that may lead to systematic under-detection in regimes where model developers are responsible for escalation: a. where escalation requires confirmed harm, events such as model weight exfiltration risk detection only after severe, irreversible harm has propagated; b. where incidents are assessed individually, systemic harms emerging from accumulation risk being under-detected; and c. where thresholds align with legal instruments rather than quantitatively testable terms, criteria risk being impractical to apply under time pressure. We also find that escalation rules are only one component of a broader framework: the underlying definitions against which thresholds are set, and the data available to the responsible actor, create interdependencies that can themselves drive under-detection.

title: A Unified Fractional Regularization Framework for Sparse Recovery
summary: We propose a unified fractional regularization framework for sparse signal recovery based on the $\ell_1/\ell_p^q$ model. Our main theoretical contribution is the characterization of the equivalence between the first-order stationary points of the $\ell_1/\ell_p^q$ formulation and the subtractive $\ell_1 - α\ell_p$ model, providing a unified perspective on these nonconvex regularizers. In addition, we establish a new sufficient recovery condition under the Restricted Isometry Property (RIP), showing that the framework's robustness even under high-coherence sensing matrices. To solve the resulting problem, we develop a majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm and prove its convergence via the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz (KL) property. Numerical experiments on different sensing matrices and MRI reconstruction demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently outperforms existing methods.

title: DyABD: The Abdominal Muscle Segmentation in Dynamic MRI Benchmark
summary: This work introduces DyABD, a novel and complex benchmark dataset of dynamic abdominal MRIs from patients with abdominal hernias and associated high quality abdominal muscle annotations. DyABD is the first-of-its-kind in four key ways; (1) it proposes the first abdominal muscle segmentation task, (2) the dynamic MRIs are acquired whilst the patients perform various exercises, introducing extreme anatomical variability, making it one of the most challenging segmentation datasets to date, (3) it includes both pre and post corrective MRIs and (4) DyABD promotes clinical research into the high recurrence rates of abdominal hernias. Beyond dataset introduction, this work provides a comprehensive evaluation of the generalisation capabilities of existing segmentation models across Supervised, Few Shot and Zero Shot paradigms on the unseen DyABD dataset. This work reveals that there is still room for substantial improvement in the field of medical image segmentation, with the majority of techniques achieving a Dice Coefficient of 0.82.
