AI.conclusion: EndoGov证明了显式的临床规则治理能够确保风险分层符合指南要求，同时保持竞争力的预测性能，是实现可审计、高安全性医疗AI的有效路径。
AI.translation: 用于子宫内膜癌（EC）风险分层的多模态人工智能模型通常优化总体预测性能，但缺乏强制执行强制性指南覆盖的机制，例如尽管形态学级别较高，仍将POLE突变肿瘤归入低风险组。我们提出了EndoGov，这是一个两层多智能体专家系统，将决策过程分解为D(x) = G(P(x), R)，其中专家智能体P提取结构化证据，治理智能体G应用可执行规则集R。第一层包括病理、分子和临床智能体，它们独立地从冻结的基础模型特征或结构化记录中生成受模式约束的报告。第二层查询证据级别加权的指南知识图谱，使用确定性硬路径规则进行高优先级覆盖，并对模糊案例使用受约束的软路径推理。在TCGA-UCEC（n=541）中，EndoGov在触发暴露病例中实现了0.943的准确率、0.973的宏AUC和0.93%的条件逻辑违规率（C-LVR）。在参考标签为指南导出的CPTAC-UCEC（n=95）中，EndoGov的准确率为0.842，而锁定迁移神经基线低于0.31，支持分布偏移下的治理路径迁移，而不是针对独立临床事实的验证。端到端安全性分解将残余故障主要定位在上游分子检测，而不是下游治理。后端交换实验进一步表明，硬路径合规性与LLM后端无关。这些发现表明，显式的临床规则治理可以提供符合指南、可审计的EC风险分配，同时保持竞争性辨别力。
AI.summary: EndoGov是一个用于子宫内膜癌风险分层的多智能体专家系统，它通过将决策过程分解为证据提取（Tier 1）和基于指南知识图谱的规则治理（Tier 2），成功实现了符合临床指南要求的风险评估，解决了传统黑盒模型难以执行强制性临床规则的难题。
AI.keywords: 子宫内膜癌, 多智能体系统, 知识治理, 风险分层, 指南合规性
AI.comments: 该研究通过将临床指南显式编码为知识图谱，解决了传统黑盒AI模型难以强制执行临床规则（如POLE突变优先级）的问题。其创新点在于将决策过程分解为证据提取和规则治理两个层级，不仅提高了风险分层的准确性，还显著增强了模型的可解释性和安全性，在医疗合规性AI领域具有重要参考价值。

title: Bringing a Personal Point of View: Evaluating Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Scene Reconstruction
comments: Accepted at the EgoVis Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Egocentric video provides a unique view into human perception and interaction, with growing relevance for augmented reality, robotics, and assistive technologies. However, rapid camera motion and complex scene dynamics pose major challenges for 3D reconstruction from this perspective. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a state-of-the-art method for efficient, high-quality novel view synthesis, variants, that focus on reconstructing dynamic scenes from monocular video are rarely evaluated on egocentric video. It remains unclear whether existing models generalize to this setting or if egocentric-specific solutions are needed. In this work, we evaluate dynamic monocular 3DGS models on egocentric and exocentric video using paired ego-exo recordings from the EgoExo4D dataset. We find that reconstruction quality is consistently lower in egocentric views. Analysis reveals that the difference in reconstruction quality, measured in peak signal-to-noise ratio, stems from the reconstruction of static, not dynamic, content. Our findings underscore current limitations and motivate the development of egocentric-specific approaches, while also highlighting the value of separately evaluating static and dynamic regions of a video.
comment: Accepted at the EgoVis Workshop at CVPR 2026

title: Reparameterization through Coverings and Topological Weight Priors
summary: We generalise the reparameterization trick applied in variational autoencoders (VAEs) letting these have latent spaces of non-trivial topology - i.e. that of base manifolds covered with other ones, on which some technique for RT is available. That is possible since covering maps are measurable - moreover, in case of particular measure preservation property holding for the covering, one can establish an inequality on KL-divergence between pushforward (PF) densities on the base latent manifold, making the KL-term of VAE's ELBO analytically tractable, despite the topological non-triviality of the supporting latent manifold. Our development follows a route close but somewhat alternative to reparameterization on Lie groups, the latest proposal for which is to reparameterize PFs of normal densities from the Lie algebra - "through" the exponential map, seen by us as sometimes a particular case of what we propose to call reparameterization through a covering. Covering maps need not be global diffeomorphisms (although Lie-exp maps, in general, need not either, but, to date only smooth ones were considered in this context, to the best of our knowledge), which makes many non-trivial topologies tamable to our proposed technique, that we detail on a particular such example. We demonstrate the working of our approach by constructing a VAE with the latent space of Klein bottle (not a Lie group) topology, which we call KleinVAE, successfully learning an appropriate artificial dataset. We discuss potential applicability of such topology-informed generative models as weight priors in Bayesian learning, particularly for convolutional vision models, where said manifold was peculiarly shown to have some relevance.

AI.title_translation: 通过覆盖与拓扑权重先验进行重参数化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用拓扑覆盖映射在复杂非平凡潜在空间（如克莱因瓶）中实现VAE重参数化的方法，并验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的VAE重参数化技巧通常假设潜在空间具有平凡拓扑，限制了模型对具有复杂拓扑结构（如非欧几里得流形）数据的建模能力。
AI.method: 通过引入拓扑覆盖映射（Covering maps）来处理非平凡拓扑潜在空间，并利用覆盖映射的测度保持特性，推导出基流形上前推（pushforward）密度的KL散度解析解，从而实现VAE的重参数化。
AI.result: 成功构建了基于克莱因瓶拓扑空间的KleinVAE模型，并证明了该模型能够有效学习人工数据集，验证了该方法在处理非平凡拓扑空间时的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种基于覆盖映射的重参数化方法，使得在非平凡拓扑空间（如克莱因瓶）上构建VAE成为可能，并展示了其在处理特定数据集及作为贝叶斯学习中权重先验的潜在价值。
AI.translation: 我们推广了变分自编码器（VAE）中应用的重参数化技巧，使其能够处理非平凡拓扑的潜在空间——即以其他流形为覆盖的基流形，且在这些覆盖流形上存在可用的重参数化技术。这是可行的，因为覆盖映射是可测的；此外，如果覆盖满足特定的测度保持属性，我们可以在基潜在流形上的前推（PF）密度之间建立关于KL散度的不等式，从而使得VAE的ELBO中的KL项在解析上变得可处理，尽管支撑潜在流形具有拓扑非平凡性。我们的发展路径与李群上的重参数化相近但略有不同，后者最近的提议是从李代数出发，通过指数映射来重参数化正态密度的PF，我们将其视为我们所提议的“通过覆盖进行重参数化”的一种特例。覆盖映射不一定是全局微分同胚（尽管李指数映射通常也不一定是，但据我们所知，迄今为止在此背景下仅考虑了光滑映射），这使得许多非平凡拓扑结构能够通过我们提出的技术进行处理，我们通过一个特定的例子详细说明了这一点。我们通过构建一个具有克莱因瓶（非李群）拓扑潜在空间的VAE（称为KleinVAE）来展示我们方法的有效性，并成功学习了一个人工数据集。我们讨论了此类拓扑信息生成模型作为贝叶斯学习中权重先验的潜在适用性，特别是在卷积视觉模型中，因为上述流形已被证明具有一定的相关性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过拓扑覆盖实现重参数化的通用方法，扩展了VAE的潜在空间范围。通过利用覆盖映射的测度保持属性，作者解决了非平凡拓扑流形上KL散度难以处理的问题，并成功实现了基于克莱因瓶拓扑的KleinVAE。
AI.keywords: 变分自编码器, 重参数化技巧, 拓扑覆盖, 潜在空间, 克莱因瓶
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入拓扑覆盖（Covering）的概念，极大地扩展了变分自编码器（VAE）中重参数化技巧的适用范围，使其能够处理具有复杂非平凡拓扑结构的潜在空间。其创新点在于证明了利用覆盖映射可以实现KL散度的解析化，为处理非欧几里得空间（如克莱因瓶）的生成模型提供了理论支撑。该方法在处理具有周期性或特定几何约束的数据建模中具有重要潜力。

title: Symmetric Equilibrium Propagation for Thermodynamic Diffusion Training
summary: The reverse process in score-based diffusion models is formally equivalent to overdamped Langevin dynamics in a time-dependent energy landscape. In our prior work we showed that a bilinearly-coupled analog substrate can physically realize this dynamics at a projected three-to-four orders of magnitude energy advantage over digital inference by replacing dense skip connections with low-rank inter-module couplings. Whether the \emph{training} loop can be closed on the same substrate -- without routing gradients through an external digital accelerator -- has remained open. We resolve this affirmatively: Equilibrium Propagation applied directly to the bilinear energy yields an unbiased estimator of the denoising score-matching gradient in the zero-nudge limit. For finite nudging we derive a sharp bias bound controlled solely by substrate stiffness, local curvature, and the norm of the loss-gradient signal, with a bilinear-specific corollary showing that one dominant bias term vanishes identically for coupling-parameter updates. Symmetric nudging further upgrades the leading bias from $ \mathcal{O}(β) $ to $ \mathcal{O}(β^2) $ at negligible extra cost. Under realistic finite-relaxation budgets this upgrade is essential, as one-sided EqProp produces anti-correlated gradients while symmetric EqProp yields well-aligned updates. Bias-variance analysis determines the optimal operating point, and end-to-end physical-unit accounting projects a $ 10^3$-$10^4\times $ energy advantage per training step over a matched GPU baseline. Symmetric bilinear EqProp is the first local, readout-only training rule that preserves the low-rank coupling enabling scalable thermodynamic diffusion models.

title: Compile-Time Tensor Shape Checking via Staged Shape-Dependent Types
comments: A long version of a conference paper to appear on ECOOP 2026
summary: When writing programs involving matrices or tensors in general, it is desirable to rule out the inconsistency of tensor shapes (i.e., the generalization of matrix sizes) before actual computation. For this purpose, some languages provide dependent types such as Mat m n, and others offer refinement types to track predicates for shapes. Despite the theoretical maturity, however, such methods are often unhandy for continuous software development due to the requirement of proofs for judging type equality or subtyping; even automated proving is often unsuitable due to its unforeseeable time consumption. To remedy this, our study provides an alternative formalization by using staging. Based on the observation that conditions for the shape consistency can be extracted before running the actual tensor computations in many typical cases, we ensure such consistency by assertions evaluated as compile-time computations, not by proofs. Under this formalization, we can verify the consistency virtually statically in the sense that inconsistencies as to tensor shapes will be immediately detected as assertion failures during compile-time computation. Our work achieves a mathematical guarantee that successfully generated code is always consistent with respect to tensor shapes. Furthermore, to vastly lessen the burden of adding shape- or stage-related descriptions, we (1) allow shape-related arguments to be implicit and infer them in a best-effort manner, and (2) offer a non-staged surface language that seemingly resembles ordinary dependently-typed languages and translate its programs into the staged core language. By a prototype implementation, we confirm that our language is expressive enough to verify a number of programs, including several examples offered by ocaml-torch.

title: LegalDrill: Diagnosis-Driven Synthesis for Legal Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: Small language models (SLMs) are promising for real-world deployment due to their efficiency and low operational cost. However, their limited capacity struggles with high-stakes legal reasoning tasks that require coherent statute interpretation and logically consistent deduction. Furthermore, training SLMs for such tasks demands high-quality, concise reasoning trajectories, which are prohibitively expensive to manually collect and difficult to curate via standard rejection sampling, lacking granularity beyond final verdicts. To address these challenges, we propose {LegalDrill}, a diagnosis-driven synthesis framework that extracts and iteratively refines reasoning trajectories from a capable teacher via fine-grained prompting, then a self-reflective verification is employed to adaptively select the most effective data for the SLM student. The resulting data empower SLM training through supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. Extensive experiments on several legal benchmarks demonstrate that {LegalDrill} significantly bolsters the legal reasoning capabilities of representative SLMs while bypassing the need for scarce expert annotations, paving a scalable path toward practical legal reasoning systems.

AI.title_translation: LegalDrill：用于小语言模型法律推理的诊断驱动合成方法
AI.tldr: LegalDrill 通过诊断引导的合成数据生成和反思验证机制，解决了小语言模型法律推理能力不足及高质量训练数据稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型在复杂的法律推理任务中能力受限，且高质量、细粒度的法律推理训练数据获取成本高昂且难以通过标准采样获得。
AI.method: 提出 LegalDrill 框架，通过细粒度提示从教师模型提取推理轨迹，结合自我反思验证机制筛选高质量数据，并应用于监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.result: 实验表明，LegalDrill 显著提升了代表性小语言模型的法律推理能力，并在多个基准测试中表现优异，有效降低了对专家标注的依赖。
AI.conclusion: LegalDrill 证明了通过诊断驱动的合成数据训练，可以在不依赖昂贵专家标注的情况下，显著提升小语言模型在法律推理任务中的逻辑一致性和解释能力。
AI.translation: 小语言模型（SLMs）因其高效和低运营成本，在实际部署中具有广阔前景。然而，它们有限的容量难以胜任需要连贯法规解读和逻辑一致推理的高风险法律任务。此外，为此类任务训练 SLMs 需要高质量、简洁的推理轨迹，这类数据的手动收集成本高昂，且难以通过标准的拒绝采样进行筛选，缺乏超越最终结论的细粒度。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 LegalDrill，这是一种诊断驱动的合成框架，通过细粒度提示从能力较强的教师模型中提取并迭代优化推理轨迹，然后采用自我反思验证来自适应地为 SLM 学生选择最有效的数据。所得数据通过监督微调和直接偏好优化来赋能 SLM 训练。在多个法律基准上的广泛实验表明，LegalDrill 在无需稀缺专家标注的情况下，显著增强了代表性 SLM 的法律推理能力，为构建实用的法律推理系统开辟了一条可扩展的路径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LegalDrill，这是一个诊断驱动的数据合成框架，旨在通过教师模型生成并精炼高质量的推理轨迹，配合自我反思验证机制筛选数据，从而提升小语言模型在复杂法律推理任务中的表现。
AI.keywords: 法律推理, 小语言模型, 数据合成, 诊断驱动, 指令微调
AI.comments: 该研究针对小语言模型（SLMs）在复杂法律推理任务中表现不足的问题，提出了一种创新的“诊断驱动”数据合成范式。其核心价值在于无需昂贵的人工标注，通过教师模型引导和自我反思验证，实现了高质量推理轨迹的自动生成与筛选，为资源受限场景下的专业模型训练提供了高效路径。

title: Similar Users-Augmented Interest Network
summary: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is one of the core tasks in recommender systems. User behavior sequences, as one of the most effective features, can accurately reflect user preferences and significantly improve prediction accuracy. Richer behavior sequences often enable more comprehensive user profiling, and recent studies have shown that scaling the length of user behavior sequence can yield substantial gains in CTR. However, due to the widespread sparsity in recommender systems, incomplete behavior sequences are common in real-world scenarios. Existing sequential modeling methods often rely solely on the target user's own behavior, and therefore struggle in such scenarios. This paper proposes a novel method called SUIN (Similar Users-augmented Interest Network), which enhances the target user's behavior sequence with behaviors from similar users to enhance the user profile for CTR prediction. Specifically, we use behavior embeddings encoded by a sequence encoder to retrieve users with similar behaviors from a user retrieval pool. The behavior sequences of these similar users are then concatenated with that of the target user in descending order of similarity to construct an augmented sequence. Given that the augmented sequence contains behaviors from multiple users, we propose a user-specific target-aware position encoding, which identifies the source user of each behavior and captures its relative position to the target item. Furthermore, to mitigate the empirically observed noise in similar users' behaviors, we design a user-aware target attention that jointly considers item-item and user-user correlations, fully exploiting the potential of the augmented behavior sequence. Comprehensive experiments on widely-used short-term and long-term sequence benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art sequential CTR models.

AI.title_translation: 相似用户增强兴趣网络
AI.tldr: 针对推荐系统用户行为稀疏问题，SUIN通过融合相似用户的行为序列并设计相应的噪声抑制机制，显著提升了点击率预测性能。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中存在普遍的数据稀疏问题，导致目标用户的行为序列往往不完整，仅依靠目标用户自身的行为难以精准刻画用户兴趣，从而限制了点击率预测的准确性。
AI.method: 提出SUIN模型：首先利用序列编码器检索相似用户，将相似用户的行为序列与目标用户行为序列拼接；接着采用用户特定的目标感知位置编码以区分行为来源并定位相对位置；最后通过用户感知的目标注意力机制处理扩充序列，以缓解噪声影响并提取有效特征。
AI.result: 在多个广泛使用的短期和长期序列基准数据集上的实验表明，SUIN模型在CTR预测任务中显著优于当前的先进序列模型。
AI.conclusion: SUIN通过整合相似用户的行为信息并配合专门设计的注意力机制，成功克服了数据稀疏带来的序列不完整问题，在CTR预测任务中表现优于现有最优模型。
AI.translation: 点击率（CTR）预测是推荐系统中的核心任务之一。用户行为序列作为最有效的特征之一，能够准确反映用户偏好并显著提高预测准确性。更丰富的行为序列通常能实现更全面的用户画像，近期研究表明，增加用户行为序列的长度可以为CTR预测带来实质性的增益。然而，由于推荐系统中普遍存在稀疏性，不完整的行为序列在现实场景中非常常见。现有的序列建模方法往往仅依赖目标用户自身的行为，因此在这些场景下表现不佳。本文提出了一种名为SUIN（相似用户增强兴趣网络）的新方法，通过利用相似用户的行为来增强目标用户的行为序列，从而优化CTR预测的用户画像。具体而言，我们使用由序列编码器编码的行为嵌入，从用户检索池中检索行为相似的用户。然后，将这些相似用户的行为序列按相似度降序与目标用户的行为序列拼接，构建增强序列。鉴于增强序列包含来自多个用户的行为，我们提出了用户特定的目标感知位置编码，用以识别每个行为的来源用户，并捕获其相对于目标物品的相对位置。此外，为了减轻在相似用户行为中观察到的经验性噪声，我们设计了用户感知的目标注意力机制，该机制综合考虑了物品-物品和用户-用户之间的相关性，充分挖掘了增强行为序列的潜力。在广泛使用的短期和长期序列基准数据集上的全面实验证明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的序列化CTR模型。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种相似用户增强兴趣网络（SUIN），旨在通过引入相似用户的行为序列来弥补目标用户行为数据稀疏的缺陷。该方法通过检索相似用户并拼接行为序列，结合专门设计的用户特定位置编码和用户感知目标注意力机制，有效提升了CTR预测的准确性。
AI.keywords: 点击率预测, 行为序列, 用户画像, 相似用户增强, 序列建模
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入相似用户行为来解决推荐系统中用户行为序列稀疏的问题，这一思路非常实用。其创新点在于设计了用户特定的目标感知位置编码和用户感知的目标注意力机制，有效地平衡了序列扩充带来的噪声问题，是序列化CTR建模领域的一个有力补充。

title: SeqShield: A Behavioral Analysis Approach to Uncover Rootkits
comments: 15 pages, 1 Algorithm, 1 Architecute Digram. Model training on both relevant features and irrelevant features with featured extraction method is explored
summary: Rootkits are among the most elusive types of malware, capable of bypassing traditional static analysis methods due to their metamorphic behavior. Signature-based detection techniques struggle against these threats, necessitating a shift toward dynamic analysis approaches. We propose SeqShield, a behavior-based rootkit detection approach designed specifically for the Windows OS, leveraging API call sequences for dynamic behavior analysis. Instead of relying on static signatures, SeqShield examines the execution patterns of API calls, which inherently reflect malicious intent. Analyzing API sequences, we can effectively identify rootkit-like behavior. We also employed a metamorphic code engine to generate 10X mutated variants of rootkits, demonstrating their obfuscation strategies. SeqShield applies n-gram analysis to extract bigram and trigram features from these API call sequences, enabling effective detection of rootkit-like activity. Among the models tested, Random Forest achieves the highest accuracy of 97.27% (bigram) and 96.17% (trigram). To optimize performance and decrease the dimension, we apply feature importance ranking using the Gini Impurity Index, iteratively selecting the most significant features. The optimized lower-dimensional feature matrix significantly enhances detection efficiency without sacrificing accuracy. Using the optimized feature set, our approach achieves 96.72% accuracy for bigrams and 97.81% accuracy for trigrams.
comment: 15 pages, 1 Algorithm, 1 Architecute Digram. Model training on both relevant features and irrelevant features with featured extraction method is explored

AI.title_translation: SeqShield：一种揭露Rootkit的行为分析方法
AI.tldr: SeqShield通过分析Windows API调用序列并结合随机森林模型，实现了对变体Rootkit的高效、高精度检测。
AI.motivation: 传统基于签名的静态分析方法难以检测具有变体行为的Rootkit，亟需一种基于动态行为分析的有效检测方案。
AI.method: 提出SeqShield框架，通过捕获Windows系统中的API调用序列，利用n-gram（bigram和trigram）提取行为特征；应用随机森林（Random Forest）模型进行分类，并使用基尼不纯度指数（Gini Impurity Index）进行特征重要性排序与降维优化。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，随机森林模型在bigram和trigram特征下分别达到了97.27%和96.17%的准确率；经过特征降维优化后，trigram准确率进一步提升至97.81%，且显著提高了检测效率。
AI.conclusion: SeqShield提供了一种高效且准确的Windows环境Rootkit检测方案，通过优化特征维度，在保证高检测率的同时提高了系统性能，证明了基于API调用序列的行为分析在对抗变体恶意软件方面的有效性。
AI.translation: Rootkit是最难以捉摸的恶意软件类型之一，由于其变体行为，它们能够绕过传统的静态分析方法。基于签名的检测技术在应对这些威胁时显得力不从心，因此有必要转向动态分析方法。我们提出了SeqShield，这是一种专门为Windows操作系统设计的基于行为的Rootkit检测方法，利用API调用序列进行动态行为分析。SeqShield不依赖于静态签名，而是检查API调用的执行模式，这些模式本质上反映了恶意意图。通过分析API序列，我们可以有效地识别类似Rootkit的行为。我们还使用了一个变体代码引擎来生成10倍的Rootkit变体，以展示它们的混淆策略。SeqShield应用n-gram分析从这些API调用序列中提取bigram和trigram特征，从而实现对类似Rootkit活动的有效检测。在测试的模型中，随机森林达到了最高的准确率，分别为97.27%（bigram）和96.17%（trigram）。为了优化性能并降低维度，我们使用基尼不纯度指数进行特征重要性排序，并迭代选择最重要的特征。优化后的低维特征矩阵在不牺牲准确性的前提下，显著提高了检测效率。使用优化后的特征集，我们的方法在bigram上达到了96.72%的准确率，在trigram上达到了97.81%的准确率。
AI.summary: SeqShield是一种针对Windows系统的行为分析Rootkit检测方法，它通过分析API调用序列的执行模式，利用n-gram技术提取特征，并结合随机森林分类器与基尼不纯度特征降维技术，实现了对变体Rootkit的高精度与高效率检测。
AI.keywords: Rootkit检测, 行为分析, API调用序列, n-gram分析, 特征选择
AI.comments: 该研究通过利用API调用序列这一行为特征，成功绕过了传统静态分析对变体Rootkit检测的局限性。其创新点在于结合了n-gram特征提取与基尼不纯度指数（Gini Impurity Index）的特征选择，在保持高精度的同时显著提升了检测效率，具有较强的实际应用价值。

title: ShredBench: Evaluating the Semantic Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs in Document Reconstruction
comments: ACL 2026 Findings. Code available at https://github.com/ythere-y/ShredBench
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in Visually Rich Document Understanding (VRDU) tasks, but their capabilities are mainly evaluated on pristine, well-structured document images. We consider content restoration from shredded fragments, a challenging VRDU setting that requires integrating visual pattern recognition with semantic reasoning under significant content discontinuities. To facilitate systematic evaluation of complex VRDU tasks, we introduce ShredBench, a benchmark supported by an automated generation pipeline that renders fragmented documents directly from Markdown. The proposed pipeline ensures evaluation validity by allowing the flexible integration of latest or unseen textual sources to prevent training data contamination. ShredBench assesses four scenarios (English, Chinese, Code, Table) with three fragmentation granularities (8, 12, 16 pieces). Empirical evaluations on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a significant performance gap: The method is effective on intact documents; however, once the document is shredded, restoration becomes a significant challenge, with NED dropping sharply as fragmentation increases. Our findings highlight that current MLLMs lack the fine-grained cross-modal reasoning required to bridge visual discontinuities, identifying a critical gap in robust VRDU research.
comment: ACL 2026 Findings. Code available at https://github.com/ythere-y/ShredBench

AI.title_translation: ShredBench：评估多模态大模型在文档重构中的语义推理能力
AI.tldr: ShredBench基准测试揭示了多模态大模型在处理碎片化文档时，因缺乏细粒度跨模态推理能力而表现出显著的性能下降。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型在视觉富文档理解任务中的评估多基于完整、结构良好的文档，缺乏对碎片化文档重构这一复杂场景的评估，无法全面衡量模型的逻辑推理能力。
AI.method: 提出ShredBench基准测试，并开发了一套自动化文档碎片化生成流水线，通过渲染Markdown文件生成不同语言和代码格式的碎片化文档，涵盖多种碎片颗粒度。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有模型在完整文档上表现良好，但面对碎片化文档时，随着碎片数量增加，归一化编辑距离（NED）急剧下降，性能差距显著。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的多模态大模型在处理碎片化文档时存在明显的性能瓶颈，缺乏克服视觉不连续性所需的细粒度跨模态推理能力，亟需进一步研究。
AI.translation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）在视觉富文档理解（VRDU）任务中取得了显著成就，但其能力主要是在原始、结构良好的文档图像上进行评估的。我们考虑从碎片中恢复内容，这是一个具有挑战性的VRDU设置，需要在内容严重不连续的情况下，将视觉模式识别与语义推理相结合。为了促进对复杂VRDU任务的系统评估，我们引入了ShredBench，这是一个由自动化生成流水线支持的基准，该流水线直接从Markdown渲染碎片化文档。所提出的流水线通过允许灵活集成最新的或未见过的文本源来防止训练数据污染，从而确保评估的有效性。ShredBench评估了四种场景（英语、中文、代码、表格）以及三种碎片粒度（8、12、16片）。对最先进的MLLMs的实证评估揭示了一个显著的性能差距：该方法在完整文档上有效；然而，一旦文档被粉碎，恢复就变得非常困难，随着碎片化的增加，归一化编辑距离（NED）急剧下降。我们的研究结果强调，当前的MLLMs缺乏弥合视觉不连续性所需的细粒度跨模态推理能力，确定了稳健VRDU研究中的一个关键差距。
AI.summary: ShredBench是一个专门评估多模态大模型在碎片化文档重构任务中语义推理能力的基准。该研究通过自动化流水线生成碎片化数据，评估发现模型在处理视觉不连续文档时能力严重受限。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 文档重建, 视觉富文档理解, 基准测试, 跨模态推理
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入ShredBench基准测试，揭示了当前多模态大模型在处理非结构化、碎片化文档时的逻辑推理能力短板。其创新之处在于构建了一个能够防止数据污染的自动化碎片化文档生成流水线，对评估模型在复杂视觉任务中的稳健性具有重要意义。

title: Mapping License Plate Recoverability Under Extreme Viewing Angles for Oppor-tunistic Urban Sensing
summary: Urban environments contain many imaging sensors built for specific purposes, including ATM, body-worn, CCTV, and dashboard cameras. Under the opportunistic sensing paradigm, these sensors can be repurposed for secondary inference tasks such as license plate recognition. Yet objects of interest in such imagery are often noisy, low-resolution, and captured from extreme viewpoints. Recent advances in AI-based restoration can recover use-ful information even from severely degraded images. A central challenge is determining which distortion parame-ters allow reliable recovery and which lead to inference failure. This paper introduces recoverability maps, a task-agnostic method for quantifying this boundary. The method combines a dense synthetic sweep of degrada-tion parameters with two summary measures: boundary area-under-curve, which estimates the recoverable frac-tion of the parameter space, and a reliability score, which captures the frequency and severity of failures within that region. We demonstrate the method on license plate recognition from highly angled views under realistic camera artifacts. Several restoration architectures are trained and evaluated, including U-Net, Restormer, Pix2Pix, and SR3 diffusion. The best model recovers about 93% of the parameter space. Similar results across models sug-gest that sensing geometry, rather than architecture, sets the limit of recovery.

AI.title_translation: 面向机会城市感知的极端视角下车牌可恢复性映射研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种量化方法来确定在极端视角和降质条件下，车牌图像是否能被成功恢复，发现视角限制比AI模型架构更能决定恢复的上限。
AI.motivation: 城市环境中存在大量可用于“机会感知”的成像传感器，但在极端视角、低分辨率和噪声环境下，如何确定这些图像在何种畸变参数下仍能可靠地识别车牌是一个尚未解决的关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“可恢复性地图”的通用方法，通过结合密集合成退化参数扫描、边界曲线下面积（AUC）评估以及可靠性评分，来量化图像恢复的边界和失败风险。并对U-Net、Restormer、Pix2Pix和SR3等多种架构进行了训练与评估。
AI.result: 研究表明最佳模型可恢复约93%的参数空间。实验发现，不同模型在处理极端视角下的表现相似，证明了传感几何结构在限制恢复能力方面起决定性作用。
AI.conclusion: 感知几何结构（视角）是限制图像恢复能力的主要因素，而非模型架构。研究提出的可恢复性地图方法有效地量化了恢复的边界与可靠性。
AI.translation: 城市环境包含了许多为特定目的构建的成像传感器，包括ATM、随身摄像头、CCTV和行车记录仪。在机会感知范式下，这些传感器可以被重新利用于诸如车牌识别等二次推理任务。然而，这些图像中的目标物体通常伴随噪声、低分辨率，且是在极端视角下拍摄的。基于AI的图像恢复技术的最新进展，即使从严重退化的图像中也能恢复有用的信息。一个核心挑战是确定哪些畸变参数允许可靠的恢复，哪些会导致推理失败。本文介绍了可恢复性地图，这是一种用于量化该边界的任务无关方法。该方法结合了退化参数的密集合成扫描与两个汇总指标：边界曲线下面积（估计参数空间的可恢复分数）和可靠性评分（捕捉该区域内失败的频率和严重程度）。我们在现实相机伪影下的高角度车牌识别上演示了该方法。我们训练并评估了多种恢复架构，包括U-Net、Restormer、Pix2Pix和SR3扩散模型。表现最好的模型恢复了约93%的参数空间。各模型相似的结果表明，传感几何结构而非架构本身，设定了恢复的极限。
AI.summary: 本文针对城市机会感知场景中图像质量差、视角极端的问题，提出了一种名为“可恢复性地图”的量化方法，用于评估图像恢复的可靠边界。通过对多种主流图像恢复模型进行实验，验证了该方法能有效量化恢复参数空间，并得出结论：感知的几何限制是决定图像恢复成败的关键，而非模型架构本身。
AI.keywords: 城市传感, 车牌识别, 图像恢复, 可恢复性地图, 视角限制
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了“可恢复性地图（recoverability maps）”这一量化框架，将原本模糊的图像恢复边界问题转化为可评估的参数空间问题。研究指出，感知的几何限制（视角）比模型架构更能决定图像恢复的上限，这为未来在城市传感中选择何种部署策略提供了重要指导。

title: DRACULA: Hunting for the Actions Users Want Deep Research Agents to Execute
summary: Scientific Deep Research (DR) agents answer user queries by synthesizing research papers into multi-section reports. User feedback can improve their utility, but existing protocols only score the final report, making it hard to study and learn which intermediate actions DR agents should take to improve reports. We collect DRACULA, the first dataset with user feedback on intermediate actions for DR. Over five weeks, nineteen expert CS researchers ask queries to a DR system that proposes actions (e.g., "Add a section on datasets"). Our users select actions they prefer, then judge whether an output report applied their selections successfully, yielding 8,103 action preferences and 5,230 execution judgments. After confirming a DR agent can execute DRACULA's actions, we study the predictability of user-preferred actions via simulation-how well LLMs predict the actions users select-a step toward learning to generate useful actions. We discover: (1) LLM judges initially struggle to predict action selections, but improve most when using a user's full selection history, rather than self-reported or extrapolated user context signals; (2) Users' selections for the same query differ based on unstated goals, bottlenecking simulation and motivating affordances that let users steer reports; and (3) Our simulation results inform an online intervention that generates new actions based on the user's past interactions, which users pick most often in follow-up studies. Overall, while work extensively studies execution, DRACULA reveals a key challenge is deciding which actions to execute in the first place. We open-source DRACULA's study design, user feedback, and simulation tasks to spur future work on action feedback for long-horizon agents.

AI.title_translation: DRACULA：探寻用户希望深度研究代理执行的动作
AI.tldr: 针对深度研究代理缺乏中间动作反馈的问题，本文构建了DRACULA数据集，证明了利用历史交互记录预测用户动作偏好能有效提升代理的决策水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度研究（DR）评估往往只关注最终报告的质量，导致代理难以学习如何通过中间动作来优化报告生成过程，缺乏针对“执行什么动作”的反馈机制。
AI.method: 1. 构建DRACULA数据集：邀请19名CS专家对深度研究系统建议的中间动作进行选择并评估执行情况；2. 模拟研究：评估LLM预测用户偏好动作的能力；3. 在线干预：基于用户的历史交互记录，动态生成并推荐新的动作建议。
AI.result: 1. LLM在预测用户动作选择上初期表现不佳，但利用用户的完整历史记录可显著提升预测准确性；2. 同一查询下用户偏好差异巨大，受限于未表达的个人目标；3. 基于用户历史交互生成的动作建议在后续实验中被用户采纳率最高。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，深度研究代理的瓶颈不仅在于执行能力，更在于如何智能地决定执行哪些动作。DRACULA数据集为学习生成用户预期的中间动作提供了关键基础，并证明了基于历史交互的在线动作干预能有效提升用户体验。
AI.translation: 科学深度研究（DR）代理通过综合研究论文生成多章节报告来回答用户查询。用户反馈可以提高其实用性，但现有的协议只对最终报告进行评分，这使得研究和学习DR代理应采取哪些中间动作来改进报告变得困难。我们收集了DRACULA，这是第一个关于DR中间动作的用户反馈数据集。在五周的时间里，十九名计算机科学研究专家向DR系统提出查询，系统会提出动作建议（例如，“添加关于数据集的章节”）。用户选择他们偏好的动作，然后判断输出报告是否成功应用了他们的选择，产生了8,103个动作偏好和5,230个执行判断。在确认DR代理能够执行DRACULA的动作后，我们通过模拟研究了用户偏好动作的可预测性——即LLM在多大程度上能够预测用户选择的动作——这是学习生成有用动作的一步。我们发现：（1）LLM裁判最初难以预测动作选择，但在使用用户的完整选择历史记录（而不是自我报告或推断的用户上下文信号）时改进最为明显；（2）用户对同一查询的选择因未说明的目标而异，这限制了模拟效果，并促使我们需要提供让用户引导报告的交互方式；（3）我们的模拟结果为在线干预提供了依据，该干预基于用户的过去交互生成新动作，用户在后续研究中更频繁地选择这些动作。总的来说，虽然现有的工作广泛研究了执行，但DRACULA揭示了一个关键挑战是首先决定执行哪些动作。我们开源了DRACULA的研究设计、用户反馈和模拟任务，以推动未来关于长程代理动作反馈的研究。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DRACULA数据集，旨在解决深度研究代理在执行过程中的决策难题。通过收集专家对中间动作的偏好数据，研究发现利用用户历史交互记录能有效提升代理对动作决策的预测能力，并据此开发了更符合用户预期的在线动作推荐机制。
AI.keywords: 深度研究代理, 用户反馈, 中间动作决策, 交互式学习, DRACULA数据集
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将关注点从“模型执行能力”转向“动作决策逻辑”，通过构建DRACULA数据集，填补了深度研究（DR）代理在中间交互反馈层面的空白。其局限性在于用户偏好的多样性（受未陈述目标影响）导致模拟预测存在瓶颈，这表明仅靠预测用户行为是不够的，还需要更强的用户引导机制。

title: Query2Diagram: Answering Developer Queries with UML Diagrams
summary: Software documentation frequently becomes outdated or fails to exist entirely, yet developers need focused views of their codebase to understand complex systems. While automated reverse engineering tools can generate UML diagrams from code, they produce overwhelming detail without considering developer intent. We introduce query-driven UML diagram generation, where LLMs create diagrams that directly answer natural language questions about code. Unlike existing methods, our approach produces semantically focused diagrams containing only relevant elements with contextual descriptions. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-Coder-14B on a curated dataset of code files, developer queries, and corresponding diagram representations in a structured JSON format, evaluating with both automatic detection of structural defects and human assessment of semantic relevance. Results demonstrate that fine-tuning on a modest amount of manually corrected data yields dramatic improvements: our best model achieves the highest F1 scores while reducing defect rates below state-of-the-art LLMs, generating diagrams that are both structurally sound and semantically faithful to developer queries. Thus, we establish the feasibility of using LLMs for scalable contextual, on-demand documentation generation. We make our code and dataset publicly available at https://github.com/i-need-a-pencil/query2diagram.

AI.tldr: 利用微调后的大语言模型，根据开发者的自然语言查询自动生成精准、聚焦的UML图，解决传统文档工具信息冗余的问题。
AI.motivation: 软件文档常缺失或过时，而现有的自动化逆向工程工具生成的UML图往往细节过于繁杂，无法满足开发者针对特定代码问题的理解需求。
AI.method: 提出查询驱动的UML图生成方法，通过在包含代码文件、开发者查询及结构化JSON格式图表表示的精选数据集上，对Qwen2.5-Coder-14B模型进行微调，并结合结构缺陷检测与人工评估进行验证。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在F1分数上达到最高，且显著降低了结构缺陷率，能够生成既符合结构规范又精准响应开发者查询的UML图。
AI.conclusion: 通过对Qwen2.5-Coder-14B进行微调，该研究证实了利用大语言模型根据自然语言查询生成结构准确且语义相关的UML图是可行的，显著优于现有模型。
AI.translation: 软件文档常常变得过时或完全缺失，但开发者需要代码库的聚焦视图来理解复杂系统。虽然自动逆向工程工具可以从代码生成UML图，但它们在不考虑开发者意图的情况下产生了令人难以应付的细节。我们引入了查询驱动的UML图生成，即大语言模型创建直接回答关于代码的自然语言问题的图表。与现有方法不同，我们的方法生成的语义聚焦图表仅包含相关元素及上下文描述。我们在包含代码文件、开发者查询及对应JSON格式图表表示的精选数据集上微调了Qwen2.5-Coder-14B，并通过自动结构缺陷检测和人类语义相关性评估进行了验证。结果表明，在少量人工校正数据上进行微调可带来显著提升：我们的最佳模型在实现最高F1分数的同时，将缺陷率降低至优于现有最先进大语言模型的水平，生成的图表在结构上不仅合理，而且在语义上忠实于开发者的查询。因此，我们确立了使用大语言模型进行可扩展的、上下文相关的、按需文档生成的可行性。我们已在 GitHub 上公开了代码和数据集。
AI.summary: Query2Diagram是一种基于大语言模型的查询驱动UML图生成方法。它通过微调Qwen2.5-Coder-14B模型，能够根据开发者的自然语言查询，从代码库中提取相关元素并生成具备上下文描述的、语义聚焦的UML图，有效解决了传统文档生成工具信息过载且缺乏意图引导的问题。
AI.keywords: 查询驱动生成, UML图, 大语言模型, 软件文档, 代码理解
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将大语言模型与软件工程中的UML图生成任务相结合，通过引入“查询驱动”的理念，解决了传统逆向工程工具生成的文档细节冗余且缺乏针对性的问题。其局限性可能在于对复杂代码库的理解深度以及生成图表的通用性，但该方法为自动化、按需生成的软件文档提供了一条极具前景的路径。

title: FUTURAL: A Metasearch Platform for Empowering Rural Areas with Smart Solutions
summary: The FUTURAL project aims to provide a comprehensive suite of digital Smart Solutions (SS) across five critical domains to address pressing social and environmental issues. Central to this initiative is a robust Metasearch platform, which will not only serve as the primary access point to FUTURAL's solutions but also facilitate the search and retrieval of SS developed by other initiatives. This paper elaborates on the MVP implementation for the MetaSearch platform. It focuses on a single, open-source data service and harnesses the generative capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to create a user-friendly natural language interface. The design of the Minimum Viable Product (MVP), the tools used for adapting LLMs to our specific application, and our comprehensive set of evaluation techniques are thoroughly detailed. The results from our evaluations demonstrate that our approach is highly effective and can be efficiently implemented in future iterations of the MVP. This groundwork paves the way for extending the platform to include additional services and diverse data sets from the FUTURAL project, enhancing its capacity to address a broader array of queries and datasets.

title: On the Generalization Properties of Selective State-Space Models for Filtering Tasks for Unknown Systems
comments: Conference on Decision and Control 2026, 8 pages, 4 figures
summary: Selective State-Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba have emerged as an alternative architecture to self-attention based transformers in sequence modeling tasks. Recent works have demonstrated the use of transformers in some filtering and output prediction tasks via in-context learning. In this paper, we analyze whether structured SSMs can work equally well for filtering of unknown systems. In particular, we train the SSM on trajectory samples from a set of systems. At run-time, the SSM is given the outputs of an unknown system from the same set and is expected to predict the next output online. Theoretically, under appropriate assumptions, we derive generalization bounds as to why SSMs succeed in such tasks. Empirically, we demonstrate the performance via several numerical examples. We also discuss the advantages and disadvantages of SSMs versus transformers for this task.
comment: Conference on Decision and Control 2026, 8 pages, 4 figures

title: Playing Dice with the Universe: Programming Quantum Computers to Play Traditional Games
summary: The challenge of programming classical computers to play traditional, competitive games against human players has helped to advance classical hardware and software. Quantum computers have the potential to play games in a unique way: programmed only with the rules of a game, they should be able to implicitly represent all future paths of a game leading to wins, losses, or draws, and sample from this path set to identify moves that maximize the likelihood of a win. This permits skilled play without hard-coded or machine-learned strategy. As a proof of principle, we present early results obtained after programming the D-Wave quantum annealer with the rules of tic-tac-toe, enabling it to play against a human opponent. We anticipate that, as it has for classical computers, game-playing will serve as an important real-world benchmark for quantum computers.

AI.title_translation: 与宇宙掷骰子：编程量子计算机进行传统游戏博弈
AI.tldr: 利用量子退火机通过规则隐式表示博弈路径，实现无需预设策略的智能博弈，为量子计算提供了一种新的基准测试方法。
AI.motivation: 受传统计算机博弈研究推动硬件发展的启发，探索量子计算机在无需预设策略或机器学习的情况下，仅通过规则驱动进行博弈的潜力。
AI.method: 将游戏的规则编程至D-Wave量子退火机中，使其能够隐式地表示所有未来的博弈路径，并从中采样以选择最优决策。
AI.result: 成功在D-Wave量子退火机上实现了井字棋程序，并使其能够与人类玩家进行博弈，验证了该方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 游戏博弈可以作为评估量子计算机性能的重要基准，证明了量子退火机在无需预设策略的情况下进行博弈的可行性。
AI.translation: 将传统计算机编程用于与人类玩家进行竞技游戏，曾有力地推动了经典硬件和软件的发展。量子计算机在游戏博弈方面具有独特的潜力：仅需编程输入游戏规则，它们就能够隐式地表示所有通向胜、负或平局的未来路径，并通过从路径集中采样来识别出能最大化胜率的移动。这使得其在无需硬编码或机器学习策略的情况下也能实现高水平博弈。作为原理验证，我们展示了在D-Wave量子退火机上编程井字棋规则的初步结果，使其能够与人类对手进行对弈。我们预计，正如其对经典计算机所起的作用一样，游戏博弈将成为量子计算机重要的现实世界基准。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了利用量子计算机进行博弈的可能性。通过将游戏规则直接编程到D-Wave量子退火机中，系统能够隐式表示所有可能的博弈路径并进行采样以实现最优决策，无需依赖传统的硬编码或机器学习策略。实验证明了该方法在井字棋游戏中的有效性，提出博弈将成为量子计算机性能评估的重要基准。
AI.keywords: 量子计算, 量子退火, 游戏博弈, 基准测试, 井字棋
AI.comments: 该研究提出了利用量子计算解决博弈问题的创新思路，通过量子退火机隐式表示博弈路径，而非依赖传统的启发式搜索或机器学习。这为评估量子硬件能力提供了一个直观且具有挑战性的基准测试。其局限在于目前仅在井字棋这一简单游戏上进行了验证，未来在大规模复杂博弈中的表现尚待观察。

title: The software space of science
summary: Science advances not only through the accumulation of facts but also through the evolution of tools. Crucially, tools are rarely used in isolation. They form tool portfolios, combinations shaped by a discipline's workflows and analytical demands. Software, near-ubiquitous in modern research and traceable across the published literature, offers a unique window to study tool use in science. Here, we map the software space of science by analyzing mentions to software from 1.3 million publications from 2004 to 2021. We construct a network of 520 software tools linked by disciplinary co-usage, with link strength weighted by proximity based on revealed comparative advantage. This network reveals a structured landscape in which tools cluster into 8 functional communities, including computing and statistics, wet lab instrumentation, and several bioinformatics specializations, with each discipline occupying a distinct position reflecting its characteristic tool portfolios. The breadth of a discipline's tool portfolio is shaped by the nature of its research workflow: fields combining experimental and computational tasks draw on multiple communities, while those with narrower methodological demands concentrate in one. These structural differences are stable across the observation period. At the same time, across all broad disciplinary categories, disciplinary tool portfolios are crystallizing, settling on a common set of tools.

AI.tldr: 通过分析130万篇论文，研究绘制了科学软件的生态图谱，揭示了科研工具如何根据学科需求聚类，并发现科学研究正趋向于在各自领域内形成标准化的工具组合。
AI.motivation: 现有的科学进步研究多关注事实积累，但对作为科学进步核心驱动力的“工具”演变及其组合规律缺乏系统性理解，特别是软件作为现代科研工具的普遍性及其在不同学科中的分布规律尚不明确。
AI.method: 分析了2004年至2021年间130万篇出版物中的软件提及情况，构建了一个包含520种软件工具的关联网络，并使用基于显示比较优势（RCA）的加权链路来分析学科间的共用关系。
AI.result: 研究发现软件工具聚类为8个功能社区；学科的工具组合广度取决于其工作流性质（实验与计算结合的领域工具更广）；这种结构性差异在研究期间保持稳定，且各学科内部的工具组合正趋于标准化。
AI.conclusion: 科学研究的软件工具生态系统呈现出结构化的特征，学科演变与工具组合高度相关，且不同学科在保持工具组合差异性的同时，正趋向于在各自领域内形成更统一的工具共识。
AI.translation: 科学的进步不仅在于事实的积累，还在于工具的演进。至关重要的是，工具很少被孤立使用。它们形成了由学科工作流和分析需求塑造的“工具组合”。软件在现代研究中无处不在，且可在已发表的文献中进行追踪，这为研究科学中的工具使用提供了一个独特的窗口。在此，我们通过分析2004年至2021年间130万篇出版物中对软件的提及情况，绘制了科学的软件空间图谱。我们构建了一个由520种软件工具组成的网络，这些工具通过学科共用进行关联，链路强度根据基于显示比较优势的邻近度进行加权。该网络揭示了一个结构化的图景，工具聚类为8个功能社区，包括计算与统计、湿实验室仪器以及多个生物信息学专业领域，每个学科都占据着反映其特征工具组合的独特位置。学科工具组合的广度由其研究工作流的性质决定：结合实验和计算任务的领域利用多个社区的工具，而方法论需求较窄的领域则集中于某一个社区。这些结构性差异在观察期间保持稳定。同时，在所有广泛的学科类别中，学科工具组合正在结晶，逐渐固定在一套共同的工具集上。
AI.summary: 本文通过分析130万篇论文中的软件提及数据，构建并绘制了科学软件的工具网络。研究揭示了软件工具在不同科学领域中形成的结构化功能集群，分析了学科工作流如何塑造工具组合的广度，并发现尽管各学科保持着独特的工具布局，但在工具选择上正趋向于形成共识。
AI.keywords: 科学软件, 文献计量学, 科研工具, 学科结构, 工具组合
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模文献计量学方法，成功量化了科学研究中软件工具的生态布局。其创新之处在于将软件作为观测科学实践演变的窗口，揭示了科学学科与工具组合之间的深层结构关系。这项研究对于理解科学协作、技术传播以及科研基础设施的演进具有重要参考价值。

title: KISS Sorcar: A Stupidly-Simple General-Purpose and Software Engineering AI Assistant
summary:
Large language models can generate code and call tools with remarkable fluency, yet deploying them as practical software engineering assistants still expose stubborn gaps: finite context windows, single mistakes that derail entire sessions, agents that get stuck in dead ends, AI slop, and generated changes that are difficult to review or revert.
  We present KISS Sorcar, a general-purpose assistant and integrated development environment (IDE) built on top of the KISS Agent Framework, a stupidly-simple AI agent framework of roughly 1,850 lines of code. The framework addresses these gaps using a robust system prompt and through a five-layer agent hierarchy in which each layer adds exactly one concern: budget-tracked ReAct execution, automatic continuation across sub-sessions via summarization, coding, and browser tools with parallel sub-agents, persistent multi-turn chat with history recall, and git worktree isolation so every task runs on its own branch.
  To assess the power of the KISS agent framework, we implemented KISS Sorcar as a free, open-source Visual Studio Code extension that runs locally and effectively for long-horizon tasks, and supports browser automation, multimodal input, and Docker containers.
  In this research, we deliberately prioritize output quality over latency: giving a frontier model adequate time to validate its own output -- running linters, type checkers, and tests -- dramatically reduces the low-quality code that plagues faster but less thorough agents. The entire system was built using itself in 4.5 months, providing a continuous stress test in which any agent-introduced bug immediately impairs its own ability to work. On Terminal Bench 2.0, KISS Sorcar achieves a 62.2% overall pass rate with Claude Opus 4.6, comparing favorably to Claude Code (58%) and Cursor Composer 2 (61.7).

AI.title_translation: KISS Sorcar：一个简单到愚蠢的通用软件工程 AI 助手
AI.tldr: KISS Sorcar 通过五层简化代理架构和强制性的代码自我验证机制，解决了 AI 编程助手在长周期任务中的低效和质量问题，并在基准测试中超越了主流竞品。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型在软件工程应用中存在上下文窗口受限、易陷入死循环、生成代码质量低下及难以回滚等痛点，现有工具难以胜任长周期的复杂开发任务。
AI.method: 基于KISS Agent框架，构建了一个五层代理层级系统，每层处理单一关注点（预算追踪、会话摘要、工具调用、历史记忆、Git分支隔离）。同时，强制要求模型在生成代码后执行Lint检查、类型检查和自动化测试，优先保证输出质量。
AI.result: KISS Sorcar 在 Terminal Bench 2.0 测试中达到 62.2% 的成功率，优于 Claude Code (58%) 和 Cursor Composer 2 (61.7%)。
AI.conclusion: KISS Sorcar 通过引入分层代理架构和严格的代码验证机制，在保持系统简洁性的同时，显著提升了长周期软件工程任务的成功率和代码质量，优于当前主流的同类工具。
AI.translation: 大语言模型在代码生成和工具调用方面表现出色，但在实际软件工程场景中仍存在顽疾：上下文窗口有限、单次错误导致会话崩溃、代理陷入死循环、产生低质量代码（AI slop）以及代码难以审查或回滚。我们提出了 KISS Sorcar，这是一个基于 KISS Agent 框架的通用助手和集成开发环境（IDE），该框架代码量仅约 1850 行。通过稳健的系统提示词和五层代理层级，每层仅负责一个核心关注点：预算追踪的 ReAct 执行、基于摘要的自动会话延续、具备并行子代理的编码与浏览器工具、持久化多轮对话记忆、以及基于 Git 工作树的任务分支隔离。为了验证该框架，我们将 KISS Sorcar 实现为 VS Code 扩展，支持本地运行、浏览器自动化、多模态输入和 Docker。研究中我们优先考虑输出质量而非延迟，通过让模型进行自我验证（运行 Lint、类型检查和测试），大幅减少了低质量代码。整个系统在 4.5 个月内由其自身构建完成，实现了持续压力测试。在 Terminal Bench 2.0 上，KISS Sorcar 使用 Claude Opus 4.6 达到了 62.2% 的通过率，优于 Claude Code (58%) 和 Cursor Composer 2 (61.7%)。
AI.summary: KISS Sorcar 是一个基于 KISS Agent 框架的轻量级 AI 编程助手。它通过五层代理架构解决长周期任务中的复杂性问题，并在生成代码后引入强制验证步骤，显著提升了输出质量和任务成功率。该系统已实现为 VS Code 开源插件，并在开发过程中通过自身进行持续测试。
AI.keywords: AI编程助手, KISS原则, 代理层级, 代码质量, 软件工程
AI.comments: 该论文通过极其简洁的架构（KISS原则）解决了当前AI编程助手普遍存在的上下文受限、易陷入死循环及代码质量差等问题。其最大的创新在于“五层代理层级”设计以及通过自托管（self-hosting）开发模式实现的持续压力测试，证明了牺牲少量响应延迟以换取代码验证质量的有效性。

title: Resource-Lean Lexicon Induction for German Dialects
summary: Automatic induction of high-quality dictionaries is essential for building lexical resources, yet low-resource languages and dialects pose several challenges: limited access to annotators, high degree of spelling variations, and poor performance of large language models (LLMs). We empirically show that statistical models (random forests) trained on string similarity features are surprisingly effective for inducing German dialect lexicons. They outperform LLMs, enable cross-dialect transfer, and offer a lightweight data-driven alternative. We evaluate our models intrinsically on bilingual lexicon induction (BLI) and extrinsically on dialect information retrieval (IR). On BLI, random forests outperform Mistral-123b while being more resource-lean. On dialect IR with BM25, using our dialect dictionaries for query expansion yields relative improvements of up to 28.9% in nDCG@10 and 50.7% in Recall@100. Motivated by the resource scarcity in dialects, we further investigate the extent to which models transfer across different German dialects, and their performance under varying amounts of training data.

AI.title_translation: 德语方言的资源稀缺词典归纳研究
AI.tldr: 针对低资源德语方言，随机森林模型在词典归纳任务中表现优于大模型，且能显著提升方言信息检索效果。
AI.motivation: 德语方言面临标注资源匮乏、拼写变体多以及大模型表现不佳等挑战，亟需一种低资源、高效的词典构建方法。
AI.method: 利用随机森林模型结合字符串相似度特征进行词典归纳，并在双语词典归纳（BLI）和方言信息检索（IR）任务中进行评估。
AI.result: 在BLI任务中，随机森林表现优于Mistral-123b；在方言IR任务中，利用生成的词典进行查询扩展，nDCG@10提升高达28.9%，Recall@100提升高达50.7%。
AI.conclusion: 对于德语方言，基于字符串相似度特征的随机森林模型是构建词典的高效且轻量级方案，优于大模型，且具备良好的跨方言迁移能力。
AI.translation: 自动构建高质量词典对于建立词汇资源至关重要，然而低资源语言和方言带来了诸多挑战：标注人员获取受限、拼写变体多以及大语言模型（LLMs）表现不佳。我们通过实证研究表明，在字符串相似度特征上训练的统计模型（随机森林）对于归纳德语方言词典非常有效。它们优于LLMs，能够实现跨方言迁移，并提供了一种轻量级的数据驱动替代方案。我们在双语词典归纳（BLI）和方言信息检索（IR）方面评估了我们的模型。在BLI任务中，随机森林的表现优于Mistral-123b，且更具资源优势。在结合BM25的方言IR任务中，使用我们的方言词典进行查询扩展，nDCG@10取得了高达28.9%的相对提升，Recall@100取得了高达50.7%的相对提升。受方言资源稀缺性的驱动，我们进一步研究了模型在不同德语方言间的迁移程度，以及在不同训练数据量下的表现。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对德语方言的轻量级词典归纳方法。研究发现，基于字符串相似度特征的随机森林模型在处理方言拼写变体方面比大语言模型更有效，且在信息检索任务中显著提升了性能。
AI.keywords: 词典归纳, 德语方言, 低资源语言, 随机森林, 信息检索
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了“大模型在所有任务中均优于传统模型”的定势思维，证明了在特定低资源场景下，基于特征工程的统计模型（如随机森林）不仅更轻量，且在性能上优于大规模语言模型。这为低资源语言的研究提供了极具价值的工程化思路。

title: Are Digital Humanities really committed to open? An exploratory study on the availability of methodological workflows and open peer review practices
summary: Open Science has become a central framework for promoting transparency, accessibility, and inclusiveness in scholarly research. While the Digital Humanities (DH) community has long embraced openness in terms of research outputs, less attention seems to have been paid to the openness of the methodological and evaluative processes underlying knowledge production. This paper presents an exploratory study that investigates the current state of openness in DH research practices, focusing specifically on research data management documentation and peer review processes. In particular, this study addresses two research questions: (1) to what extent DH publications that describe data explicitly reference external documentation detailing data creation and management processes; and (2) how widely open peer review practices are adopted across DH conferences and journals. The results revealed a limited adoption of open methodological practices. Only a small fraction of the analysed articles provided explicit, reusable documentation of data creation workflows, and no references to data management plans or formal research data management documentation were found. An even more critical picture emerges from the analysis of peer review practices: the vast majority of DH venues continue to rely on traditional single- or double-blind review models, with open peer review adopted in only a few isolated cases.

AI.title_translation: 数字人文真的致力于开放吗？关于方法论工作流可用性与开放同行评审实践的探索性研究
AI.tldr: 该研究发现数字人文领域在方法论透明度和开放同行评审实践方面表现滞后，远未达到开放科学的要求。
AI.motivation: 尽管数字人文社区长期以来重视研究成果的开放，但对知识生产过程中的方法论和评估流程的开放性关注不足，因此作者旨在通过实证研究评估该领域在这些方面的开放现状。
AI.method: 采用探索性研究方法，通过分析数字人文出版物对数据创建和管理文档的引用情况，以及调查数字人文会议和期刊中开放同行评审机制的采纳程度。
AI.result: 研究发现，数字人文领域在开放方法论实践方面采纳率极低，几乎没有找到关于数据管理计划的引用；在同行评审方面，绝大多数场所仍依赖传统的盲审模式，开放同行评审仅在极少数情况下被采用。
AI.conclusion: 数字人文领域在开放方法论和开放同行评审的实践中仍处于初级阶段，与开放科学的理想目标存在显著差距，亟需在后续研究和学术交流中建立更具透明度的机制。
AI.translation: 开放科学已成为促进学术研究透明度、可访问性和包容性的核心框架。虽然数字人文（DH）社区长期以来在研究成果方面拥抱开放，但对于知识生产背后的方法论和评估流程的开放性关注较少。本文提出了一项探索性研究，调查了DH研究实践中开放性的现状，特别关注研究数据管理文档和同行评审过程。具体而言，本研究旨在解决两个研究问题：（1）DH出版物在描述数据时，在多大程度上明确引用了详述数据创建和管理过程的外部文档；以及（2）开放同行评审实践在DH会议和期刊中的采纳程度如何。结果显示，开放方法论实践的采纳受到限制。只有极少数分析的文章提供了明确的、可重用的数据创建工作流文档，且未发现任何对数据管理计划或正式研究数据管理文档的引用。同行评审实践的分析呈现出更严峻的情况：绝大多数DH场所继续依赖传统的单盲或双盲评审模式，开放同行评审仅在极少数孤立案例中被采用。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了数字人文（DH）领域在开放科学实践中的现状，重点分析了研究数据管理文档的可用性及开放同行评审的普及程度。研究表明，DH领域目前在方法论透明度和评估过程的开放性上表现欠佳，多数出版物缺乏可复用的数据工作流文档，且同行评审仍以传统盲审模式为主。
AI.keywords: 数字人文, 开放科学, 方法论工作流, 开放同行评审, 研究数据管理
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了数字人文领域在“开放科学”实践上的严重滞后，特别是在方法论透明度和同行评审机制方面。论文的创新之处在于将评估视角从最终研究成果转向了知识生产的过程，为该领域如何更好地践行开放科学提供了重要的实证依据。局限性在于其作为探索性研究，样本范围可能有限，但仍具有很高的警示意义。

title: Domain-Filtered Knowledge Graphs from Sparse Autoencoder Features
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) extract millions of interpretable features from a language model, but flat feature inventories aren't very useful on their own. Domain concepts get mixed with generic and weakly grounded features, while related ideas are scattered across many units, and there's no way to understand relationships between features. We address this by first constructing a strict domain-specific concept universe from a large SAE inventory using contrastive activations and a multi-stage filtering process. Next, we build two aligned graph views on the filtered set: a co-occurrence graph for corpus-level conceptual structure, organized at multiple levels of granularity, and a transcoder-based mechanism graph that links source-layer and target-layer features through sparse latent pathways. Automated edge labeling then turns these graph views into readable knowledge graphs rather than unlabeled layouts. In a case study on a biology textbook, these graphs recover coherent chapter and subchapter-level structure, reveal concepts that bridge neighboring topics, and transform messy sentence-level activity containing thousands of features into compact, readable views that illustrate the model's local activity. Taken together, this reframes a flat SAE inventory as an internal knowledge graph that converts feature-level interpretability into a global map of model knowledge and enables audits of reasoning faithfulness.

AI.title_translation: 基于稀疏自编码器特征的领域过滤知识图谱
AI.tldr: 本文通过过滤SAE特征并构建多视图知识图谱，将大模型零散的内部特征转化为可读、结构化的知识地图，从而提升模型可解释性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取的特征通常是平铺且零散的，领域概念与通用特征混杂，缺乏特征间的关系描述，难以直接用于理解模型知识。
AI.method: 1. 使用对比激活和多阶段过滤过程，从SAE特征库中构建特定领域概念宇宙；2. 构建两种对齐的图视图：基于语料库的共现图（多粒度）和基于转码器的机制图（链接特征层）；3. 使用自动边标记技术将图形转化为可读的知识图谱。
AI.result: 通过生物学教材案例验证，该方法能够恢复章节结构，识别跨主题概念，并将成千上万的特征转化为紧凑、可读的知识图谱，有效展现了模型的局部活动。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了通过过滤和图构建技术，可以将大模型零散的特征库存转化为结构化、可解释的知识图谱，从而提升了对模型内部知识和推理过程的理解。
AI.translation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）从语言模型中提取了数百万个可解释的特征，但平铺的特征清单本身并不是很有用。领域概念与通用和弱基础特征混合在一起，相关思想分散在许多单元中，并且无法理解特征之间的关系。我们通过首先使用对比激活和多阶段过滤过程从大型SAE库存中构建严格的特定领域概念宇宙来解决这个问题。接下来，我们在过滤后的集合上构建两个对齐的图视图：用于语料库级概念结构的共现图（以多粒度组织），以及通过稀疏潜在路径链接源层和目标层特征的基于转码器的机制图。自动边标记随后将这些图视图转换为可读的知识图谱，而不是未标记的布局。在生物学教科书的案例研究中，这些图谱恢复了连贯的章节和子章节级结构，揭示了连接相邻主题的概念，并将包含数千个特征的混乱句子级活动转换为紧凑、可读的视图，说明了模型的局部活动。总之，这不仅将平铺的SAE库存重新定义为内部知识图谱，将特征级可解释性转换为模型知识的全局地图，还实现了对推理忠实度的审计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种从稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征中构建领域过滤知识图谱的方法。通过多阶段过滤和构建共现及机制图视图，将平铺的特征库存转化为结构化的知识图谱，实现了从特征级可解释性到模型全局知识地图的跨越。
AI.keywords: 稀疏自编码器, 知识图谱, 模型可解释性, 特征过滤, 概念映射
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种将稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取的特征转化为结构化知识图谱的创新方法。通过引入领域过滤和多视图图构建，它有效地解决了原始SAE特征零散、难以理解的问题，为大模型的内部知识表征提供了全局视角，在模型可解释性和推理忠实度评估方面具有重要意义。

title: Who Gets to Interpret the Workout? User Tensions with AI-Generated Fitness Feedback
summary: Fitness tracking platforms increasingly integrate generative AI to interpret activity data, such as Strava's Athlete Intelligence. These integrations raise questions about how athletes engage with AI-supported fitness self-tracking. We analyzed 297 Reddit threads and 5,692 comments from r/Strava following the company's launch of AI features to examine user reactions to AI-generated fitness feedback. Our findings revealed four recurring tensions: (1) numerical evaluation versus contextual understanding; (2) isolated session summaries versus ongoing training narratives; (3) a fixed AI tone versus diverse emotional states; and (4) a single AI voice versus different athletic types. Across these tensions, users resisted AI feedback that constrained interpretations of their own lived experiences. These findings shed light on the implicit challenges of integrating AI into self-tracking platforms. We conclude with implications for the design of AI-supported self-tracking systems that preserve interpretive openness and user agency.

AI.title_translation: 谁来解读健身数据？用户与AI生成健身反馈之间的矛盾
AI.tldr: 用户在面对AI生成的健身反馈时，常因AI缺乏情境理解、叙事单一和语气僵化而产生抗拒，研究呼吁设计更具自主性和解释空间的人工智能系统。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI被广泛应用于健身追踪平台，了解用户如何与这些AI驱动的反馈进行互动、以及其中潜藏的潜在矛盾显得尤为重要。
AI.method: 通过对Reddit平台r/Strava板块中297个相关讨论帖及5,692条评论进行定性分析，探讨用户对AI健身反馈的反应与态度。
AI.result: 研究揭示了用户与AI反馈之间的四种核心矛盾：数值评价与情境理解的脱节、单次总结与长期训练叙事的割裂、AI固定语气与用户多变情绪的不匹配，以及AI单一声音与多元运动类型之间的冲突。用户普遍抗拒那些限制其自身生活经验解读的AI反馈。
AI.conclusion: AI健身反馈系统应在设计上注重保留用户的解释空间，避免过度单一的算法评价，从而保护用户的自主权和对个人运动体验的掌握。
AI.translation: 健身追踪平台越来越多地整合生成式AI来解读活动数据，例如Strava的“运动员智能”（Athlete Intelligence）。这些整合引发了关于运动员如何参与AI辅助健身自我追踪的问题。我们分析了Strava推出AI功能后r/Strava板块的297个Reddit讨论帖和5,692条评论，以审查用户对AI生成健身反馈的反应。我们的研究结果揭示了四个反复出现的矛盾：（1）数值评估与情境理解；（2）孤立的会话总结与持续的训练叙事；（3）固定的AI语气与多样的情绪状态；（4）单一的AI声音与不同的运动类型。在这些矛盾中，用户抵制那些限制了他们对自己生活经验解读的AI反馈。这些发现揭示了将AI整合到自我追踪平台中的潜在挑战。最后，我们总结了对AI辅助自我追踪系统设计的启示，以保持解释的开放性和用户的主体性。
AI.summary: 本文通过分析Reddit社区关于Strava AI功能的讨论，揭示了用户在接受AI健身反馈时面临的四重矛盾。研究指出，用户倾向于抗拒AI对个人运动体验的刻板解读，并建议未来的健身系统应在设计中注重保持解释的开放性与用户自主权。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, 健身追踪, 用户体验, 人机交互, 数据解释
AI.comments: 该研究深入探讨了AI在个人健康追踪领域的应用局限，强调了用户的主体性与AI算法解释之间的冲突，对于设计以人为本的AI健身系统具有重要的参考价值。

title: Architectural Isolation as a Timing Safety Primitive for Edge AI Medical Devices: Controlled Experimental Evidence on a Shared-Silicon Platform
comments: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Embedded Systems Letters
summary: A system can satisfy accuracy-based validation, maintain output stability (Safety-Threshold Exceedance Rate, STER, equal to zero), and still violate timing constraints under deployment load. These are structurally independent properties that current pre-market validation protocols often do not operationalize at the inference layer. This letter demonstrates their independence through a controlled same-hardware experiment: identical MobileNetV2 models are evaluated under identical adversarial load on two execution paths of the same NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super, a dedicated GPU accelerator (TensorRT FP16, half-precision floating point) and a general-purpose CPU (ONNX Runtime FP32, single-precision floating point). Both paths maintain STER = 0; the CPU path (ONNX Runtime FP32) degrades 7.2x under combined load (mean latency 9.8x higher than the GPU path (TensorRT FP16), which maintains latency below 11 ms), breaching the 10 Hz clinical cycle budget by 65%. Joint STER and latency verification is proposed as a candidate method for operationalizing U.S. FDA Draft Guidance FDA-2024-D-4488 robustness requirements at the inference layer, subject to regulatory review and clinical validation.
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Embedded Systems Letters

title: Characterizing the Usefulness of Code Review Comments in Scientific Software for Software Quality and Scientific Rigor
comments: Accepted at The Platform for Advanced Scientific Computing (PASC) Conference 2026, Bern, Switzerland
summary: Context: Innovation thrives on scientific software, with useful code review feedback enhancing its correctness and impact. However, unlike general-purpose commercial and open-source software, the usefulness of code review feedback (CR comment) in scientific software remains largely unstudied. Objective: This paper aims to characterize the usefulness of CR comment in scientific opens ource software (Sci-OSS), leveraging existing research on useful CR comment. Method: To achieve this objective, we mine successful Sci-OSS from GitHub, analyze their CR comments with usefulness related features, and compare the findings from prior research on general-purpose commercial and open-source CR comments. Results: The investigation on the usefulness of CR comments in SciOSS confirms many characteristics that prior research identified in general-purpose software. For example, subjective or negative CR comments remain not useful for the Sci-OSS. We also find CR comments which receive negative emoji reactions have a very small correlation with not useful comments, whereas the positive emojis show mixed correlations. Importantly, 6-33% CR comments in Sci-OSS are not useful in our mined repositories. Conclusions: Our investigation into Sci-OSS extends findings from CR comments' usefulness research on general-purpose software, benefiting developers, scientists, and researchers in the Sci-OSS community.
comment: Accepted at The Platform for Advanced Scientific Computing (PASC) Conference 2026, Bern, Switzerland

AI.title_translation: 表征科学软件中代码评审评论对软件质量和科学严谨性的有用性
AI.tldr: 本研究分析了科学开源软件中的代码评审评论，发现其有用性特征与通用软件相似，但仍存在高达6%-33%的无效评论，为改进科学软件开发流程提供了参考。
AI.motivation: 尽管科学软件对科学创新至关重要，但目前缺乏关于科学软件代码评审反馈有用性的专门研究，无法像通用软件那样通过有效反馈保障软件质量和科学严谨性。
AI.method: 通过从GitHub挖掘成功的科学开源软件（Sci-OSS），分析其代码评审评论的有用性特征，并将其与既往针对通用软件的研究结果进行对比分析。
AI.result: 研究确认了科学软件与通用软件在评审评论特征上的高度一致性（如主观/负面评论通常无效）。此外，发现负面表情符号与评论无效性相关性极低，正面表情符号相关性不明确；且在所研究的存储库中，有6%-33%的评论被判定为无效。
AI.conclusion: 科学软件的代码评审反馈特征与通用软件高度相似，但也存在其特殊性。研究发现科学软件中存在约6%-33%的无效评审评论，该结论为科学软件社区提供了改进代码评审过程的实证依据。
AI.translation: 背景：创新依赖于科学软件，有效的代码评审反馈能增强其正确性和影响力。然而，与通用商业和开源软件不同，科学软件中代码评审反馈（CR评论）的有用性在很大程度上尚未得到研究。目标：本文旨在利用现有关于有用CR评论的研究，表征科学开源软件（Sci-OSS）中CR评论的有用性。方法：为实现此目标，我们从GitHub挖掘成功的Sci-OSS项目，分析其CR评论的有用性相关特征，并将研究结果与既往关于通用商业和开源软件CR评论的研究进行比较。结果：对Sci-OSS中CR评论有用性的调查证实了先前研究在通用软件中识别出的许多特征。例如，主观或负面的CR评论对Sci-OSS仍然无效。我们还发现，收到负面表情反应的CR评论与无效评论的相关性非常小，而正面表情符号则显示出混合的相关性。重要的是，在我们挖掘的存储库中，6-33%的Sci-OSS CR评论是无效的。结论：我们对Sci-OSS的调查扩展了关于CR评论有用性的通用软件研究成果，使Sci-OSS社区的开发人员、科学家和研究人员受益。
AI.summary: 本文通过对科学开源软件（Sci-OSS）代码评审评论的定量分析，探究了其有用性特征。研究对比了科学软件与通用软件的评审差异，验证了通用软件评审特征的适用性，并揭示了科学软件开发中存在显著比例的无效评审评论，旨在提升科学软件的质量与科学严谨性。
AI.keywords: 科学软件, 代码评审, 软件质量, 科学严谨性, 开源软件
AI.comments: 该研究填补了科学软件领域代码评审反馈研究的空白，验证了通用软件评审特征在科学软件中的适用性，并指出了科学软件代码评审中存在的高比例“无效评论”问题，对提升科学软件开发质量具有实际指导意义。

title: One Size Fits None: Heuristic Collapse in LLM Investment Advice
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as advisors in high-stakes domains -- answering medical questions, interpreting legal documents, recommending financial products -- where good advice requires integrating a user's full context rather than responding to salient surface features. We investigate whether frontier LLMs actually do this, or whether they instead exhibit heuristic collapse: a systematic reduction of complex, multi-factor decisions to a small number of dominant inputs. We study the phenomenon in investment advice, where legal standards explicitly require individualized reasoning over a client's full circumstances. Applying interpretable surrogate models to LLM outputs, we find systematic heuristic collapse: investment allocation decisions are largely determined by self-reported risk tolerance, while other relevant factors contribute minimally. We further find that web search partially attenuates heuristic collapse but does not resolve it. These findings suggest that heuristic collapse is not resolved by web search augmentation or model scale alone, and that deploying LLMs as advisors requires auditing input sensitivity, not just output quality.

AI.title_translation: 一刀切的困境：大语言模型投资建议中的启发式崩溃
AI.tldr: 大语言模型在处理投资建议时往往会忽略复杂背景，仅依赖单一因素做出决策，这种“启发式崩溃”现象无法通过简单的模型扩容或网络搜索解决。
AI.motivation: 调查前沿大语言模型在处理高风险领域（如投资）时，是否真正整合了用户的所有背景信息，还是仅仅依赖少数显著特征进行决策，即是否存在“启发式崩溃”现象。
AI.method: 通过应用可解释的替代模型分析LLM的输出，评估其在投资分配决策中对不同输入因素的依赖程度，并测试网络搜索增强对该现象的影响。
AI.result: LLM在投资建议中存在系统性的启发式崩溃，其决策主要受用户自述的风险承受能力影响，而忽略了其他关键因素；网络搜索能在一定程度上缓解但无法彻底解决此问题。
AI.conclusion: 启发式崩溃在LLM投资建议中普遍存在，且单纯依靠模型规模扩张或网络搜索无法完全解决，因此在将LLM部署为高风险顾问时，必须进行输入敏感性审计。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被部署为高风险领域的顾问——回答医疗问题、解读法律文件、推荐金融产品——在这些领域，好的建议需要整合用户的全部背景，而不是仅对显著的表面特征做出反应。我们调查了前沿大语言模型是否真的做到了这一点，或者它们是否表现出了“启发式崩溃”：即将复杂的、多因素的决策系统性地简化为少量主导输入。我们研究了投资建议中的这一现象，法律标准明确要求针对客户的全部情况进行个性化推理。通过将可解释的替代模型应用于大语言模型的输出，我们发现了系统性的启发式崩溃：投资分配决策在很大程度上由自述的风险承受能力决定，而其他相关因素的贡献微乎其微。我们进一步发现，网络搜索在一定程度上缓解了启发式崩溃，但并未解决它。这些发现表明，仅靠网络搜索增强或模型规模的提升并不能解决启发式崩溃问题，将大语言模型部署为顾问需要对输入敏感性进行审计，而不仅仅是评估输出质量。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在金融咨询等高风险决策任务中的表现，指出模型常出现“启发式崩溃”，即倾向于简化复杂决策，仅依赖少数关键因素。研究发现，即使通过网络搜索增强，模型仍无法充分整合用户的所有相关背景信息，强调了对AI决策系统进行输入敏感性审计的必要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 启发式崩溃, 投资建议, 个性化推理, 输入敏感性审计
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了LLM在处理高风险决策任务时的一个关键缺陷：启发式崩溃。这一发现对于AI在金融、法律等需要高度个性化决策领域的应用具有深远的警示意义，表明仅靠扩大模型规模或引入网络搜索无法解决根本问题，必须建立更严格的输入敏感性审计机制。

title: JigsawRL: Assembling RL Pipelines for Efficient LLM Post-Training
summary: We present JigsawRL, a cost-efficient framework that explores Pipeline Multiplexing as a new dimension of RL parallelism. JigsawRL decomposes each pipeline into a Sub-Stage Graph that exposes the intra-stage and inter-worker imbalance hidden by stage-level systems. On this abstraction, JigsawRL resolves multiplexing interference through dynamic resource allocation, eliminates fragmented utilization by migrating long-tail rollouts across workers, and formulates their coordination as a graph scheduling problem solved with a look-ahead heuristic. On 4-64 H100/A100 GPUs across different agentic RL pipelines and models, JigsawRL achieves up to 1.85x throughput over Verl on synchronous RL, 1.54x over StreamRL and AReaL on asynchronous RL, and supports heterogeneous pipelines with moderate latency trade-off.

title: Focus on What Matters: Two-Stage ROI-Aware Refinement for Anatomy-Preserving Fetal Ultrasound Reconstruction
comments: 18 pages, 7 figures, multiple tables. Preprint submitted to arXiv
summary: Measurement-critical ultrasound tasks often depend on a small anatomical region, making global reconstruction metrics an unreliable proxy for clinical fidelity. We propose an ROI-aware representation learning framework and instantiate it for first-trimester nuchal translucency (NT) screening under multi-hospital domain shift. A two-phase convolutional autoencoder (CAE) first learns a globally faithful 128-D latent code via MS-SSIM, then refines the NT ROI using intensity (L1) and normalized Sobel-edge constraints. To combine these heterogeneous objectives without manual tuning, we initialize loss weights via gradient-based calibration from per-term gradient magnitudes. Under strict hospital-wise evaluation with one hospital held out, ROI refinement improves both global and measurement-relevant quality: on the standard dev split it increases PSNR by +0.27 dB (val) and +0.29 dB (held-out test), reduces ROI MAE by 8.87% (val) and 6.43% (held-out test), and reduces ROI Edge-MAE by 11.10% on source hospitals and 4.90% on the unseen hospital. Beyond reconstruction, frozen-latent probes provide additional evidence of generalization: hospital provenance becomes less confidently predictable on the unseen site (0.556 to 0.541 max-softmax; 0.684 to 0.688 entropy) while OOD detection remains strong across site-held-out protocols (Mahalanobis AUROC up to 0.9956, with modest KNN gains in challenging splits). The same ROI-aware refinement principle is anatomy-agnostic and can be adopted for other fetal biometry targets (e.g., crown-rump length (CRL), nasal bone (NB)) and broader medical imaging settings where small ROIs dominate clinical decisions.
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, multiple tables. Preprint submitted to arXiv

AI.title_translation: 专注于重点：用于解剖结构保留的胎儿超声重建的两阶段ROI感知细化方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种两阶段ROI感知超声重建框架，通过局部细化提升了胎儿关键部位（如NT）的测量精度，并解决了跨医院数据间的域偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的超声图像重建通常依赖全局指标，而临床关键测量任务往往聚焦于特定的微小解剖区域，导致全局指标难以反映临床保真度，且多中心数据存在域偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出一种两阶段卷积自编码器（CAE）：第一阶段利用MS-SSIM学习全局潜在代码，第二阶段利用强度（L1）和归一化Sobel边缘约束对NT ROI进行细化，并使用基于梯度的标定方法自动平衡损失权重。
AI.result: 在NT筛查实验中，该方法显著提升了PSNR，并将ROI处的平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了6.43%-8.87%，边缘MAE降低了4.90%-11.10%，同时在跨医院评估中表现出良好的泛化性和OOD检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的两阶段ROI感知细化框架显著提升了胎儿超声图像在关键测量区域的质量和保真度，证明了其在多中心临床环境下的泛化能力和临床应用潜力。
AI.translation: 测量关键型超声任务通常依赖于微小的解剖区域，这使得全局重建指标无法成为临床保真度的可靠代理。我们提出了一种ROI感知的表示学习框架，并将其应用于多医院域偏移下的早孕期颈后透明层（NT）筛查。两阶段卷积自编码器（CAE）首先通过MS-SSIM学习全局忠实的128维潜在代码，然后利用强度（L1）和归一化Sobel边缘约束细化NT ROI。为了在不进行手动调整的情况下结合这些异构目标，我们通过基于每项梯度幅值的梯度标定来初始化损失权重。在严格的医院间评估（留一法）下，ROI细化改善了全局和测量相关质量：在标准验证集上，PSNR增加了+0.27 dB（验证集）和+0.29 dB（留一测试集），ROI MAE降低了8.87%（验证集）和6.43%（留一测试集），ROI边缘MAE在源医院降低了11.10%，在未见过的医院降低了4.90%。除了重建之外，冻结的潜在探针提供了泛化性的额外证据：医院来源在未见过的站点上变得更难预测，同时OOD检测在所有站点留一协议中保持稳健。相同的ROI感知细化原则与解剖结构无关，可用于其他胎儿生物测量目标（如头臀长、鼻骨）以及小ROI主导临床决策的更广泛医学成像场景。
AI.summary: 本文针对胎儿超声测量任务，提出了一种两阶段ROI感知重建框架。通过结合全局特征学习与局部ROI细化，并在自动损失权重调整的辅助下，该方法在多中心环境下有效提升了关键解剖区域的测量准确性与图像质量。
AI.keywords: 胎儿超声, ROI感知, 表示学习, 领域自适应, 图像重建
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将ROI（感兴趣区域）感知引入超声重建，解决了传统全局重建指标在临床关键任务（如NT测量）中不准确的问题。其采用的基于梯度的损失权重自动标定方法有效避免了繁琐的手动调参，且该框架具有良好的解剖学通用性，在跨医院域适应场景下表现稳健。

title: Scalable Production Scheduling: Linear Complexity via Unified Homogeneous Graphs
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Efficiently solving the Job Shop Scheduling Problem in real-world industrial applications requires policies that are both computationally lean and topologically robust. While Reinforcement Learning has shown potential in automating dispatching rules, existing models often struggle with a scalability bottleneck caused by quadratic graph complexity or the architectural overhead of heterogeneous layers. We introduce a unified graph framework that employs feature-based homogenization to project distinct node roles into a shared latent space. This allows a standard homogeneous Graph Isomorphism Network to capture complex resource contention with linear complexity, ensuring low-latency inference for large-scale industrial applications. Our empirical results demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance while exhibiting consistent zero-shot generalization. We identify the job-to-machine ratio as the primary driver of policy effectiveness, rather than absolute problem size. Based on this, we propose a hypothesis of structural saturation, demonstrating that policies trained on critically congested instances ($\mathcal{J} \approx \mathcal{M}$) learn scale-invariant resolution strategies. Agents trained at this saturation point internalize invariant conflict-resolution logic, allowing them to treat massive rectangular instances as a sequential concatenation of saturated sub-problems. This approach eliminates the need for expensive scale-specific retraining and prevents overfitting to statistical shortcuts, providing a robust and efficient pathway for deploying RL solutions in dynamic production environments.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: Reheat Nachos for Dinner? Evaluating AI Support for Cross-Cultural Communication of Neologisms
summary: Neologisms and emerging slang are central to daily conversation, yet challenging for non-native speakers (NNS) to interpret and use appropriately in cross-cultural communication with native speakers (NS). NNS increasingly make use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to learn these words. We study the utility of such tools in mediating an informal communication scenario through a human-subjects study (N=234): NNS participants learn English neologisms with AI support, write messages using the learned word to an NS friend, and judge contextual appropriateness of the neologism in two provided writing samples. Using both NS evaluator-rated communicative competence of NNS-produced writing and NNS' contextual appropriateness judgments, we compare three AI-based support conditions: AI Definition, AI Rewrite into simpler English, AI Explanation of meaning and usage, and Non-AI Dictionary for comparison. We show that AI Explanation yields the largest gains over no support in NS-rated competence, while contextual appropriateness judgments show indifference across support. NNS participants' self-reported perceptions tend to overestimate NS ratings, revealing a mismatch between perceived and actual competence. We further observe a significant gap between NNS- and NS-produced writing, highlighting the limitations of current AI tools and informing design for future tools.

AI.title_translation: 晚餐吃加热的玉米片？评估AI对新词跨文化交流的支持作用
AI.tldr: 研究发现，AI提供的详细解释能有效帮助非母语者使用新词，但用户往往会高估自己的能力，且AI在语境化使用方面仍有待提升。
AI.motivation: 非母语者在跨文化交流中理解和使用新兴俚语（新词）存在困难，尽管他们越来越多地使用AI工具进行学习，但这些工具在实际交流中的有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过一项涉及234名参与者的受试者研究，对比了四种不同条件（AI定义、AI改写、AI解释、传统字典），要求非母语者学习英语新词并编写消息，随后由母语者评估其沟通能力，并测试非母语者对语境合适性的判断。
AI.result: AI解释（Explanation）显著提升了母语者评价的沟通能力；然而，不同支持条件下，非母语者对语境合适性的判断没有显著差异；此外，非母语者倾向于高估自己的沟通能力，且其写作水平与母语者之间仍存在明显差距。
AI.conclusion: AI解释（Explanation）在提升非母语者沟通能力方面最有效，但AI工具在帮助用户精准把握语境方面仍有局限，且用户往往会高估自己运用新词的能力。
AI.translation: 新词和新兴俚语是日常对话的核心，但对于非母语者（NNS）来说，在与母语者（NS）的跨文化交流中理解并恰当使用这些词汇具有挑战性。NNS越来越多地使用人工智能（AI）工具来学习这些词汇。我们通过一项涉及234名受试者的研究，探讨了此类工具在调解非正式交流场景中的效用：NNS参与者在AI支持下学习英语新词，向NS朋友写下包含该词的信息，并判断所提供两个写作样本中新词的语境合适性。我们通过NS对NNS书写内容的沟通能力评估以及NNS对语境合适性的判断，比较了三种基于AI的支持条件：AI定义、AI改写为简单英语、AI解释含义和用法，并与非AI字典进行了对比。结果显示，与无支持相比，AI解释在NS评价的沟通能力方面带来了最大的提升，而语境合适性判断在不同支持条件下表现出无差异。NNS参与者的自我报告倾向于高估NS的评分，揭示了感知能力与实际能力之间的错位。我们进一步观察到NNS与NS创作的写作之间存在显著差距，凸显了当前AI工具的局限性，并为未来工具的设计提供了参考。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了三种AI辅助工具对非母语者学习和使用英语新词的影响。研究发现，相比于简单的定义或改写，AI提供的详细解释在提升非母语者沟通能力方面更具优势，但所有AI工具在帮助用户精准把控社交语境方面仍存在不足。
AI.keywords: 新词, 跨文化交流, 人工智能辅助, 沟通能力, 非母语者
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了AI在辅助非母语使用者理解新兴俚语方面的潜力与局限。特别值得注意的是，参与者对自身能力的自我评估与母语者的实际评价存在显著偏差，这为未来AI辅助工具的设计提供了重要的研究方向，即不仅要提供定义，更需提供语境化的使用指导。

title: Translate or Simplify First: An Analysis of Cross-lingual Text Simplification in English and French
summary: Cross-Lingual Text Simplification (CLTS) aims to make content more accessible across languages by simultaneously addressing both linguistic complexity and translation. This study investigates the effectiveness of different prompting strategies for CLTS between English and French using large language models (LLMs). We examine five distinct prompting systems: a direct prompt instructing the LLM to perform both translation and simplification simultaneously, two Composition approaches that either translate-then-simplify or simplify-then-translate within a single prompt, and two decomposition approaches that perform the same operations in separate, consecutive prompts. These systems are evaluated across a diverse set of five corpora of different genres (Wikipedia and medical texts) using seven state-of-the-art LLMs. Output quality is assessed through a multi-faceted evaluation framework comprising automatic metrics, comprehensive linguistic feature analysis, and human evaluation of simplicity and meaning preservation. Our findings reveal that while direct prompting consistently achieves the highest BLEU scores, indicating meaning fidelity, Translate-then-Simplify approaches demonstrate the highest simplicity, as measured by the linguistic features.

AI.title_translation: 先翻译还是先简化：英法跨语言文本简化分析
AI.tldr: 研究发现，在大语言模型中，直接提示能更好地保持语义，而“先翻译后简化”策略则能产生更简单的文本。
AI.motivation: 旨在探讨如何通过大语言模型（LLM）有效实现跨语言文本简化（CLTS），即在翻译的同时降低语言复杂性，以提高跨语言信息的可访问性。
AI.method: 研究对比了五种提示策略（直接提示、两种组合提示、两种分解提示），在五个语料库上测试了七种主流LLM，并采用自动指标、语言特征分析及人工评估进行多维度分析。
AI.result: 直接提示在语义忠实度上表现最好；“先翻译后简化”的组合策略在文本简化效果（语言特征维度）上表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，虽然直接提示在保持语义准确性（BLEU分数）方面表现最优，但“先翻译后简化”策略在提高文本可读性和简化程度方面表现更为突出。
AI.translation: 跨语言文本简化（CLTS）旨在通过同时解决语言复杂性和翻译问题，提高跨语言内容的可访问性。本研究探讨了使用大语言模型（LLM）进行英法之间CLTS的不同提示策略的有效性。我们考察了五种不同的提示系统：指令LLM同时执行翻译和简化的直接提示；在单个提示内先翻译后简化或先简化后翻译的两种组合方法；以及在单独、连续提示中执行相同操作的两种分解方法。这些系统在五个不同体裁（维基百科和医学文本）的语料库中，使用七个最先进的LLM进行了评估。输出质量通过一个多方面的评估框架进行评估，包括自动指标、全面的语言特征分析以及对简洁性和意义保持的人工评估。研究结果表明，虽然直接提示始终获得最高的BLEU分数（表明意义忠实度高），但“先翻译后简化”的方法在语言特征所衡量的简洁性方面表现最高。
AI.summary: 本文分析了在英法双语间进行跨语言文本简化的不同提示策略。通过评估五种提示方案在七个主流大模型上的表现，研究发现直接提示最能保持原始语义，而“先翻译后简化”的策略在提升文本易读性方面更具优势。
AI.keywords: 跨语言文本简化, 大语言模型, 提示工程, 文本可读性, 语义保持
AI.comments: 该研究通过对比多种提示策略，揭示了LLM在处理跨语言文本简化任务时，性能与策略选择之间的权衡。其创新之处在于系统性地对比了单步与多步提示策略，并结合了自动指标、语言特征分析和人工评估，为复杂自然语言处理任务的提示工程提供了实证参考。

title: ClawTrace: Cost-Aware Tracing for LLM Agent Skill Distillation
summary: Skill-distillation pipelines learn reusable rules from LLM agent trajectories, but they lack a key signal: how much each step costs. Without per-step cost, a pipeline cannot distinguish adding a missing step to fix a bug from removing an expensive step that never affected the outcome. We introduce ClawTrace, an agent tracing platform that records every LLM call, tool use, and sub-agent spawn during an agent session and compiles each session into a TraceCard: a compact YAML summary with per-step USD cost, token counts, and redundancy flags. Built on ClawTrace, CostCraft is a distillation pipeline that reads TraceCards and produces three types of skill patches. Preserve patches keep behaviors that led to success. Prune patches remove expensive steps that did not matter, each backed by a counterfactual argument against a named high-cost step. Repair patches fix failures grounded in oracle evidence. Ablations on 30 held-out SpreadsheetBench tasks show that both cost attribution and prune patches independently reduce quality regressions. When the same skill is applied to 30 unrelated SkillsBench tasks, an unexpected asymmetry emerges: prune rules transferred across benchmarks and cut median cost by 32%, while preserve rules, trained on benchmark-specific conventions, caused regressions on new task types. We release ClawTrace and TraceCards as open infrastructure for cost-aware agent research.

title: Does Machine Unlearning Preserve Clinical Safety? A Risk Analysis for Medical Image Classification
summary: The application of Deep Learning in medical diagnosis must balance patient safety with compliance with data protection regulations. Machine Unlearning enables the selective removal of training data from deployed models. However, most methods are validated primarily through efficiency and privacy-oriented metrics, with limited attention to clinically asymmetric error costs. In this work, we investigate how unlearning affects clinical risk in binary medical image classification. We show that standard unlearning strategies (Fine-Tuning, Random Labeling, and SalUn) may reduce test utility while increasing false-negative rates, thereby amplifying clinical risk. To mitigate this, we propose SalUn-CRA (Clinical Risk-Aware), a variant of SalUn that replaces random relabeling with entropy-based forgetting for malignant samples in the forget set, preventing the model from learning harmful benign associations. We evaluate on DermaMNIST and PathMNIST medical image datasets under 20% and 50% data removal. Using Global Risk metrics with asymmetric costs, SalUn-CRA achieves lower or comparable clinical risk to full retraining while preserving unlearning effectiveness. These results suggest that clinical risk should be an integral component of unlearning validation in medical systems.

AI.title_translation: 机器遗忘能保障临床安全吗？医疗图像分类的风险分析
AI.tldr: 在医疗AI中进行机器遗忘时，传统的隐私保护策略可能会导致漏诊率上升；本文提出的SalUn-CRA方法通过引入临床风险意识，在删除数据的同时有效规避了医疗诊断中的严重安全风险。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器遗忘方法主要关注隐私合规和效率，缺乏对医疗诊断中“非对称错误成本”（如漏诊带来的高昂代价）的考量，可能导致模型在遗忘数据后产生危险的临床误判。
AI.method: 分析了三种标准遗忘策略（微调、随机标签、SalUn）的临床风险，并提出了SalUn-CRA（临床风险感知）方法，该方法通过基于熵的遗忘机制替代随机重标注，以保护恶性样本的诊断准确性。
AI.result: 研究表明，传统遗忘策略会降低测试效用并提高漏诊率。SalUn-CRA在DermaMNIST和PathMNIST数据集上，在保持遗忘有效性的同时，实现了比传统方法更低或相当的临床风险，表现接近于全模型重训练。
AI.conclusion: 在医疗AI系统中，临床风险评估必须成为机器遗忘验证的核心组成部分，以避免因遗忘操作导致的医疗漏诊风险增加。
AI.translation: 深度学习在医疗诊断中的应用必须在患者安全与数据保护法规遵从之间取得平衡。机器遗忘技术能够实现已部署模型中训练数据的选择性移除。然而，大多数遗忘方法主要通过效率和隐私导向的指标进行验证，对临床非对称错误成本的关注有限。在这项工作中，我们研究了遗忘如何影响二分类医疗图像分类中的临床风险。我们表明，标准的遗忘策略（微调、随机标签和SalUn）可能会在降低测试效用的同时增加假阴性率，从而放大临床风险。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了SalUn-CRA（临床风险感知），这是SalUn的一种变体，它用基于熵的遗忘机制取代了遗忘集中恶性样本的随机重标注，防止模型学习到有害的良性关联。我们在DermaMNIST和PathMNIST医疗图像数据集上，在20%和50%的数据移除比例下进行了评估。使用具有非对称成本的全局风险指标，SalUn-CRA在保持遗忘有效性的同时，实现了比全模型重训练更低或相当的临床风险。这些结果表明，临床风险应成为医疗系统中遗忘验证的一个组成部分。
AI.summary: 本文针对医疗图像分类中的机器遗忘问题，分析了主流遗忘算法对临床风险的影响。作者发现传统方法可能无意中提高漏诊率，进而提出了一种临床风险感知的遗忘方法SalUn-CRA，有效平衡了数据删除需求与医疗诊断安全性。
AI.keywords: 机器遗忘, 医疗AI, 临床风险, 深度学习安全, 图像分类
AI.comments: 该论文指出了医疗领域机器学习遗忘（Machine Unlearning）的一个关键盲点：现有的评估指标过度关注隐私和效率，而忽视了医疗诊断中不同错误（如漏诊与误诊）带来的严重后果差异。提出“临床风险感知”的遗忘策略是该领域的一个重要创新，对医疗AI的落地安全具有重要参考价值。

title: Learning Selective LLM Autonomy from Copilot Feedback in Enterprise Customer Support Workflows
summary: We present a deployed system that automates end-to-end customer support workflows inside an enterprise Business Process Management (BPM) platform. The approach is scalable in production and reaches selective automation within two weeks for a new process, leveraging supervision already generated at scale: structured per-case UI interaction traces and low-overhead copilot feedback, where operators either accept a suggestion or provide a correction. A staged deployment pipeline trains a next UI action policy, learns a critic from copilot feedback to calibrate abstention, and executes only high-confidence steps in the background while deferring uncertain decisions to operators and resuming from the updated UI state. This setup lets one operator supervise multiple concurrent sessions and be interrupted only when the system is uncertain. The system operates on a schema-driven view of the BPM interface and includes monitoring and safe fallbacks for production. In production, it automated 45% of sessions and reduced average handling time by 39% without degrading support quality level.

title: Latent Inter-Frame Pruning: A Training-Free Method Bridging Traditional Video Compression and Modern Diffusion Transformers for Efficient Generation
summary: Video generation, while capable of generating realistic videos, is computationally expensive and slow, prohibiting real-time applications. In this paper, we observe that video latents encoded via an autoencoder under the Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) framework contain redundancy along the temporal axis. Analogous to how traditional video compression algorithms avoid transmitting redundant frame data, we propose the Latent Inter-frame Pruning framework to prune (skip the re-computation of) duplicated latent patches, thereby reducing computational burden and increasing throughput. However, direct pruning results in visual artifacts due to the discrepancy between full-sequence training and pruned inference. To resolve these artifacts, we propose an Attention Recovery mechanism to bridge the train-inference gap. With our proposed method, we increase video editing throughput by 1.44$\times$, achieving 12.44 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 6000 while maintaining video quality. We hope our work inspires further research into integrating traditional video compression methods with modern video generation pipelines. This work is a preliminary work on Training-free Latent Inter-Frame Pruning with Attention Recovery.

title: Time-Series Forecasting in Safety-Critical Environments: An EU-AI-Act-Compliant Open-Source Package / Zeitreihenprognose in sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen: Ein KI-VO-konformes Open-Source-Paket
comments: Bilingual twin paper: English version first, German original below (91 pages total). Single shared bibliography
summary: With spotforecast2-safe we present an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments. A review of the relevant open-source tooling shows that existing compliance solutions operate consistently outside of the library to be used - e.g. as scanners, templates, or runtime layers. spotforecast2-safe takes the inverse approach and anchors the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the EU AI Act, in German: KI-VO), of IEC 61508, of the ISA/IEC 62443 standards series, and of the Cyber Resilience Act within the library: in application-programming-interface contracts, persistence formats, and continuous-integration gates. The approach is operationalised by four non-negotiable code-development rules (zero dead code, deterministic processing, fail-safe handling, minimal dependencies) together with the corresponding process rules (model card, executable docstrings, CI workflows, Common-Platform-Enumeration (CPE) identifier, REUSE-conformant licensing, release pipeline). Interactive visualisation, hyperparameter tuning and automated machine learning (AutoML), as well as deep-learning and large-language-model backends are deliberately excluded, because each of these components either enlarges the attack surface, introduces non-determinism, or impairs reproducibility. A bidirectional traceability matrix maps every regulatory provision onto the corresponding mechanism in the code; an end-to-end example of European-market electricity generation, transmission, and consumption forecasting demonstrates the application. The package is open-source and available under Affero General Public License (AGPL) 3.0-or-later.
comment: Bilingual twin paper: English version first, German original below (91 pages total). Single shared bibliography

title: Exploring Audio Hallucination in Egocentric Video Understanding
summary: Egocentric videos provide a distinctive setting in which sound serves as crucial cues to understand user activities and surroundings, particularly when visual information is unstable or occluded due to continuous camera movement. State-of-the-art large audio-visual language models (AV-LLMs) can generate multimodal descriptions. However, we show in this work that they are prone to audio hallucinations, often inferring sounds from visual cues that are visible but not heard. We present a systematic and automatic evaluation framework for analyzing audio hallucinations in egocentric video through a targeted question-answering (Q/A) protocol. We curate a dataset of 300 egocentric videos and design 1,000 sound-focused questions to probe model outputs. To characterize hallucinations, we propose a grounded taxonomy that distinguishes between foreground action sounds from the user activities and background ambient sounds. Our evaluation shows that advanced AV-LLMs, such as Qwen2.5 Omni, exhibit high hallucination rates, achieving only 27.3% and 39.5% accuracy on Q/As related to foreground and background sounds, respectively. With this work, we highlight the need to measure the reliability of multimodal responses, emphasizing that robust evaluation of hallucinations is essential to develop reliable AV-LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 探索第一人称视频理解中的音频幻觉现象
AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态大模型在理解第一人称视频时常产生“音频幻觉”，即仅凭视觉臆测声音；为此作者构建了评估框架和基准，证实了当前模型在该任务上表现极差。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频中声音是理解环境的关键，但现有的多模态大模型（AV-LLMs）常出现“音频幻觉”，即根据可见的视觉线索错误地推断出并未实际发生的声音。
AI.method: 提出了一套系统且自动化的评估框架，通过特定的问答（Q/A）协议进行分析；构建了包含300个视频和1000个针对声音问题的基准数据集；并设计了一套区分前景动作声音与背景环境声音的分类学方法。
AI.result: 评估显示先进的AV-LLMs（如Qwen2.5 Omni）表现不佳，在前景和背景声音相关的问答任务中，准确率分别仅为27.3%和39.5%。
AI.conclusion: 当前先进的多模态大模型在第一人称视频的音频理解任务中存在显著的幻觉现象，亟需通过更完善的评估手段和训练策略来提升其推理的可靠性。
