AI.translation: 门口和通道是室内机器人导航的关键结构元素，但在现代视觉SLAM（VSLAM）框架中仍未得到充分探索。本文提出了一种用于RGB-D VSLAM的通道感知结构化映射方法，通过联合融合几何、语义和拓扑线索来检测门和可通行开口。门被建模为嵌入墙壁内的平面实体，并根据其与支撑墙的共面性被分类为可通行或不可通行。通道通过两种互补策略进行推断：从连续关键帧的相机-墙壁交互中累积的遍历证据，以及基于映射墙壁几何形状中不连续性的几何开口验证。该方法作为概念验证被集成到vS-Graphs中，丰富了其具有通道级抽象的场景图，并改进了房间连接性建模。对室内办公序列的定性评估证明了其可靠的门口检测能力，该框架为在BIM辅助的VSLAM中利用这些元素奠定了基础。源代码已公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对RGB-D视觉SLAM的通道感知结构化映射方法，通过融合几何、语义和拓扑信息来检测门道和可通行开口。该方法将门建模为墙面上的平面，并结合交互证据与几何验证推断通道，成功将其集成至vS-Graphs中，增强了室内环境的场景图建模与导航能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉SLAM, 室内导航, 门道检测, 场景图, RGB-D
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将门道和通道等结构元素引入视觉SLAM，弥补了现有框架在室内环境语义建模方面的不足。通过融合几何、语义和拓扑信息，增强了场景图的表达能力，对实现更高级的机器人导航具有重要意义。

title: Scalable Hyperparameter-Divergent Ensemble Training with Automatic Learning Rate Exploration for Large Models
summary:
Training large neural networks with data-parallel stochastic gradient descent allocates N GPU replicas to compute effectively identical updates -- a practice that leaves the rich space of learning rate configurations entirely unexplored during training. We propose Hyperparameter-Divergent Ensemble Training (HDET), a method that repurposes these replicas for simultaneous learning rate exploration at negligible communication overhead. HDET operates in alternating phases: a fan-out stage in which replicas train independently under a structured, symmetric spread of learning rates, and a converge stage in which parameters are averaged across all replicas via AllReduce every T steps. Building on this ensemble substrate, we further propose an automatic learning rate (auto-LR) controller that treats the relative training loss across replicas as a performance signal, updating the shared base schedule toward higher-performing configurations via a momentum-based gradient-free meta-update. The combined method produces a self-adapting learning rate schedule that improves both optimization quality and generalization without additional hyperparameter sweeps or training budget.
  Crucially, the framework generalizes beyond learning rate: any scalar hyperparameter that does not alter model architecture -- such as dropout rate, attention scale temperature, or weight-decay coefficient -- can be explored across replicas using the same fan-out/converge protocol, with inter-replica loss differences serving as zero-order hypergradients that guide the search direction. HDET is implemented as a drop-in replacement for PyTorch's OneCycleLR scheduler, requiring no changes to model architecture, optimizer, or data pipeline.

title: Case-Specific Rubrics for Clinical AI Evaluation: Methodology, Validation, and LLM-Clinician Agreement Across 823 Encounters
comments: 14 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, submitted to JAMIA
summary:
Objective. Clinical AI documentation systems require evaluation methodologies that are clinically valid, economically viable, and sensitive to iterative changes. Methods requiring expert review per scoring instance are too slow and expensive for safe, iterative deployment. We present a case-specific, clinician-authored rubric methodology for clinical AI evaluation and examine whether LLM-generated rubrics can approximate clinician agreement.
  Materials and Methods. Twenty clinicians authored 1,646 rubrics for 823 clinical cases (736 real-world, 87 synthetic) across primary care, psychiatry, oncology, and behavioral health. Each rubric was validated by confirming that an LLM-based scoring agent consistently scored clinician-preferred outputs higher than rejected ones. Seven versions of an EHR-embedded AI agent for clinicians were evaluated across all cases.
  Results. Clinician-authored rubrics discriminated effectively between high- and low-quality outputs (median score gap: 82.9%) with high scoring stability (median range: 0.00%). Median scores improved from 84% to 95%. In later experiments, clinician-LLM ranking agreement (tau: 0.42-0.46) matched or exceeded clinician-clinician agreement (tau: 0.38-0.43), attributable to both ceiling compression and LLM rubric improvement.
  Discussion. This convergence supports incorporating LLM rubrics alongside clinician-authored ones. At roughly 1,000 times lower cost, LLM rubrics enable substantially greater evaluation coverage, while continued clinical authorship grounds evaluation in expert judgment. Ceiling compression poses a methodological challenge for future inter-rater agreement studies.
  Conclusion. Case-specific rubrics offer a path for clinical AI evaluation that preserves expert judgment while enabling automation at three orders lower cost. Clinician-authored rubrics establish the baseline against which LLM rubrics are validated.
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, submitted to JAMIA

AI.title_translation: 临床AI评估的案例特异性评分标准：跨823个病例的方法论、验证及LLM与临床医生的一致性研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用临床医生编写的评分标准结合LLM进行临床AI评估的方法，在保持专家准确性的前提下，将评估成本降低了1000倍，并实现了与临床医生相当的评估一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的临床AI评估方法依赖专家逐个评分，成本高昂且速度缓慢，无法满足临床AI安全、快速迭代部署的需求。
AI.method: 开发了一种案例特异性的评分标准方法，由20名临床医生为823个临床案例编写了1,646个评分标准，并使用LLM作为评分代理，通过验证其对临床医生偏好输出的区分能力来评估七个版本的EHR嵌入式AI系统。
AI.result: 临床医生撰写的评分标准在区分高质量与低质量输出方面表现出色（中位数得分差距为82.9%），稳定性高。LLM与临床医生的评估一致性（tau: 0.42-0.46）达到了甚至超过了临床医生之间的一致性（tau: 0.38-0.43），且成本降低了约1000倍。
AI.conclusion: 案例特异性评分标准为临床AI评估提供了一种既能保留专家判断，又能以极低成本实现自动化评估的有效途径。
AI.translation:
目标：临床AI文档系统需要临床有效、经济可行且对迭代变化敏感的评估方法。目前依赖专家逐个评分的方法对于安全、迭代的部署来说过于缓慢和昂贵。我们提出了一种针对案例的、由临床医生撰写的评分标准方法，并检验了LLM生成的评分标准是否能近似临床医生的一致性。
材料与方法：20名临床医生为初级保健、精神病学、肿瘤学和行为健康领域的823个临床案例（736个真实案例，87个合成案例）撰写了1,646个评分标准。每个评分标准都通过验证LLM评分代理是否始终给予临床医生首选输出更高的分数来确认。在所有案例中评估了七个版本的EHR嵌入式AI代理。
结果：临床医生撰写的评分标准有效地分辨了高质量和低质量的输出（中位数得分差距为82.9%），具有很高的评分稳定性（中位数范围为0.00%）。中位数得分从84%提高到95%。在后续实验中，临床医生与LLM的排名一致性（tau: 0.42-0.46）达到或超过了临床医生之间的一致性（tau: 0.38-0.43），这归因于天花板压缩和LLM评分标准的改进。
讨论：这种趋同性支持将LLM评分标准与临床医生撰写的评分标准结合使用。LLM评分标准的成本降低了约1000倍，能够实现更广泛的评估覆盖，而持续的临床医生撰写则确保了评估基于专家判断。天花板压缩为未来的评分者间一致性研究带来了方法论挑战。
结论：案例特异性评分标准为临床AI评估提供了一条路径，既保留了专家判断，又以低三个数量级的成本实现了自动化。临床医生撰写的评分标准确立了验证LLM评分标准的基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种案例特异性的评分标准方法，旨在解决临床AI评估成本高、效率低的问题。通过让临床医生编写评分标准并利用LLM进行自动化评估，研究证明了该方法在保持专家判断准确性的同时，能以极低的成本显著提升评估效率和覆盖范围。
AI.keywords: 临床AI, 评估方法, 评分标准, 大语言模型, 自动化评估
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的临床AI评估方法，通过“专家撰写评分标准+LLM辅助评估”的混合模式，巧妙平衡了评估的专业性（专家判断）与经济性（自动化），为临床AI的迭代部署提供了切实可行的路径。其局限性在于“天花板效应”（Ceiling Compression）对评估区分度的影响，以及临床医生与LLM在评估标准上的一致性仍有提升空间。

title: When Prompt Under-Specification Improves Code Correctness: An Exploratory Study of Prompt Wording and Structure Effects on LLM-Based Code Generation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used for code generation, yet the correctness of their outputs depends not only on model capability but also on how tasks are specified. Prior studies demonstrate that small changes in natural language prompts, particularly under-specification can substantially reduce code correctness; however, these findings are largely based on minimal-specification benchmarks such as HumanEval and MBPP, where limited structural redundancy may exaggerate sensitivity. In this exploratory study, we investigate how prompt structure, task complexity, and specification richness interact with LLM robustness to prompt mutations. We evaluate 10 different models across HumanEval and the structurally richer LiveCodeBench. Our results reveal that robustness is not a fixed property of LLMs but is highly dependent on prompt structure: the same under-specification mutations that degrade performance on HumanEval have near-zero net effect on LiveCodeBench due to redundancy across descriptions, constraints, examples, and I/O conventions. Surprisingly, we also find that prompt mutations can improve correctness. In LiveCodeBench, under-specification often breaks misleading lexical or structural cues that trigger incorrect retrieval-based solution strategies, leading to correctness improvements that counterbalance degradations. Manual analysis identifies consistent mechanisms behind these improvements, including the disruption of over-fitted terminology, removal of misleading constraints, and elimination of spurious identifier triggers. Overall, our study shows that structurally rich task descriptions can substantially mitigate the negative effects of under-specification and, in some cases, even enhance correctness. We outline categories of prompt modifications that positively influence the behavior of LLM code-generation, offering practical insights for writing robust prompts.

AI.title_translation: 当提示词欠明确反而提升代码正确性时：关于提示词措辞与结构对LLM代码生成影响的探索性研究
AI.tldr: 研究发现，在复杂的编程任务中，提示词的“欠明确”并不总是坏事，它有时能通过消除误导性线索从而提升代码生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多基于HumanEval等极简基准，认为提示词欠明确会显著降低代码正确性。研究者怀疑这种结论因缺乏结构冗余而被夸大，因此旨在探讨在更复杂的任务场景下，提示词结构如何影响模型对“欠明确”变体的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 通过在HumanEval（基准）和LiveCodeBench（结构更丰富）上评估10个LLM，系统研究提示词结构、任务复杂度及规范丰富度如何影响模型性能。通过手动分析提示词变体（如去除误导性约束、术语等）来识别触发正确性提升的机制。
AI.result: 在结构丰富的LiveCodeBench中，欠明确的提示词对性能影响极小。研究发现，当提示词中包含误导性词汇或结构化陷阱时，通过“欠明确”的修改（去除这些干扰项）反而能提高代码生成的正确率。
AI.conclusion: 提示词的稳健性并非模型固定属性，而是高度依赖于任务的结构丰富度。结构化冗余（如示例、约束等）能有效缓冲欠明确带来的负面影响，甚至通过干扰误导性线索来提升生成准确性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于代码生成，但其输出的正确性不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于任务的描述方式。先前的研究表明，自然语言提示词的微小变化，特别是“欠明确”描述，可能会显著降低代码正确性。然而，这些发现大多基于HumanEval和MBPP等极简规范基准，其中有限的结构冗余可能夸大了模型对提示词的敏感度。在这项探索性研究中，我们调查了提示词结构、任务复杂度和规范丰富度如何与LLM对提示词变异的鲁棒性相互作用。我们在HumanEval和结构更丰富的LiveCodeBench上评估了10种不同的模型。结果显示，鲁棒性并非LLM的固定属性，而是高度依赖于提示词结构：在HumanEval上导致性能下降的相同欠明确变异，在LiveCodeBench上几乎没有净影响，这归功于描述、约束、示例和I/O约定之间的冗余。令人惊讶的是，我们还发现提示词变异可以提高正确性。在LiveCodeBench中，欠明确的描述往往能打破触发错误检索式解决方案的误导性词汇或结构线索，从而带来抵消性能下降的正确性提升。手动分析确定了这些改进背后的机制，包括破坏过拟合术语、移除误导性约束以及消除虚假标识符触发。总的来说，我们的研究表明，结构丰富的任务描述可以显著减轻欠明确带来的负面影响，在某些情况下甚至能提高正确性。我们概述了对LLM代码生成行为产生积极影响的提示词修改类别，为编写稳健的提示词提供了实用见解。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了提示词结构与任务复杂度如何影响LLM代码生成的鲁棒性。研究发现，在结构丰富的任务中，提示词的欠明确性对性能的影响被显著缓解；更重要的是，通过去除提示词中误导性的术语或约束，欠明确的提示反而能提升代码的正确性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 代码生成, 提示工程, 提示词稳健性, 任务结构化
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了“提示词欠明确必然导致代码生成质量下降”的传统认知。其核心洞见在于：在复杂的、结构丰富的任务中，适度的欠明确反而能通过消除误导性线索（如过拟合术语或虚假标识符）来提升模型性能。这为提示工程提供了反直觉但极具实用价值的视角。

title: Long-Context Aware Upcycling: A New Frontier for Hybrid LLM Scaling
summary: Hybrid sequence models that combine efficient Transformer components with linear sequence modeling blocks are a promising alternative to pure Transformers, but most are still pretrained from scratch and therefore fail to reuse existing Transformer checkpoints. We study upcycling as a practical path to convert pretrained Transformer LLMs into hybrid architectures while preserving short-context quality and improving long-context capability. We call our solution \emph{HyLo} (HYbrid LOng-context): a long-context upcycling recipe that combines architectural adaptation with efficient Transformer blocks, Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), and linear blocks (Mamba2 or Gated DeltaNet), together with staged long-context training and teacher-guided distillation for stable optimization. HyLo extends usable context length by up to $32\times$ through efficient post-training and reduces KV-cache memory by more than $90\%$, enabling up to 2M-token prefill and decoding in our \texttt{vLLM} inference stack, while comparable Llama baselines run out of memory beyond 64K context. Across 1B- and 3B-scale settings (Llama- and Qwen-based variants), HyLo delivers consistently strong short- and long-context performance and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art upcycled hybrid baselines on long-context evaluations such as RULER. Notably, at similar scale, HyLo-Qwen-1.7B trained on only 10B tokens significantly outperforms JetNemotron (trained on 400B tokens) on GSM8K, Lm-Harness common sense reasoning and RULER-64K.

AI.title_translation: 长上下文感知的模型升级：混合LLM缩放的新前沿
AI.tldr: HyLo通过将现有Transformer模型升级为混合架构，在极低训练成本下实现了2M token的长上下文支持及90%以上的KV缓存压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有混合序列模型大多需要从头训练，无法利用现有的Transformer检查点，且在长文本处理上存在效率瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出HyLo方案，通过架构适配（结合Transformer、MLA、线性块如Mamba2/Gated DeltaNet）、分阶段长文本训练及教师引导的蒸馏技术，将预训练Transformer转换为混合模型。
AI.result: HyLo将可用上下文长度提升至32倍，KV缓存需求降低90%以上，支持2M token的推理，并在短文本和长文本基准测试（如RULER）中显著优于现有基准模型。
AI.conclusion: HyLo证明了通过升级预训练Transformer为混合架构，是实现高效长文本推理和降低显存占用的有效途径，优于从零训练的基准模型。
AI.translation: 结合高效Transformer组件与线性序列建模块的混合序列模型是纯Transformer的一种有前途的替代方案，但大多数模型仍需从头开始预训练，因此无法重用现有的Transformer检查点。我们研究了“升级”（Upcycling）作为一种将预训练Transformer LLM转换为混合架构的实用路径，该路径在保持短上下文质量的同时提高了长上下文能力。我们提出了HyLo（HYbrid LOng-context）：一种长上下文升级方案，它结合了架构适配与高效Transformer块、多头潜在注意力（MLA）及线性块（Mamba2或Gated DeltaNet），并辅以分阶段的长上下文训练和教师引导的蒸馏以实现稳定优化。HyLo通过高效的后训练将可用上下文长度扩展至32倍，并将KV缓存内存减少了90%以上，在我们的vLLM推理堆栈中实现了高达2M token的预填充和解码，而可比的Llama基准模型在超过64K上下文时会耗尽内存。在1B和3B规模设置（基于Llama和Qwen的变体）中，HyLo表现出持续强劲的短文本和长文本性能，并在RULER等长文本评估中显著优于最先进的升级混合基准模型。值得注意的是，在相似规模下，仅用10B token训练的HyLo-Qwen-1.7B在GSM8K、Lm-Harness常识推理和RULER-64K上的表现显著优于JetNemotron（使用400B token训练）。
AI.summary: HyLo是一种将预训练Transformer转换为混合架构的升级方案，利用MLA与线性模块结合，在保持短文本性能的同时，大幅提升了长文本处理能力并降低了推理显存占用。
AI.keywords: 混合模型, 长文本, 模型升级, 蒸馏, 推理优化
AI.comments: 该研究通过“升级”现有Transformer模型为混合架构，展示了在不从头训练的情况下显著提升长文本处理能力的潜力。其创新点在于结合了MLA、线性层和蒸馏技术，不仅降低了推理成本，还通过极少量的数据实现了性能超越，为大模型的高效扩展提供了新范式。

title: Learning to Rotate: Temporal and Semantic Rotary Encoding for Sequential Modeling
summary:
Every Transformer architecture dedicates enormous capacity to learning rich representations in semantic embedding space -- yet the rotation manifold acted upon by Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) has been treated as a fixed, hand-crafted structure, populated only by discrete ordinal indices. We argue that this rotation space is a largely overlooked second dimension of expressivity in the attention mechanism, one whose systematic exploration may open a new door for attention-based architectures. The analogy to complex numbers is instructive: just as introducing the imaginary axis -- orthogonal to and independent of the real line -- unlocked new algebraic structure once believed impossible, treating the rotation manifold as a learnable, signal-conditioned space opens an orthogonal degree of freedom in attention. In this framing, the token embedding encodes the semantic (real) component of a representation -- what a token means -- while the rotation encodes its dynamic (imaginary) component -- how it relates to every other token across time, position, and context.
  We introduce SIREN-RoPE, a concrete instantiation of this idea, which populates the rotation dimension with heterogeneous signals -- continuous timestamps, cyclical temporal patterns, and categorical metadata -- via a dual-branch Sinusoidal Representation Network (SIREN). As a proof of concept, we evaluate on a production-scale news feed dataset from a major social network using a generative recommender as the ranking model, demonstrating that activating this hidden dimension yields consistent improvements across calibration and ranking objectives with negligible computational overhead. We invite the community to view the rotation space not as a solved positional-encoding detail, but as an untapped axis whose rich structure may prove as consequential for attention as the imaginary unit proved for algebra.

AI.title_translation: 学会旋转：用于序列建模的时间与语义旋转编码
AI.tldr: 将RoPE从固定编码升级为可学习的动态旋转空间，通过SIREN网络注入多维异构信息，显著增强了注意力机制的表达能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的RoPE被视为固定的、手工设计的结构，仅用于简单的序数索引，忽略了旋转流形作为注意力机制中第二维度表达能力的潜力。
AI.method: 提出了SIREN-RoPE，通过双分支正弦表示网络（SIREN）将连续时间戳、周期性模式和分类元数据等异构信号注入到旋转维度中。
AI.result: 在生产规模的社交网络新闻流数据集上，作为生成式推荐系统的排序模型，SIREN-RoPE在校准和排序目标上均实现了持续的性能提升，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 将旋转流形视为可学习的信号条件空间是有效的，SIREN-RoPE通过引入动态信号显著增强了注意力机制的表达能力，且计算开销极低。
AI.translation: 每一项Transformer架构都投入了巨大的容量来学习语义嵌入空间中的丰富表征，然而，旋转位置编码（RoPE）所作用的旋转流形却一直被视为一种固定的、手工设计的结构，仅由离散的序数索引填充。我们认为，这个旋转空间是注意力机制中一个被严重忽视的第二维度表达能力，对其进行系统性探索可能为基于注意力的架构开启一扇新门。复数的类比具有启发性：正如引入虚轴（与实数轴正交且独立）解锁了曾经被认为不可能的新代数结构一样，将旋转流形视为可学习的、信号条件化的空间，为注意力机制开辟了一个正交的自由度。在此框架下，Token嵌入编码表征的语义（实数）分量——即Token的含义，而旋转编码其动态（虚数）分量——即它如何在时间、位置和上下文上与所有其他Token关联。我们引入了SIREN-RoPE，这是该思想的一个具体实现，它通过双分支正弦表示网络（SIREN）用异构信号（连续时间戳、周期性时间模式和分类元数据）填充旋转维度。作为概念验证，我们在某大型社交网络的生产规模新闻流数据集上进行了评估，使用生成式推荐系统作为排序模型，证明激活这一隐藏维度可以在校准和排序目标上产生一致的改进，且计算开销可忽略不计。我们邀请社区将旋转空间视为一个尚未开发的轴，而非一个已解决的位置编码细节，其丰富的结构对注意力机制的影响可能就像虚数单位对代数的影响一样深远。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SIREN-RoPE的新型位置编码方法。该方法将旋转流形从固定的序数索引转变为可学习的信号条件空间，利用SIREN网络将多种异构信息编码到旋转维度中，从而为注意力机制引入了与语义平行的动态表示维度。实验证明该方法在推荐系统中具有显著的性能优势。
AI.keywords: 旋转位置编码, 注意力机制, 序列建模, SIREN, 语义表征
AI.comments: 该研究具有极高的创新性，将RoPE从固定的位置编码视角转变为可学习的动态表示空间。通过类比复数引入虚轴的思想，为Transformer提供了一个全新的正交自由度，即“语义”与“旋转”解耦，在处理复杂上下文时展现了巨大潜力。限制在于目前仅在推荐系统场景进行了验证，在大规模语言模型上的通用性仍需进一步探索。

title: WildLIFT: Lifting monocular drone video to 3D for species-agnostic wildlife monitoring
summary: Monocular RGB cameras mounted on drones are widely used for wildlife monitoring, yet most analytical pipelines remain confined to two-dimensional image space, leaving geometric information in video underexploited. We present WildLIFT, a computational framework that integrates three-dimensional scene geometry from monocular drone video with open-vocabulary 2D instance segmentation to enable species-agnostic 3D detection and tracking. Oriented 3D bounding box labels with semantic face information enable quantitative assessment of viewpoint coverage and inter-animal occlusion, producing structured metadata for downstream ecological analyses. We validate the framework on 2,581 manually curated frames comprising over 6,700 3D detections across four large mammal species. WildLIFT maintains high identity consistency in multi-animal scenes and substantially reduces manual 3D annotation effort through keyframe-based refinement. By transforming standard drone footage into structured 3D and viewpoint-aware representations, WildLIFT extends the analytical utility of aerial wildlife datasets for behavioural research and population monitoring.

AI.title_translation: WildLIFT：将单目无人机视频提升至 3D 以实现物种无关的野生动物监测
AI.tldr: WildLIFT 是一种通过单目无人机视频实现 3D 野生动物检测与追踪的框架，有效提升了生态监测的自动化水平与数据结构化程度。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机野生动物监测多局限于 2D 图像空间，未能充分利用视频中的几何信息，限制了生态分析的深度。
AI.method: 提出 WildLIFT 框架，结合单目视频 3D 场景几何重建与开放词汇 2D 实例分割，通过关键帧细化生成带语义信息的定向 3D 边界框。
AI.result: 在包含 4 种大型哺乳动物的 2,581 帧数据上验证，实现了超过 6,700 次 3D 检测，保持了高身份一致性，并大幅减少了手动 3D 标注工作量。
AI.conclusion: WildLIFT 提供了一种将单目无人机视频转化为结构化 3D 监测数据的有效框架，提升了空中野生动物数据集的分析效能。
AI.translation: 安装在无人机上的单目 RGB 相机被广泛用于野生动物监测，但大多数分析流程仍局限于二维图像空间，导致视频中的几何信息未得到充分利用。我们提出了 WildLIFT，这是一个计算框架，它将单目无人机视频的三维场景几何与开放词汇 2D 实例分割相结合，实现了物种无关的 3D 检测和追踪。带有语义面信息的定向 3D 边界框标签能够对视点覆盖范围和动物间遮挡进行定量评估，从而为下游生态分析提供结构化元数据。我们在包含 4 种大型哺乳动物、超过 6,700 次 3D 检测的 2,581 帧人工精选数据上验证了该框架。WildLIFT 在多动物场景中保持了较高的一致性，并通过基于关键帧的优化显著降低了手动 3D 标注的工作量。通过将标准无人机镜头转换为结构化的 3D 和视点感知的表示，WildLIFT 扩展了空中野生动物数据集在行为研究和种群监测方面的分析效用。
AI.summary: WildLIFT 是一个计算框架，旨在将无人机拍摄的单目 RGB 视频转换为结构化的 3D 数据，通过整合场景几何与开放词汇分割，实现物种无关的 3D 动物检测与追踪，从而支持更深入的生态与行为研究。
AI.keywords: 无人机视频, 三维重建, 野生动物监测, 开放词汇分割, 行为分析
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将单目无人机视频提升至三维空间，并结合开放词汇分割技术，实现了物种无关的野生动物监测。这对于自动化生态研究具有重要意义，能够显著降低手动标注成本并提供更深层的行为分析数据。局限性在于主要针对大型哺乳动物，在复杂环境或更小动物上的通用性需进一步验证。

title: DiffuSAM: Diffusion-Based Prompt-Free SAM2 for Few-Shot and Source-Free Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Segmentation models such as Segment Anything Model (SAM) and SAM2 achieve strong prompt-driven zero-shot performance. However, their training on natural images limits domain transfer to medical data. Consequently, accurate segmentation typically requires extensive fine-tuning and expert-designed prompts. We propose DiffuSAM, a diffusion-based adaptation of SAM2 for prompt-free medical image segmentation. Our framework synthesizes SAM2-compatible segmentation mask-like embeddings via a lightweight diffusion-prior from off-the-shelf frozen SAM2 image features. The generated embeddings are integrated into SAM2's mask decoder to produce accurate segmentations, thereby eliminating the need for user prompts. The diffusion prior is further conditioned on previously segmented slices, enforcing spatial consistency across volumes. Evaluated on the BTCV and CHAOS datasets for CT and MRI under Source-Free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (SF-UDA) and Few-Shot settings, DiffuSAM achieves competitive performance with efficient training and inference. Code is available upon request from the corresponding author.

title: Sentiment and Emotion Classification of Indonesian E-Commerce Reviews via Multi-Task BiLSTM and AutoML Benchmarking
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Final project for Natural Language Processing course (PBA 2026) at Institut Teknologi Sumatera
summary: Indonesian marketplace reviews mix standard vocabulary with slang, regional loanwords, numeric shorthands, and emoji, making lexicon-based sentiment tools unreliable in practice. This paper describes a two-track classification pipeline applied to the PRDECT-ID dataset, which contains 5,400 product reviews from 29 Indonesian e-commerce categories, each labeled for binary sentiment (Positive/Negative) and five-class emotion (Happy, Sad, Fear, Love, Anger). The first track applies TF-IDF vectorization with a PyCaret AutoML sweep across standard classifiers. The second track is a PyTorch Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network with a shared encoder and two task-specific output heads. A preprocessing module applies 14 sequential cleaning steps, including a 140-entry slang dictionary assembled from marketplace corpora. Four configurations are benchmarked: BiLSTM Baseline, BiLSTM Improved, BiLSTM Large, and TextCNN. Training uses class-weighted cross-entropy loss, ReduceLROnPlateau scheduling, and early stopping. Both tracks are deployed as Gradio applications on Hugging Face Spaces. Source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ikii-sd/pba2026-crazyrichteam.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Final project for Natural Language Processing course (PBA 2026) at Institut Teknologi Sumatera

AI.title_translation: 基于多任务BiLSTM与AutoML基准测试的印尼电商评论情感与情绪分类研究
AI.tldr: 针对印尼电商评论中复杂的非标准语言，研究通过预处理和多任务BiLSTM模型实现了更精准的情感与情绪分类，并提供了AutoML基准对比。
AI.motivation: 印尼电商评论中混合了标准词汇、俚语、地区借词、数字缩写和表情符号，导致传统的基于词典的情感分析工具效果不佳，因此需要更鲁棒的自动化分类方案。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含14步预处理（含俚语词典）的流程，并采用了两条路径：一是基于TF-IDF与PyCaret的AutoML分类；二是具有共享编码器和两个任务特定输出头的多任务BiLSTM网络。使用了加权交叉熵损失、学习率调度和早停机制进行训练。
AI.result: 通过对包含5400条评论的PRDECT-ID数据集进行基准测试，验证了多任务BiLSTM架构在处理印尼电商评论的情感与情绪识别任务上的有效性，并提供了AutoML作为对比基准。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，结合多任务学习的BiLSTM模型在处理复杂的印尼电商评论时表现优异，通过精细的预处理和任务特定头的架构设计，能够有效提升情感与情绪分类的准确性。
AI.translation: 印尼电商平台评论中混合了标准词汇、俚语、地区借词、数字缩写和表情符号，这使得基于词典的情感工具在实际应用中变得不可靠。本文描述了一个应用于PRDECT-ID数据集的两轨道分类流水线，该数据集包含来自29个印尼电商类别的5400条产品评论，每条评论都标注了二元情感（正面/负面）和五类情绪（快乐、悲伤、恐惧、喜爱、愤怒）。第一轨道应用了TF-IDF向量化，并使用PyCaret进行AutoML扫描以对比标准分类器。第二轨道是一个PyTorch双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）网络，具有共享编码器和两个任务特定的输出头。预处理模块应用了14个连续的清洗步骤，包括从电商语料库中收集的140条俚语词典。研究对比了四种配置：BiLSTM基线、BiLSTM改进版、BiLSTM大型版和TextCNN。训练使用了类加权交叉熵损失、ReduceLROnPlateau调度和早停机制。两条轨道均作为Gradio应用程序部署在Hugging Face Spaces上。源代码已在GitHub上公开。
AI.summary: 本文针对印尼电商评论中非标准语言杂糅的问题，提出了一种包含预处理模块和双路径分类架构（AutoML与多任务BiLSTM）的解决方案，旨在提升情感与情绪分类的准确度。
AI.keywords: 印尼语电商评论, 情感分析, 多任务学习, BiLSTM, AutoML
AI.comments: 该研究针对印尼电商评论中复杂的语言特性（如俚语、缩写、表情符号）提出了有效的解决方案。通过对比AutoML与深度学习模型（BiLSTM），不仅提升了分类性能，还通过开源代码和应用部署增强了研究的实用价值。其创新点在于针对印尼语境的精细化预处理流程以及多任务学习架构。

title: Data-Driven Privacy-Preserving Modeling and Frequency Regulation with Aggregated Electric Vehicles via Bilinear Hidden Markov Model
comments: 12 Pages, 10 figures, Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid
summary: Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology allows bidirectional power flow for real-time grid support, making electric vehicles (EVs) well-suited for ancillary services such as frequency regulation. However, existing methods for flexibility estimation and coordinating aggregated EVs often rely on individual EV traveling information (e.g., arrival/departure time) and/or characteristic parameters (e.g., charging efficiency, battery capacity) as well as real-time state-of-charge (SOC), which raises privacy concerns and faces data quality issues. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a data-driven, privacy-preserving modeling and control framework for frequency regulation using aggregated EVs. The proposed method can provide accurate estimation for power outputs and flexibility of aggregated EVs and carry out effective frequency regulation without any individual EV information. %preserving user privacy and ensuring practical scalability. Simulation results validate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method, which also outperforms the model-based and federated learning-based method under SOC data inaccuracies.
comment: 12 Pages, 10 figures, Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid

AI.title_translation: 基于双线性隐马尔可夫模型的聚合电动汽车数据驱动隐私保护建模与频率调节
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需个体隐私数据即可实现电动汽车聚合建模与频率调节的新型双线性隐马尔可夫模型框架，在准确性与鲁棒性上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的电动汽车聚合建模与频率调节方法通常依赖于个体的详细行驶数据和电池参数，这不仅引发了严重的隐私泄露问题，还面临数据质量不佳的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于双线性隐马尔可夫模型（Bilinear Hidden Markov Model）的数据驱动建模与控制框架，无需依赖任何个体电动汽车的隐私信息（如到达/离开时间、充电效率、电池容量或实时SOC）。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该方法能够精确估计聚合电动汽车的功率输出和灵活性，在频率调节方面表现有效，且在SOC数据不准确的情况下，性能优于现有的基于模型和基于联邦学习的方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于双线性隐马尔可夫模型的框架能够实现隐私保护下的电动汽车聚合建模与频率调节，在准确性和鲁棒性方面优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 车网互动（V2G）技术允许双向功率流以实现实时电网支持，使得电动汽车（EVs）非常适合参与辅助服务，如频率调节。然而，现有的灵活性评估和聚合电动汽车协调方法通常依赖于个体电动汽车的行驶信息（例如到达/离开时间）和/或特征参数（例如充电效率、电池容量）以及实时荷电状态（SOC），这引起了隐私顾虑并面临数据质量问题。为了解决这些挑战，本文提出了一种用于聚合电动汽车频率调节的数据驱动、隐私保护建模与控制框架。所提方法能够在无需任何个体电动汽车信息的情况下，提供对聚合电动汽车功率输出和灵活性的准确估计，并执行有效的频率调节。仿真结果验证了该方法的准确性和有效性，且在SOC数据不准确的情况下，其表现优于基于模型和基于联邦学习的方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对电动汽车参与电网频率调节中的隐私保护与数据质量难题，提出了一种基于双线性隐马尔可夫模型（BHMM）的数据驱动建模与控制框架。该方法无需个体车辆的敏感信息，即可实现对聚合电动汽车灵活性和功率输出的准确估计，并在仿真中验证了其在复杂数据条件下的优越性能。
AI.keywords: 车网互动 (V2G), 频率调节, 隐私保护, 双线性隐马尔可夫模型, 电动汽车聚合
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用双线性隐马尔可夫模型（BHMM）在不泄露个体隐私数据（如到达时间、电池参数等）的前提下，实现对聚合电动汽车的高效建模与频率调节控制。相比传统的基于模型或联邦学习的方法，该方案在SOC数据存在误差的情况下表现更具鲁棒性，具有较高的实际应用价值。

title: VEHRON: A Configuration-Driven BEV Simulation Framework for Subsystem-Level Studies
summary: In practical early-stage battery-electric vehicle studies, analysis workflows may become fragmented across spreadsheets, notebooks, and project-specific scripts, making reuse, audit, and extension harder. VEHRON is an open-source Python framework for a deterministic, traceable workflow built around prescribed-speed longitudinal simulation of battery-electric vehicles using validated YAML configuration, packaged drive-cycle resources, interchangeable subsystem models, and auditable case outputs. VEHRON currently runs as a command-line workflow in which a vehicle definition and a testcase definition are combined to execute a simulation, emit a flat time series, and write a case package containing copied inputs, resolved configuration, summary metadata, and standard plots. Architecturally, VEHRON is organized around a small simulation engine, a shared state bus, a registry of model selections, schema-based configuration loading, and extension points for custom battery and HVAC models loaded from external Python files. VEHRON currently focuses on battery-electric longitudinal simulation with low-order battery, thermal, auxiliary-load, and HVAC models. This paper explains how VEHRON is structured, how it is used, which models it implements, and where its present limits lie. Source code is available at https://github.com/vehron-dev/vehron, with archived release metadata recorded under DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19820111.

AI.title_translation: VEHRON：用于子系统级研究的配置驱动式纯电动汽车仿真框架
AI.tldr: VEHRON是一个基于配置驱动的开源Python框架，用于标准化、审计和简化电动汽车的纵向动力学子系统仿真。
AI.motivation: 解决早期电动汽车研究中分析流程分散在各种脚本和表格中，导致难以重用、审计和扩展的问题。
AI.method: 采用基于YAML的配置驱动方法，通过小型仿真引擎、共享状态总线、模型注册机制以及可扩展的子系统接口（电池、HVAC等）构建确定性工作流。
AI.result: 成功实现了一个能够执行规定速度纵向仿真、生成可审计案例包（包含输入、配置、元数据和图表）的Python框架。
AI.conclusion: VEHRON是一个开源、确定性且可追踪的电动汽车仿真框架，为子系统级研究提供了一种标准化的工作流程。
AI.translation: 在实际的纯电动汽车早期研究中，分析工作流往往分散在电子表格、笔记本和针对特定项目的脚本中，这使得重用、审计和扩展变得困难。VEHRON是一个开源的Python框架，它围绕纯电动汽车的规定速度纵向仿真构建了确定性且可追踪的工作流，采用了经过验证的YAML配置、打包的驱动循环资源、可互换的子系统模型以及可审计的案例输出。VEHRON目前作为命令行工作流运行，其中车辆定义和测试用例定义相结合以执行仿真，输出平坦的时间序列，并写入包含复制输入、已解析配置、摘要元数据和标准图表的案例包。在架构上，VEHRON围绕小型仿真引擎、共享状态总线、模型选择注册表、基于模式的配置加载以及用于从外部Python文件加载自定义电池和HVAC模型的扩展点进行组织。VEHRON目前专注于具有低阶电池、热、辅助负载和HVAC模型的纯电动纵向仿真。本文解释了VEHRON的结构、使用方法、实现的模型以及目前的局限性。源代码可在https://github.com/vehron-dev/vehron获取，归档的发布元数据记录在DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19820111下。
AI.summary: VEHRON是一款开源的Python框架，旨在通过配置驱动的方法，为电动汽车的子系统级纵向仿真提供确定性、可追踪且标准化的工作流程。
AI.keywords: 电动汽车, 仿真框架, 配置驱动, 纵向动力学, 开源软件
AI.comments: VEHRON通过配置驱动的方式解决了早期电动汽车仿真流程碎片化的问题，提高了仿真工作的可审计性和可重复性。其架构设计模块化程度高，具备良好的扩展性，是学术研究和工程开发中进行子系统级分析的有力工具。

title: SpecRLBench: A Benchmark for Generalization in Specification-Guided Reinforcement Learning
summary: Specification-guided reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for encoding complex, temporally extended tasks using formal specifications such as linear temporal logic (LTL). While recent methods have shown promising results, their ability to generalize across unseen specifications and diverse environments remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce SpecRLBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the generalization capabilities of LTL-based specification-guided RL methods. The benchmark spans multiple difficulty levels across navigation and manipulation domains, incorporating both static and dynamic environments, diverse robot dynamics, and varied observation modalities. Through extensive empirical evaluation, we characterize the strengths and limitations of existing approaches and reveal the challenges that emerge as specification and environment complexity increase. SpecRLBench provides a structured platform for systematic comparison and supports the development of more generalizable specification-guided RL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/BU-DEPEND-Lab/SpecRLBench.

title: Error analysis for the approximation of a flow in deformable porous media with nonlinear strain-stress relation
summary: We study a model describing the slow flow of a fluid through a deformable, porous, elastic solid undergoing small deformations. The stress-strain relationship of the solid incorporates nonlinear effects, formulated as a perturbation of the classical linear elasticity. To approximate the coupled system, we introduce a discrete scheme based on a first order semi-implicit time integration scheme combined with a standard finite element spatial discretization. We establish the existence and uniqueness of the discrete solution and derive a priori convergence estimates under the assumption that the nonlinear perturbations remain sufficiently small. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed scheme through numerical experiments that also highlight the nonlinear phenomena captured by the model.

title: Distributional Robustness of Linear Contracts
summary: Linear contracts are ubiquitous in practice, yet optimal contract theory often prescribes complex, nonlinear structures. We provide a distributional robustness justification for linear contracts. We study a principal-agent problem where the agent exerts costly effort across multiple tasks, generating a stochastic signal upon which the principal conditions payment. The principal faces distributional ambiguity: she knows the expected signal for each effort level, but not the full distribution. She seeks a contract maximizing her worst-case payoff over all distributions consistent with this partial knowledge. Our main result shows that linear contracts are optimal for such a principal. For any contract, there exists a linear contract achieving weakly higher worst-case payoff. The proof introduces the concavification approach built around the notion of self-inducing actions; these are actions where an affine contract simultaneously induces the action as optimal and supports the concave envelope of payments from above. We show that self-inducing actions always exist as maximizers of the gap between the concave envelope and agent's cost function. We extend these results to multi-party settings. In common agency with multiple principals, we show that affine contracts improve all principals' worst-case payoffs. In team production with multiple agents, we establish a complementary necessity result: if any agent's contract is non-affine, the unique ex-post robust equilibrium is zero effort. Finally, we show that homogeneous utility and cost functions yield tractable characterizations, enabling closed-form approximation ratios and a sharp boundary between computational tractability results.

title: Learning to Think from Multiple Thinkers
comments: Comments are welcome. There are 78 pages and 5 Figures
summary:
We study learning with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision from multiple thinkers, all of whom provide correct but possibly systematically different solutions, e.g., step-by-step solutions to math problems written by different thinkers, or step-by-step execution traces of different programs solving the same problem.
  We consider classes that are computationally easy to learn using CoT supervision from a single thinker, but hard to learn with only end-result supervision, i.e., without CoT (Joshi et al. 2025). We establish that, under cryptographic assumptions, learning can be hard from CoT supervision provided by two or a few different thinkers, in passive data-collection settings.
  On the other hand, we provide a generic computationally efficient active learning algorithm that learns with a small amount of CoT data per thinker that is completely independent of the target accuracy $\varepsilon$, a moderate number of thinkers that scales as $\log \frac{1}{\varepsilon}\log \log \frac{1}{\varepsilon}$, and sufficient passive end-result data that scales as $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\cdot poly\log\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$.

AI.title_translation: 从多位思考者中学习思考
AI.tldr: 研究表明在被动设置下利用多思维链监督学习可能很困难，但通过一种新型主动学习算法，可以高效地利用多思维者提供的信息。
AI.motivation: 研究在多思维者（提供正确但方法不同的思维链）监督下，如何解决单思维者CoT监督容易但仅依靠最终结果监督困难的学习问题，并探索其计算复杂性。
AI.method: 提出了一种通用的计算高效主动学习算法。该算法结合了每个思维者少量的CoT数据、适量数量的思维者（规模为log(1/ε)loglog(1/ε)）以及充足的被动结果数据（规模为(1/ε)·polylog(1/ε)）。
AI.result: 在密码学假设下，证明了在被动数据收集设置中，从两个或少数几个思维者获取CoT监督可能导致学习困难；同时证明了所提出的主动学习算法能够实现高效学习。
AI.conclusion: 虽然在被动数据收集设置下，多思维链监督可能面临计算困难，但通过主动学习策略，可以利用少量CoT数据和充足的被动结果数据高效地学习目标任务。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在来自多个思维者的思维链（CoT）监督下进行学习的问题，这些思维者提供正确但可能系统性不同的解决方案（例如，由不同思维者编写的数学问题分步解答，或解决相同问题的不同程序的执行踪迹）。我们考虑了那些使用单思维者CoT监督在计算上易于学习，但仅依靠最终结果监督（即没有CoT）则难以学习的类别。我们证明，在密码学假设下，在被动数据收集设置中，从两个或少数几个不同思维者提供的CoT监督下进行学习可能是困难的。另一方面，我们提供了一种通用的计算高效主动学习算法，该算法使用每个思维者少量且与目标精度ε完全无关的CoT数据、适量（规模为log(1/ε)loglog(1/ε)）的思维者，以及规模为(1/ε)·polylog(1/ε)的充足被动结果数据进行学习。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了从多个提供不同思维链（CoT）的思维者处进行学习的问题。研究发现，在被动数据收集环境下，利用多思维者CoT监督可能在计算上是困难的。为此，作者提出了一种高效的主动学习算法，仅需少量CoT数据和适量的被动结果数据即可实现学习目标。
AI.keywords: 思维链, 主动学习, 计算复杂性, 多思维者, 机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过密码学假设揭示了多思维链（CoT）学习的理论局限性，并提出了一个高效的主动学习算法来克服这些困难。其创新点在于将主动学习与多思维链监督相结合，为理解思维链在机器学习中的作用提供了深刻的理论视角。

title: Conflict-Aware Harmonized Rotational Gradient for Multiscale Kinetic Regimes
summary:
In this paper, we propose a harmonized rotational gradient method, termed HRGrad, for simultaneously tackling multiscale time-dependent kinetic problems with varying small parameters.
  These parameters exhibit asymptotic transitions from microscopic to macroscopic physics, making it a challenging multi-task problem to solve over all ranges simultaneously.
  Solving tasks in different asymptotic regions often encounter gradient conflicts, which can lead to the failure of multi-task learning.
  To address this challenge, we explicitly encode a hidden representation of these parameters, ensuring that the corresponding solving tasks are serialized for simultaneous training.
  Furthermore, to mitigate gradient conflicts, we segment the prediction results to construct task losses and introduce a novel gradient alignment metric to ensure a positive dot product between the final update and each loss-specific gradient.
  This metric maintains consistent optimization rates for all task losses and dynamically adjusts gradient magnitudes based on conflict levels.
  Moreover, we provide a mathematical proof demonstrating the convergence of the HRGrad method, which is evaluated across a range of challenging asymptotic-preserving neural networks (APNNs) scenarios.
  We conduct an extensive set of experiments encompassing the Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) equation and the linear transport equation in all ranges of Knudsen number.
  Our results indicate that HRGrad effectively overcomes the `failure modes' of APNNs in these problems.

AI.title_translation: 面向多尺度动力学机制的冲突感知协调旋转梯度法
AI.tldr: HRGrad 通过协调多尺度动力学任务中的梯度冲突，显著提升了渐近保持神经网络在处理从微观到宏观物理转换时的训练稳定性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 在多尺度时间相关动力学问题中，随着小参数从微观向宏观演变，不同渐近区域的任务在训练时会产生梯度冲突，导致多任务学习失败。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 HRGrad 的方法，通过对多尺度参数进行显式编码以实现任务序列化，并引入新的梯度对齐指标来动态调整梯度方向和大小，从而解决多任务学习中的梯度冲突问题。
AI.result: 通过在BGK方程和线性输运方程等多种渐近保持神经网络（APNNs）场景下的实验，证明了HRGrad能够有效克服现有方法在跨尺度求解中的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: HRGrad 方法通过显式参数编码和梯度对齐机制，成功克服了多尺度动力学问题中不同渐近区域的梯度冲突，为求解跨尺度物理问题提供了一种鲁棒的训练策略。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一种名为 HRGrad 的协调旋转梯度方法，用于同时处理具有不同小参数的多尺度时间相关动力学问题。这些参数展现了从微观物理到宏观物理的渐近转换，使得在所有范围内同时求解成为一个具有挑战性的多任务问题。在不同渐近区域求解任务时常会遇到梯度冲突，这可能导致多任务学习失败。为了应对这一挑战，我们显式编码了这些参数的隐藏表示，确保相应的求解任务在同时训练时是序列化的。此外，为了减轻梯度冲突，我们对预测结果进行了分割以构建任务损失，并引入了一种新颖的梯度对齐指标，以确保最终更新与每个特定任务梯度之间存在正的点积。该指标保持了所有任务损失的一致优化速率，并根据冲突水平动态调整梯度大小。此外，我们提供了数学证明来论证 HRGrad 方法的收敛性，并在一系列具有挑战性的渐近保持神经网络（APNNs）场景中进行了评估。我们开展了广泛的实验，涵盖了Knudsen数全范围内的Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) 方程和线性输运方程。结果表明，HRGrad 有效克服了这些问题中 APNNs 的“失败模式”。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 HRGrad 方法，旨在解决多尺度动力学问题中因渐近区域转换导致的梯度冲突。该方法通过参数编码和梯度对齐策略，确保了多任务训练的稳定性和收敛性，并在多种典型物理方程中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 多尺度动力学, 梯度冲突, 渐近保持神经网络, HRGrad, 梯度对齐
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种处理多尺度动力学问题的梯度调整方法，特别解决了渐近保持神经网络（APNNs）在不同尺度转换中常见的梯度冲突问题，具有很强的理论深度和实用价值。

title: A mixed interpolation-regression method for numerical integration on some planar domains
summary: In this contribution we introduce a mixed interpolation-regression operator for functions defined in some domains of the plane. We focus the attention on the ellipse, an annulus and a polygon. An upper bound for such an operator is obtained. Cubature formulas for weight functions defined in such domains are studied. The performance of the above interpolation-regression methods is illustrated with some numerical examples taking into account the variations of the dimension of the interpolation and the regression part, respectively.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于某些平面区域数值积分的混合插值-回归方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合插值与回归技术的数值积分新方法，适用于椭圆、圆环和多边形等平面区域，并提供了误差界和数值验证。
AI.motivation: 针对平面特定区域（如椭圆、圆环、多边形）上的函数，现有的数值积分方法需要更灵活的算子来提高计算效率与准确性。
