AI.title_translation: 大语言模型的思维链推理是幻影吗？基于数据分布视角的研究
AI.tldr: 思维链（CoT）并非真正的逻辑推理，而是对训练数据分布的拟合；一旦脱离训练分布，其推理能力便会失效。
AI.motivation: 针对思维链在某些任务上的失败，作者试图通过“数据分布”视角，探究思维链推理在何时以及为何成功或失败的深层机制。
AI.method: 通过引入 DataAlchemy 这一可控的抽象环境，从零开始训练LLM，并从任务、长度和格式三个维度，系统性地探究模型在不同数据分布条件下的推理表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，思维链推理的有效性高度依赖于训练数据与测试数据之间的一致性；当超出训练分布时，思维链表现得极其脆弱，证实了其作为“幻影”的假设。
AI.conclusion: 思维链推理并非真正的逻辑能力，而是一种依赖于训练数据分布的脆弱现象，在超出分布范围时会失效，揭示了当前LLM在实现真正通用推理方面的局限性。
AI.translation: 思维链（CoT）提示已被证明在激发大语言模型（LLM）进行结构化推理方面是有效的。尽管其广受欢迎，但近期研究揭示了它在某些推理任务中的失败，引发了关于 CoT 推理本质的根本性问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个数据分布视角来理解 CoT 推理在何时以及为何成功或失败。我们假设 CoT 推理反映了从分布内数据中学到的结构化归纳偏置，使模型能够有条件地生成近似于训练过程中观察到的推理轨迹。因此，CoT 推理的有效性从根本上受限于训练数据与测试查询之间的分布差异的性质和程度。基于这一视角，我们从任务、长度和格式三个维度剖析了 CoT 推理。为了验证该假设，我们引入了 DataAlchemy，这是一个抽象且完全可控的环境，用于从零开始训练 LLM，并在各种分布条件下对其进行系统性探测。通过严格的对照实验，我们揭示了当 CoT 推理被推向训练分布之外时，它只是一个脆弱的幻影，强调了实现真正且可泛化推理所面临的持续挑战。
AI.summary: 本文通过数据分布的视角重新审视了思维链（CoT）推理，提出其本质是模型对训练数据中结构化归纳偏置的模仿。通过构建可控环境 DataAlchemy 进行系统实验，研究发现 CoT 在面对分布外数据时表现出明显的脆弱性，质疑了其作为通用推理能力的可靠性。
AI.keywords: 思维链（CoT）, 大语言模型（LLM）, 数据分布, 归纳偏置, 泛化性
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了对思维链（CoT）能力的传统认知，指出其本质上可能是对训练数据分布的拟合，而非真正的逻辑推理能力。这种视角对于评估模型泛化性和设计更稳健的推理系统具有重要意义。

title: WinkTPG: An Execution Framework for Multi-Agent Path Finding Using Temporal Reasoning
summary: Planning collision-free paths for a large group of agents is a challenging problem in many real-world applications. While recent advances in Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) have shown promising progress, standard MAPF planners continue to rely on simplified kinodynamic models, preventing agents from directly following the generated MAPF plan. To bridge this gap, we propose kinodynamic Temporal Plan Graph planning (kTPG), a multi-agent speed optimization algorithm that efficiently refines a MAPF plan into a set of kinodynamically feasible speed profiles. We further incorporate execution timing uncertainty models and provide deterministic guarantees under bounded uncertainty models and probabilistic guarantees under stochastic models. Building on kTPG, we propose Windowed kTPG (WinkTPG), a MAPF execution framework that incrementally refines MAPF plans using a window-based mechanism, dynamically incorporating agent information during execution to reduce uncertainty. Experiments show that WinkTPG can generate speed profiles for up to 1,000 agents within 1 second and improves solution quality by up to 51.7% over existing MAPF execution methods. We further validate WinkTPG in high-fidelity physics-based simulation and on real-world robots.

title: Reliable Microservice Tail Latency Prediction via Decoupled Dual-Stream Learning and Gradient Modulation
summary: Microservice architectures enable scalable cloud-native applications; however, the distributed nature of these systems complicates the maintenance of strict Service Level Objectives. Accurately predicting window-level P95 tail latency remains difficult due to the complex interactions between software workload propagation and infrastructure resource limits. Existing predictive models struggle to capture these dynamics because the lack of explicit separation between traffic metrics and resource metrics causes misaligned feature representations. Building on this suboptimal data treatment, the unified architectures of prior approaches fail to isolate cascading service dependencies from localized processing capacity. Due to this entanglement, joint training suffers from an optimization imbalance wherein resource features converge faster and dominate gradient updates, thereby preventing the learning of underlying software topologies. To address these challenges, we propose USRFNet, a dual-stream framework that separates the modeling of demand and capacity. The proposed framework utilizes a Graph Neural Network to model the spatial interactions of traffic workloads across software-level service dependencies, and a gating MLP to independently extract infrastructure-level resource dynamics. The model then integrates these representations through hierarchical tensor fusion. To resolve the training imbalance, we introduce a Reliability-Aware Gradient Modulation strategy that dynamically rescales gradients based on the generalization ratio of each data stream. Experiments on three large-scale real-world benchmarks demonstrate that USRFNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods in prediction accuracy. Specifically, compared to the best-performing baselines, the proposed framework achieves relative MAPE reductions ranging from 15.62% to 26.11% across the evaluated datasets.

title: RegMean++: Enhancing Effectiveness and Generalization of Regression Mean for Model Merging
comments: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary: Regression Mean (RegMean), an approach that formulates model merging as a linear regression problem, aims to find the optimal weights for each linear layer in the merged model by minimizing the discrepancy in predictions between the merged and candidate models. RegMean provides a precise closed-form solution for the merging problem; therefore, it offers explainability and computational efficiency. However, RegMean merges each linear layer independently, overlooking how the features and information in earlier layers propagate through deeper layers and influence the final predictions of the merged model. Here, we introduce RegMean++, a simple yet effective alternative to RegMean, that explicitly incorporates both intra-layer and cross-layer dependencies between merged models' layers into RegMean's objective. By accounting for these dependencies, RegMean++ better captures the behaviors of the merged model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RegMean++ consistently outperforms RegMean across diverse settings, including in-domain (ID) and out-of-domain (OOD) generalization, sequential merging, large-scale tasks, and robustness under several types of distribution shifts. Furthermore, RegMean++ achieves competitive performance across diverse settings compared to various advanced model merging methods.
comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research

title: mKG-RAG: Leveraging Multimodal Knowledge Graphs in Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-intensive VQA
comments: In Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR'26), July 20-24, 2026, Melbourne, VIC, Australia
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as an effective paradigm for expanding the knowledge capacity of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by incorporating external knowledge sources into the generation process, and has been widely adopted for knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA). Despite impressive advancements, vanilla RAG-based VQA methods that rely on unstructured documents and overlook the structural relations among knowledge elements frequently introduce irrelevant or misleading content, degrading answer accuracy and reliability. To overcome these challenges, a promising solution is to integrate multimodal knowledge graphs (KGs) into RAG-based VQA frameworks, thereby enhancing generation through structured multimodal knowledge. To this end, this paper proposes mKG-RAG, a novel retrieval-augmented generation framework built upon multimodal KGs for knowledge-intensive VQA tasks. Specifically, mKG-RAG leverages MLLM-driven graph extraction and vision-text matching to distill semantically consistent, modality-complementary entities and relations from multimodal documents, constructing high-quality multimodal KGs as structured knowledge representations. Furthermore, a dual-stage retrieval strategy equipped with a query-aware multimodal retriever is introduced to improve retrieval efficiency while progressively refining precision. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches and sets new state-of-the-art results for knowledge-based VQA. The code is available at https://github.com/xandery-geek/mKG-RAG.

AI.title_translation: mKG-RAG：在知识密集型视觉问答中利用多模态知识图谱进行检索增强生成
AI.tldr: mKG-RAG通过引入多模态知识图谱取代非结构化文档检索，显著提升了视觉问答的准确性与知识关联能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG方法多依赖非结构化文档，忽略了知识要素间的结构化关系，导致检索内容不相关或误导性，降低了视觉问答的准确度和可靠性。
AI.method: 提出了mKG-RAG框架，利用MLLM进行图提取与视觉-文本匹配构建多模态知识图谱，并采用双阶段检索策略（结合查询感知的多模态检索器）进行精确知识获取。
AI.result: 实验证明，mKG-RAG在知识密集型VQA任务上显著优于现有方法，并确立了新的SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: mKG-RAG框架通过构建多模态知识图谱和双阶段检索策略，显著提升了视觉问答模型在处理复杂知识任务时的准确性和可靠性，达到了SOTA水平。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为通过将外部知识源整合到生成过程中来扩展多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）知识容量的有效范式，并已广泛应用于基于知识的视觉问答（VQA）。尽管取得了显著进展，但依赖非结构化文档且忽视知识元素间结构关系的传统RAG-VQA方法经常引入不相关或误导性内容，从而降低了答案的准确性和可靠性。为了克服这些挑战，一个有前景的解决方案是将多模态知识图谱（KGs）集成到基于RAG的VQA框架中，从而通过结构化的多模态知识增强生成效果。为此，本文提出了mKG-RAG，这是一个基于多模态知识图谱构建的用于知识密集型VQA任务的新型检索增强生成框架。具体而言，mKG-RAG利用MLLM驱动的图提取和视觉-文本匹配，从多模态文档中提炼语义一致、模态互补的实体和关系，构建高质量的多模态知识图谱作为结构化知识表示。此外，引入了配备查询感知多模态检索器的双阶段检索策略，以提高检索效率并逐步优化精度。全面的实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，并为基于知识的VQA设定了新的SOTA结果。代码已在https://github.com/xandery-geek/mKG-RAG开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了mKG-RAG框架，旨在通过构建多模态知识图谱来弥补传统RAG方法在处理知识密集型VQA任务时对结构化知识利用的不足。该方法通过多模态提取和双阶段检索策略，有效提高了知识的语义一致性和检索精度。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 多模态知识图谱, 视觉问答, 结构化知识, 多模态大模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多模态知识图谱引入RAG框架，解决了传统非结构化数据检索带来的噪声和逻辑关联缺失问题。通过多模态知识图谱实现结构化知识增强，是提升知识密集型视觉问答（VQA）性能的重要方向。

title: Smoothing Slot Attention Iterations and Recurrences
summary: Slot Attention (SA) lies at the heart of mainstream Object-Centric Learning (OCL). Image features can be aggregated into object-level representations by SA iteratively refining cold-start query slots. For video, such aggregation proceeds by SA recurrently shared across frames, with queries cold-started on the first frame while transitioned from the previous frame's slots thereafter. However, cold-start queries lack sample-specific cues thus hindering precise aggregation on image or video's first frame; Non-first frames' queries are already sample-specific thus requiring aggregation transforms different from the first frame. We address these issues with our SmoothSA: (1) To smooth SA iterations on image or video's first frame, we preheat cold-start queries with rich input-feature information, by a tiny module self-distilled inside OCL; (2) To smooth SA recurrences across video's first and non-first frames, we differentiate the homogeneous aggregation transforms by using full and single iterations respectively. Comprehensive experiments on object discovery, recognition and visual reasoning validate our method's effectiveness. Further visual analyses illuminate the underline mechanisms. Our source code, model checkpoints and training logs are provided on https://github.com/Genera1Z/SmoothSA.

AI.title_translation: 平滑槽注意力机制的迭代与递归
AI.tldr: SmoothSA通过预热冷启动查询并优化视频帧间的迭代策略，提升了目标中心学习在图像和视频任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的Slot Attention在图像/视频首帧中由于冷启动查询缺乏样本特定信息导致聚合不精准，且视频帧间存在聚合需求差异，传统同质化处理方式效率低下。
AI.method: 1. 引入一个小型自蒸馏模块，通过预热手段为图像或视频首帧的冷启动查询注入丰富的输入特征信息；2. 针对视频的首帧与非首帧，采用差异化的迭代策略，分别使用全量和单次迭代来平滑递归过程。
AI.result: 在目标发现、识别和视觉推理任务的综合实验中，验证了SmoothSA的有效性，并通过视觉分析揭示了其内在机制。
AI.conclusion: SmoothSA 通过引入查询预热和差异化迭代策略，显著提升了目标中心学习在图像和视频任务中的聚合精度与稳定性。
AI.translation: Slot Attention (SA) 是主流对象中心学习 (OCL) 的核心。图像特征可以通过 SA 迭代地细化冷启动查询槽，从而聚合成对象级表示。对于视频，这种聚合通过在帧间循环共享的 SA 进行，查询在第一帧冷启动，随后从前一帧的槽中转换。然而，冷启动查询缺乏样本特定的线索，从而阻碍了图像或视频第一帧上的精确聚合；非第一帧的查询已经是样本特定的，因此需要与第一帧不同的聚合转换。我们用 SmoothSA 解决了这些问题：(1) 为了平滑图像或视频第一帧上的 SA 迭代，我们通过 OCL 内部自蒸馏的一个微小模块，用丰富的输入特征信息预热冷启动查询；(2) 为了平滑视频第一帧和非第一帧之间的 SA 递归，我们通过分别使用完全迭代和单次迭代来区分同质聚合转换。对目标发现、识别和视觉推理的全面实验验证了我们方法的有效性。进一步的视觉分析阐明了其潜在机制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SmoothSA的方法，旨在优化Slot Attention在对象中心学习中的迭代与递归过程。通过引入自蒸馏预热机制解决首帧冷启动的不足，并针对视频帧间差异采用不同的迭代策略，有效提升了模型在图像和视频任务中的聚合性能。
AI.keywords: Slot Attention, 对象中心学习, 视频处理, 自蒸馏, 迭代优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过微调Slot Attention的迭代与递归机制，解决了冷启动查询缺乏样本信息及视频帧间聚合差异的问题，是一种针对目标中心学习（OCL）架构的有效改进。其创新点在于引入自蒸馏预热机制和差异化迭代策略，具有较强的实用价值。

title: Affordance-R1: Reinforcement Learning for Generalizable Affordance Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Model
summary: Affordance grounding focuses on predicting the specific regions of objects that are associated with the actions to be performed by robots. It plays a vital role in the fields of human-robot interaction, human-object interaction, embodied manipulation, and embodied perception. Existing models often neglect the affordance shared among different objects because they lack the Chain-of-Thought(CoT) reasoning abilities, limiting their out-of-domain (OOD) generalization and explicit reasoning capabilities. To address these challenges, we propose Affordance-R1, the first unified affordance grounding framework that integrates cognitive CoT guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) within a reinforcement learning paradigm. Specifically, we designed a sophisticated affordance function, which contains format, perception, and cognition rewards to effectively guide optimization directions. Furthermore, we constructed a high-quality affordance-centric reasoning dataset, ReasonAff, to support training. Trained exclusively via reinforcement learning with GRPO and without explicit reasoning data, Affordance-R1 achieves robust zero-shot generalization and exhibits emergent test-time reasoning capabilities. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our model outperforms well-established methods and exhibits open-world generalization. To the best of our knowledge, Affordance-R1 is the first to integrate GRPO-based RL with reasoning into affordance reasoning. The code of our method and our dataset is released on https://github.com/hq-King/Affordance-R1.

AI.title_translation: Affordance-R1：用于多模态大模型通用意图推理的强化学习方法
AI.tldr: Affordance-R1是首个通过GRPO强化学习训练多模态模型进行意图推理的框架，无需显式推理数据即可实现强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有意图定位模型缺乏思维链（CoT）推理能力，导致其在不同物体间的意图共享理解不足，限制了模型的域外（OOD）泛化能力和显式推理能力。
AI.method: 提出Affordance-R1框架，整合了认知CoT引导的组相对策略优化（GRPO）强化学习范式，设计了包含格式、感知和认知奖励的奖励函数，并构建了ReasonAff数据集。
AI.result: Affordance-R1在无需显式推理数据的情况下，实现了鲁棒的零样本泛化，在多个实验中超越了现有主流方法，并表现出显著的开放世界泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Affordance-R1 提供了一种新颖且有效的框架，证明了通过强化学习优化多模态大模型在具身任务中的推理能力是可行的，且在开放世界场景下展现出优异的性能。
AI.translation: 意图定位（Affordance grounding）专注于预测物体上与机器人执行动作相关的特定区域。它在人机交互、人机交互、具身操作和具身感知领域发挥着至关重要的作用。现有的模型由于缺乏思维链（CoT）推理能力，往往忽略了不同物体之间共享的意图，从而限制了它们的域外（OOD）泛化能力和显式推理能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Affordance-R1，这是第一个将认知CoT引导的组相对策略优化（GRPO）集成到强化学习范式中的统一意图定位框架。具体而言，我们设计了一种复杂的意图函数，其中包含格式、感知和认知奖励，以有效指导优化方向。此外，我们构建了一个高质量的以意图为中心的推理数据集ReasonAff，以支持训练。Affordance-R1仅通过带有GRPO的强化学习进行训练，且无需显式推理数据，实现了鲁棒的零样本泛化，并展现出涌现的测试时推理能力。综合实验表明，我们的模型优于现有的成熟方法，并表现出开放世界的泛化能力。据我们所知，Affordance-R1是第一个将基于GRPO的强化学习与推理结合到意图推理中的方法。我们的代码和数据集已在 https://github.com/hq-King/Affordance-R1 上发布。
AI.summary: Affordance-R1是一个创新的多模态意图定位框架，通过GRPO强化学习引导模型进行思维链推理，有效提升了机器人在开放世界中的意图理解与泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 意图定位, 强化学习, 多模态大模型, 思维链, 零样本泛化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于首次将基于GRPO的强化学习范式引入到具身智能的意图（Affordance）推理中，通过无需显式推理数据的训练方式，实现了零样本泛化能力和涌现出的思维链推理能力。其局限性可能在于对于极端复杂或未见过的未知物体，强化学习的策略收敛和泛化稳定性仍需进一步验证。

title: Neural Bridge Processes
summary: Learning stochastic functions from partially observed context-target pairs requires models that are expressive, uncertainty-aware, and strongly conditioned on inputs. Neural Diffusion Processes (NDPs) improve expressivity with denoising diffusion, but their forward process is input-independent; inputs only enter the reverse denoiser, so the noisy training states themselves do not encode the conditioning inputs. We propose Neural Bridge Processes (NBPs), which replace the unconditional forward kernel with an input-anchored bridge trajectory. When input and output dimensions differ, NBP learns an output-space anchor $a_ψ(x)=P_ψ(x)$, allowing coordinates or other inputs to guide the generative path without changing the denoising backbone. We show theoretically that process-level anchoring induces pathwise input distinguishability, injects information about x into noisy states, and creates a direct gradient pathway unavailable to NDPs. Experiments on synthetic regression, EEG, CylinderFlow, and image regression show consistent improvements. Additional ablations show that the gains come from the full bridge construction with learned alignment, and that the same input-anchored path principle transfers to Flow Matching Neural Processes. These results suggest that bridge-anchored generative paths provide a general mechanism for strengthening conditional stochastic function modeling.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Acceleration of MILP Motion Planning with Temporal Logic and Chance Constraints
summary: Autonomous systems must solve motion planning problems subject to increasingly complex, time-sensitive, and uncertain missions. These problems often involve high-level task specifications, such as temporal logic or chance constraints, which require solving large-scale Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs). However, existing MILP-based planning methods suffer from high computational cost and limited scalability, hindering their real-time applicability. We propose to use a neuro-symbolic approach to accelerate MILP-based motion planning by leveraging machine learning techniques to guide the solver's symbolic search. Focusing on three representative classes of diverse planning problems - Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications, chance constraints formulated via Conformal Predictive Programming (CPP), and Capability Temporal Logic (CaTL) specifications - we demonstrate how graph neural network-based learning methods can guide traditional symbolic MILP solvers in solving challenging planning problems, including branching variable selection and solver parameter configuration. Through extensive experiments, we show that neuro-symbolic search techniques yield scalability gains. Our approach yields substantial improvements across all three classes of planning problems, achieving an average performance gain of about 20% over state-of-the-art solver across key metrics, including runtime and solution quality.

AI.title_translation: 基于时序逻辑和概率约束的MILP运动规划的神经符号加速
AI.tldr: 利用图神经网络优化MILP求解器，显著提升了复杂时序逻辑和概率约束下运动规划的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于MILP的运动规划方法在处理包含时序逻辑和概率约束的复杂任务时，计算成本高且可扩展性差，难以满足实时性要求。
AI.method: 提出一种神经符号方法，利用图神经网络（GNN）来指导传统MILP求解器的符号搜索过程，具体应用于分支变量选择和求解器参数配置。
AI.result: 在信号时序逻辑（STL）、基于共形预测编程（CPP）的概率约束以及能力时序逻辑（CaTL）三类问题上，性能平均提升约20%，包括运行时间和解质量的改进。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号搜索技术能够有效加速MILP求解过程，在保持解质量的同时显著提升了运动规划的实时性能。
AI.translation: 自主系统必须解决受日益复杂、对时间敏感且具有不确定性任务约束的运动规划问题。这些问题通常涉及高层任务规范，例如时序逻辑或概率约束，需要求解大规模混合整数线性规划（MILP）。然而，现有的基于MILP的规划方法计算成本高且可扩展性有限，阻碍了其实时应用。我们提出使用神经符号方法，通过利用机器学习技术来指导求解器的符号搜索，从而加速基于MILP的运动规划。我们重点研究了三类具有代表性的多样化规划问题——信号时序逻辑（STL）规范、通过共形预测编程（CPP）制定的概率约束以及能力时序逻辑（CaTL）规范，并展示了基于图神经网络的学习方法如何指导传统符号MILP求解器解决挑战性的规划问题，包括分支变量选择和求解器参数配置。通过广泛的实验，我们证明了神经符号搜索技术带来了可扩展性收益。我们的方法在所有三类规划问题上都取得了实质性改进，在包括运行时间和解质量在内的关键指标上，比最先进的求解器平均性能提升了约20%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种神经符号方法，通过利用图神经网络指导MILP求解器的符号搜索，有效解决了复杂时序逻辑和概率约束下的运动规划计算瓶颈，显著提升了求解效率与可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 神经符号方法, 混合整数线性规划 (MILP), 运动规划, 时序逻辑, 概率约束
AI.comments: 该研究通过将机器学习（图神经网络）与传统的MILP符号求解器相结合，成功解决了复杂约束下运动规划计算成本高昂的问题，展示了神经符号方法在提升组合优化问题求解效率方面的巨大潜力。

title: Multimodal Remote Inference
comments: Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Networking; a preliminary version appeared in the Proceedings of the 22nd IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS 2025)
summary: We consider a remote inference system with multiple modalities, where a multimodal machine learning (ML) model performs real-time inference using features collected from remote sensors. When sensor observations evolve dynamically over time, fresh features are critical for inference tasks. However, timely delivery of features from all modalities is often infeasible under limited network resources. To address this challenge, we formulate a multimodal scheduling problem to minimize the ML model's inference error. We model this error as a general function of the Age of Information (AoI) vector, where AoI quantifies data freshness. We cast the problem as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) and derive an equivalent reformulation with a reduced state set. We then show that the problem has fundamentally different chain structures in the two-modality and multi-modality cases. For the two-modality case, we prove that the optimal policy has an index-based threshold structure. For the general multi-modality case (i.e., with more than two modalities), we develop the optimal error-aware switching-and-transmission policy (EAST), which is computed using a multichain policy iteration algorithm (MPI). To further reduce complexity, we also develop two low-complexity policies under special settings: the error-aware transmission policy (EAT) and the fixed threshold policy (FT). Numerical results from three case studies show that the proposed policies outperform several simple heuristics, including round-robin, greedy, and uniform random policies. In particular, EAST reduces the inference error by up to 44.8% compared with the best baseline in each case. In the five-modality case, EAT and FT reduce computation time by 6.6$\times$ and 3000$\times$, respectively, relative to EAST, while increasing the inference error by 20.2% and 38.6%, respectively.
comment: Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Networking; a preliminary version appeared in the Proceedings of the 22nd IEEE International Conference on Mobile Ad-Hoc and Smart Systems (MASS 2025)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多模态远程推理的调度策略，通过基于AoI的SMDP建模，在有限网络资源下最小化推理误差，并提供了最优及低复杂度的算法实现。
AI.motivation: 在多模态远程推理系统中，传感器数据动态变化，要求数据具有高新鲜度。然而，受限的网络资源使得同时传输所有模态的数据变得不可行，因此需要设计有效的调度策略以最小化ML模型的推理误差。
AI.method: 将问题建模为半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP）；针对两模态情况推导最优阈值策略；针对多模态情况开发最优错误感知切换与传输策略（EAST），并利用多链策略迭代算法（MPI）求解；同时设计了两种低复杂度策略：错误感知传输策略（EAT）和固定阈值策略（FT）。
AI.result: 提出的EAST策略在推理误差上较最优基准降低了高达44.8%；在五模态场景下，低复杂度策略EAT和FT在极小幅增加推理误差的同时，分别实现了6.6倍和3000倍的计算时间优化。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将多模态远程推理调度问题建模为SMDP，提出了EAST、EAT和FT策略，在保证推理精度的同时有效平衡了网络资源开销，为动态环境下的多模态数据传输提供了高效的调度方案。
AI.translation: 我们研究了一个具有多种模态的远程推理系统，其中多模态机器学习（ML）模型使用从远程传感器收集的特征执行实时推理。当传感器观测值随时间动态演变时，新鲜的特征对于推理任务至关重要。然而，在有限的网络资源下，及时传输所有模态的特征往往是不可行的。为了解决这一挑战，我们制定了一个多模态调度问题，以最小化ML模型的推理误差。我们将该误差建模为信息新鲜度（AoI）向量的通用函数，其中AoI量化了数据的新鲜度。我们将该问题转化为半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP），并推导了一个具有简化状态集的等效重构。我们进而展示了该问题在双模态和多模态情况下具有本质上不同的链结构。对于双模态情况，我们证明了最优策略具有基于索引的阈值结构。对于通用的多模态情况（即多于两个模态），我们开发了最优错误感知切换与传输策略（EAST），该策略使用多链策略迭代算法（MPI）进行计算。为了进一步降低复杂度，我们还在特殊设置下开发了两种低复杂度策略：错误感知传输策略（EAT）和固定阈值策略（FT）。来自三个案例研究的数值结果表明，所提出的策略优于几种简单的启发式算法，包括轮询、贪婪和均匀随机策略。特别是，与每个案例中的最佳基准相比，EAST将推理误差降低了高达44.8%。在五模态情况下，EAT和FT相对于EAST分别将计算时间减少了6.6倍和3000倍，同时推理误差分别增加了20.2%和38.6%。
AI.summary: 本文研究了资源受限下的多模态远程推理调度问题，旨在通过优化数据传输调度来最小化推理误差。作者基于AoI定义推理误差函数，将调度问题建模为SMDP，并针对不同模态数量提出了最优策略（EAST）及两种低复杂度启发式策略（EAT和FT），实验证明这些策略在性能上显著优于传统基准算法。
AI.keywords: 多模态推理, 信息新鲜度 (AoI), 调度策略, 半马尔可夫决策过程 (SMDP), 资源优化
AI.comments: 本文针对多模态远程推理系统中的资源受限问题，提出了一种基于信息新鲜度（AoI）的调度框架。其创新点在于将推理误差与AoI关联，并通过SMDP建模，针对不同模态数量设计了最优及低复杂度的调度策略。研究不仅提供了理论上的最优性证明，还通过数值实验验证了其在降低推理误差和计算复杂度方面的显著优势，具有较强的工程应用价值。

title: BlindGuard: Safeguarding LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems under Unknown Attacks
summary: The security of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) is critically threatened by propagation vulnerability, where malicious agents can distort collective decision-making through inter-agent message interactions. While existing supervised defense methods demonstrate promising performance, they may be impractical in real-world scenarios due to their heavy reliance on labeled malicious agents to train a supervised malicious detection model. To enable practical and generalizable MAS defenses, in this paper, we propose BlindGuard, an unsupervised defense method that learns without requiring any attack-specific labels or prior knowledge of malicious behaviors. To this end, we establish a hierarchical agent encoder to capture individual, neighborhood, and global interaction patterns of each agent, providing a comprehensive understanding for malicious agent detection. Meanwhile, we design a corruption-guided detector that consists of directional noise injection and contrastive learning, allowing effective detection model training solely on normal agent behaviors. Extensive experiments show that BlindGuard effectively detects diverse attack types (i.e., prompt injection, memory poisoning, and tool attack) across MAS with various communication patterns while maintaining superior generalizability compared to supervised baselines. The code is available at: https://github.com/MR9812/BlindGuard.

AI.title_translation: BlindGuard：在未知攻击下保障基于大语言模型的多智能体系统安全
AI.tldr: BlindGuard 是一种无监督防御框架，通过层级编码和腐蚀引导学习，无需标签即可检测 LLM 多智能体系统中的多种未知攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有的监督式防御方法严重依赖标注数据，在面对未知攻击和现实场景时难以应用，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 1. 构建层级智能体编码器，捕捉个体、邻居及全局交互模式；2. 设计腐蚀引导检测器，通过定向噪声注入与对比学习，仅利用正常智能体行为进行模型训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，BlindGuard 在多种通信模式下能有效检测提示注入、记忆中毒和工具攻击，且泛化能力优于监督式基准模型。
AI.conclusion: BlindGuard 是一种高效的无监督防御方法，能够无需先验标签检测多种类型的攻击，提升了 LLM 多智能体系统的安全性和通用性。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）的安全性正受到传播漏洞的严重威胁，恶意智能体可能通过智能体间的消息交互扭曲集体决策。虽然现有的监督式防御方法表现出良好的性能，但由于严重依赖标记的恶意智能体来训练监督式检测模型，它们在现实场景中可能并不实用。为了实现实用且具有通用性的 MAS 防御，本文提出了 BlindGuard，这是一种无需任何特定攻击标签或恶意行为先验知识的无监督防御方法。为此，我们建立了一个层级智能体编码器来捕获每个智能体的个体、邻居和全局交互模式，为检测恶意智能体提供全面理解。同时，我们设计了一个由定向噪声注入和对比学习组成的腐蚀引导检测器，使得检测模型的训练仅依赖于正常智能体行为。大量实验表明，BlindGuard 能有效检测 MAS 中不同通信模式下的多种攻击类型（即提示注入、记忆中毒和工具攻击），并与监督式基准相比保持了卓越的泛化能力。代码已开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 BlindGuard 的无监督防御框架，用于保障 LLM 多智能体系统的安全。该方法通过层级编码器捕捉多维度交互模式，并利用腐蚀引导的对比学习机制，在无需攻击标签的情况下实现对多种未知攻击的有效检测。
AI.keywords: LLM多智能体系统, 无监督防御, 恶意行为检测, 鲁棒性, 安全性
AI.comments: 该研究通过无监督学习解决了LLM多智能体系统在面对未知攻击时的防御难题，摆脱了对标记数据的依赖，具有很高的实际应用价值和通用性。创新性地结合了层级编码器与腐蚀引导检测机制，是该领域的重要进展。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Membership Inference with Simple N-Gram Coverage
summary: Membership inference attacks serves as useful tool for fair use of language models, such as detecting potential copyright infringement and auditing data leakage. However, many current state-of-the-art attacks require access to models' hidden states or probability distribution, which prevents investigation into more widely-used, API-access only models like GPT-4. In this work, we introduce N-Gram Coverage Attack, a membership inference attack that relies solely on text outputs from the target model, enabling attacks on completely black-box models. We leverage the observation that models are more likely to memorize and subsequently generate text patterns that were commonly observed in their training data. Specifically, to make a prediction on a candidate member, N-Gram Coverage Attack first obtains multiple model generations conditioned on a prefix of the candidate. It then uses n-gram overlap metrics to compute and aggregate the similarities of these outputs with the ground truth suffix; high similarities indicate likely membership. We first demonstrate on a diverse set of existing benchmarks that N-Gram Coverage Attack outperforms other black-box methods while also impressively achieving comparable or even better performance to state-of-the-art white-box attacks - despite having access to only text outputs. Interestingly, we find that the success rate of our method scales with the attack compute budget - as we increase the number of sequences generated from the target model conditioned on the prefix, attack performance tends to improve. Having verified the accuracy of our method, we use it to investigate previously unstudied closed OpenAI models on multiple domains. We find that more recent models, such as GPT-4o, exhibit increased robustness to membership inference, suggesting an evolving trend toward improved privacy protections.

AI.title_translation: 基于简单N-Gram覆盖的成员推理的惊人有效性
AI.tldr: 提出一种仅需文本输出的黑盒成员推理攻击，证明了通过简单的N-Gram重叠度分析，即可高效评估大语言模型的训练数据泄露风险。
AI.motivation: 现有的先进成员推理攻击通常需要获取模型的隐藏状态或概率分布，限制了其在API访问的闭源模型（如GPT-4）上的应用。研究旨在开发一种仅依赖文本输出的黑盒攻击方法，以评估此类模型的隐私泄露问题。
AI.method: N-Gram覆盖攻击：通过模型对候选前缀生成的多个文本序列，计算并聚合这些输出与真实后缀之间的N-Gram重叠度，以此判断候选序列是否属于训练集。
AI.result: 该方法在多个基准测试中优于现有的其他黑盒方法，甚至达到或超过了白盒攻击的效果；攻击成功率随计算预算（生成序列数量）增加而提升；研究还发现GPT-4o等较新模型对成员推理的鲁棒性有所增强。
AI.conclusion: N-Gram覆盖攻击是一种高效且通用的黑盒成员推理攻击手段，证明了即使在仅有文本输出的情况下，模型也存在显著的隐私泄露风险，同时也观察到新一代模型在隐私保护方面有所增强。
AI.translation: 成员推理攻击是语言模型公平使用的有用工具，例如检测潜在的版权侵权和审计数据泄露。然而，许多当前最先进的攻击需要访问模型的隐藏状态或概率分布，这阻碍了对GPT-4等更广泛使用的仅限API访问模型的调查。在这项工作中，我们引入了N-Gram覆盖攻击，这是一种仅依赖目标模型文本输出的成员推理攻击，能够对完全黑盒的模型进行攻击。我们利用了模型更有可能记忆并随后生成其训练数据中常见文本模式的观察结果。具体而言，为了对候选成员进行预测，N-Gram覆盖攻击首先获取以候选前缀为条件的多个模型生成结果。然后，它使用N-Gram重叠度指标来计算并聚合这些输出与真实后缀的相似度；高相似度表明该序列很可能是成员。我们首先在各种现有基准测试中证明，N-Gram覆盖攻击优于其他黑盒方法，同时尽管仅能访问文本输出，其性能却令人印象深刻地达到了甚至超过了最先进的白盒攻击。有趣的是，我们发现我们的方法成功率随攻击计算预算的增加而扩展——随着我们增加以该前缀为条件从目标模型生成的序列数量，攻击性能趋于提高。在验证了我们方法的准确性后，我们用它调查了之前未研究过的多个领域的闭源OpenAI模型。我们发现，像GPT-4o这样的更新模型表现出对成员推理的鲁棒性增强，这表明了隐私保护改善的演进趋势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“N-Gram覆盖攻击”的黑盒成员推理方法，通过分析模型生成的文本序列与目标后缀之间的N-Gram重叠度，无需模型内部参数即可有效识别训练数据。实验表明该方法性能卓越，并揭示了现代大语言模型在隐私保护方面的演进趋势。
AI.keywords: 成员推理攻击, 语言模型, 黑盒攻击, N-Gram覆盖, 数据隐私
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于证明了仅依赖文本输出（黑盒）的简单N-Gram覆盖攻击，在性能上可以媲美甚至超越需要模型内部状态的白盒攻击。这为评估GPT-4等闭源模型的隐私泄露提供了高效且通用的方法，并揭示了模型厂商在隐私保护方面的演进趋势。

title: For-Value: Efficient Forward-Only Data Valuation for finetuning LLMs and VLMs
summary: Data valuation is essential for enhancing the transparency and accountability of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on gradient computations, making them computationally prohibitive for billion-parameter models and precluding batch parallelization. In this work, we introduce For-Value, a forward-only data valuation framework that enables efficient batch-scalable value estimation while maintaining effectiveness. Leveraging the expressive power of pretrained LLMs/VLMs, we theoretically demonstrate that data valuation can be captured by the alignment between the final hidden representations and prediction errors at the last layer. In light of this insight, For-Value computes data value using a simple closed-form expression with a single forward pass, eliminating the need for costly backpropagation and enabling efficient batch calculating at scale. Extensive experiments show that For-Value matches or outperforms gradient-based baselines in detecting influential data and mislabeled data, while achieving significant efficiency improvements.

title: Adaptive Multi-Subspace Representation Steering for Attribute Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: Activation steering offers a promising approach to controlling the behavior of Large Language Models by directly manipulating their internal activations. However, most existing methods struggle to jointly steer multiple attributes, often resulting in interference and undesirable trade-offs. To address this challenge, we propose Multi-Subspace Representation Steering (MSRS), a novel framework for effective multi-attribute steering via subspace representation fine-tuning. MSRS reduces inter-attribute interference by allocating orthogonal subspaces to each attribute, isolating their influence within the model's representation space. MSRS also incorporates a hybrid subspace composition strategy: it combines attribute-specific subspaces for unique steering directions with a shared subspace for common steering directions. A dynamic weighting function learns to efficiently integrate these components for precise control. During inference, MSRS introduces a token-level steering mechanism that dynamically identifies and intervenes on the most semantically relevant tokens, enabling fine-grained behavioral modulation. Experimental results show that MSRS significantly reduces attribute conflicts, surpasses existing methods across a range of attributes, and generalizes effectively to diverse downstream tasks.

title: iWatchRoad: Scalable Detection and Geospatial Visualization of Potholes for Smart Cities
summary: Potholes on the roads are a serious hazard and maintenance burden. This poses a significant threat to road safety and vehicle longevity, especially on the diverse and under-maintained roads of India. In this paper, we present a complete end-to-end system called iWatchRoad for automated pothole detection, Global Positioning System (GPS) tagging, and real time mapping using OpenStreetMap (OSM). We curated a large, self-annotated dataset of over 7,000 frames captured across various road types, lighting conditions, and weather scenarios unique to Indian environments, leveraging dashcam footage. This dataset is used to fine-tune, Ultralytics You Only Look Once (YOLO) model to perform real time pothole detection, while a custom Optical Character Recognition (OCR) module was employed to extract timestamps directly from video frames. The timestamps are synchronized with GPS logs to geotag each detected potholes accurately. The processed data includes the potholes' details and frames as metadata is stored in a database and visualized via a user friendly web interface using OSM. iWatchRoad not only improves detection accuracy under challenging conditions but also provides government compatible outputs for road assessment and maintenance planning through the metadata visible on the website. Our solution is cost effective, hardware efficient, and scalable, offering a practical tool for urban and rural road management in developing regions, making the system automated. iWatchRoad is available at https://smlab.niser.ac.in/project/iwatchroad

AI.title_translation: iWatchRoad：智慧城市中坑洼的可扩展检测与地理空间可视化
AI.tldr: iWatchRoad利用行车记录仪视频、YOLO模型及GPS同步技术，为城市道路坑洼提供了一种低成本、自动化的实时检测与地图标注解决方案。
AI.motivation: 针对道路坑洼带来的严重安全隐患和维护难题，特别是在印度等发展中国家道路维护不善的背景下，缺乏一种低成本、自动化且可扩展的道路监测解决方案。
AI.method: 构建了包含7000多帧的印度环境数据集；使用微调后的YOLO模型进行实时坑洼检测；利用自定义OCR模块提取视频时间戳，并将其与GPS日志同步以实现地理标记；最后通过OSM进行可视化展示。
AI.result: 成功开发了iWatchRoad系统，能够实现实时坑洼检测、自动地理标记及基于OSM的可视化地图，显著提升了在复杂光照和天气条件下的检测准确性。
AI.conclusion: iWatchRoad 为智慧城市提供了一种低成本、可扩展且高效的道路坑洼检测与地理可视化解决方案，有效支持了道路维护决策。
AI.translation: 道路上的坑洼是一个严重的安全隐患和维护负担。这对于道路安全和车辆寿命构成了重大威胁，特别是在印度各种各样且维护不足的道路上。在本文中，我们提出了一个名为iWatchRoad的完整端到端系统，用于自动坑洼检测、全球定位系统（GPS）标记和使用OpenStreetMap（OSM）的实时映射。我们策划了一个大型、自标注的数据集，包含超过7000帧，这些帧是在印度环境中独特的各种道路类型、光照条件和天气场景下通过行车记录仪拍摄的。该数据集用于微调Ultralytics You Only Look Once（YOLO）模型以执行实时坑洼检测，同时采用自定义的光学字符识别（OCR）模块直接从视频帧中提取时间戳。时间戳与GPS日志同步，以准确地对每个检测到的坑洼进行地理标记。处理后的数据包括坑洼的详细信息，并将帧作为元数据存储在数据库中，并通过使用OSM的用户友好Web界面进行可视化。iWatchRoad不仅提高了在挑战性条件下的检测准确性，而且通过网站上可见的元数据，为道路评估和维护规划提供了政府兼容的输出。我们的解决方案具有成本效益、硬件高效且可扩展的特点，为发展中地区的城乡道路管理提供了一种实用的工具，实现了系统的自动化。iWatchRoad可在https://smlab.niser.ac.in/project/iwatchroad访问。
AI.summary: iWatchRoad是一套端到端的道路坑洼检测与地理可视化系统。它通过微调YOLO模型处理行车记录仪视频，结合OCR时间戳提取与GPS同步技术，实现坑洼的自动地理定位，并通过Web界面进行直观展示，为城市道路管理提供了一种高效、经济的自动化工具。
AI.keywords: 坑洼检测, 智慧城市, YOLO, 地理空间可视化, 道路维护
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了计算机视觉与地理信息系统，专门针对印度等发展中国家复杂多变的道路环境进行了优化。其优势在于利用低成本的行车记录仪数据实现自动化监测，为市政维护提供了实用的工具。局限性在于主要依赖视觉检测，对于极端天气下的遮挡或复杂路面覆盖物可能存在检测瓶颈。

title: CRISP: Persistent Concept Unlearning via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, the need to selectively remove unwanted knowledge while preserving model utility has become paramount. Recent work has explored sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to perform precise interventions on monosemantic features. However, most SAE-based methods operate at inference time, which does not create persistent changes in the model's parameters. Such interventions can be bypassed or reversed by malicious actors with parameter access. We introduce CRISP, a parameter-efficient method for persistent concept unlearning using SAEs. CRISP automatically identifies salient SAE features across multiple layers and suppresses their activations. We experiment with two LLMs and show that our method outperforms prior approaches on safety-critical unlearning tasks from the WMDP benchmark, successfully removing harmful knowledge while preserving general and in-domain capabilities. Feature-level analysis reveals that CRISP achieves semantically coherent separation between target and benign concepts, allowing precise suppression of the target features.

title: Does AI Code Review Lead to Code Changes? A Case Study of GitHub Actions
summary: AI-based code review tools automatically review and comment on pull requests to improve code quality. Despite their growing presence, little is known about their actual impact. We present a large-scale empirical study of 16 popular AI-based code review actions for GitHub workflows, analyzing more than 22,000 review comments in 178 repositories. We investigate (1) how these tools are adopted and configured, (2) whether their comments lead to code changes, and (3) which factors influence their effectiveness. We develop a two-stage LLM-assisted framework to determine whether review comments are addressed, and use interpretable machine learning to identify influencing factors. Our findings show that, while adoption is growing, effectiveness varies widely. Comments that are concise, contain code snippets, and are manually triggered, particularly those from hunk-level review tools, are more likely to result in code changes. These results highlight the importance of careful tool design and suggest directions for improving AI-based code review systems.

title: Learning Binary Sampling Patterns for Single-Pixel Imaging using Bilevel Optimisation
summary: Single-Pixel Imaging (SPI) enables the reconstruction of objects using a single detector through sequential illuminations with structured light patterns. The choice of illumination patterns is critical, particularly in highly undersampled regimes, where it directly determines reconstruction quality and acquisition speed. Instead of relying on handcrafted or fixed patterns, we propose to learn task-specific patterns directly from data. Practical SPI hardware only supports binary patterns, making binary pattern design a necessary consideration. We propose a bilevel optimisation method for learning task-specific binary illumination patterns optimised for applications such as single-pixel fluorescence microscopy. We address the non-differentiable nature of binary optimisation using the Straight-Through Estimator. In addition, we incorporate learned variational regularisation, improving reconstruction quality and robustness. We demonstrate our method on the CytoImageNet microscopy dataset. We show that our learned patterns achieve superior reconstruction performance compared to baseline methods and end-to-end deep learning, particularly in highly undersampled regimes and in scarce-data settings.

AI.title_translation: 使用双层优化学习单像素成像的二值采样模式
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于双层优化和变分正则化的学习框架，能自动生成高质量的二值照明模式，显著提升了单像素成像在极低采样率下的重建效果。
AI.motivation: 单像素成像在高度欠采样情况下的重建质量和采集速度高度依赖于照明模式，而现有的手工或固定模式难以满足特定任务需求，且实际硬件限制要求使用二值模式。
AI.method: 提出了一种双层优化方法来学习任务特定的二值照明模式，利用直通估计器（Straight-Through Estimator）处理二值化的不可导问题，并引入了学习型变分正则化以增强重建质量。
AI.result: 在CytoImageNet显微成像数据集上的实验表明，该方法在极低采样率和数据稀缺环境下，重建性能优于基准方法及端到端深度学习模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过双层优化学习到的二值模式在单像素成像任务中优于传统手工设计模式及端到端深度学习方法。
AI.translation: 单像素成像（SPI）通过使用结构光图案进行顺序照明，能够利用单个探测器重建对象。照明图案的选择至关重要，特别是在高度欠采样的情况下，它直接决定了重建质量和采集速度。我们提出直接从数据中学习任务特定的图案，而不是依赖手工制作或固定的图案。实际的SPI硬件仅支持二值图案，因此二值图案设计成为必要考虑。我们提出了一种双层优化方法，用于学习针对单像素荧光显微成像等应用优化的任务特定二值照明图案。我们使用直通估计器解决了二值优化的不可导性质。此外，我们结合了学习型变分正则化，提高了重建质量和鲁棒性。我们在CytoImageNet显微成像数据集上展示了我们的方法。结果表明，与基准方法和端到端深度学习相比，我们学习到的图案实现了优越的重建性能，特别是在高度欠采样和数据稀缺的情况下。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于单像素成像的二值照明模式学习框架，采用双层优化策略，通过直通估计器解决二值约束带来的非可导问题，并结合学习型变分正则化，显著提升了在欠采样和少样本场景下的成像质量。
AI.keywords: 单像素成像, 二值模式设计, 双层优化, 变分正则化, 荧光显微成像
AI.comments: 该研究通过双层优化成功解决了单像素成像中二值模式设计的非可导性难题，并结合了学习型变分正则化，在极低采样率和数据稀缺场景下表现出显著优势，是计算成像领域的一个重要改进。

title: Self-Rewarding Vision-Language Model via Reasoning Decomposition
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often suffer from visual hallucinations: generating things that are not consistent with visual inputs and language shortcuts, where they skip the visual part and just rely on text priors. These issues arise because most post training methods for VLMs rely on simple verifiable answer matching and supervise only final outputs, leaving intermediate visual reasoning without explicit guidance. As a result, VLMs receive sparse visual signals and often learn to prioritize language based reasoning over visual perception. We introduce Vision SR1, a three stage self rewarding reinforcement learning method that improves visual reasoning without relying on external visual supervision. Vision SR1 decomposes VLM reasoning into two components: visual reasoning and language reasoning, where the model is first prompted to produce self-contained visual descriptions sufficient to answer the question without referring back to the input image, before jointly optimizing both visual and language reasoning through our multi reward loss objective. To validate this self containment, the same VLM model is reprompted to perform language reasoning using only the generated visual reasoning as input to compute visual reward. The final reward is computed through a decoupled reward-advantage framework, where visual reward and language reasoning reward each have their advantages calculated separately. Our experiments show that Vision SR1 improves visual reasoning, mitigates visual hallucinations, and reduces reliance on language shortcuts across diverse vision language tasks, while being more efficient than methods that rely on external visual reward models, which require additional GPUs to host. In contrast, Vision SR1 introduces no extra GPU overhead beyond that of standard training.

title: InquireMobile: Teaching VLM-based Mobile Agent to Request Human Assistance via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled mobile agents to perceive and interact with real-world mobile environments based on human instructions. However, the current fully autonomous paradigm poses potential safety risks when model understanding or reasoning capabilities are insufficient. To address this challenge, we first introduce \textbf{InquireBench}, a comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate mobile agents' capabilities in safe interaction and proactive inquiry with users, encompassing 5 categories and 22 sub-categories, where most existing VLM-based agents demonstrate near-zero performance. In this paper, we aim to develop an interactive system that actively seeks human confirmation at critical decision points. To achieve this, we propose \textbf{InquireMobile}, a novel model inspired by reinforcement learning, featuring a two-stage training strategy and an interactive pre-action reasoning mechanism. Finally, our model achieves an 46.8% improvement in inquiry success rate and the best overall success rate among existing baselines on InquireBench. We will open-source all datasets, models, and evaluation codes to facilitate development in both academia and industry.

AI.title_translation: InquireMobile：通过强化微调教导基于 VLM 的移动智能体请求人类协助
AI.tldr: InquireMobile 赋予了移动智能体在关键时刻主动询问人类的决策能力，有效平衡了自动化与安全性，并在新推出的 InquireBench 基准上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有完全自主的移动智能体在理解和推理能力不足时存在安全风险，缺乏在关键决策点主动向人类寻求确认的机制。
AI.method: 提出 InquireBench 基准测试集，并采用两阶段训练策略及交互式前置动作推理机制（Interactive Pre-action Reasoning Mechanism）对 VLM 进行强化微调。
AI.result: 在 InquireBench 上，InquireMobile 的询问成功率提高了 46.8%，并取得了当前基准测试中的最佳整体成功率。
AI.conclusion: InquireMobile 通过强化学习驱动的主动询问机制，显著提升了移动智能体在复杂任务中的安全性和任务成功率，是迈向更安全、可靠的移动智能体的重要一步。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展使得移动智能体能够根据人类指令感知并与现实世界的移动环境进行交互。然而，当前的完全自主范式在模型理解或推理能力不足时会带来潜在的安全风险。为了应对这一挑战，我们首先引入了 InquireBench，这是一个专门设计用于评估移动智能体在安全交互和主动向用户询问能力的综合基准，涵盖 5 个大类和 22 个子类，现有的大多数基于 VLM 的智能体在此基准上的表现几乎为零。在本文中，我们旨在开发一个在关键决策点主动寻求人类确认的交互系统。为此，我们提出了 InquireMobile，这是一个受强化学习启发的新型模型，具有两阶段训练策略和交互式前置动作推理机制。最后，我们的模型在 InquireBench 上实现了 46.8% 的询问成功率提升，并取得了现有基准中的最佳整体成功率。我们将开源所有数据集、模型和评估代码，以促进学术界和工业界的发展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 InquireMobile，这是一个旨在通过强化微调使 VLM 驱动的移动智能体能够在不确定情况下主动寻求人类协助的交互系统。通过构建包含安全交互评估的 InquireBench 基准，研究证明了该方法能有效降低安全风险并提升任务执行的成功率。
AI.keywords: 移动智能体, 视觉语言模型, 强化学习, 主动询问, 安全交互
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“主动询问”机制解决了移动智能体在复杂场景下的安全与决策不确定性问题，提出了一种兼顾自主性与安全性的新范式，具有很高的实用价值和工业应用潜力。

title: Can Compact Language Models Search Like Agents? Distillation-Guided Policy Optimization for Preserving Agentic RAG Capabilities
summary: Reinforcement Learning has emerged as a dominant post-training approach to elicit agentic RAG behaviors such as search and planning from language models. Despite its success with larger models, applying RL to compact models (e.g., 0.5--1B parameters) presents unique challenges. The compact models exhibit poor initial performance, resulting in sparse rewards and unstable training. To overcome these difficulties, we propose Distillation-Guided Policy Optimization (DGPO), which employs cold-start initialization from teacher demonstrations and continuous teacher guidance during policy optimization. To understand how compact models preserve agentic behavior, we introduce Agentic RAG Capabilities (ARC), a fine-grained metric analyzing reasoning, search coordination, and response synthesis. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that DGPO enables compact models to achieve sophisticated agentic search behaviors, even outperforming the larger teacher model in some cases. DGPO makes agentic RAG feasible in computing resource-constrained environments.

AI.title_translation: 紧凑型语言模型能像智能体一样搜索吗？用于保留代理型RAG能力的蒸馏引导策略优化
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了DGPO方法，通过蒸馏引导克服了小型语言模型在代理型RAG任务中训练不稳定的难题，使其在资源受限环境下也能展现出强大的搜索与规划能力。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法在训练小型语言模型（0.5-1B参数）进行代理型RAG任务时，常面临初始性能差、奖励稀疏及训练不稳定等挑战。
AI.method: 提出蒸馏引导策略优化（DGPO），包括从教师演示进行冷启动初始化，以及在策略优化过程中进行持续的教师引导；同时引入ARC指标来量化评估模型的推理、搜索协调和响应合成能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，DGPO使小型模型能够实现复杂的代理搜索行为，在某些情况下甚至超过了大型教师模型，为计算资源受限环境下的代理型RAG提供了可行方案。
AI.conclusion: DGPO框架通过冷启动初始化和持续的教师引导，有效地提升了小模型在代理型RAG任务中的表现，使其在受限计算资源下具备了与大模型媲美的搜索与规划能力。
AI.translation: 强化学习已成为激发语言模型代理型RAG行为（如搜索和规划）的主流后训练方法。尽管在大模型上取得了成功，但将强化学习应用于紧凑型模型（如0.5-1B参数）提出了独特的挑战。紧凑型模型表现出较差的初始性能，导致奖励稀疏和训练不稳定。为了克服这些困难，我们提出了蒸馏引导策略优化（DGPO），它采用来自教师演示的冷启动初始化，并在策略优化过程中进行持续的教师引导。为了了解紧凑型模型如何保留代理行为，我们引入了代理型RAG能力（ARC），这是一种分析推理、搜索协调和响应合成的细粒度指标。综合实验表明，DGPO使紧凑型模型能够实现复杂的代理搜索行为，在某些情况下甚至优于大型教师模型。DGPO使得代理型RAG在计算资源受限的环境中变得可行。
AI.summary: 本文针对小型语言模型在代理型RAG任务中训练困难的问题，提出了蒸馏引导策略优化（DGPO）方法。通过结合教师演示的冷启动和持续引导，该方法显著提升了小模型的搜索、规划及合成能力，实现了在计算资源受限环境下的高效代理行为。
AI.keywords: 小型语言模型, 代理型RAG, 强化学习, 蒸馏引导策略优化, 搜索与规划
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种针对小型语言模型的强化学习优化框架，解决了小模型在代理型RAG任务中训练不稳定和性能差的痛点。其核心贡献在于证明了通过蒸馏引导的策略优化，小模型不仅可以实现代理行为，甚至能在资源受限环境下超越大型教师模型，具有很高的实用价值。

title: EMCompress: Video-LLMs with Endomorphic Multimodal Compression
summary: Video-LLMs face a fundamental tension in long-video reasoning: static, sparse frame sampling either dilutes evidence across task-irrelevant segments at significant cost or misses fine-grained temporal semantics altogether. We propose a novel, cognitively-inspired task -- Endomorphic Multimodal Compression (EMC) -- as a structurally-constrained sufficient-statistic problem for VideoQA, and formulate it as an endomorphic transformation F_EMC : (V, Q) -> (v, q) that compresses the multimodal input while preserving answer invariance across reasonable downstream models. The endomorphic form keeps the compressed output in the downstream pipeline's native task space -- a structural mirror of the filter-then-reason mechanism in the cognitive literature motivating EMC -- distinguishing it from latent-code compression (IB / VIB) and making the formulation extensible to other multimodal settings. Under the Markov chain A -> (V, Q) -> (v, q), EMC realizes the classical sufficiency condition I((v, q); A) = I((V, Q); A) in its VideoQA-natural form. As a modular front-end, EMC plugs into both Video Instruction Tuning and Video Question Answering pipelines. We release the first dedicated benchmark and propose ReSimplifyIt, an EMC baseline surpassing prior methods by 0.40 F-1 with competitive query rewriting. Integrating EMC yields relative gains of 7.33% in training and 33.7% in inference for video-language understanding.

AI.title_translation: EMCompress：具有内态多模态压缩的视频大模型
AI.tldr: 提出一种名为EMC的模块化视频压缩技术，通过在任务原生空间内保留关键语义，显著提升了长视频大模型的推理效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 视频大模型在处理长视频时，稀疏采样会导致关键语义丢失，而全量采样则带来巨大的计算成本，需要在推理效率与语义保留之间找到平衡。
AI.method: 提出内态多模态压缩（EMC）框架，将原始视频-问题对通过内态变换转化为保留答案不变性的压缩表示，作为视频问答和指令微调的模块化前端，并引入ReSimplifyIt基线模型。
AI.result: EMC基线方法ReSimplifyIt在F-1分数上超过现有方法0.40，且在训练和推理阶段分别实现了7.33%和33.7%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: EMC通过在原生任务空间内实现充分统计量压缩，有效地平衡了长视频推理中的计算成本与语义保持，在提升视频理解效率的同时显著增强了模型性能。
AI.translation: 视频大模型在长视频推理方面面临一个根本性矛盾：静态、稀疏的帧采样要么以高昂的代价分散了与任务无关片段的证据，要么完全错过了细粒度的时序语义。我们提出了一种受认知启发的任务——内态多模态压缩（EMC），将其作为视频问答（VideoQA）的一个结构约束充分统计量问题，并将其表述为一个内态变换 F_EMC : (V, Q) -> (v, q)，在保持下游模型答案不变性的前提下压缩多模态输入。内态形式将压缩后的输出保持在下游流水线的原生任务空间中——这构成了激发EMC的认知文献中“过滤-后-推理”机制的结构镜像，使其区别于潜在代码压缩（IB / VIB），并使该公式可扩展到其他多模态设置。在马尔可夫链 A -> (V, Q) -> (v, q) 下，EMC以其VideoQA自然形式实现了经典充分性条件 I((v, q); A) = I((V, Q); A)。作为一种模块化前端，EMC可插入视频指令微调和视频问答流水线。我们发布了第一个专用基准测试，并提出了ReSimplifyIt，这是一个EMC基线，通过竞争性的查询重写，比先前的方法高出0.40的F-1分数。集成EMC在视频语言理解的训练中带来了7.33%的相对收益，在推理中带来了33.7%的相对收益。
AI.summary: 针对视频大模型在长视频推理中面临的效率与语义丢失矛盾，本文提出了“内态多模态压缩”（EMC）方法。该方法通过将多模态输入转化为保留答案不变性的压缩表示，实现了高效的视频理解，并能作为模块化组件嵌入现有的视频问答和指令微调流程中。
AI.keywords: 视频大模型, 多模态压缩, 视频问答, 充分统计量, 认知启发式计算
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的“内态多模态压缩”（EMC）范式，借鉴了认知科学中的“先过滤后推理”机制。与传统的隐空间压缩不同，该方法保持在任务原生空间内进行压缩，具有很强的可解释性和模块化扩展性，为解决长视频推理中的信息冗余和语义丢失问题提供了新的思路。

title: Test of Time: Rethinking Temporal Signal of Benchmark Contamination
summary: Post-cutoff performance decay has been widely interpreted as a temporal signal for benchmark contamination. We critically examine this belief and demonstrate that this temporal signal is highly sensitive to how benchmark questions are constructed. Specifically, we show that LLM-generated questions can produce remarkably different temporal patterns compared to fill-in-the-blank questions directly retrieved from the very same materials. We validated this finding on previous benchmarks that reported clear post-cutoff performance decay such as LiveCodeBench and further showed simple LLM transformation could effectively remove this temporal pattern when evaluated on the same models. We also provide a mechanistic understanding of our observation using influence function analysis. Overall, this work offers a new perspective on the sensitivity of temporal contamination signal and highlights the need for more robust contamination detection methods for reliable AI evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 时间考验：重新思考基准测试污染的时间信号
AI.tldr: 事后性能衰减并不一定意味着基准测试污染，其表现形式高度依赖于问题的构建方式，简单的转换即可改变这种模式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍认为大模型的“事后性能衰减”是基准测试污染的信号，但该假设缺乏严谨的验证，作者旨在探讨这种时间信号的敏感性及其背后的构建因素。
AI.method: 通过对比LLM生成问题与直接提取的填空题，分析它们在同一基准测试中的时间模式差异；使用影响函数分析（influence function analysis）提供机制解释；并在LiveCodeBench等基准上验证了通过简单的LLM转换可以消除时间模式。
AI.result: 研究发现时间信号高度依赖于问题的构建方式；LLM生成的问题与原始填空题表现出截然不同的时间模式；通过简单的LLM转换即可消除已有的性能衰减模式。
AI.conclusion: 事后性能衰减并非污染的绝对证据，评估结果高度依赖于问题构建方式。研究呼吁开发更稳健的污染检测方法，以确保人工智能评估的可靠性。
AI.translation: 事后性能衰减通常被广泛解释为基准测试污染的时间信号。我们批判性地审视了这一信念，并证明这种时间信号对于基准测试问题的构建方式高度敏感。具体而言，我们展示了与直接从相同材料中提取的填空题相比，LLM生成的问题可以产生截然不同的时间模式。我们在之前报告了明显事后性能衰减的基准测试（如LiveCodeBench）上验证了这一发现，并进一步表明，简单的LLM转换可以在同一模型上评估时有效地消除这种时间模式。我们还利用影响函数分析对我们的观察结果提供了机制性的理解。总的来说，这项工作为时间污染信号的敏感性提供了一个新的视角，并强调了为可靠的AI评估开发更稳健的污染检测方法的必要性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了“事后性能衰减”作为基准测试污染信号的可靠性，指出该信号对问题构建方式高度敏感。研究表明，通过优化问题构建方法或应用LLM转换，可以改变甚至消除这种性能衰减模式，从而挑战了现有污染检测方法的准确性。
AI.keywords: 基准污染, 大语言模型, 性能衰减, 评估可靠性, 时间信号
AI.comments: 该论文通过批判性思维挑战了评估领域的一个普遍假设，即“事后性能衰减”直接等同于基准测试污染。其创新点在于揭示了评估指标对问题构建方式的敏感性，并提供了机制解释，对未来大模型评估基准的构建具有重要的指导意义。

title: Enabling Transparent Cyber Threat Intelligence Combining Large Language Models and Domain Ontologies
comments: 14 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, presented at the 1st workshops on eXplainable AI, Knowledge Representation and Knowledge Graphs (XAI-KRKG) and User-Centered Explanations in XAI Workshop (UCEX-XAI), October 25-30, 2025, Bologna, Italy
summary: Effective Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) relies upon accurately structured and semantically enriched information extracted from cybersecurity system logs. However, current methodologies often struggle to identify and interpret malicious events reliably and transparently, particularly in cases involving unstructured or ambiguous log entries. In this work, we propose a novel methodology that combines ontology-driven structured outputs with Large Language Models (LLMs), to build an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent that improves the accuracy and explainability of information extraction from cybersecurity logs. Central to our approach is the integration of domain ontologies and SHACL-based constraints to guide the language model's output structure and enforce semantic validity over the resulting graph. Extracted information is organized into an ontology-enriched graph database, enabling future semantic analysis and querying. The design of our methodology is motivated by the analytical requirements associated with honeypot log data, which typically comprises predominantly malicious activity. While our case study illustrates the relevance of this scenario, the experimental evaluation is conducted using publicly available datasets. Results demonstrate that our method achieves higher accuracy in information extraction compared to traditional prompt-only approaches, with a deliberate focus on extraction quality rather than processing speed.

AI.title_translation: 结合大语言模型与领域本体实现透明的网络威胁情报分析
AI.tldr: 通过在大语言模型中引入领域本体约束，实现了从安全日志中更准确、可解释地提取威胁情报。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理非结构化或模糊的安全日志时，难以可靠且透明地识别和解释恶意事件，且缺乏语义化支持。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合大语言模型与领域本体的新型方法，利用SHACL约束引导模型输出结构，并将提取的数据存入本体增强的图数据库中以确保语义有效性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在信息提取的准确性上优于传统的纯提示（prompt-only）方法，且通过本体约束实现了更高的输出质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过引入本体约束，显著提升了从非结构化安全日志中提取威胁情报的准确性和可解释性，为构建更可靠的自动化网络安全防御系统提供了有效路径。
AI.translation: 有效的网络威胁情报（CTI）依赖于从网络安全系统日志中提取准确结构化且语义丰富的信息。然而，当前的方法在识别和解释恶意事件时，特别是在涉及非结构化或模糊日志条目时，往往难以做到可靠和透明。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，结合了本体驱动的结构化输出与大语言模型（LLM），构建了一个人工智能（AI）代理，以提高从网络安全日志中提取信息的准确性和可解释性。我们方法的核心是整合领域本体和基于SHACL的约束，以引导语言模型的输出结构并强制执行结果图的语义有效性。提取的信息被组织进一个本体增强的图数据库中，从而支持未来的语义分析和查询。我们的方法设计源于与蜜罐日志数据相关的分析需求，这些数据通常包含大量的恶意活动。虽然我们的案例研究说明了该场景的相关性，但实验评估是使用公开数据集进行的。结果表明，与传统的纯提示方法相比，我们的方法在信息提取方面实现了更高的准确性，并特别注重提取质量而非处理速度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型与领域本体的方法，旨在从网络安全日志中提取结构化、语义化的威胁情报。通过引入SHACL约束引导模型输出，该方法不仅提升了信息提取的准确性，还增强了结果的可解释性与语义一致性。
AI.keywords: 网络威胁情报, 大语言模型, 领域本体, 信息提取, 安全日志分析
AI.comments: 该研究通过将领域本体论与大语言模型结合，有效解决了LLM在网络安全日志分析中存在的“幻觉”和缺乏可解释性问题，是知识图谱与大模型融合应用的一个典型范例。其局限性在于侧重提取质量，可能在实时性要求极高的生产环境中面临挑战。

title: Learning to Refine: Self-Refinement of Parallel Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) has gained widespread attention for enhancing LLM reasoning. Existing approaches such as Best-of-N and majority voting are limited as their performance depends on the quality of candidate responses, making them unable to produce a correct solution when all candidates are incorrect. Parallel self-refinement, generating multiple candidates and synthesizing a refined answer conditioned on them, offers a promising alternative, but the underlying mechanism driving its effectiveness remains obscure. To bridge this gap in understanding, we introduce a new metric, the Refinement Gap, designed to quantify the relative improvement of self-refinement beyond majority voting. We show that the Refinement Gap exhibits a clear scaling trend with model size and is only weakly correlated with the base capability. Based on this discovery, we propose Generative Self-Refinement (GSR), a parallel test-time scaling framework that transfers the refinement policy from larger teacher models with higher refinement gap into smaller students. Crucially, GSR jointly trains a single model to generate strong candidates and refine a better final answer based on these candidates. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across five mathematical benchmarks over other parallel aggregation methods, while the learned refinement skill transfers across multiple model scales and families and exhibits robust generalization to an out-of-distribution domain.

title: A Simple and Fast Reduction from Gomory-Hu Trees to Polylog Maxflows
comments: The proof of the claimed running time bound contains a gap. The algorithmic correctness is not affected, but the stated runtime is not justified by the current analysis
summary:
Given an undirected graph $G=(V,E,w)$, a Gomory-Hu tree $T$ (Gomory and Hu, 1961) is a tree on $V$ that preserves all-pairs mincuts of $G$ exactly.
  We present a simple, efficient reduction from Gomory-Hu trees to polylog maxflow computations. On unweighted graphs, our reduction reduces to maxflow computations on graphs of total instance size $\tilde{O}(m)$ and the algorithm requires only $\tilde{O}(m)$ additional time. Our reduction is the first that is tight up to polylog factors. The reduction also seamlessly extends to weighted graphs, however, instance sizes and runtime increase to $\tilde{O}(n^2)$.
  Finally, we show how to extend our reduction to reduce Gomory-Hu trees for unweighted hypergraphs to maxflow in hypergraphs. Again, our reduction is the first that is tight up to polylog factors.
comment: The proof of the claimed running time bound contains a gap. The algorithmic correctness is not affected, but the stated runtime is not justified by the current analysis

AI.title_translation: 一种将Gomory-Hu树归约为多对数最大流的简单快速方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的归约算法，将Gomory-Hu树的构造简化为多对数次最大流计算，在无权图和超图上达到了近乎最优的复杂度。
AI.motivation: 旨在寻找一种更简单、高效且在多对数因子内紧凑的算法，以解决Gomory-Hu树的构造问题，并将其与最大流计算建立直接联系。
AI.method: 提出了一种将Gomory-Hu树构造归约为一系列最大流计算的算法。对于无权图，该方法通过总实例大小为 $\tilde{O}(m)$ 的最大流计算实现，额外运行时间仅需 $\tilde{O}(m)$；对于加权图，实例大小和运行时间增至 $\tilde{O}(n^2)$；同时该方法还被扩展应用于无权超图。
AI.result: 在无权图上实现了 $\tilde{O}(m)$ 的实例大小和额外运行时间；在加权图上实现了 $\tilde{O}(n^2)$ 的复杂度；并首次为无权超图的Gomory-Hu树构造提供了多对数因子内紧凑的归约方法。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功提出了一种将Gomory-Hu树构造归约为多对数最大流计算的简洁高效方法，实现了在无权图和超图上的近乎最优复杂度，并为加权图提供了可扩展的解决方案。
AI.translation: 给定一个无向图 $G=(V,E,w)$，Gomory-Hu树 $T$ (Gomory and Hu, 1961) 是一个定义在 $V$ 上的树，它精确保留了 $G$ 的所有点对最小割。我们提出了一种将Gomory-Hu树归约为多对数最大流计算的简单、高效的方法。在无权图上，我们的归约将其转化为总实例大小为 $\tilde{O}(m)$ 的最大流计算，且该算法仅需 $\tilde{O}(m)$ 的额外时间。我们的归约是首个在多对数因子内达到紧凑性的方法。该归约还可无缝扩展至加权图，但实例大小和运行时间增加到 $\tilde{O}(n^2)$。最后，我们展示了如何将该归约扩展至无权超图的Gomory-Hu树构造，同样实现了多对数因子内的紧凑性。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种将Gomory-Hu树构造归约为最大流计算的简洁高效算法。该算法在无权图和超图上达到了多对数因子内的最优复杂度，并可扩展至加权图，为全对最小割问题提供了高效的计算路径。
AI.keywords: Gomory-Hu树, 最大流, 最小割, 图算法, 超图
AI.comments: 该研究在图算法领域具有重要意义，通过提出一种简洁且高效的归约方法，实现了Gomory-Hu树构造与多对数最大流计算之间的紧密联系。其创新之处在于将复杂度降低到了接近最优（多对数因子内），并成功地将方法扩展到了加权图和超图，为解决全对最小割问题提供了更高效的理论基础。

title: Mind the Gap: Evaluating Model- and Agentic-Level Vulnerabilities in LLMs with Action Graphs
comments: ICLR 2026 Agents in the Wild (Spotlight & Oral); ICLR 2026 AFAA; OpenAI Red-Teaming Challenge Winner (2025); NeurIPS 2025 LLMEval
summary: As large language models increasingly deployed into agentic systems, existing methods face critical gaps in observing, assessing, and mitigating deployment-specific risks. We present a comprehensive, observability-driven workflow: we introduce \textbf{AgentSeer}, observability tool which decomposes agentic executions into granular \emph{action-component} graphs; we use this decomposition to rigorously quantify the gap between model-level and agent-level jailbreaking risk via cross-model validation on GPT-OSS-20B and Gemini-2.0-flash with HarmBench under single-turn and iterative-refinement attacks; we leverage action-graph risk signals to automate iterative prompt hardening against direct and iterative jailbreak attacks. Stark differences is revealed between model-level and agentic-level vulnerability profiles. Model-level evaluation reveals baseline differences: GPT-OSS-20B (39.47\% ASR) versus Gemini-2.0-flash (50.00\% ASR), with both models showing susceptibility to social engineering. However, agentic-level assessment exposes agent-specific risks invisible to traditional evaluation. We discover "agentic-only" vulnerabilities that emerge exclusively in agentic contexts, with tool-calling showing 24-60\% higher ASR across both models. Cross-model analysis reveals universal agentic patterns, where agent transfer operations as highest-risk tools, with semantic pattern revealed rather than syntactic vulnerability mechanisms. Direct attack transfer from model-level to agentic contexts shows degraded performance of successful prompts (GPT-OSS-20B: 57\% human injection ASR; Gemini-2.0-flash: 28\%), while context-aware iterative attacks successfully compromise objectives that failed at model-level, confirming systematic vulnerabilities gaps. Action-based prompt improvement substantially reduces action-averaged agentic jailbreak success on GPT-OSS-20B (direct: 45.3\%
