AI.title_translation: 关注鸿沟：利用动作图评估大语言模型中模型层与智能体层面的漏洞
AI.tldr: 该论文提出AgentSeer工具，利用动作图揭示了LLM智能体在部署中存在的“智能体特有”安全漏洞，并证明了基于动作的防御机制能有效提升智能体安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法无法有效观察、评估和缓解大语言模型在智能体系统部署中产生的特定风险，且模型层面的评估不能完全代表实际智能体运行环境下的安全性。
AI.method: 提出了AgentSeer工具，将智能体执行过程分解为动作组件图；通过跨模型验证（GPT-OSS-20B和Gemini-2.0-flash）量化模型层与智能体层风险差异；利用动作图风险信号实现自动化的迭代提示词加固。
AI.result: 智能体层存在模型层无法察觉的特有漏洞，工具调用使攻击成功率（ASR）提高了24-60%；直接攻击在智能体环境中的迁移效果下降，但上下文感知的迭代攻击能成功攻破模型层无法攻破的目标；基于动作的提示词加固显著降低了智能体被越狱的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了模型层评估不足以涵盖智能体系统的安全性，并证明基于动作图的观测和缓解策略能够有效降低智能体层面的越狱攻击风险。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被部署到智能体系统中，现有方法在观察、评估和缓解部署特定风险方面面临严峻的缺口。我们提出了一种全面的、以可观测性为驱动的工作流：我们引入了AgentSeer，这是一种将智能体执行分解为细粒度“动作-组件”图的可观测性工具；我们利用这种分解，通过对GPT-OSS-20B和Gemini-2.0-flash在HarmBench基准下的单轮和迭代细化攻击进行跨模型验证，严格量化了模型层和智能体层越狱风险之间的差距；我们利用动作图风险信号来自动化针对直接和迭代越狱攻击的迭代提示词加固。研究揭示了模型层和智能体层漏洞概况之间的显著差异。模型层评估显示了基准差异：GPT-OSS-20B（39.47% ASR）与Gemini-2.0-flash（50.00% ASR），两种模型都显示出对社会工程攻击的易感性。然而，智能体层面的评估揭示了传统评估无法察觉的智能体特定风险。我们发现了仅在智能体上下文中出现的“智能体特有”漏洞，工具调用在两种模型中显示出高出24-60%的ASR。跨模型分析揭示了通用的智能体模式，即智能体传输操作是最高风险的工具，并揭示了语义模式而非句法漏洞机制。从模型层到智能体上下文的直接攻击迁移显示出成功提示词的性能下降（GPT-OSS-20B：57%人类注入ASR；Gemini-2.0-flash：28%），而上下文感知的迭代攻击成功攻破了模型层失败的目标，证实了系统性的漏洞差距。基于动作的提示词改进显著降低了GPT-OSS-20B上动作平均的智能体越狱成功率（直接：45.3%）。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了AgentSeer，一种通过动作图分解来评估智能体系统安全性的可观测性工具。研究发现模型层评估与智能体实际部署风险之间存在显著鸿沟，智能体环境下的工具调用引入了新的风险维度。该方法通过动作图信号实现了有效的自动化防御，为智能体安全评估提供了新的视角。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 智能体安全, 动作图, 越狱攻击, 可观测性
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“动作图（action graphs）”这一概念，成功量化了模型层与智能体层风险之间的鸿沟。其创新之处在于揭示了仅在智能体上下文中出现的“智能体特有漏洞（agentic-only vulnerabilities）”，这对于当前LLM智能体安全评估具有重要的学术和工程指导意义。局限性在于主要基于特定的基准和模型进行测试，其普适性有待进一步验证。

title: Feedback Linearisation with State Constraints
summary: Feedback Linearisation (FBL) is a widely used technique that applies feedback laws to transform input-affine nonlinear control systems into linear control systems, allowing for the use of linear controller design methods such as pole placement. However, for problems with state constraints, controlling the linear system induced by FBL can be more challenging than controlling the original system. This is because simple state constraints in the original nonlinear system become complex nonlinear constraints in the FBL induced linearised system, thereby diminishing the advantages of linearisation. To avoid increasing the complexity of state constraints under FBL, this paper introduces a method to first augment system dynamics to capture state constraints before applying FBL. We show that our proposed augmentation method leads to ill-defined relative degrees at state constraint boundaries. However, we show that ill-defined relative degrees can be overcome by using a switching FBL controller. Numerical experiments illustrate the capabilities of this method for handling state constraints within the FBL framework.

AI.title_translation: 带状态约束的反馈线性化
AI.tldr: 本文通过在反馈线性化前增广系统动力学并配合切换控制器，解决了线性化过程中状态约束变得复杂且难以处理的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的反馈线性化方法在处理状态约束时，会将简单的原始约束转化为复杂的非线性约束，从而抵消了线性化所带来的设计优势。因此，需要一种方法在保持线性化便利性的同时有效处理状态约束。
AI.method: 提出了一种在反馈线性化（FBL）之前对系统动力学进行增广的方法，旨在预先捕获状态约束。针对该方法在约束边界处产生的相对度定义不明问题，引入了切换FBL控制器进行处理。
AI.result: 数值实验证明，所提方法能够在反馈线性化框架下有效地处理状态约束。研究表明，尽管增广方法在约束边界会导致相对度定义不明，但通过切换FBL控制器可以克服这一限制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功通过动力学增广和切换FBL控制器的结合，解决了反馈线性化中状态约束复杂化的问题，并在数值实验中验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 反馈线性化（FBL）是一种广泛使用的技术，它通过应用反馈律将输入仿射非线性控制系统转换为线性控制系统，从而可以使用极点配置等线性控制器设计方法。然而，对于存在状态约束的问题，控制由FBL诱导的线性系统可能比控制原始系统更具挑战性。这是因为原始非线性系统中的简单状态约束在FBL诱导的线性化系统中变成了复杂的非线性约束，从而削弱了线性化的优势。为了避免在FBL下增加状态约束的复杂性，本文提出了一种在应用FBL之前先增广系统动力学以捕获状态约束的方法。我们证明了我们提出的增广方法会导致状态约束边界处的相对度定义不明。然而，我们证明了可以通过使用切换FBL控制器来克服相对度定义不明的问题。数值实验说明了该方法在FBL框架内处理状态约束的能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过动力学增广来处理反馈线性化（FBL）中状态约束的方法。该方法旨在避免FBL将简单约束转化为复杂非线性约束的问题。针对增广后在约束边界出现的相对度定义不明问题，作者设计了切换FBL控制器，并通过数值仿真验证了该策略的有效性。
AI.keywords: 反馈线性化, 状态约束, 动力学增广, 相对度, 切换控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种巧妙的预处理方法（动力学增广），旨在解决反馈线性化（FBL）中状态约束复杂化的问题。其核心创新在于通过在FBL前处理约束，并在边界处利用切换控制器处理奇异性。该方法为在非线性控制中保留线性化工具的优势提供了新的视角，但其在处理高维系统时的计算复杂度和切换逻辑的鲁棒性值得进一步关注。

title: DreamAudio: Customized Text-to-Audio Generation with Diffusion Models
comments: Lastest arxiv version. Accepted by IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing. Demos are available at https://yyua8222.github.io/DreamAudio_demopage/
summary: With the development of large-scale diffusion-based and language-modeling-based generative models, impressive progress has been achieved in text-to-audio generation. Despite producing high-quality outputs, existing text-to-audio models mainly aim to generate semantically aligned sound and fall short of controlling fine-grained acoustic characteristics of specific sounds. As a result, users who need specific sound content may find it difficult to generate the desired audio clips. In this paper, we present DreamAudio for customized text-to-audio generation (CTTA). Specifically, we introduce a new framework that is designed to enable the model to identify auditory information from user-provided reference concepts for audio generation. Given a few reference audio samples containing personalized audio events, our system can generate new audio samples that include these specific events. In addition, two types of datasets are developed for training and testing the proposed systems. The experiments show that DreamAudio generates audio samples that are highly consistent with the customized audio features and aligned well with the input text prompts. Furthermore, DreamAudio offers comparable performance in general text-to-audio tasks. We also provide a human-involved dataset containing audio events from real-world CTTA cases as the benchmark for customized generation tasks.
comment: Lastest arxiv version. Accepted by IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing. Demos are available at https://yyua8222.github.io/DreamAudio_demopage/

AI.title_translation: DreamAudio：基于扩散模型的定制化文本转音频生成
AI.tldr: DreamAudio 是一种新型文本转音频框架，通过少量参考样本实现对特定音频事件的精确定制，有效提升了音频生成的个性化控制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本转音频模型虽然能生成语义对齐的高质量音频，但缺乏对特定音频细粒度声学特征的精确控制，导致用户难以生成符合特定需求的目标音频片段。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 DreamAudio 的框架，利用用户提供的少量参考音频样本提取特定的听觉信息，并结合扩散模型实现定制化的音频生成。此外，作者还开发了专门用于训练和测试该系统的两类数据集，以及一个用于评估定制化生成任务的基准数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，DreamAudio 生成的音频不仅与定制化的音频特征高度一致，而且与输入的文本提示对齐良好，同时在通用文本转音频任务中也表现出相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: DreamAudio 成功实现了在保持通用文本转音频任务性能的同时，通过少量参考样本完成高精度的定制化音频生成。
AI.translation: 随着大规模基于扩散和语言建模的生成模型的发展，文本转音频生成取得了令人瞩目的进展。尽管现有的文本转音频模型能够产生高质量的输出，但它们主要旨在生成语义对齐的声音，而在控制特定声音的细粒度声学特征方面表现不足。因此，需要特定声音内容的用户可能难以生成所需的音频片段。在本文中，我们提出了用于定制化文本转音频（CTTA）的 DreamAudio。具体而言，我们引入了一个新框架，旨在使模型能够从用户提供的参考概念中识别听觉信息以进行音频生成。给定包含个性化音频事件的少量参考音频样本，我们的系统可以生成包含这些特定事件的新音频样本。此外，我们还开发了两类数据集用于训练和测试所提出的系统。实验表明，DreamAudio 生成的音频样本与定制化的音频特征高度一致，并与输入的文本提示良好对齐。此外，DreamAudio 在通用文本转音频任务中也提供了相当的性能。我们还提供了一个包含来自真实世界 CTTA 案例的音频事件的人类参与数据集，作为定制化生成任务的基准。
AI.summary: DreamAudio 是一种定制化文本转音频（CTTA）生成框架。它允许用户通过提供少量参考音频样本，生成包含特定音频事件的定制化内容，解决了现有模型难以控制细粒度声学特征的问题。
AI.keywords: 文本转音频, 扩散模型, 个性化生成, 定制化音频, 音频合成
AI.comments: 该论文针对现有文本生成音频模型难以控制细粒度声学特征的问题，提出了个性化音频生成框架。其创新点在于通过少量参考样本实现特定音频事件的定制化生成，并配套构建了新的数据集，为音频领域的个性化生成提供了有效方案。

title: Large Language Models as Virtual Survey Respondents: Evaluating Sociodemographic Response Generation
summary: Questionnaire-based surveys are foundational to social science research and public policymaking, yet traditional survey methods remain costly, time-consuming, and often limited in scale. Although prior work has explored large language models (LLMs) as virtual survey respondents, existing studies often address narrow task settings, focus on single sociological domains, or lack a unified evaluation framework that enables systematic comparison across diverse datasets and models. To address these gaps, we introduce two complementary task abstractions: Partial Attribute Simulation (PAS), where LLMs predict missing attributes from incomplete respondent profiles, and Full Attribute Simulation (FAS), where LLMs generate complete synthetic datasets under zero-context and context-enhanced conditions. Both are framed as diagnostic and exploratory tools rather than replacements for human data collection. We curate LLM-S^3 (Large Language Model-based Sociodemographic Survey Simulation), a benchmark spanning 11 real-world public datasets across four sociological domains, and evaluate GPT-3.5/4 Turbo and LLaMA 3.0/3.1-8B under zero-shot and few-shot settings. Our evaluation reveals consistent performance trends across model families, highlights failure modes in structured output generation, and demonstrates how context and prompt design affect simulation fidelity. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/dart-lab-research/LLM-S-Cube-Benchmark

AI.title_translation: 作为虚拟调查受访者的大语言模型：评估社会人口统计学响应生成能力
AI.tldr: 本文构建了LLM-S^3基准测试，系统评估了LLM在模拟社会调查数据时的能力、局限及影响因素，旨在为社会科学研究提供诊断与探索工具。
AI.motivation: 传统问卷调查成本高、耗时长且规模受限；现有研究在评估框架上缺乏统一性且任务设置单一，无法系统比较不同模型在多样化社会科学场景下的模拟能力。
AI.method: 提出了两种任务抽象：部分属性模拟（PAS）和完整属性模拟（FAS）；构建了包含11个真实世界数据集的基准测试集LLM-S^3；评估了GPT-3.5/4 Turbo和LLaMA 3.0/3.1-8B在零样本和少样本设置下的表现。
AI.result: 研究揭示了不同模型家族的性能趋势，识别了结构化输出生成中的常见故障模式，并证实了上下文和提示词设计对模拟保真度的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: LLM在社会调查模拟中表现出一定潜力，但仍存在结构化输出故障和对上下文依赖性等局限，目前应将其定位为诊断和探索性工具，而非人类数据采集的替代品。
AI.translation: 基于问卷的调查是社会科学研究和公共政策制定的基础，但传统的调查方法成本高、耗时长，且规模往往受限。虽然之前的研究已经探索了将大语言模型（LLM）作为虚拟调查受访者，但现有研究往往针对狭窄的任务设置，专注于单一社会学领域，或者缺乏一个能够在不同数据集和模型之间进行系统比较的统一评估框架。为了弥补这些差距，我们引入了两种互补的任务抽象：部分属性模拟（PAS），即LLM从不完整的受访者资料中预测缺失属性；以及完整属性模拟（FAS），即LLM在零上下文和上下文增强条件下生成完整的合成数据集。两者都被定位为诊断和探索性工具，而不是人类数据收集的替代品。我们策划了LLM-S^3（基于大语言模型的社会人口统计调查模拟），这是一个跨越四个社会学领域、包含11个真实世界公共数据集的基准，并在零样本和少样本设置下评估了GPT-3.5/4 Turbo和LLaMA 3.0/3.1-8B。我们的评估揭示了模型家族之间一致的性能趋势，强调了结构化输出生成中的失败模式，并展示了上下文和提示词设计如何影响模拟的保真度。我们的代码和数据集可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/dart-lab-research/LLM-S-Cube-Benchmark
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在模拟社会调查数据中的应用，提出了一个统一的评估框架和基准测试集LLM-S^3。通过PAS和FAS两种任务抽象，研究评估了主流模型在多个社会学领域的表现，明确了其作为诊断工具的潜力和在处理结构化数据时的局限性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 社会调查, 合成数据, 基准测试, 社会人口统计学
AI.comments: 该研究通过构建统一的基准测试框架，系统性地评估了LLM在社会人口统计学调查模拟中的能力。其创新之处在于提出了PAS和FAS两种任务抽象，有助于深入理解模型在处理结构化社会调查数据时的偏差与局限，对于探索“合成数据”在社会科学研究中的潜力具有重要意义。

title: BIR-Adapter: A parameter-efficient diffusion adapter for blind image restoration
summary: We introduce the BIR-Adapter, a parameter-efficient diffusion adapter for blind image restoration. Diffusion-based restoration methods have demonstrated promising performance in addressing this fundamental problem in computer vision, typically relying on auxiliary feature extractors or extensive fine-tuning of pre-trained models. Building on the observation that large-scale pretrained diffusion models can retain informative representations under image degradations, BIR-Adapter introduces a parameter-efficient, plug-and-play attention mechanism that substantially reduces the number of trained parameters. To further improve reliability, we adapt a sampling guidance mechanism that mitigates hallucinations during restoration. Experiments on synthetic and real-world degradations demonstrate that BIR-Adapter achieves competitive, and in several settings superior, performance compared to state-of-the-art methods while requiring up to 36x fewer trained parameters. Moreover, the adapter-based design enables integration into existing models. We validate this generality by extending a super-resolution-only diffusion model to handle additional unknown degradations, highlighting the adaptability of our approach for broader image restoration tasks.

AI.title_translation: BIR-Adapter：一种用于盲图像恢复的参数高效扩散适配器
AI.tldr: BIR-Adapter 是一种高效的扩散模型适配器，通过显著减少训练参数和抑制幻觉，在保持高性能的同时实现了更灵活的盲图像恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的图像恢复方法通常依赖于辅助特征提取器或对预训练模型进行大规模微调，这导致了高昂的计算和存储成本。
AI.method: 提出了一种参数高效的即插即用注意力适配器（BIR-Adapter），并结合了一种旨在减轻恢复过程中幻觉现象的采样引导机制。
AI.result: 在合成和真实图像退化任务中，BIR-Adapter 达到了与现有最先进方法相当甚至更优的性能，同时训练参数量减少了多达 36 倍，且具有良好的跨任务通用性。
AI.conclusion: BIR-Adapter 证明了在保持高性能的同时，通过参数高效的适配器技术能够使大规模预训练扩散模型更高效、更可靠地应用于各种盲图像恢复任务。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了 BIR-Adapter，这是一种用于盲图像恢复的参数高效扩散适配器。基于扩散的恢复方法在解决这一计算机视觉基础问题上表现出了良好的性能，但通常依赖于辅助特征提取器或对预训练模型进行大规模微调。基于大规模预训练扩散模型在图像退化下仍能保留信息丰富表示的观察，BIR-Adapter 引入了一种参数高效、即插即用的注意力机制，大幅减少了训练参数的数量。为了进一步提高可靠性，我们适配了一种采样引导机制，以减轻恢复过程中的幻觉。在合成和真实退化上的实验表明，BIR-Adapter 在训练参数减少多达 36 倍的情况下，实现了与最先进方法相当甚至在某些设置下更优的性能。此外，基于适配器的设计使其能够集成到现有模型中。我们通过将仅支持超分辨率的扩散模型扩展到处理其他未知退化任务，验证了该方法的通用性，凸显了其在更广泛图像恢复任务中的适用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 BIR-Adapter，这是一种用于盲图像恢复的参数高效扩散适配器。该方法通过引入即插即用的注意力机制和改进的采样引导策略，在大幅降低训练参数需求的同时，有效地提升了图像恢复的质量与可靠性，并具备良好的模型兼容性。
AI.keywords: 盲图像恢复, 扩散模型, 参数高效, 注意力适配器, 采样引导
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了一种即插即用的注意力适配器，极大降低了盲图像恢复任务中预训练扩散模型的微调成本。其通过采样引导机制有效减少了模型幻觉，并在保持高性能的同时显著提升了模型的参数效率和通用性。

title: Prototype-Guided Robust Learning against Backdoor Attacks
summary: Backdoor attacks poison the training data, causing the model to behave normally on clean inputs but predict attacker-chosen labels when trigger patterns are embedded into the input samples. Defending against such attacks is highly challenging, especially when the defender has limited access to clean data. Existing defense methods often rely on restrictive assumptions-such as high poisoning ratios or poisoning strategies-limiting their practicality and generalization. To overcome these limitations, we propose Prototype-Guided Robust Learning (PGRL), a defense that only requires a small set of verified benign samples, and integrates two complementary components during fine-tuning: Label Consistency Verification (LCV), which detects and removes suspicious samples from the potentially poisoned dataset; and Feature Distance Estimation (FDE), which enforces the unlearning of backdoor-related representations. Extensive experiments against eight existing defenses show that PGRL achieves superior robustness across diverse architectures, datasets, and advanced attack scenarios, establishing a new standard for practical and generalizable backdoor defense.

AI.title_translation: 面向后门攻击的原型引导鲁棒学习
AI.tldr: 提出一种仅需少量良性样本的PGRL防御框架，通过样本过滤和特征遗忘机制，有效提升了模型对抗后门攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有后门防御方法通常依赖于高毒化比例等严苛假设，导致在实际场景中实用性和泛化能力较差。
AI.method: 提出原型引导鲁棒学习（PGRL）框架，包含两部分：1. 标签一致性验证（LCV），用于识别并剔除可疑样本；2. 特征距离估计（FDE），通过强制遗忘后门相关特征来提升模型的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在八种现有防御方法的对比实验中，PGRL在多种架构、数据集和高级攻击场景下均表现出优越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PGRL通过整合标签一致性验证和特征距离估计，为应对各种高级后门攻击提供了一种高效、通用且实用的防御方案。
AI.translation: 后门攻击通过污染训练数据，使模型在处理正常输入时表现正常，但当输入中嵌入触发模式时会预测为攻击者设定的标签。防御此类攻击极具挑战性，特别是在防御者只能获取少量干净数据的情况下。现有的防御方法往往依赖于限制性假设（如高毒化比例或特定的中毒策略），限制了其实用性和泛化能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了原型引导鲁棒学习（PGRL），这是一种仅需少量验证过的良性样本即可工作的防御机制。该方法在微调阶段集成了两个互补组件：标签一致性验证（LCV），用于检测并从潜在的中毒数据集中移除可疑样本；以及特征距离估计（FDE），用于强制模型遗忘与后门相关的表示。针对八种现有防御方法的广泛实验表明，PGRL在多种架构、数据集和高级攻击场景下均实现了卓越的鲁棒性，确立了实用且可泛化的后门防御新标准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PGRL的原型引导鲁棒学习框架，旨在解决后门防御中对高毒化比例等假设的过度依赖问题。该方法仅需少量良性样本，通过标签一致性验证和特征距离估计两个组件，有效识别并剔除中毒样本，同时消除后门特征影响，在多项实验中表现出卓越的防御性能。
AI.keywords: 后门攻击, 鲁棒学习, 原型引导, 样本清洗, 特征解耦
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的防御框架PGRL，通过仅利用少量已知良性样本来实现对后门攻击的防御，摆脱了对高毒化比例等假设的依赖。其创新之处在于结合了样本清洗（LCV）与特征解耦（FDE）两种机制，具有很强的实用性和泛化能力。

title: Proactive AI Adoption can be Threatening: When Help Backfires
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) assistants are increasingly embedded in workplace tools, raising the question of how initiative-taking shapes adoption. Prior work highlights trust and expectation mismatches as barriers, but the underlying psychological mechanisms remain unclear. Drawing on self-affirmation and social exchange theories, we theorize that unsolicited help elicits self-threat, thereby reducing willingness to accept help, likelihood of future use, and performance expectancy of AI. We report two vignette-based experiments (Study~1: $N=761$; Study~2: $N=571$, preregistered). Study~1 compared anticipatory and reactive help provided by an AI vs. a human, while Study~2 distinguished between \emph{offering} (suggesting help) and \emph{providing} (acting automatically). In Study 1, AI reactive help was more threatening than reactive human help. Across both studies, anticipatory help increased user's self-threat and reduced adoption outcomes. Our findings identify self-threat as a mechanism through which anticipatory help, a proactive AI feature, may backfire, and suggest design implications to be tested in interactive systems.

AI.title_translation: 主动式AI采纳可能带来威胁：当帮助适得其反时
AI.tldr: AI主动提供帮助可能会引发用户的“自我威胁”感，导致用户排斥使用AI，而非促进采纳。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI助手在工作中日益普及，但关于AI主动性如何影响用户采纳的心理机制尚不明确。研究旨在探讨为何AI主动提供帮助有时会适得其反，并揭示其中的心理动力。
AI.method: 采用了两项基于情境的实验研究：研究1对比了AI与人类在主动（预见性）和被动（响应性）帮助下的差异；研究2区分了“提议帮助”与“自动执行帮助”两种方式。通过实验数据分析验证了自我威胁作为中介变量的作用。
AI.result: 研究发现，AI提供的预见性帮助会显著增加用户的自我威胁感，并降低后续的采纳意愿。与人类提供的响应性帮助相比，AI的响应性帮助更容易让人感到威胁；且无论AI是提议帮助还是直接行动，主动式帮助均会导致负面采纳结果。
AI.conclusion: 主动式AI（预见性帮助）会引发用户的自我威胁感，进而降低用户对AI的接受度、使用意愿及绩效期望。设计AI交互时，应谨慎处理主动介入的程度，以避免产生反作用。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）助手正越来越多地嵌入到办公工具中，这引发了关于“主动性”如何影响AI采纳的问题。以往研究强调信任和期望错位是主要障碍，但其潜在的心理机制尚不清楚。本研究借鉴自我肯定理论和社会交换理论，推论出未经请求的帮助会引发自我威胁，从而降低用户接受帮助的意愿、未来使用的可能性以及对AI的绩效期望。我们报告了两个基于情境的实验（研究1：N=761；研究2：N=571，已预注册）。研究1比较了AI与人类提供的预见性和响应性帮助；研究2区分了“提议”（建议帮助）和“提供”（自动执行）。在研究1中，AI的响应性帮助比人类的响应性帮助更具威胁性。在两项研究中，预见性帮助均增加了用户的自我威胁感，并降低了采纳结果。我们的研究结果确定了自我威胁是预见性帮助（一种主动式AI功能）产生反作用的机制，并提出了在交互系统中需要测试的设计含义。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了主动式AI在职场中引发的负面心理效应。通过引入自我肯定和社会交换理论，研究发现AI的主动预见性帮助会诱发用户的自我威胁感，导致用户对AI的采纳意愿下降。实验证明，过度的AI主动性会适得其反，为交互系统的设计提供了心理学层面的优化建议。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 人机交互, 主动式AI, 自我威胁, 用户采纳
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地从心理学角度（自我肯定与社会交换理论）解释了AI主动性带来的负面效应，揭示了“主动提供帮助”可能引发用户自我威胁感，从而导致阻力。这对人机交互设计具有重要的指导意义，提醒开发者在设计主动式AI功能时需权衡用户心理感受。

title: A Note on Constructive Canonical Splitter Strategies in Nowhere Dense Graph Classes
comments: This is the accepted manuscript that includes changes as suggested by reviewers. Namely, we clarified which version of the splitter game we consider in this work and explained some of our arguments in more detail. Moreover, we added an explanatory figure for Claim 7
summary: The radius-$r$ splitter game is played on a graph $G$ between two players: Splitter and Connector. In each round, Connector selects a vertex $v$, and the current game arena is restricted to the radius-$r$ neighborhood of $v$. Then Splitter removes a vertex from this restricted subgraph. The game ends, and Splitter wins, when the arena becomes empty. Splitter aims to end the game as quickly as possible, while Connector tries to prolong it for as long as possible. The splitter game was introduced by Grohe, Kreutzer and Siebertz to characterize nowhere dense graph classes. They showed that a class $\mathscr{C}$ of graphs is nowhere dense if and only if for every radius $r$ there exists a number $k$ such that Splitter has a strategy on every $G\in \mathscr{C}$ to win the radius-$r$ splitter game in at most $k$ rounds. It was recently proved by Ohlmann et al. that for every nowhere dense class $\mathscr{C}$ and every radius $r$ there are only a bounded number of possible Splitter moves that are progressing, that is, moves that lead to an arena where Splitter can win in one less round. The proof of Ohlmann et al. is based on the compactness theorem and does not give a constructive bound on the number of progressing moves. In this work, we give a simple constructive proof, showing that if Splitter can force a win in the radius-$r$ game in $k$ rounds, then there are at most $(2r+1)^{\,2^{k-1}-1}$ progressing moves.
comment: This is the accepted manuscript that includes changes as suggested by reviewers. Namely, we clarified which version of the splitter game we consider in this work and explained some of our arguments in more detail. Moreover, we added an explanatory figure for Claim 7

title: Learning to Conceal Risk: Controllable Multi-turn Red Teaming for LLMs in the Financial Domain
comments: Accepted for ACL'26 (Main). TL;DR: We propose a controllable multi-turn risk-concealed red-teaming framework, CoRT, that progressively conceals surface-level risk while exploiting regulatory-violating behaviors on a proposed new benchmark, FinRisk-Bench
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in finance, where unsafe behavior can lead to serious regulatory risks. However, most red-teaming research focuses on overtly harmful content and overlooks attacks that appear legitimate on the surface yet induce regulatory-violating responses. We address this gap by introducing a controllable black-box multi-turn risk-concealed red-teaming framework (CoRT) that progressively conceals surface-level risk while exploiting regulatory-violating behaviors. CoRT contains two key components: (i) a Risk Concealment Attacker (RCA) that generates multi-turn prompts via iterative refinement, and (ii) a Risk Concealment Controller (RCC) that predicts a turn-level Risk Concealment Score (RCS) to steer RCA's follow-up style. We also built a domain-specific benchmark, FinRisk-Bench, with 522 instructions spanning six financial risk categories. Experiments on nine widely used LLMs show that CoRT (RCA) achieves 93.19% average attack success rate (ASR), and CoRT (RCA+RCC) further improves the average ASR to 95.00%. Our code and FinRisk-Bench are available at https://github.com/gcheng128/CoRT.

AI.title_translation: 学习掩盖风险：金融领域大语言模型的可控多轮红队测试
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CoRT的金融领域大模型红队测试框架，通过迭代优化和风险控制引导，成功诱导模型产生表面合法但实际违规的回复，平均攻击成功率高达95%。
AI.motivation: 现有红队测试研究多关注显性有害内容，忽略了金融领域中表面合法但实则诱导模型产生违规行为的隐蔽风险，且缺乏针对性的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为CoRT的黑盒多轮风险隐蔽红队测试框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 风险隐蔽攻击者（RCA），通过迭代优化生成多轮提示；(2) 风险隐蔽控制器（RCC），通过预测逐轮的风险隐蔽得分（RCS）来引导RCA的后续攻击风格。同时构建了包含522条指令的金融领域基准测试集FinRisk-Bench。
AI.result: 在九种主流大模型上的实验表明，CoRT (RCA) 的平均攻击成功率（ASR）达到93.19%，引入RCC后进一步提升至95.00%。
AI.conclusion: CoRT框架通过迭代优化和风险控制得分机制，有效地揭露了LLMs在金融领域中隐蔽的违规风险，为金融大模型的安全合规提供了有效的评估工具。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地应用于金融领域，其中不安全的行为可能导致严重的监管风险。然而，大多数红队测试研究侧重于显性有害内容，而忽略了表面合法但诱导产生违规响应的攻击。我们通过引入一个可控的黑盒多轮风险隐蔽红队测试框架（CoRT）来填补这一空白，该框架在利用监管违规行为的同时，逐步掩盖表面风险。CoRT包含两个关键组件：（i）风险隐蔽攻击者（RCA），通过迭代优化生成多轮提示；以及（ii）风险隐蔽控制器（RCC），通过预测逐轮的风险隐蔽得分（RCS）来引导RCA的后续风格。我们还构建了一个特定领域的基准测试集FinRisk-Bench，涵盖了六个金融风险类别的522条指令。在九种广泛使用的大模型上的实验表明，CoRT (RCA) 实现了93.19%的平均攻击成功率（ASR），而CoRT (RCA+RCC) 将平均ASR进一步提高到了95.00%。我们的代码和FinRisk-Bench可在 https://github.com/gcheng128/CoRT 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在金融领域中隐蔽违规风险的评估问题，提出了一种可控的多轮红队测试框架（CoRT）。该框架通过风险隐蔽攻击者和控制器的协同工作，实现了对违规行为的高效诱导，并构建了FinRisk-Bench数据集用于系统评估。实验证明该方法在金融场景下具有极高的攻击成功率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 金融风险, 红队测试, 风险隐蔽, 模型安全
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其关注点从显性的有害内容转向了金融领域中表面合法但诱导违规的隐蔽性风险，提出了可控的红队测试框架。这对于提升大模型在金融等高监管行业的安全性具有重要意义。局限性在于其主要针对金融领域，其通用性及对抗防御策略的有效性有待进一步研究。

title: CodecSep: Prompt-Driven Universal Sound Separation on Neural Audio Codec Latents
comments: main content- 27 pages, total - 53 pages, 12 figure, pre-print, under review
summary:
Text-guided sound separation enables flexible audio editing, assistive listening, and open-domain source extraction, but systems such as AudioSep remain too expensive for low-latency edge or codec-mediated deployment. Existing neural audio codec separators are efficient, yet largely restricted to fixed stems or closed taxonomies. We introduce CodecSep, a prompt-driven universal sound separation framework that extracts sources directly in neural audio codec latent space. CodecSep combines a frozen DAC backbone with a lightweight FiLM-conditioned Transformer masker driven by CLAP text embeddings, enabling open-vocabulary separation while preserving codec-native efficiency.
  Across dnr-v2 and five open-domain benchmarks, CodecSep consistently improves over AudioSep in SI-SDR, remains competitive in ViSQOL, and achieves clear gains in human MOS-LQS. Controlled analyses show that fine-grained prompts outperform coarse labels, and that explicit latent masking is substantially more effective than decoder-style latent generation in codec space. Qualitative diagnostics show that neural audio codec latents retain source-dependent structure, which CodecSep exploits mainly through channel-wise source-conditioned modulation.
  CodecSep also provides a practical code-stream deployment path. When audio is transmitted as neural audio codec codes, CodecSep maps codes to embeddings, separates directly in codec space, and outputs waveforms or re-quantized codes, avoiding the decode-separate-re-encode loop. In this regime, CodecSep requires only 1.35 GMACs end-to-end: about 54 times less compute than AudioSep in the same pipeline and 25 times lower separator-only compute, with much lower latency and memory. More broadly, CodecSep offers a blueprint for codec-native downstream audio processing.

AI.title_translation: CodecSep：基于神经音频编解码器潜空间的提示驱动通用声音分离
AI.tldr: CodecSep通过在音频编解码器潜空间直接进行提示驱动的分离，在保持高质量的同时，大幅降低了计算开销，实现了高效的边缘侧部署。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导的分离系统（如AudioSep）计算开销过大，难以满足低延迟边缘侧或编解码器中继部署的需求，而现有的编解码器分离方法又多局限于固定类别。
AI.method: 利用冻结的DAC作为骨干网络，结合由CLAP文本嵌入驱动的轻量级FiLM条件Transformer掩码器，在音频编解码器的潜空间直接进行源分离。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，CodecSep在SI-SDR指标上优于AudioSep，在MOS-LQS上取得显著提升；计算开销比AudioSep降低了约54倍，且支持直接对编解码器码流进行操作，无需解码-分离-再编码的循环。
AI.conclusion: CodecSep证明了在神经音频编解码器潜空间进行直接分离是高效且高质量的，为未来的音频处理提供了低延迟、低计算开销的通用解决方案。
AI.translation: 文本引导的声音分离实现了灵活的音频编辑、辅助听力及开放域源提取，但如AudioSep等系统对于低延迟边缘侧或编解码器中继部署而言过于昂贵。现有的神经音频编解码器分离器虽高效，但大多受限于固定源或封闭分类。我们介绍了CodecSep，一个通过提示驱动的通用声音分离框架，直接在神经音频编解码器潜空间中提取源。CodecSep结合了冻结的DAC骨干网络和由CLAP文本嵌入驱动的轻量级FiLM条件Transformer掩码器，在保持编解码器原生效率的同时实现了开放词汇分离。在dnr-v2和五个开放域基准测试中，CodecSep在SI-SDR指标上持续优于AudioSep，在ViSQOL上保持竞争力，并在人类MOS-LQS上取得了明显提升。对照分析表明，细粒度提示优于粗粒度标签，且显式潜空间掩码比解码器式的潜空间生成在编解码器空间中更有效。定性诊断显示，神经音频编解码器潜空间保留了源依赖结构，CodecSep主要通过通道级源条件调制来利用这一点。CodecSep还提供了一种实用的码流部署路径。当音频以神经音频编解码器代码传输时，CodecSep将代码映射到嵌入，直接在编解码器空间进行分离，并输出波形或重新量化的代码，避免了“解码-分离-再编码”循环。在此模式下，CodecSep端到端仅需1.35 GMACs：在相同流水线中比AudioSep计算量减少约54倍，分离器计算量降低25倍，且具有更低的延迟和内存占用。更广泛地说，CodecSep为编解码器原生的下游音频处理提供了蓝图。
AI.summary: CodecSep是一个基于文本提示的通用音频分离框架，通过在神经音频编解码器潜空间直接进行操作，实现了高效且开放词汇的源分离，显著降低了计算复杂度和延迟。
AI.keywords: 音频分离, 神经音频编解码器, 文本引导, 潜空间处理, 低延迟
AI.comments: CodecSep的创新之处在于将音频分离任务直接迁移至神经音频编解码器的潜空间，不仅极大地提升了计算效率，还通过Prompt驱动实现了开放词汇的通用分离能力，为音频处理的边缘侧部署提供了高效范式。

title: xOffense: An Autonomous Multi-Agent Framework for Penetration Testing with Domain-Adapted Large Language Models
summary: This work introduces xOffense, an AI-driven, multi-agent penetration testing framework that shifts the process from labor-intensive, expert-driven manual efforts to fully automated, machine-executable workflows capable of scaling seamlessly with computational infrastructure. At its core, xOffense leverages a fine-tuned, mid-scale open-source LLM (Qwen3-32B) to drive reasoning and decision-making in penetration testing. The framework assigns specialized agents to reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, and exploitation, with an orchestration layer ensuring seamless coordination across phases. Fine-tuning on Chain-of-Thought penetration testing data further enables the model to generate precise tool commands and perform consistent multi-step reasoning. We evaluate xOffense on two rigorous benchmarks: AutoPenBench and AI-Pentest-Benchmark. The results demonstrate that xOffense consistently outperforms contemporary methods, achieving a sub-task completion rate of 79.17%, decisively surpassing leading systems such as VulnBot and PentestGPT. These findings highlight the potential of domain-adapted mid-scale LLMs, when embedded within structured multi-agent orchestration, to deliver superior, cost-efficient, and reproducible solutions for autonomous penetration testing.

AI.title_translation: xOffense：基于领域适配大语言模型的自主多智能体渗透测试框架
AI.tldr: xOffense 利用微调的 LLM 和多智能体编排，实现了全自动化、高性能的渗透测试，子任务完成率达 79.17%。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决传统渗透测试依赖人工、效率低下且难以扩展的问题，通过自动化手段提升渗透测试的效率与可重复性。
AI.method: 构建了一个多智能体框架，利用经过思维链（CoT）渗透测试数据微调的 Qwen3-32B 模型进行推理与决策，并通过编排层协调侦察、漏洞扫描和利用等专业智能体。
AI.result: 在 AutoPenBench 和 AI-Pentest-Benchmark 基准测试中表现卓越，子任务完成率达到 79.17%，显著优于 VulnBot 和 PentestGPT 等系统。
AI.conclusion: xOffense 通过领域微调的 LLM 和多智能体协同，实现了高效、可扩展的自动化渗透测试，性能优于现有主流方案。
AI.translation: 本研究介绍了 xOffense，这是一个人工智能驱动的多智能体渗透测试框架，将渗透测试过程从劳动密集型、专家主导的人工工作转向完全自动化、机器可执行且可随计算基础设施无缝扩展的工作流。xOffense 的核心是利用经过微调的中等规模开源大模型（Qwen3-32B）来驱动渗透测试中的推理和决策。该框架为侦察、漏洞扫描和利用分配了专业智能体，并配备了编排层以确保各阶段之间的无缝协调。在思维链（CoT）渗透测试数据上进行的微调，进一步使模型能够生成精确的工具命令并执行一致的多步推理。我们在 AutoPenBench 和 AI-Pentest-Benchmark 两个严格的基准测试上评估了 xOffense。结果表明，xOffense 的表现持续优于当前方法，子任务完成率达到 79.17%，决定性地超过了 VulnBot 和 PentestGPT 等领先系统。这些发现突显了领域适配的中等规模大模型在嵌入结构化多智能体编排中，为自主渗透测试提供卓越、高性价比和可重复解决方案的潜力。
AI.summary: xOffense 是一个全自动的多智能体渗透测试框架，通过微调 Qwen3-32B 模型驱动决策，结合侦察、扫描和漏洞利用智能体，实现了高效的自动化安全测试，在基准测试中展现了超越现有系统的性能。
AI.keywords: 渗透测试, 多智能体系统, 大语言模型, 自动化安全, 领域微调
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将领域微调后的中等规模大模型（Qwen3-32B）与多智能体编排框架相结合，有效解决了渗透测试中复杂推理和工具执行的自动化难题。其局限性在于未在真实、复杂的企业级生产环境中进行大规模验证。

title: A hybrid dynamic model and parameter estimation method for accurately simulating overhead cranes with friction
comments: 10 pages, 12 figures. Major changes in all the sections
summary: This paper presents a new approach to accurately simulating 3D overhead cranes with friction. Although nonlinear friction dynamics has a significant impact on these systems, accurately modeling this phenomenon in simulations is a significant challenge. Traditional methods often rely on imprecise approximations of friction or require excessive computational times for reliable results. To address this, we present a hybrid dynamical model that features a trade-off between high-fidelity friction modeling and computational efficiency. Furthermore, we present a step-by-step algorithm for the comprehensive estimation of all unknown system parameters, including friction. This methodology is based on Bayesian Linear Regression and Least Squares (LS) estimations. Finally, experimental validation with a laboratory crane confirms the effectiveness of the proposed modeling and estimation approach.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于精确模拟带摩擦起重机的混合动力模型及参数估计方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种平衡仿真精度与计算效率的起重机混合动力模型，并利用贝叶斯回归与最小二乘法实现了系统参数的精确估计。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在起重机仿真中对摩擦的建模往往不够精确，或者由于模型过于复杂导致计算时间过长，无法满足高效且精确的仿真需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合动力模型以平衡摩擦建模精度与计算效率，并采用基于贝叶斯线性回归和最小二乘法的算法来估计包括摩擦在内的所有未知系统参数。
AI.result: 通过实验室起重机实验，验证了所提建模与参数估计方法能够准确模拟系统行为。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证表明，该混合动力模型与参数估计方法能够有效提升起重机系统的仿真精度，且在计算成本上具有优势。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种精确模拟带有摩擦的三维起重机的新方法。尽管非线性摩擦动力学对这些系统有显著影响，但在仿真中精确建模这一现象是一个重大挑战。传统方法往往依赖于不精确的摩擦近似，或者需要过多的计算时间才能获得可靠结果。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个混合动力模型，在保持高保真摩擦建模的同时兼顾计算效率。此外，我们提出了一种逐步算法，用于全面估计所有未知的系统参数，包括摩擦参数。该方法基于贝叶斯线性回归和最小二乘法（LS）估计。最后，通过实验室起重机的实验验证，证实了所提建模和估计方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对三维起重机仿真中摩擦动力学建模的难题，提出了一种兼顾高保真度和计算效率的混合动力模型。此外，论文还开发了一种基于贝叶斯线性回归和最小二乘法的参数估计算法，并通过实验证实了该方法在提升仿真准确性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 起重机, 摩擦动力学, 混合模型, 参数估计, 贝叶斯线性回归
AI.comments: 该论文通过结合高保真摩擦模型与计算效率，解决了工业起重机仿真中长期存在的精度与效率平衡问题。其创新点在于提出了一种混合动力模型，并结合贝叶斯线性回归与最小二乘法实现了参数的系统性估计，具有很强的工程实用价值。

title: SWE-QA: Can Language Models Answer Repository-level Code Questions?
comments: Accepted to ACL 2026 Findings. Code and data available at https://github.com/peng-weihan/SWE-QA-Bench
summary: Understanding and reasoning about entire software repositories is an essential capability for intelligent software engineering tools. While existing benchmarks such as CoSQA and CodeQA have advanced the field, they predominantly focus on small, self-contained code snippets. These setups fail to capture the complexity of real-world repositories, where effective understanding and reasoning often require navigating multiple files, understanding software architecture, and grounding answers in long-range code dependencies. In this paper, we present SWE-QA, a repository-level code question answering (QA) benchmark designed to facilitate research on automated QA systems in realistic code environments. SWE-QA involves 576 high-quality question-answer pairs spanning diverse categories, including intention understanding, cross-file reasoning, and multi-hop dependency analysis. To construct SWE-QA, we first crawled 77,100 GitHub issues from 11 popular repositories. Based on an analysis of naturally occurring developer questions extracted from these issues, we developed a two-level taxonomy of repository-level questions and constructed a set of seed questions for each category. For each category, we manually curated and validated questions and collected their corresponding answers. As a prototype application, we further develop SWE-QA-Agent, an agentic framework in which LLM agents reason and act to find answers automatically. We evaluate six advanced LLMs on SWE-QA under various context augmentation strategies. Experimental results highlight the promise of LLMs, particularly our SWE-QA-Agent framework, in addressing repository-level QA, while also revealing open challenges and pointing to future research directions.

title: V-SEAM: Visual Semantic Editing and Attention Modulating for Causal Interpretability of Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent advances in causal interpretability have extended from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), seeking to reveal their internal mechanisms through input interventions. While textual interventions often target semantics, visual interventions typically rely on coarse pixel-level perturbations, limiting semantic insights on multimodal integration. In this study, we introduce V-SEAM, a novel framework that combines Visual Semantic Editing and Attention Modulating for causal interpretation of VLMs. V-SEAM enables concept-level visual manipulations and identifies attention heads with positive or negative contributions to predictions across three semantic levels: objects, attributes, and relationships. We observe that positive heads are often shared within the same semantic level but vary across levels, while negative heads tend to generalize broadly. Finally, we introduce an automatic method to modulate key head embeddings, demonstrating enhanced performance for both LLaVA and InstructBLIP across three diverse VQA benchmarks. Our data and code are released at: https://github.com/petergit1/V-SEAM.

title: Animalbooth: multimodal feature enhancement for animal subject personalization
summary: Personalized animal image generation is challenging due to rich appearance cues and large morphological variability. Existing approaches often exhibit feature misalignment across domains, which leads to identity drift. We present AnimalBooth, a framework that strengthens identity preservation with an Animal Net and an adaptive attention module, mitigating cross domain alignment errors. We further introduce a frequency controlled feature integration module that applies Discrete Cosine Transform filtering in the latent space to guide the diffusion process, enabling a coarse to fine progression from global structure to detailed texture. To advance research in this area, we curate AnimalBench, a high resolution dataset for animal personalization. Extensive experiments show that AnimalBooth consistently outperforms strong baselines on multiple benchmarks and improves both identity fidelity and perceptual quality.

AI.title_translation: AnimalBooth：面向动物主体个性化的多模态特征增强方法
AI.tldr: AnimalBooth 通过引入多模态特征增强和频率引导生成机制，有效解决了动物个性化生成中的身份漂移问题，提升了生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的个性化生成方法在处理动物图像时，常因跨域特征对齐偏差导致身份识别不准确（身份漂移），且动物外观特征丰富、形态多变，难以保持一致性。
AI.method: 1. 引入 Animal Net 和自适应注意力模块以增强身份一致性；2. 采用频率控制特征集成模块（利用离散余弦变换）在潜在空间引导扩散过程，实现从全局结构到局部细节的生成；3. 构建 AnimalBench 数据集用于评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，AnimalBooth 在多项基准测试中均超越了现有主流方法，显著提升了生成图像的身份保真度和感知质量。
AI.conclusion: AnimalBooth 通过多模态特征增强和频率引导的扩散过程，有效解决了动物图像个性化生成中的身份漂移问题，在身份保真度和感知质量上均达到了领先水平。
AI.translation: 个性化动物图像生成由于其丰富的外观线索和巨大的形态变异性而充满挑战。现有的方法往往在不同域之间表现出特征不对齐，从而导致身份漂移。我们提出了 AnimalBooth，这是一个通过 Animal Net 和自适应注意力模块来加强身份保持的框架，旨在减轻跨域对齐错误。我们进一步引入了一种频率控制特征集成模块，该模块在潜在空间中应用离散余弦变换滤波来引导扩散过程，实现了从全局结构到详细纹理的由粗到细的演进。为了推动该领域的研究，我们策划了 AnimalBench，这是一个用于动物个性化的高分辨率数据集。大量实验表明，AnimalBooth 在多个基准测试中始终优于强基线，并提高了身份保真度和感知质量。
AI.summary: AnimalBooth 是一种针对动物个性化图像生成的框架，旨在解决跨域特征对齐偏差引发的身份漂移难题。该框架通过整合 Animal Net、自适应注意力机制以及基于频率控制的特征集成模块，实现了从全局到细节的高质量生成，并通过全新的 AnimalBench 数据集验证了其卓越性能。
AI.keywords: 动物图像生成, 个性化生成, 特征对齐, 扩散模型, 频率控制
AI.comments: 该论文针对动物个性化生成领域中常见的身份漂移问题，提出了创新的特征增强机制。其核心贡献在于通过频率控制和多模态注意力模块，实现了从全局结构到局部细节的精细化生成，并配套发布了高质量基准数据集，具有很强的实用价值和学术参考意义。

title: Clotho: Measuring Task-Specific Pre-Generation Test Adequacy for LLM Inputs
summary: Software increasingly relies on the emergent capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), from natural language understanding to program analysis and generation. Yet testing them on specific tasks remains difficult and costly: many prompts lack ground truths, forcing reliance on human judgments, while existing test adequacy measures typically rely on output uncertainty and thus are only available after full inference. A key challenge is to assess how useful a test input is in a way that reflects the demands of the task, ideally before even generating any output. We introduce Clotho, a task-specific, pre-generation test adequacy measure that estimates input difficulty directly from LLM hidden states. Given a large pool of unlabelled inputs for a specific task, Clotho uses a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) to adaptively sample the most informative cases for human labelling. Based on this reference set the GMM can then rank unseen inputs by their likelihood of failure. In our empirical evaluation across eight benchmark tasks and three open-weight LLMs, Clotho can predict failures with a ROC-AUC of 0.716, after labelling reference sets that are on average only 5.4% of inputs. It does so without generating any outputs, thereby significantly reducing LLM execution costs compared to output-based uncertainty or confidence measures. Comparison of Clotho and these post-generation adequacy measures shows that the two approaches complement each other. Crucially, we show that adequacy scores learnt from open-weight LLMs transfer effectively to proprietary models, extending the applicability of the approach. When prioritising test inputs for proprietary models, Clotho increases the average number of failing inputs from 18.7 to 42.5 out of 100, compared to random prioritisation.

title: Why Are We Moral? An LLM-based Agent Simulation Approach to Study Moral Evolution
comments: Accepted at ACL 2026 Main Conference. 51 pages including appendix
summary: The evolution of morality presents a puzzle: natural selection should favor self-interest, yet humans developed moral systems promoting altruism. Traditional approaches must abstract away cognitive processes, leaving open how cognitive factors shape moral evolution. We introduce an LLM-based agent simulation framework that brings cognitive realism to this question: agents with varying moral dispositions perceive, remember, reason, and decide in a simulated prehistoric hunter-gatherer society. This enables us to manipulate factors that traditional models cannot represent -- such as moral type observability and communication bandwidth -- and to discover emergent cognitive mechanisms from agent interactions. Across 20 runs spanning four settings, we find that cooperation and mutual help are the central driver of evolutionary survival, with universal and reciprocal morality exhibiting the most stable outcomes across conditions while selfishness is strongly disfavoured. Beyond cooperation itself, we further identify cognition as a central mediator -- most clearly through a cost of moral judgment that shifts the winning moral type across settings, with a self-purging effect among selfish agents as an additional cognitive pattern. We validate robustness across multiple LLM backbones, architecture ablations, and prompt sensitivity analyses. This work establishes LLM-based simulation as a powerful new paradigm to complement traditional research in evolutionary biology and anthropology, opening new avenues for investigating the complexities of moral and social evolution.
comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 Main Conference. 51 pages including appendix

title: CoRaCMG: Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Commit Message Generation
comments: Preprint accepted for publication in Information and Software Technology, 2026
summary: Commit messages play a key role in documenting the intent behind code changes. However, they are often low-quality, vague, or incomplete, limiting their usefulness. Commit Message Generation (CMG) aims to automatically generate descriptive commit messages from code diffs to reduce developers' effort and improve message quality. Although recent advances in LLMs have shown promise in automating CMG, their performance remains limited. This paper aims to enhance CMG performance by retrieving similar diff-message pairs to guide LLMs to generate commit messages that are more precise and informative. We proposed CoRaCMG, a Contextual Retrieval-augmented framework for Commit Message Generation, structured in three phases: (1) Retrieve: retrieving the similar diff-message pairs; (2) Augment: combining them with the query diff into a structured prompt; and (3) Generate: generating commit messages corresponding to the query diff via LLMs. CoRaCMG enables LLMs to learn project-specific terminologies and writing styles from the retrieved diff-message pairs. We evaluated CoRaCMG across multiple LLMs (e.g., GPT, DeepSeek, and Qwen) and compared its performance against SOTA baselines. Experimental results show that CoRaCMG significantly boosts LLM performance across four metrics (BLEU, Rouge-L, METEOR, and CIDEr). Specifically, DeepSeek-R1 achieves relative improvements of 76% in BLEU and 71% in CIDEr when augmented with a single retrieved example pair. After incorporating the single example pair, GPT-4o achieves the highest improvement rate, with BLEU increasing by 89%. Moreover, performance gains plateau after more than three examples are used, indicating diminishing returns. Further analysis shows that the improvements are attributed to the model's ability to capture the terminologies and writing styles of human-written commit messages from the retrieved example pairs.
comment: Preprint accepted for publication in Information and Software Technology, 2026

AI.title_translation: CoRaCMG：用于提交信息生成的上下文检索增强框架
AI.tldr: CoRaCMG 框架通过向 LLM 提供相似的历史提交记录作为参考，显著提升了自动生成代码提交信息的质量。
AI.motivation: 针对现有 LLM 在自动生成提交信息时质量不高、描述模糊或不完整的问题，旨在通过引入项目相关的历史上下文来提升生成信息的准确性和信息量。
AI.method: 提出 CoRaCMG 框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 检索相似的 diff-message 对；(2) 将检索到的示例与当前 diff 合并为结构化提示；(3) 利用 LLM 生成高质量的提交信息。
AI.result: 实验表明 CoRaCMG 在多个 LLM（如 GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen）上显著提升了性能。DeepSeek-R1 的 BLEU 和 CIDEr 分别提升了 76% 和 71%，GPT-4o 的 BLEU 提升高达 89%；研究还发现使用超过 3 个示例后性能提升趋于平缓。
AI.conclusion: CoRaCMG 框架通过引入上下文检索增强，显著提升了 LLM 在提交信息生成任务中的质量与准确性，是解决代码文档自动化的有效方案。
AI.translation: 提交信息在记录代码变更意图方面起着关键作用。然而，它们往往质量低下、含糊不清或不完整，限制了其效用。提交信息生成（CMG）旨在从代码差异（diff）中自动生成描述性提交信息，以减少开发人员的工作量并提高信息质量。尽管 LLM 的最新进展在自动化 CMG 方面显示出前景，但其性能仍然有限。本文旨在通过检索相似的 diff-message 对来引导 LLM 生成更精确和信息丰富的提交信息，从而增强 CMG 的性能。我们提出了 CoRaCMG，一个用于提交信息生成的上下文检索增强框架，其结构分为三个阶段：（1）检索：检索相似的 diff-message 对；（2）增强：将它们与查询 diff 组合成结构化提示；以及（3）生成：通过 LLM 生成对应于查询 diff 的提交信息。CoRaCMG 使 LLM 能够从检索到的 diff-message 对中学习项目特定的术语和写作风格。我们在多个 LLM（如 GPT、DeepSeek 和 Qwen）上评估了 CoRaCMG，并将其性能与 SOTA 基线进行了比较。实验结果表明，CoRaCMG 在四个指标（BLEU、Rouge-L、METEOR 和 CIDEr）上显著提升了 LLM 的性能。具体而言，当使用单个检索示例对进行增强时，DeepSeek-R1 在 BLEU 上实现了 76% 的相对提升，在 CIDEr 上实现了 71% 的相对提升。在加入单个示例对后，GPT-4o 实现了最高的提升率，BLEU 增加了 89%。此外，在使用超过三个示例后，性能增益趋于平稳，表明收益递减。进一步分析表明，性能的提升归功于模型能够从检索到的示例对中捕捉到人类编写的提交信息的术语和写作风格。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 CoRaCMG 框架，这是一种通过上下文检索增强技术来改进提交信息生成（CMG）的方法。该框架通过检索相似的 diff-message 对作为提示，引导 LLM 学习项目特定的术语和写作风格，从而显著提高了生成信息的质量。
AI.keywords: 提交信息生成, 检索增强生成, 大语言模型, 代码差异分析
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入上下文检索增强机制有效解决了LLM在提交信息生成（CMG）任务中的局限性。其创新点在于利用项目特定的历史数据来指导生成，显著提升了模型对特定术语和写作风格的把握。研究发现性能提升存在边际效应（超过三个示例后增益趋于平缓），这为未来优化提示工程提供了有价值的参考。

title: Parameter-Efficient Multi-Task Learning via Progressive Task-Specific Adaptation
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods have emerged as a promising solution for adapting pre-trained models to various downstream tasks. While these methods perform well in single-task learning, extending them to multi-task learning exacerbates common issues, such as task interference and negative transfer, due to the limited number of trainable parameters. To address these challenges, we introduce progressive task-specific multi-task adaptation, a novel parameter-efficient approach for multi-task learning. Our approach introduces adapter modules that are shared in early layers and become increasingly task-specific in later layers. Additionally, we propose a gradient-based approach for computing task similarity and use this measure to allocate similar tasks to the shared adapter modules. To evaluate our approach, we adapt Swin and Pyramid Vision Transformers on PASCAL and NYUD-v2. On both datasets, our approach outperforms prior parameter-efficient multi-task methods while using fewer trainable parameters.

AI.title_translation: 通过渐进式任务特定适应实现参数高效的多任务学习
AI.tldr: 提出一种渐进式适配器架构和任务相似度分配策略，在多任务学习中以更少的参数实现了更优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数高效微调方法在多任务学习场景下容易产生任务干扰和负迁移，且受限于参数数量，难以在多个任务间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出渐进式任务特定多任务适应方法，在早期层使用共享适配器，在后期层使用任务特定适配器，并引入基于梯度的任务相似度计算方法来分配共享模块。
AI.result: 在Swin和Pyramid Vision Transformers模型上，该方法在PASCAL和NYUD-v2数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，且参数量更少。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，该方法在减少可训练参数的同时，在PASCAL和NYUD-v2数据集上均优于现有的参数高效多任务学习方法。
AI.translation: 参数高效微调方法已成为将预训练模型适应各种下游任务的有前途的解决方案。虽然这些方法在单任务学习中表现良好，但将它们扩展到多任务学习会因可训练参数数量有限而加剧任务干扰和负迁移等常见问题。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了渐进式任务特定多任务适应，这是一种用于多任务学习的创新参数高效方法。我们的方法引入了在早期层共享并在后期层变得越来越具有任务特性的适配器模块。此外，我们提出了一种用于计算任务相似度的基于梯度的方法，并使用该度量将相似的任务分配给共享适配器模块。为了评估我们的方法，我们在PASCAL和NYUD-v2上调整了Swin和Pyramid视觉Transformer。在这两个数据集上，我们的方法在使用的可训练参数更少的情况下，优于先前的参数高效多任务方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为渐进式任务特定多任务适应的参数高效学习框架。通过在模型早期层共享适配器并在后期层增加任务特异性，同时利用基于梯度的任务相似度度量来优化资源分配，该方法有效缓解了多任务学习中的干扰问题，并在视觉任务中实现了优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 参数高效微调, 多任务学习, 任务干扰, 渐进式适应, 视觉Transformer
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的渐进式多任务适应方法，通过结合共享与特定任务的适配器模块，并利用任务相似度来优化参数分配，有效地解决了多任务学习中的任务干扰和负迁移问题，在保持参数高效性的同时提升了性能。

title: OLaPh: Optimal Language Phonemizer
summary: Phonemization is a critical component in text-to-speech synthesis. Traditional approaches rely on deterministic transformations and lexica, while neural methods offer potential for higher generalization on out-of-vocabulary (OOV) terms. This work introduces OLaPh (Optimal Language Phonemizer), a hybrid framework that integrates extensive multilingual lexica with advanced NLP techniques and a statistical subword segmentation function. Evaluations on the WikiPron benchmark show that the OLaPh framework significantly outperforms established baselines in overall accuracy and maintains robustness on OOV data through advanced fallback mechanisms. To further explore neural generalization, we utilize the framework to synthesize a high-consistency training corpus for an instruction-tuned Large Language Model (LLM). While the deterministic framework remains more accurate overall, the LLM demonstrates strong generalization, matching or partly exceeding the framework's performance. This suggests that the LLM successfully internalized phonetic intuitions from the synthetic data that transcend the framework's capabilities. Together, these tools provide a comprehensive, open-source resource for multilingual G2P research.

AI.tldr: OLaPh是一个结合了词典与统计方法的高性能音素转换框架，不仅自身准确鲁棒，还能通过合成数据教会LLM处理复杂的音素转换任务。
AI.motivation: 传统音素转换方法依赖确定性转换和词典，难以处理词汇表外（OOV）词汇，而现有神经网络方法在泛化能力上仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合框架OLaPh，集成了大规模多语言词典、高级NLP技术以及统计子词分割功能，并利用该框架合成数据对指令微调LLM进行训练。
AI.result: 在WikiPron基准测试中，OLaPh在准确性和OOV鲁棒性上均显著优于现有基准；同时，实验证明LLM通过学习合成语料，能够展现出超越原框架的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: OLaPh是一个高效、鲁棒的多语言音素转换框架，不仅在性能上优于现有基准，还通过合成数据成功赋予了LLM音素理解能力。
AI.translation: 音素转换是语音合成中的关键环节。传统方法依赖于确定性转换和词典，而神经方法则为处理词汇表外（OOV）词汇提供了更高的泛化潜力。本文介绍了OLaPh（最优语言音素转换器），这是一个混合框架，整合了广泛的多语言词典、高级NLP技术以及统计子词分割功能。在WikiPron基准测试中的评估显示，OLaPh框架在总体准确性上显著优于既有基准，并通过高级回退机制保持了在OOV数据上的鲁棒性。为了进一步探索神经泛化能力，我们利用该框架为指令微调的大型语言模型（LLM）合成了一个高一致性的训练语料库。虽然确定性框架在总体准确性上仍然保持领先，但LLM表现出了强大的泛化能力，匹配甚至部分超过了该框架的性能。这表明LLM成功地从合成数据中内化了超越框架能力的音素直觉。总之，这些工具为多语言G2P研究提供了全面的开源资源。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了OLaPh，一种用于文本转语音的混合音素转换框架。该系统结合了词典与高级NLP技术，在WikiPron基准上表现优异，并能通过生成高质量合成数据来提升大型语言模型的音素泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 音素转换, 语音合成, 多语言模型, 神经网络, OOV泛化
AI.comments: 该论文通过结合传统词典法与现代神经网络技术，解决了音素转换（G2P）中准确性与泛化能力之间的平衡问题。其亮点在于构建了一个高质量的合成语料库，并验证了LLM能够通过学习该语料库内化音素直觉，为多语言语音合成研究提供了重要的开源基准和工具。

title: Investigating the Representation of Backchannels and Fillers in Fine-tuned Language Models
summary: Backchannels and fillers are important linguistic expressions in dialogue, but often treated as 'noise' to be bypassed in modern transformer-based language models (LMs). Here, we study how they are represented in LMs using three fine-tuning strategies on three dialogue corpora in English and Japanese, in which backchannels and fillers are both preserved and annotated. This allows us to investigate how fine-tuning can help LMs learn these representations. We first apply clustering analysis to the learnt representation of backchannels and fillers, and find increased silhouette scores in representations from fine-tuned models, which suggests that fine-tuning enables LMs to distinguish the nuanced semantic variation in different backchannel and filler use. We also employ natural language generation metrics and qualitative analyses to verify that utterances produced by fine-tuned LMs resemble those produced by humans more closely. Our findings suggest the potential for transforming general LMs into conversational LMs that can produce human-like language more adequately.

AI.title_translation: 研究精调语言模型中回馈词与填充词的表征
AI.tldr: 研究发现通过精调可以使语言模型更好地处理并生成对话中重要的回馈词和填充词，从而使模型生成的对话更具人类自然感。
AI.motivation: 现代基于Transformer的语言模型常将对话中的回馈词（backchannels）和填充词（fillers）视为噪声并予以忽略，研究旨在探索如何通过精调使模型学习并有效表征这些重要的对话元素。
AI.method: 在英语和日本语的三个对话语料库上，采用三种精调策略对语言模型进行训练，并结合聚类分析（轮廓系数）、自然语言生成指标及定性分析来评估模型表现。
AI.result: 精调后的模型在回馈词和填充词的表征上具有更高的轮廓系数，表明模型能够更好地区分其细微的语义差异；同时，生成指标和定性分析证实模型生成的语句更接近人类的对话风格。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过针对性的精调，通用语言模型可以更好地学习和表征对话中的回馈词与填充词，从而生成更具人类对话特征的自然语言。
AI.translation: 回馈词和填充词是对话中重要的语言表达，但在现代基于Transformer的语言模型（LM）中常被视为需要绕过的“噪声”。本文研究了如何通过三种精调策略在英语和日语的三个对话语料库中对这些词进行表征，其中回馈词和填充词均被保留并标注。这使我们能够研究精调如何帮助语言模型学习这些表征。我们首先对学习到的回馈词和填充词表征进行了聚类分析，发现精调模型产生的表征轮廓系数有所提高，这表明精调使语言模型能够区分不同回馈词和填充词使用中的细微语义差异。我们还采用了自然语言生成指标和定性分析，验证了精调模型生成的语句与人类生成的语句更为相似。我们的研究结果表明，将通用语言模型转化为能够更充分地产生类人语言的对话模型具有巨大潜力。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了如何通过精调使语言模型更好地理解对话中的回馈词与填充词。研究发现，精调策略不仅提升了模型对这些表达的语义区分能力，还显著增强了模型生成类人对话的能力，为将通用模型转化为高性能对话模型提供了有效路径。
AI.keywords: 回馈词, 填充词, 语言模型, 对话系统, 精调
AI.comments: 该研究填补了对话系统中对“非语言特征”（回馈词和填充词）处理的空白，通过实验证明了精调方法能有效提升模型对这些细微语言表达的语义表征能力。其创新点在于将这些常被视为“噪声”的元素作为核心研究对象，为构建更拟人的对话模型提供了实证依据。

title: CFDLLMBench: A Benchmark Suite for Evaluating Large Language Models in Computational Fluid Dynamics
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across general NLP tasks, but their utility in automating numerical experiments of complex physical system -- a critical and labor-intensive component -- remains underexplored. As the major workhorse of computational science over the past decades, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) offers a uniquely challenging testbed for evaluating the scientific capabilities of LLMs. We introduce CFDLLMBench, a benchmark suite comprising three complementary components -- CFDQuery, CFDCodeBench, and FoamBench -- designed to holistically evaluate LLM performance across three key competencies: graduate-level CFD knowledge, numerical and physical reasoning of CFD, and context-dependent implementation of CFD workflows. Grounded in real-world CFD practices, our benchmark combines a detailed task taxonomy with a rigorous evaluation framework to deliver reproducible results and quantify LLM performance across code executability, solution accuracy, and numerical convergence behavior. CFDLLMBench establishes a solid foundation for the development and evaluation of LLM-driven automation of numerical experiments for complex physical systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/NREL-Theseus/cfdllmbench/.

title: A Fano-Style Accuracy Upper Bound for LLM Single-Pass Reasoning in Multi-Hop QA
comments: 22 pages, 6 figures, ICLR 2026. Reported by MIT Technology Review
summary: Multi-Hop Question Answering (MHQA) requires integrating dispersed, interdependent evidence through sequential reasoning under noise. This task is challenging for LLMs as they have a finite per-pass output capacity, beyond which the integration of task-relevant evidence proves unreliable. Consequently, the single-pass reasoning paradigm is inherently vulnerable to this capacity overflow. To formalize this bottleneck, our analysis establishes a Fano-style accuracy upper bound, defining a theoretical performance ceiling for single-pass LLMs. This bound reveals that accuracy inevitably collapses once task complexity exceeds model capacity, providing general principles for capacity-aware representation and structuring of MHQA in LLMs. Building on these principles, we introduce a proof-of-concept multi-call framework for MHQA, InfoQA. It ensures high per-step accuracy by combining capacity-aware task decomposition with active pruning of prior reasoning traces, keeping the information load within the single-pass limit. It further achieves robustness by a dependency-explicit workflow that enables precise control over the reasoning path. We construct a stringent and noise-rich benchmark to validate our theory and framework. Experimental results show that model behavior aligns with our predicted capacity curves while InfoQA achieves consistent performance improvements. We hope our work inspires more LLM multi-step reasoning methods: \faGithub \href{https://github.com/KaiyangWan/InfoQA}{InfoQA}.
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, ICLR 2026. Reported by MIT Technology Review

AI.title_translation: 针对大语言模型多跳问答单次推理的 Fano 式精度上限研究
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了 LLM 单次推理存在理论上的精度上限，并提出了 InfoQA 框架，通过控制推理负载来突破这一容量限制。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答中分散的证据整合超出了 LLM 单次推理的输出容量，导致推理不可靠，现有的单次推理范式存在内在的容量溢出问题。
AI.method: 1. 建立 Fano 式精度上限理论以量化单次推理瓶颈；2. 提出 InfoQA 框架，采用基于容量感知的任务分解与推理轨迹主动修剪技术；3. 构建高噪声基准测试以验证理论与框架。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，模型性能表现与预测的容量曲线高度吻合，且 InfoQA 框架在多跳问答任务中实现了持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了单次推理范式存在不可逾越的理论性能上限，并证明通过多步交互框架（InfoQA）能够有效突破该限制。
AI.translation: 多跳问答（MHQA）需要在噪声环境下通过连续推理整合分散且相互依赖的证据。对于大语言模型（LLM）而言，这是一项挑战，因为它们具有有限的单次输出容量，一旦超出该容量，任务相关证据的整合将变得不可靠。因此，单次推理范式本质上容易受到这种容量溢出的影响。为了形式化这一瓶颈，我们的分析建立了一个 Fano 式精度上限，定义了单次推理 LLM 的理论性能天花板。该边界揭示了当任务复杂度超过模型容量时，准确率必然会崩溃，并为 LLM 中 MHQA 的容量感知表示和结构化提供了通用原则。基于这些原则，我们引入了一个 MHQA 的概念验证多调用框架 InfoQA。它通过将容量感知任务分解与先前推理轨迹的主动修剪相结合，确保了每一步的高准确性，并将信息负载保持在单次推理限制内。它还通过依赖显式工作流实现了鲁棒性，从而能够精确控制推理路径。我们构建了一个严苛且富含噪声的基准测试来验证我们的理论和框架。实验结果表明，模型行为与我们预测的容量曲线一致，且 InfoQA 实现了持续的性能提升。我们希望我们的工作能激发更多 LLM 多步推理方法的研究。
AI.summary: 本文分析了 LLM 在多跳问答中因单次推理容量有限而导致的性能瓶颈，通过 Fano 不等式推导出理论精度上限。在此基础上，提出了 InfoQA 框架，通过任务分解和轨迹修剪将信息负载控制在模型容量范围内，有效提升了推理鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 多跳问答, 大语言模型, Fano 不等式, 推理容量, InfoQA
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将信息论中的 Fano 不等式引入 LLM 推理研究，从理论上量化了单次推理的容量限制，为理解复杂推理任务中的性能瓶颈提供了坚实的数学基础。其提出的 InfoQA 框架通过主动修剪和任务分解有效应对了这一瓶颈，具有很强的实用指导意义。

title: InfiniPipe: Elastic Pipeline Parallelism for Efficient Variable-Length Long-Context LLM Training
summary: Long context training is crucial for LLM's context extension. Existing schemes, such as sequence parallelism, incur substantial communication overhead. Pipeline parallelism (PP) reduces this cost, but its effectiveness hinges on partitioning granularity. Batch-level PP employing sequence packing exhibits high memory consumption in long-context scenarios, whereas token-level PP splitting sequences into slices alleviates memory overhead but may incur hardware under-utilization. Moreover, the skewed distribution of sequence length in real-world datasets renders monolithic and static granularity PP's sub-optimal performance. In this paper, we propose 1) \textit{Elastic Pipeline Parallelism} (EPP) that orchestrates token-level PP and batch-level PP to adapt to resource and workload heterogeneity, and 2) \textit{Stage-Aware Chunk-Level Adaptive Checkpointing} that efficiently integrates gradient checkpointing with EPP. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that InfiniPipe achieves a 1.69x speedup over state-of-the-art systems. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/wsjdsg/InfiniPipe-code.git.

AI.title_translation: InfiniPipe：面向高效变长长上下文 LLM 训练的弹性流水线并行技术
AI.tldr: InfiniPipe 通过自适应的弹性流水线并行和分块检查点技术，显著提升了长上下文大模型的训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的序列并行通信开销大，而传统的流水线并行在面对真实世界中变长序列分布不均时，存在显存消耗高或硬件利用率低的问题。
AI.method: 提出弹性流水线并行 (EPP)，结合令牌级与批处理级并行策略以适应异构负载；引入阶段感知的分块级自适应检查点技术以优化梯度计算。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，InfiniPipe 相比当前最先进的系统实现了 1.69 倍的训练加速。
AI.conclusion: InfiniPipe 通过弹性流水线并行和阶段感知自适应检查点技术，成功提升了长上下文 LLM 的训练效率，为处理大规模变长序列提供了优化的解决方案。
AI.translation: 长上下文训练对于大语言模型（LLM）的上下文扩展至关重要。现有的方案，如序列并行，会产生巨大的通信开销。流水线并行（PP）虽然降低了这种成本，但其有效性取决于划分粒度。采用序列打包的批处理级 PP 在长上下文场景下显存消耗巨大，而将序列切分为切片的令牌级 PP 虽然减轻了显存负担，却可能导致硬件利用率不足。此外，真实数据集中序列长度的偏态分布使得单一、静态粒度的 PP 性能表现不佳。在本文中，我们提出了：1) 弹性流水线并行（EPP），它协同令牌级 PP 和批处理级 PP 以适应资源和工作负载的异构性；2) 阶段感知的分块级自适应检查点，有效地将梯度检查点与 EPP 相结合。综合实验表明，InfiniPipe 比最先进的系统实现了 1.69 倍的加速。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/wsjdsg/InfiniPipe-code.git 开源。
AI.summary: InfiniPipe 是一种针对长上下文 LLM 训练的弹性流水线并行系统，通过结合令牌级与批处理级并行策略并配合自适应检查点技术，有效解决了变长序列训练中的硬件利用率低与显存压力问题。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 长上下文训练, 流水线并行, 弹性调度, 梯度检查点
AI.comments: 该论文针对长上下文大模型训练中的显存与通信平衡问题，创新性地提出了弹性流水线并行机制，通过动态调整粒度有效解决了长序列数据分布不均导致的硬件利用率低下问题，具有很高的工程实用价值。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Food Innovation
summary: Global food systems must deliver nutritious, sustainable foods while sharply reducing environmental impact. Yet, food innovation remains slow, empirical, and fragmented. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers a transformative path to link molecular composition to functional performance, connect chemical structure to sensory outcomes, and accelerate cross-disciplinary innovation across the production pipeline. While broadly applicable to food systems, we focus on sustainable proteins--plant-based, fermentation-derived, and cultivated--as a high-impact testbed for AI-driven closed-loop design. We review the applications, opportunities, and challenges of AI for Food as an emerging discipline that integrates ingredient design, formulation development, fermentation and production, texture analysis, sensory science, manufacturing, and recipe generation. We identify four priorities: advancing scientific machine learning with embedded domain priors, treating food as a programmable biomaterial, building self-driving laboratories for automated discovery, and developing deep reasoning models that integrate nutrition and sustainability. Integrating AI responsibly into the food innovation cycle can accelerate the transition to sustainable food systems and establish a predictive, design-driven science of food for human and planetary health.

AI.title_translation: 食品创新的人工智能应用
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“食品AI”框架，旨在利用人工智能解决传统食品研发缓慢且碎片化的问题，通过自驱动实验室和科学机器学习加速可持续蛋白质等食品的创新设计。
AI.motivation: 全球食品系统面临提供营养、可持续食品同时降低环境影响的压力，但目前的食品创新过程缓慢、经验化且碎片化，亟需引入人工智能来加速跨学科创新。
AI.method: 构建了基于人工智能的闭环设计框架，涵盖成分设计、配方开发、发酵生产、质地分析、感官科学、制造及食谱生成等多个环节，并提出了包括嵌入领域先验的科学机器学习、自驱动实验室自动化发现及深度推理模型在内的四大优先发展方向。
AI.result: 论文综述了AI在食品领域的应用、机遇与挑战，并确立了“食品AI”作为一门新兴学科的框架，明确了通过AI驱动的闭环设计来实现食品成分与功能、结构与感官的精准关联。
AI.conclusion: 将人工智能负责任地集成到食品创新周期中，能够加速向可持续食品系统的转型，并建立起一套旨在保障人类和地球健康的预测性、设计驱动型食品科学。
AI.translation: 全球食品系统必须在提供营养、可持续食品的同时，大幅降低环境影响。然而，食品创新仍然缓慢、经验化且分散。人工智能（AI）提供了一条变革性的途径，将分子组成与功能表现联系起来，将化学结构与感官结果连接起来，并加速整个生产流程中的跨学科创新。虽然AI广泛适用于食品系统，但我们将其重点放在可持续蛋白质（植物基、发酵衍生和培养肉）上，作为AI驱动闭环设计的高影响力试验场。我们回顾了“食品AI”作为一门新兴学科的应用、机遇和挑战，该学科整合了成分设计、配方开发、发酵与生产、质地分析、感官科学、制造和食谱生成。我们确定了四个优先事项：推进具有嵌入式领域先验的科学机器学习、将食品视为可编程生物材料、建立用于自动化发现的自驱动实验室，以及开发整合营养和可持续性的深度推理模型。将人工智能负责任地集成到食品创新周期中，可以加速向可持续食品系统的转型，并建立一门以预测和设计为驱动的食品科学，以造福人类和地球健康。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了人工智能在加速食品创新中的变革作用，重点关注可持续蛋白质领域。通过整合机器学习、自动化实验室和深度推理模型，旨在克服传统食品研发的局限性，建立一种预测性和设计驱动的科学范式，以应对全球营养与环境的可持续性挑战。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 食品创新, 可持续蛋白质, 科学机器学习, 自驱动实验室
AI.comments: 该论文对“食品AI”这一新兴交叉学科进行了系统性梳理，指出了传统食品创新效率低下的痛点，并提出了以可持续蛋白质为核心的闭环设计框架。其创新之处在于将“食品作为可编程生物材料”的理念与自驱动实验室相结合，为食品科学从经验驱动向预测性设计驱动转型提供了清晰的路线图。未来挑战在于如何将复杂的生物学先验知识有效嵌入机器学习模型中。

title: Benchmarking and Mitigating Sycophancy in Medical Vision Language Models
summary: Visual language models (VLMs) have the potential to transform medical workflows. However, the deployment is limited by sycophancy. Despite this serious threat to patient safety, a systematic benchmark remains lacking. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a Medical benchmark that applies multiple templates to VLMs in a hierarchical medical visual question answering task. We find that current VLMs are highly susceptible to visual cues, with failure rates showing a correlation to model size or overall accuracy. we discover that perceived authority and user mimicry are powerful triggers, suggesting a bias mechanism independent of visual data. To overcome this, we propose a Visual Information Purification for Evidence based Responses (VIPER) strategy that proactively filters out non-evidence-based social cues, thereby reinforcing evidence based reasoning. VIPER reduces sycophancy while maintaining interpretability and consistently outperforms baseline methods, laying the necessary foundation for the robust and secure integration of VLMs.

title: Characterizing FaaS Workflows on Public Clouds: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
comments: This is a preprint version of an article accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems,2026 (TPDS). DOI: 10.1109/TPDS.2026.3678606
summary: Function-as-a-service (FaaS) is a popular serverless computing paradigm for developing event-driven functions that elastically scale on public clouds. FaaS workflows, such as AWS Step Functions and Azure Durable Functions, are composed from FaaS functions, like AWS Lambda and Azure Functions, to build practical applications. But, the complex interactions between functions in the workflow and the limited visibility into the internals of proprietary FaaS platforms are major impediments to gaining a deeper understanding of FaaS workflow platforms. While several works characterize FaaS platforms to derive such insights, there is a lack of a principled and rigorous study for FaaS workflow platforms, which have unique scaling, performance and costing behavior influenced by the platform design, dataflow and workloads. In this article, we perform extensive evaluations of three popular FaaS workflow platforms from AWS and Azure, running 25 micro-benchmark and application workflows over 132k invocations. Our detailed analysis confirms some conventional wisdom but also uncovers unique insights on the function execution, workflow orchestration, inter-function interactions, cold-start scaling and monetary costs. Our observations help developers better configure and program these platforms, set performance and scalability expectations, and identify research gaps on enhancing the platforms.
